people.bio: An MBA with 32 years of experience, he joined the family company in January 1995, straight into the business. As MD he took it into hot, warm and cold forgings, castings, advanced machining and heat treatment, and made it India's second-largest forging company by revenue. He drove greenfield plants and acquisitions. He is 51; FY26 pay was ₹4.92cr, including ₹2.5cr commission above the legal limits that needs shareholder approval.

people.name: Chaitanya Jalan
people.since: Joined 2017; employed as whole-time director since Nov 2019
people.relation: Son of MD Naresh Jalan; grandson of founder Mahabir Prasad Jalan
people.stake: 1.68% (30,47,900 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), plus 34,00,000 warrants at ₹588 (about ₹200cr) allotted Jan 2026
people.bio: A B.Com (Hons) graduate of St. Xavier's College, Kolkata, and the third generation of the family in the business. He joined in 2017 and leads acquisitions and forward integration, including the moves into warm and cold forgings, castings and electric-mobility parts. He also oversees daily plant operations and pushed wider use of IT. He is 29; FY26 pay was ₹2.21cr.

people.name: Lalit Kumar Khetan
people.stake: 0.04% (66,000 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), plus ESOPs
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant with 30 years in finance, accounts, compliance and audit. He was CFO of several companies, including large EPC and manufacturing firms, for about 20 years; his last job was at McNally Bharat Engineering. At Ramkrishna he worked on all the recent acquisitions and won CII (Southern Region)'s CFO excellence award for FY24. He is 56; FY26 pay was ₹2.02cr.

people.name: Milesh Gandhi
people.since: With the company since Sep 2000; whole-time director since Jun 2024
people.stake: 0.01% (25,632 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), plus ESOPs
people.bio: A B.Com (Hons) graduate with executive programmes, and 25 years at the company. He heads marketing and global sales strategy. He opened markets in autos, railways, defence, earthmoving, mining, farm equipment and energy in India and abroad. He is 46; FY26 pay was ₹1.01cr.

people.name: Sakti Prasad Senapati
people.bio: Holds an MBA and a diploma in labour law, with 28 years of experience. He joined from NRB Bearings in April 2016 and is among the company's ten highest-paid employees named in the FY26 annual report. He is 53.

people.name: Rahul Kumar Bagaria
people.bio: A chartered accountant with 21 years of experience, all at the company since September 2005. He heads accounts and finance under the CFO and is listed on the company's leadership page. He is 48.

companies.changes: No change in key managerial personnel in FY26. Independent directors Partha Sarathi Bhattacharyya and Sandipan Chakravortty completed their terms on 20–21 May 2026; Chetan Desai joined as an independent director on 29 Apr 2026.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of US-based Tenneco (owned by Apollo funds). Tenneco group companies own 74.79% after the November 2025 IPO, which was entirely a sale of shares by the parent. Hired managers run it; the chairman, Niranjan Kumar Gupta (CFO of Hindustan Unilever), is independent, and two Tenneco LLC executives sit as non-executive directors. No director or manager is from a promoter family, and no director owns shares.

people.name: Arvind Chandrasekharan (Arvind Chandra)
people.bio: He has a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering from Bombay University, a master's in industrial engineering (robotics) from Oklahoma State University and an MBA from the University of Michigan. He has more than two decades in the auto industry, with leadership roles at Delphi (now Phinia) across its powertrain, energy and exhaust divisions, Faurecia's exhaust business, WABCO and Minda Corporation. Just before Tenneco he was India CEO of the Aliaxis Group. He runs all of Tenneco's Indian businesses: clean air, Monroe ride products, Champion ignition, and bearings and seals.

people.name: Rishi Verma
people.role: President (runs Clean Air & Powertrain and Advanced Ride Technologies)
people.since: With the company since April 2019; Tenneco group since August 2007
people.bio: He leads the company's operations across both its clean air and powertrain business and its ride (suspension) business. He has been with the Tenneco group since August 2007, working across R&D, operations, sales, programme management and general management. Before that he worked at National Engineering Industries, Dana India Technical Centre and Walker Exhaust India.

people.name: Mahender Chhabra
people.bio: He has nearly three decades in finance and business leadership, and is responsible for financial strategy, operations, compliance and overall financial performance. Before joining in June 2025 he held senior finance roles at Motherson Sumi Wiring India and HMD Mobile India.

people.name: R. C. Subramaniam
people.role: Managing Director, Advanced Ride Technologies (in subsidiary Tenneco Automotive India)
people.bio: He runs the Advanced Ride Technologies (shock absorbers and struts) division, which sits in the material subsidiary Tenneco Automotive India. He has been with the Tenneco group since January 2009. Earlier he worked at General Motors India and Saint-Gobain Glass India, with a background in manufacturing and operations.

people.name: Aditya Kohli
people.bio: He has a postgraduate diploma in human resources from Symbiosis Institute of Management Studies and more than 20 years in HR. Before joining on 1 April 2026 he worked at Orient Electric, Clix Capital, Bharti Airtel, Standard Chartered Bank and Hewitt Associates.

companies.changes: Aditya Kohli joined as CHRO on 1 April 2026. Non-executive director Utsav Baijal (Apollo nominee) resigned on 30 May 2026 and Noah Jesse Falk joined as a non-executive director. No change in the CEO or CFO since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Relan family. Promoter Ajay Relan has been MD since the company was set up in 1986 and his son Aashim Relan is CEO. From 1 September 2026 Ajay Relan was re-appointed as a whole-time director with the title Executive Chairperson (board approved in August; put to the 24 September 2026 AGM). The current chairperson, Kishan N Parikh, is a non-executive, non-independent director and not family. Promoters own about 64.3%, of which 46% sits in the SMIL Trust with Ajay Relan as trustee. A hired Deputy MD (ex-Varroc CEO) joined in July 2025.

people.name: Ajay Relan
people.role: Managing Director; Whole-time Director & Executive Chairperson from 1 September 2026
people.relation: Promoter; father of CEO Aashim Relan
people.stake: 12.25% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); as trustee of the SMIL Trust he also controls another 46.00%; promoter group together about 64.3%
people.bio: He has a B.Com (Hons.) and attended Harvard Business School's Owner/President Management Programme. He has been with Sharda Motor since it was incorporated in 1986 and has led it as MD, building its exhaust and suspension parts business, new plants and joint ventures with global component makers; the board credits him with the company's turnaround. He is also a director of Relan Industrial Finance, an associate company. He is 64. His proposed pay as Executive Chairperson is above the SEBI threshold for promoter directors, so it needs a special resolution.

people.name: Aashim Relan
people.since: Not stated in the annual report
people.relation: Son of MD Ajay Relan
people.bio: He graduated in finance and economics from Emory University, Atlanta, and holds other business certifications. As CEO he is responsible for supply chain, operations, strategy and innovation. He is a key managerial person but not on the board.

people.name: Ashwani Maheshwari
people.role: Deputy Managing Director (senior management, not on the board)
people.bio: He has a mechanical engineering degree from IIT Roorkee, is a Sloan Fellow of London Business School, and attended executive programmes at Wharton and Stanford. He has more than 31 years of experience in turnarounds and transformations. He was CEO and executive director of Varroc Engineering from 2018 to 2020 and an operating partner at private-equity firm Kedaara Capital in 2024–25; earlier he was President of Birla Tyres at Kesoram Industries and a senior vice president at ITC Infotech.

people.name: Nitin Vishnoi
people.since: On the board as whole-time director (DIN 08538925)
people.bio: He has a B.Com (Hons.) and is a fellow member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India, with more than 34 years in corporate restructuring, compliance and governance. He sits on the board as the only executive director other than Ajay Relan, and also serves as company secretary. He led the company's ERP implementation.

people.name: Ghan Shyam Dass
people.bio: He is a qualified chartered accountant and cost accountant (CMA) with more than 25 years across industries including automotive. He has handled large organic and acquisition-led growth projects and business transformations. He became CFO on 1 April 2025.

people.name: Deepak Manchanda
people.bio: He has a PG diploma in business management (marketing and systems) from IMT Ghaziabad and a master's-level certification in mechanical engineering from CIIMS Nagpur. He has more than 29 years in automotive, aerospace and defence businesses, including Spark Minda, Samvardhana Motherson, Escorts and Delphi Automotive. He leads the company's overseas business.

companies.changes: Two senior managers (Head–People Practices and Head–Strategic Initiatives) stopped being counted as senior management on 31 January 2026 after a reorganisation; both stay employed. Ajay Relan's term as MD ended on 31 August 2026; he was re-appointed as Whole-time Director and Executive Chairperson from 1 September 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the 24 September 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Relan family. Promoter Rohit Relan is non-executive Co-Chairman and his son Rishabh Relan is a non-executive director; his twin sons Pranav and Ayush Relan are whole-time directors who run day-to-day operations. The chairman, Sanjiv Kapur, is a non-executive director and not family. In September 2025 the family moved all its shares, 73.13% of the company, into the Rohit Relan Family Trust, so no family member now holds shares directly. Pranav, Ayush and Rajat Bhandari all came from Bharat Seats, a related party.

people.name: Pranav Relan
people.relation: Son of Co-Chairman Rohit Relan; brother of directors Rishabh and Ayush Relan
people.stake: nil directly (FY26 annual report); a beneficiary of the Rohit Relan Family Trust, which holds 73.13%
people.bio: He has an economics degree from Emory College of Arts and Sciences, Emory University (USA), and has passed the NISM equity derivatives certification. From July 2015 to July 2018 he worked at a stockbroking firm that is a member of the NSE, then served as Assistant Chief Operating Officer at group company Bharat Seats, handling financial, operating and compliance controls. He joined the NDR board in October 2020 and runs day-to-day management with a focus on operations and growth. He is 34. Shareholders re-appointed him for three more years from 27 October 2026 at the July 2026 AGM.

people.name: Ayush Relan
people.since: January 2021 (on the board from October 2020; re-appointed to January 2030)
people.relation: Son of Co-Chairman Rohit Relan; brother of directors Rishabh and Pranav Relan

Before NDR he was Assistant Chief Operating Officer at group company Bharat Seats. He has been a whole-time director since 2 January 2021 and shares day-to-day management with his brother, with a focus on operations and growth. He is also a director of the joint ventures Toyota Boshoku Relan India and Toyo Sharda India and the new subsidiaries. He is 34. Shareholders re-appointed him for three more years from 2 January 2027.

people.name: Rajat Bhandari
people.since: November 2020 on the board; whole-time director since January 2021 (re-appointed to January 2030)
people.bio: He is a chartered accountant and company secretary with more than 40 years in the Indian auto-component industry. He has worked in finance, secretarial, purchasing and supply chain at Escorts group companies, Federal-Mogul Goetze India and Bharat Seats. He is the company's only executive director from outside the family. He is 62.

people.name: Vikram Krishan Rathi
people.stake: 2,450 shares (FY26 annual report), a negligible stake
people.bio: He is a chartered accountant with about 25 years of experience. He joined NDR in August 2024 from Uno Minda and became CFO on 1 April 2025. He is 52.

companies.changes: No change in executives since the annual report. The July 2026 AGM approved three-year re-appointments of Pranav Relan, Ayush Relan and Rajat Bhandari. The board granted employee stock options in August 2026.

companies.styleNote: Co-founder K. A. Joseph is Managing Director and his son Kevin Joseph is an executive director, but a hired Group CEO, Sanjay Thapar, has led strategy, acquisitions and finance since 2015. The promoter owns only 20.90%; private-equity firm Everstone (Evergraph) sold out and was reclassified as public in 2025. The chairman, Ramesh C. Jain (ex-Eicher Group Vice Chairman), is independent.

people.name: K. A. Joseph
people.relation: Promoter and co-founder; father of Executive Director Kevin K. Joseph
people.stake: 20.90% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); he is the only named promoter
people.bio: He has a B.Sc. from Bangalore University and a postgraduate diploma in business administration from St. Joseph's College of Business Administration, Bengaluru. He has more than 39 years in the decorative printing (aesthetics) business and co-founded SJS. He leads plant and manufacturing operations and technology and product innovation, and designed the Bengaluru plant the company moved into in 2018. He received the SPAI FESPA Lifetime Achievement Award in 2023. He is also a director of subsidiaries SJS Decoplast and Walter Pack India.

people.name: Sanjay Thapar
people.stake: 3,87,505 shares, about 1.2% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: He has a first-class mechanical engineering degree (with distinction) from Delhi College of Engineering and more than 40 years in the auto industry. He began at TELCO (now Tata Motors), and was later President of Minda HUF, Managing Director of Minda Valeo Security Systems and Group Chief Strategy Officer of the Ashok Minda Group. At SJS he leads strategy, M&A, business development and finance, and led the purchases of Exotech (now SJS Decoplast) and Walter Pack India and the push into exports. He is 67; the board re-appointed him in May 2026, subject to the July 2026 AGM.

people.name: Kevin K. Joseph
people.relation: Son of MD K. A. Joseph
people.stake: 100 shares, negligible (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: He has a mechanical engineering degree from Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belgaum, and completed IIM Bangalore's Executive General Management Programme in May 2025. He started as a design engineer at Tata Elxsi in the passenger-vehicle segment. At SJS he drives manufacturing excellence and product innovation and oversees day-to-day operations. He is 34; the board re-appointed him in May 2026, subject to the July 2026 AGM.

people.name: Mahendra Kumar Naredi
people.bio: He has a B.Com (Hons.) and a law degree from Rajasthan University, and is a chartered accountant and company secretary with more than 25 years of experience. He worked at GE India and Wipro and spent 17 years in the Spark Minda Group, where he was CFO of its European companies, CFO and company secretary of Minda Vast Access Systems, and AVP of corporate finance at Minda Corporation. He joined SJS in August 2022. CII named him leading CFO of the year 2024-25 in the auto and auto-components sector.

people.name: Ranjit Raghunath Nambiar
people.bio: He has a postgraduate diploma in plastics technology from CIPET Mysore and a B.Sc. from Calicut University, and did IIM Ahmedabad's Transformational Leadership Program. He has more than 30 years across chemicals, plastics, appliances, auto systems and EV components. He held senior roles at Spark Minda, Tata AutoComp and International Automotive Components (IAC Group), where he built IAC India from scratch. He replaced Mahender Singh, who resigned in September 2025.

people.name: R. Raju
people.bio: He has a diploma in mechanical engineering from Thiagarajar Polytechnic, Salem, a diploma in production management from Annamalai University, and a PG diploma and MBA in marketing from IGNOU. He has more than 26 years in marketing, business development and sales in automotive, appliances and engineering. He previously worked at ITW India, Sundaram Auto Components (TVS group) and the Minda group, including Minda Asean in Indonesia and Minda SAI.

companies.changes: Chief Operating Officer Sadashiva Baligar retired on 20 April 2026. Randhir Singh Kalsi, a former Maruti Suzuki executive, joined as an independent director on 5 May 2026. Group COO Mahender Singh left in September 2025 and was replaced by Ranjit Nambiar.

Group CFO Sanjay Mehta sits on the board as a non-executive director.

companies.changes: Avishrant Keshava, the previous CFO (to March 2025) and whole-time director (to September 2025), stayed as GM – Special Projects but resigned on 30 April 2026. Director – Operations Rajeev Kumar Saraswat retired in October 2025. Michael Discenza joined the board as a Timken nominee in April 2026.

companies.styleNote: The industrial half of SKF India, demerged in October 2025 and listed in December 2025. Sweden's AB SKF owns about 52.6% and runs it through group executives. Sujeeth Pai became MD on 1 September 2026 after Mukund Vasudevan moved to a group role within a year of listing. The chairman, Gopal Subramanyam, is independent.

people.name: Sujeeth Pai
people.since: Whole-time Director from 1 October 2025; MD since 1 September 2026
people.bio: Holds a mechanical engineering degree from P.E.S.I.T., Bengaluru, and an MBA from ISB, Hyderabad. He has over 20 years of experience in technology and industrial companies, covering technical support, distribution strategy and running regional P&Ls. As whole-time director he led manufacturing, supply chain and new capacity for SKF's industrial business in India, Southeast Asia and the Middle East. He was named MD for five years from 1 September 2026, replacing Mukund Vasudevan. He is 44 and is not related to any director or the promoter.

people.name: Ashish Saraf
people.since: CFO of SKF India from May 2022; CFO of this company since 1 October 2025
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com from the University of Calcutta and over 20 years in finance. Before SKF he worked at Honeywell, Microsoft, SAP and Lucent Technologies. He was CFO of the undivided SKF India from May 2022 and moved to the industrial company when it was demerged on 1 October 2025. He leads finance, accounting, treasury and tax.

people.name: Poorva Bang
people.bio: A company secretary (ICSI) with an MBA and B.Com from Devi Ahilya University, Indore. She has over 8.5 years of experience as a company secretary in corporate law and secretarial work. She replaced Ranjan Kumar, who left for another job.

companies.changes: MD Mukund Vasudevan resigned from 31 Aug 2026 for a role change within SKF Group and stays on the board as a non-executive director; Sujeeth Pai became MD on 1 Sep 2026. Company Secretary Ranjan Kumar left in Jan 2026.

companies.styleNote: Now SKF's automotive business in India after the industrial side was demerged in October 2025. The SKF group owns 52.58%, held since December 2025 through SKF Vertevo AB, the vehicle for SKF's own automotive separation. It is run by long-time SKF managers; group executives sit on the board as non-executive directors and the chairman is independent.

people.name: Shailesh Kumar Sharma
people.since: Whole-time Director from February 2025; MD since 1 October 2025
people.bio: Holds a mechanical engineering degree from Government Engineering College, Jabalpur, and an MBA from Symbiosis International University, Pune. He has over 34 years in precision engineering, covering manufacturing, industrial engineering, product development and large projects. At SKF he led several Indian plants and rolled out the SKF Production System. He was Director of Operations and a whole-time director from February 2025, and became MD on 1 October 2025 for five years, when the company was split. He is 56.

people.name: Mayank Holani
people.bio: A fellow chartered accountant with a master's in commerce from Jiwaji University, Gwalior, and diplomas in information systems audit (ICAI) and IFRS (ACCA). He has over 23 years in finance, six of them as CFO. His last job was CFO of Indian Synthetic Rubber, a joint venture of Indian Oil and Taiwan's TSRC. Before that he spent 12 years at Schneider Electric India, including as CFO of the listed Schneider Electric Infrastructure. Earlier he worked at Cairn India, Chambal Fertilisers and JK Tyre.

people.name: Prahlada GirishKumar
people.role: Head – Product Portfolio and Business Intelligence, Automotive OEM (Senior Management)
people.bio: Holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering from PES College of Engineering, University of Mysore, and has over 33 years of experience. He started as a graduate engineer trainee at Buhler India and later held senior roles at ACE Designers before a long career at SKF. There he headed the business line for India and Southeast Asia, led automotive application engineering and helped set up SKF's Global Technical Centre. He was Head of Strategy and Special Projects before taking charge of the automotive OEM product portfolio.

companies.changes: MD Mukund Vasudevan moved to the industrial company on 1 Oct 2025; CFO Ashish Saraf also moved across. Interim CFO Aashi Arora resigned in May 2026 and Mayank Holani became CFO on 14 May 2026. Head of Automotive Business Alagesan Thasari resigned in April 2026; the company said it would appoint a successor.

companies.styleNote: Run by two founding families. Rajendra Shah is Executive Chairman; his son Pilak Shah (COO) and daughter Hetal Naik are whole-time directors. Harish Rangwala is MD and his son Vishal Rangwala is CEO. All five are on the board. The promoter group, including relatives and a family trust, owns about 75%. Finance is run by a hired CFO.

people.name: Rajendra Shah
people.since: Director since May 2011; over 53 years in the Harsha bearing-cage business
people.relation: Co-promoter; father of COO Pilak Shah and whole-time director Hetal Naik
people.stake: 13.19% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 75%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Lukhdhirji Engineering College, Morbi. He has over 53 years in precision engineering for bearing cages and stamped components and helped build the business. He oversees overall management, with a focus on finance. He was Chairman of CII Gujarat in 2019–20 and won the Ahmedabad Management Association's Outstanding Entrepreneur of the Year award in 2001. He is also a director of Transformers and Rectifiers (India), Ratnamani Metals and Tubes and Welcast Steels, and was Chairman of AIA Engineering until April 2026. He is 78.

people.name: Harish Rangwala
people.since: Director since December 2010; over 53 years in the business
people.relation: Co-promoter; father of CEO Vishal Rangwala
people.stake: 12.31% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); his wife Charusheela Rangwala holds 11.47%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Lukhdhirji Engineering College, Morbi. He began his career at Tata Chemicals before joining the business. He has over 53 years of experience in bearing cages and precision stamped parts. As MD he oversees overall management and leads the renewable energy (solar EPC) division. He is 78.

people.name: Vishal Rangwala
people.relation: Son of MD Harish Rangwala
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Pune and an M.S. in engineering management from the University of Southern California. He started his career in the US at Access Business Group and United Airlines (United Services), in industrial engineering and supply-chain analysis. He joined Harsha in 2007 and worked in marketing and operations, serving as COO before becoming CEO in 2022. He drives the group's strategy and overseas expansion, including the Romania and China plants, and leads the analyst calls.

people.name: Pilak Shah
people.relation: Son of Chairman Rajendra Shah; brother of Hetal Naik
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Nirma Institute of Technology and a master's in integrated manufacturing systems engineering from North Carolina State University. He has over 20 years in precision engineering and joined the company in 2006. As COO he runs manufacturing and operational efficiency across the group.

people.name: Hetal Naik
people.relation: Daughter of Chairman Rajendra Shah; sister of COO Pilak Shah
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from L.D. Engineering College and an M.Tech in design engineering from Nirma University. She joined the company in 2015. She leads Total Productive Maintenance, lean programmes, capability building, health and safety, and sustainability.

people.name: Maulik Jasani
people.role: Vice President – Finance & Group Chief Financial Officer
people.since: CFO of the merged Harsha Engineers Ltd from May 2019; Group CFO since December 2021
people.bio: A chartered accountant, company secretary and cost accountant, with bachelor's and master's degrees in commerce from Gujarat University. Before Harsha he worked at Cadila Healthcare, Delhi Assam Roadways and the CA firm Mukesh M. Shah & Co, and was CFO of Biotech Vision Care. He joined the older Harsha Engineers Ltd as VP – Finance & Accounts, became its CFO in May 2019 and has been Group CFO of the listed company since December 2021, taking it through its 2022 IPO.

companies.changes: Lokesh Miglani, Head of the Brass business unit, resigned on 21 Aug 2026. No change in directors or KMP since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: A Sahney-family company, started in 1965 as a joint venture with Nadella. Harshbeena Zaveri, daughter of the late Trilochan Singh Sahney, has been MD since 2010 and is the only executive on the board. Under a January 2025 family settlement with her brother Devesh Sahney's branch, shares held by a family trust moved to her, lifting her stake to 41.48% by March 2026; promoters pledged shares to fund it. The chairman since 30 March 2026, Tashwinder Singh, is non-executive. Promoters owned 51.2% in March 2026 and about 44.7% after sales in the June quarter.

people.name: Harshbeena Zaveri
people.since: Board since April 1994; MD since 1 October 2010; re-appointed to September 2030
people.relation: Promoter; daughter of the late Trilochan Singh Sahney; sister of Devesh Sahney, the other party to the 2025 family settlement
people.stake: 41.48% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), up from 13.60% a year earlier after family-trust shares moved to her; promoters together 51.2% then, about 44.7% after sales in the June quarter; she sold about 2.66 lakh more shares in Sep 2026
people.bio: A graduate of Wellesley College, USA, where she was a Wellesley Scholar and graduated magna cum laude. She joined the board in 1994 and has been MD since October 2010. Under her NRB set up R&D and innovation centres, grew exports, and was named by Forbes among Asia's Best 200 companies under $1 billion. She has been on Fortune India's 50 Most Powerful Women list for over a decade and is a founder of Ashoka University. She chairs subsidiary SNL Bearings and sits on the ACMA executive committee and the Indo-French, Indo-German and American chambers. As a non-resident, her re-appointment needed central government approval. She is 66.

people.name: Vineet Goel
people.bio: A US CPA and cost accountant (ICWAI) with an MBA in finance from IMT Ghaziabad and a B.Com (Hons) from Delhi University. He has over 25 years of finance experience in India and Germany. He was CFO of Saurer Textile Solutions, a textile-machinery maker, and Group CFO at Batliboi and Samtel, and spent three years on deputation in Germany. His most recent role was at Quantum Business Solutions. He has led greenfield projects, acquisitions in France and Germany, and SAP finance projects.

companies.changes: CFO Raman Malhotra resigned on 13 Dec 2025; Dhara Dhedhi was interim CFO until Vineet Goel joined on 11 Feb 2026. Company Secretary Kishor Talreja left in Oct 2025; Khyati Danani took over on 3 Nov 2025. Independent Chairman Ashank Desai retired on 29 Mar 2026 and Tashwinder Singh (non-executive) became Chairman.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Kabra family. In June 2025 the two elder brothers, Executive Chairman Tribhuvanprasad Kabra and MD Shreegopal Kabra, left the board under a succession plan. Their brother Mahendrakumar Kabra is now MD, and his two nephews Mahhesh and Rajesh Kabra became Joint MDs in June 2026. The chairman, Ramesh Chandak (ex-MD of KEC International), is independent and not family. Hired professionals run finance, operations and exports. Promoters own 61.65%.

people.name: Mahendrakumar Kabra
people.since: Board since 1995; Joint MD 2014–2025; MD since June 2025
people.relation: Promoter; brother of former Executive Chairman Tribhuvanprasad Kabra and former MD Shreegopal Kabra; paternal uncle of Joint MDs Mahhesh and Rajesh Kabra
people.stake: 5.83% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); his son Hemant Kabra holds another 5.83%; promoter group together 61.65%
people.bio: Holds a licentiate diploma in mechanical engineering from Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute (VJTI), Mumbai. He has been with the company since it started and on its board since February 1995, with more than four decades in the electrical industry. He was a director of MEW Electricals earlier. He served as Joint MD from 2014 and took over as MD in June 2025, when his elder brothers stepped down. He is also a director of group company Ram Ratna Wires, a listed maker of winding wires. He is 69.

people.name: Mahhesh Kabra
people.role: Joint Managing Director (heads FMEG and switches)
people.since: On the board 2010–2022; rejoined June 2025; Joint MD since June 2026
people.relation: Nephew of MD Mahendrakumar Kabra; cousin of Joint MD Rajesh Kabra
people.stake: 5.19% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); his wife Vvidhi Kabra holds 4.20%
people.bio: A commerce graduate with over 26 years in the electrical industry. He first joined the board in November 2010 and was a whole-time director until he resigned in December 2022. He came back as an executive director in June 2025 and was made Joint MD from 1 June 2026. He leads the consumer electricals (fans, lights, appliances) and switches business and works with the MD on capex, new products and capital allocation. He is 49.

people.name: Rajesh Kabra
people.role: Joint Managing Director (heads wires and cables)
people.since: Board since June 2025; Joint MD since June 2026
people.relation: Nephew of MD Mahendrakumar Kabra; cousin of Joint MD Mahhesh Kabra
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in business administration and an M.Sc. in engineering business management. Before joining the board he was Managing Director of group company Ram Ratna Infrastructure, which the company says became India's largest supplier of automated car-parking systems; there he ran sales, operations and finance. He joined the board as an executive director in June 2025 and became Joint MD from 1 June 2026. He leads the wires and cables business and expansion at home and abroad, and meets institutional investors. He is 38.

people.name: Jigar Mehta
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 20 years in finance, audit and governance. He spent nearly 20 years at KPMG in senior roles, working with manufacturing, infrastructure, real-estate, pharma and services clients. He joined RR Kabel as VP-Finance about two years before his promotion to CFO on 1 November 2025.

people.name: Rajesh Jain
people.since: With the company over 25 years; COO since November 2025
people.bio: A commerce graduate, associate cost accountant (ICWAI) and licentiate company secretary. He has been with RR Kabel for over 25 years and was its CFO for about eight years, including through the 2023 IPO. In November 2025 he handed over the CFO role and became COO of the wires and cables business.

people.name: Sanjay Taparia
people.bio: A science graduate from the University of Bombay. He joined in November 2010 and is responsible for the export business and its expansion overseas.

people.name: Shishir Sharma
people.bio: A science graduate from Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda. He heads sales and marketing for wires and cables. Before joining in December 2008 he worked at Godrej-GE Appliances, Whirlpool of India and Electrolux Voltas.

companies.changes: Executive Chairman Tribhuvanprasad Kabra and MD Shreegopal Kabra left the board on 31 May 2025. CFO Rajesh Jain moved to COO and Jigar Mehta became CFO on 1 Nov 2025. Mahhesh and Rajesh Kabra became Joint MDs on 1 Jun 2026.

companies.styleNote: No promoter sits on the board. The Chhabria family and its companies own about 35.8% (Orbit Electricals alone 30.70%), and sister company Finolex Industries holds another 14.51%, but the family is split into two camps fighting in court over voting control. Former Executive Chairman Deepak Chhabria lost his re-appointment vote at the 2023 AGM. Since then long-serving employees run it: plant head Ratnakar Barve is Chairman, and CEO Mahesh Viswanathan leads day to day. The annual report says no directors are related to each other.

people.name: Mahesh Viswanathan
people.since: Joined 2008; CFO, then Deputy CEO & CFO; CEO since June 2026
people.bio: A commerce graduate and chartered accountant with 42 years of experience. He came from Philips Electronics India and joined Finolex Cables in October 2008. Over 18 years he handled internal audit, treasury, controllership and M&A, and served as CFO and later Deputy CEO & CFO. He became CEO on 1 June 2026. He was the best-paid person in the company in FY26 at ₹4.96cr, most of it incentive. He is 66.

people.name: Ratnakar Barve
people.since: Board since September 2021; re-appointment to 2031 put to the Sep 2026 AGM
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electronics and telecommunication engineering and an MBA in operations management, and is a Six Sigma Black Belt. He started in 1987 at Goa Telecommunications & Systems, joined Bharti Teletech (Airtel's manufacturing arm) in 1995 and became a plant head there in 2002. He joined Finolex Cables in 2009 and heads all its units at Verna, Goa. He joined the board as executive director (operations) in 2021 and is now Chairman. He is 60.

people.name: Pravin Ahire
people.bio: A B.Tech with over 25 years in manufacturing, process engineering and product development in wires and cables. He worked at General Cable India Energy before joining Finolex Cables in July 2009. He has helped build its optical fibre, communication cable and power cable manufacturing and has commissioned new plants. He joined the board as executive director for operations in October 2024. He is 51.

people.name: Sachin Naik
people.bio: Has about 26 years of finance experience. He was earlier CFO and head of legal and secretarial at Shalimar Paints. He joined as CFO on 1 June 2026, when Mahesh Viswanathan moved up to CEO.

people.name: Sunil Upmanyu
people.bio: Holds an M.Tech, a BE, a diploma in business management and a PG diploma, with 37 years of experience. He came from Aksh Optic Fibre and joined Finolex Cables in May 2000. He was its second-best-paid employee in FY26.

people.name: Amit Mathur
people.bio: Has 27 years of sales experience. He came from Havells India and joined Finolex Cables in April 2015, where he runs sales.

companies.changes: Mahesh Viswanathan became CEO and Sachin Naik became CFO on 1 Jun 2026. Company Secretary Siddhesh Mandke resigned on 11 Jun 2026; Nirnoy Sur took over on 11 Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: A founder-family company. Founder Kushal Hegde (87) is Executive Chairman, his son Rajesh Hegde is MD, and his daughter Rakhi Shetty is a whole-time director. His other son Rohit Hegde stepped down as Joint MD in January 2026 but stays on the board as a non-executive director and owns 14.80%. Since April 2026 a hired CEO, Hukumchand Lakhotiya, runs operations under the family. Promoters own 74.58%.

people.name: Kushal Subbayya Hegde
people.relation: Founder; father of MD Rajesh Hegde, director Rohit Hegde and whole-time director Rakhi Shetty
people.stake: 35.23% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter family together 74.58%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in arts from Bombay University. He is one of the founders and has been on the board since the company was set up in 1979, with over 45 years in strategy and management. Outside the company he has been president of the Bunts Sangha and the Kannada Sangha, a Lions Club district governor and chairman of the Kaveri group. He was paid ₹2.88cr in FY26, the most of any director. He is 87.

people.name: Rajesh Kushal Hegde
people.relation: Son of the founder-Chairman Kushal Hegde; brother of director Rohit Hegde and whole-time director Rakhi Shetty
people.bio: Holds a B.S. in mechanical engineering from Michigan Technological University and a master's in manufacturing systems engineering from Oklahoma State University, both in the US. He joined the company in September 1996 and has over 28 years in strategy and management. As MD he runs the business day to day; he was paid ₹2.45cr in FY26. He is 55.

people.name: Rakhi Shetty
people.since: With the company since 2006; whole-time director since 2025
people.relation: Daughter of the founder-Chairman Kushal Hegde; sister of MD Rajesh Hegde and director Rohit Hegde
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in arts (psychology) from the University of California and a master's in science from the University of South Florida. She has been with the company since 2006, with over 18 years in corporate social responsibility and management, and chairs its CSR committee. She is president of the National Council of Women in India and the Poona Women's Council.

people.name: Hukumchand Lakhotiya
people.bio: Holds an M.Tech in industrial management from IIT Bombay and a bachelor's in electrical engineering from Government College of Engineering, Amravati, where he was a gold medallist. He has over 30 years in the electrical and power sectors, more than 25 of them at CG Power & Industrial Systems and Schneider Electric (Singapore). At CG Power he led the transformer, switchgear and EPC business across Asia, several Asian plants and exports. Just before joining KSH he was COO for waste-to-energy at SAEL Industries. He became CEO on 2 April 2026.

people.name: Amod Joshi
people.bio: A chartered accountant who has also done a senior management programme at IIM Ahmedabad and holds an ACCA diploma in international financial reporting. He has over 15 years in logistics, audit and manufacturing, and earlier worked at the audit firms S.R. Batliboi & Co. and BSR & Co. He joined KSH in August 2017 and runs finance.

people.name: Ganesh Prasad
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Karnatak University, Dharwad and a diploma in management studies from the University of Mumbai. He worked at Otis Elevator (India) before joining KSH in January 2002. He runs production and product development and is a key managerial person (not a board director).

companies.changes: Rohit Hegde stepped down as Joint MD on 1 Jan 2026 and stays as a non-executive director. CEO Sandesh Bhagwat resigned (left 31 Mar 2026); Hukumchand Lakhotiya became CEO on 2 Apr 2026. Company Secretary Sarthak Malvadkar left on 31 Mar 2026; Nakul Patil took over on 1 Apr 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Mangal family of Jaipur. Ashish Mangal is MD and runs the business; his brother Rahul Mangal is the non-executive Chairman and also runs sister company Mangal Electrical Industries. Ashish's wife and two children hold senior management jobs. The family owns 68.18%, including their mother Saroj Mangal's 13.62%. A hired CFO runs finance.

people.name: Ashish Mangal
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Chairman Rahul Mangal; husband of Shalu Mangal; father of Aditi and Rasik Mangal
people.stake: 31.81% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); family together 68.18%
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Rajasthan with over 30 years in the wires and cables industry. He oversees production, marketing, finance and the supply chain, and the company credits him with technology choices and new-business investments. He was re-appointed MD from July 2022. He is also a director of sister company Mangal Electrical Industries and other family companies, and with his brother has given personal guarantees on the company's bank loans.

people.name: Murari Lal Poddar
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a commerce degree from the University of Rajasthan. Before Dynamic Cables he was senior manager (finance and accounts) at Wires and Fabriks, and worked at Shree Silica Products and Saboo Sodium Chloro. He earlier also served as the company's Company Secretary and now runs finance as CFO.

people.name: Shalu Mangal
people.relation: Wife of MD Ashish Mangal
people.bio: Listed by the company as senior management, heading accounts as Vice-President. She has also given a personal guarantee for the company's bank loans. The annual report gives no further detail on her education or career.

people.name: Aditi Mangal
people.role: Head of Human Resources & Corporate Communication
people.relation: Daughter of MD Ashish Mangal
people.bio: Listed by the company as senior management, heading HR and corporate communication. The annual report gives no further detail on her education or career.

people.name: Rasik Mangal
people.since: Joined July 2024; GM Marketing since June 2026
people.relation: Son of MD Ashish Mangal
people.bio: A graduate of New York University's Stern School of Business, majoring in management and operations. He joined in July 2024 as senior manager, marketing, and was made general manager, marketing and senior management on 16 June 2026. He works on business promotion and marketing strategy. The July 2026 AGM was asked to raise his pay to up to ₹40 lakh a year.

companies.changes: Rasik Mangal (MD's son) promoted to General Manager, Marketing on 16 Jun 2026. Neeraj Bali joined as an independent director on 16 Jun 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Kolkata family company. Deepak Goel is Chairman & MD, and his sons Devesh (CEO) and Akshat are whole-time directors; his wife Rakhi Goel is a promoter but has no role. The family owned all of it before the July 2026 IPO and about 75.3% after it. A hired COO and CFO support them.

people.name: Deepak Goel
people.relation: Promoter; father of Devesh and Akshat Goel; husband of promoter Rakhi Goel
people.stake: 45.41% before the July 2026 IPO (RHP), and he sold shares in it; promoters together about 75.3% after the IPO
people.bio: Has been with the company since it was incorporated and has more than 36 years in the cable and power industry. He has no formal education, as the offer document states. He sets strategy and oversees operations and governance. He won the TV9 Young Business Leader (Dare 2 Dream) award in 2021 and a Hurun Industry Achievement Award in 2024 for power transmission and distribution.

people.name: Devesh Goel
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Deepak Goel and promoter Rakhi Goel; brother of Akshat Goel
people.stake: 25.00% before the July 2026 IPO (RHP), and he sold shares in it
people.bio: Completed higher secondary school. He was briefly a director in 2010–11, rejoined in April 2015 as head of marketing and joined the board in August 2024. As CEO he runs operations, business expansion, customer relationships and R&D in insulation and cable design. He won the India 500 CEO Award for Quality Excellence in 2021, is co-chair of the CII eastern region's energy sub-committee for 2025-26, and has chaired IEEMA's eastern region committee.

people.name: Akshat Goel
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Deepak Goel and promoter Rakhi Goel; brother of CEO Devesh Goel
people.bio: Completed higher secondary school. He joined in June 2016 as head of operations and joined the board in August 2024. He now handles corporate strategy, marketing plans, new markets and brand positioning.

people.name: Navin Kumar Saffar
people.role: Executive Director (not on the board) & Chief Operating Officer
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Calcutta with over 13 years in operations, business development, M&A, corporate finance and accounts. He worked at Lumino Industries before joining in October 2017 as a whole-time director. He now runs day-to-day operations and key decisions on finance and risk as COO, but no longer sits on the board.

people.name: Amit Kumar Goel
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a commerce degree from the University of Delhi and over 22 years in finance. He previously worked at Lux Industries, DTDC Express, Vodafone Idea, Tata Teleservices, Virgin Mobile India and Genpact, among others. He joined as CFO in November 2024 and handles planning, reporting, tax, compliance and risk. He is not listed as related to the promoter family.

people.name: Praveen Kumar Paul
people.bio: A science graduate from Vidyasagar University with over 27 years in manufacturing and marketing. He previously worked at Royle Extrusion Systems, the Royle Systems Group and Sterlite Optical Technologies. He runs production, quality control and plant safety.

people.name: Debashish Rout
people.bio: Holds a diploma in mechanical engineering and a B.Tech in electrical engineering from Janardan Rai Nagar Rajasthan Vidyapeeth. He has over 14 years in project management and operations and runs project planning and execution.

companies.changes: Listed on NSE and BSE on 16 Jul 2026. Company Secretary Payal Agarwal (named in the Sep 2025 draft offer document) has been replaced by Debendra Banthiya, per the July 2026 offer document.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Aggarwal family of Delhi. Two brothers run it: Sanjay Aggarwal is Chairman & CEO and Sandeep Aggarwal is MD. They are sons of founder S.S. Aggarwal. Three third-generation family members, Dhruv, Tushar and Parth Aggarwal, are presidents for strategy, operations and marketing. The promoter group owns 49.18%, and promoters took 72 lakh warrants at ₹42 in the 2026 preferential issue. A long-serving hired CFO runs finance.

people.name: Sanjay Aggarwal
people.since: Board since 1994; joined the family business in 1983
people.relation: Promoter; son of founder S.S. Aggarwal; brother of MD Sandeep Aggarwal
people.stake: 4.68% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); 36 lakh warrants from the 2026 preferential issue; promoter group together 49.18%
people.bio: A B.Com (Hons) graduate from Shri Ram College of Commerce (1983). He took the company his father founded from a small-scale unit to a large cable maker, led its 1995 IPO and its move into optical fibre and high-voltage cables. He was president of the PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry in 2020-21. He has received the National Small Industries Award (1984) from the President of India and AIMO's Entrepreneur of the Year (1994). He has over four decades of leadership experience.

people.name: Sandeep Aggarwal
people.since: Board since 1994; joined the business in 1986
people.relation: Promoter; son of founder S.S. Aggarwal; brother of Chairman & CEO Sanjay Aggarwal
people.bio: Studied economics (Hons) at Shri Ram College of Commerce and has more than four decades in the cable industry. The company credits him with building its reputation as a trusted cable maker. He holds roles in industry bodies including ITI Raini, TEPC, RCDA and the PHD Chamber, and has honorary titles from Hemchandracharya North Gujarat University and American East Coast University. Shareholders re-appointed him as a director at the September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Shambhu Kumar Agarwal
people.bio: Has been CFO of Paramount since about 2014 and certifies its accounts with the Chairman & CEO. The annual report gives no detail on his education or earlier jobs.

people.name: Dhruv Aggarwal
people.relation: Third-generation promoter family member; cousin of Tushar Aggarwal
people.bio: Studied engineering in the US and joined the business in 2010, during the post-crisis slump. Forbes India credits the third generation with pushing the company into the US market, which it said had become about half of revenue by 2024. He heads strategy as a senior manager.

people.name: Tushar Aggarwal
people.relation: Third-generation promoter family member; cousin of Dhruv Aggarwal
people.bio: Graduated in international business in the UK. He joined in 2010 and came back in 2015 to lead a change in export strategy. He now heads operations.

people.name: Parth Aggarwal
people.relation: Youngest third-generation promoter family member
people.bio: The youngest of the third generation (31 in 2024, per Forbes India). He heads marketing as a senior manager. No further detail on his education or career is published.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Nitin Gupta left on 31 Mar 2026; Rashi Goel returned as Company Secretary on 13 May 2026. VP Marketing Rajeev Gupta retired on 30 Apr 2026. Harish Bhardwaj joined as Executive VP (Exports) on 15 Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: A founder-run company. Shalin Sheth founded it in 2009 and is MD; his wife Rejal Sheth is a whole-time director. Their daughter Rutvi Sheth-Kundalia heads people, media and strategy, and their son-in-law Vatsal Kundalia is MD of the green-energy subsidiary Advait Greenergy. The chairman, Dinesh Patel, is non-executive and not family. The promoter group owns 66.80%. A hired CFO took over from Rejal Sheth in November 2025.

people.name: Shalin Sheth
people.relation: Founder; husband of whole-time director Rejal Sheth; father of Rutvi Sheth-Kundalia; father-in-law of Vatsal Kundalia
people.stake: 51.20% at 31 Mar 2026 (FY26 annual report); 60.34% per the Aug 2026 AGM notice, as his wife's holding fell; promoter group 66.80%
people.bio: A mechanical engineering graduate of Birla Vishvakarma Mahavidyalaya, with a management diploma from the Ahmedabad Management Association. Before starting Advait in 2009 he worked in the power sector at Kalpataru Power, the KHS Group and Adani Power. He built Advait from transmission hardware (OPGW, conductor accessories, stringing tools) into solar EPC, battery storage and green hydrogen. The FY26 annual report sets out his plan to develop and own energy assets.

people.name: Rejal Sheth
people.since: Director since 2010; also CFO until November 2025
people.relation: Wife of founder-MD Shalin Sheth; mother of Rutvi Sheth-Kundalia
people.stake: 14.88% at 31 Mar 2026 (FY26 annual report); 5.72% per the Aug 2026 AGM notice
people.bio: A commerce graduate with over 30 years in the power transmission business, per the company. She takes part in strategic decisions and financial planning, and was also the company's CFO until 15 November 2025. She was paid ₹72.8 lakh in FY26. She is 49.

people.name: Narayan Singh
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 12 years in strategic planning, business restructuring, fund management and ERP roll-outs. He became CFO on 16 November 2025, taking over from Rejal Sheth, and handles financial governance, risk and capital efficiency.

people.name: Vatsal Kundalia
people.relation: Son-in-law of MD Shalin Sheth and Rejal Sheth
people.bio: Became MD of Advait Greenergy, the 74.63%-owned subsidiary that holds the solar, battery and hydrogen businesses, on 7 October 2025. He writes in the annual report as Director of Operations and New Businesses. The company says he brings entrepreneurial, financial and operational expertise; it gives no detail on his education or earlier jobs. The September 2026 AGM was asked to approve a pay rise for him.

people.name: Rutvi Sheth-Kundalia
people.role: Head of People, Media and Strategy
people.relation: Daughter of MD Shalin Sheth and Rejal Sheth; wife of Vatsal Kundalia
people.bio: Joined as Head of Human Resources and Strategy on 5 September 2024 and now heads people, media and strategy. The company says she has wide experience in HR and strategic communication. The September 2026 AGM was asked to raise her pay ceiling to ₹55 lakh a year.

companies.changes: Rejal Sheth stepped down as CFO on 15 Nov 2025; Narayan Singh became CFO on 16 Nov 2025. Vatsal Kundalia became MD of Advait Greenergy on 7 Oct 2025.

companies.styleNote: A young, founder-run Kolkata company. Founder Piyush Garodia (35) is Chairman & MD and the sole promoter, owning 69.86%. He sold about ₹11.6cr of shares in the September 2025 SME IPO and has since lent the company money at interest. The other executives are hired: a whole-time director for marketing and a CFO. The offer document says no directors are related to each other.

people.name: Piyush Garodia
people.relation: Founder and sole promoter
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Calcutta. He founded the company and has run it from the start, with about 10 years in the business. He handles financing, marketing, management and administration. He sold 7.6 lakh shares (about ₹11.6cr) in the September 2025 IPO, and in FY26 lent the company about ₹9.2cr, on which it pays him interest. He is 35.

people.name: Rajesh Jhunjhunwala
people.bio: A B.Com (Hons) graduate from the University of Calcutta with about 27 years of experience. He was at Laser Filament as assistant vice president (1987–2010), Lumino Industries as vice president of projects (2010–2018), and PCI Cables Industries as CFO (2018–2023). He joined JD Cables as an executive director in 2023 and runs marketing. The offer document noted he could not trace copies of his degree certificate. He is 54.

people.name: Hemant Kumar Choradia
people.since: Finance head since 2021; CFO (KMP) since October 2024
people.bio: Holds a master's in business management from the ICFAI University, Tripura. He was an accountant at J M Bafna Publications (2005–08), audit manager at Lunia Singh Mohanty & Co. (2008–18) and finance and accounts manager at NU Sri Shyam Pharmaceuticals (2018–21). He joined JD Cables in 2021 and was named CFO from October 2024. He handles financial planning, risk, internal control and compliance. He is 41.

companies.changes: No change in directors or KMP in FY26, per the annual report.

companies.styleNote: The Suranna/Surana family runs it: the founder Narrindra Suranna is Chairman & MD and his son Ddev Surana is Whole-time Director & CEO. The compounding business was demerged from the family's Kkalpana Industries in 2022. Promoters own 75%, almost all through Bbigplas Poly Pvt Ltd (74.99%); the family members hold only a few hundred shares directly.

people.name: Narrindra Suranna
people.relation: Founder; father of Ddev Surana
people.stake: 550 shares, about 0% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together 75%, mainly via Bbigplas Poly Pvt Ltd
people.bio: Narrindra Suranna is a commerce graduate with a law degree (LLB) from Calcutta University. He has spent his career in the plastics industry and led the group's move into polymer compounding, which grew into one of India's larger compound makers. The business sat inside the listed Kkalpana Industries (India) Ltd until it was demerged into DDev Plastiks in 2022. He is also an executive director of Kkalpana Industries, so he runs two listed group companies.

people.name: Ddev Surana
people.since: Whole-time Director; CEO since the 2022 listing
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD Narrindra Suranna
people.bio: Ddev Surana holds a B.Com (Hons), an MSc in Management for Business Excellence from the UK and an MBA from the USA. He is one of the promoters and is described by the company as the key driving force of the business, with skills in project management, HR, administration and IT. He signs the annual report's CEO letter and leads the new product and battery-storage plans. He is also a non-executive director of Kkalpana Industries (India) Ltd.

people.name: Rajesh Kothari
people.since: Board since Dec 2020; Whole-time Director since Mar 2022
people.bio: Rajesh Kothari is a commerce graduate (B.Com) from Rajasthan University, Ajmer. He began his career in 1985 at Kanoria Chemicals & Industries and joined the group in 1997; he was earlier a whole-time director of Kalpana Industries. He has over three decades in marketing, after-sales service and market research for wire and cable compounds and handles key domestic and export customers. He runs the company's plants in western India. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is proposed for re-appointment.

people.name: Arihant Bothra
people.since: CFO (in place through FY26; no change during the year)
people.bio: Arihant Bothra, born in 1989, graduated from Calcutta University in 2010 and is an associate member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. He has over a decade of experience in finance, accounting, insurance, information systems and project financing. The company says he is pursuing a CFO programme with IIM Calcutta.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the annual report. Independent director Ramya Hariharan resigned in Jul 2026 for professional reasons; Rajni Mishra joined as independent director in Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Choudhary family company: Anurag Choudhary is Chairman, MD & CEO, his father Shyam Sundar Choudhary (a founder) and brother Amit Choudhary are whole-time directors. Promoters own 52.5%; the family members hold about 15% in their own names and the rest mainly through Modern Hi-Rise Pvt Ltd (36.8%).

people.name: Anurag Choudhary
people.since: Joined 1992; CEO since 2006; MD & CEO since Aug 2019
people.relation: Son of Shyam Sundar Choudhary; brother of Amit Choudhary
people.stake: 8.59% (4.33 crore shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 52.5%
people.bio: Anurag Choudhary, born 1972, holds a B.Com (Hons). He joined the family business in 1992 at about eighteen, became CEO in 2006 and MD & CEO in August 2019; his current term runs to August 2029. He led the change from a coal tar pitch maker into an integrated carbon chemicals group, adding carbon black, battery materials (anode and LFP cathode) and the Birla Tyres acquisition. Business Today named him India's Best CEO 2026 in chemicals. He is also a director of several group and battery-materials subsidiaries.

people.name: Shyam Sundar Choudhary
people.relation: Founder; father of Anurag and Amit Choudhary
people.bio: Shyam Sundar Choudhary, aged about 78, is a commerce graduate and one of the founders who set up the company in 1987. He has been on the board ever since and has decades of industrial and commercial experience. The company credits him with commissioning plants ahead of schedule. His present term as whole-time director runs to March 2028.

people.name: Amit Choudhary
people.since: With the business since 1994; board since Jun 2021
people.relation: Son of Shyam Sundar Choudhary; brother of Anurag Choudhary
people.bio: Amit Choudhary, aged about 50, is a commerce graduate from St. Xavier's College, Kolkata, with management education at IESE Business School, Spain. He has worked in the business since 1994 and oversees project expansions, plant operations and human resources. The company credits him with the Mahistikry specialty carbon black complex, the LFP cathode plant and the turnaround of Birla Tyres. He chairs the international advisory committee of the Asia Pacific Carbon Black Conference.

people.name: Kamlesh Kumar Agarwal
people.bio: Kamlesh Kumar Agarwal has been CFO since March 2014 and presents the results on the company's earnings calls. His education and earlier employers are not stated in the annual report or on the company website.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report; independent directors Girish Vanvari and Gopal Malpani were re-appointed for second terms in 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Makharia brothers: Punit Makharia is Chairman & MD and Gautam Makharia is Joint MD. Punit's son Raghav joined the board as a non-executive director in Aug 2026 and runs the Madhya Bharat Phosphate subsidiary. Promoters own 69.4%; the brothers' mother Bhanu Makharia holds 55.3% on her own.

people.name: Punit Gopikishan Makharia
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Gautam Makharia; father of Raghav Makharia
people.stake: 5.00% (16.2 lakh shares, FY26 annual report); family together 69.4%
people.bio: Punit Makharia, aged 55, holds a B.Com from Mumbai University. He is a promoter and has been a director since the company was set up in March 1993. He has more than two decades in dyes, dye intermediates and fertilisers and sets the group's strategy and customer relationships. He was re-appointed Chairman & MD from April 2026 and is also a director of group companies Madhya Bharat Phosphate, Kleur Speciality Chemicals and Krishvanta Fertchem.

people.name: Gautam Gopikishan Makharia
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Punit Makharia; uncle of Raghav Makharia
people.stake: 5.00% (Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); he was also allotted 7.36 lakh warrants in Dec 2025
people.bio: Gautam Makharia, aged 52, holds a bachelor's in electronics and telecommunications from Mumbai University and an MBA from Manchester Business School, UK. Before the family business he worked at General Electric (USA), Procter & Gamble (UK), Barclays Bank and the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre. He runs production and quality control at the Lote Parshuram plants in Ratnagiri. He was re-appointed Joint MD from April 2026.

people.name: Deepak Beriwala
people.bio: Deepak Beriwala, aged 38, holds a B.Com from the University of Rajasthan and is a qualified Chartered Accountant and Company Secretary. Before joining as CFO in June 2019 he worked in finance at a Mumbai shipping company, handling accounts, audit and strategy work.

people.name: Dr. N. N. Mahapatra
people.bio: Dr. Mahapatra, aged 67, studied textile chemistry at UDCT (now ICT) Mumbai, holds an MSc and a doctorate in applied chemistry from Utkal University and an MBA from IMM Kolkata. He has 39 years in textiles in India and abroad with the Birla groups, Reliance Industries, Raymond (Kenya) and the Churchgate Group (Nigeria). He joined in August 2018 to run the dyes business.

companies.changes: Non-executive director Ramakant Nayak resigned in Aug 2026 due to age; Raghav Makharia (son of the Chairman) joined the board as a non-executive director from 13 Aug 2026. No executive changes.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Rajesh Rathi is Chairman & MD, but the promoter group now owns only about 9.3%: other Rathi family branches were reclassified as public shareholders in 2025, and the former chairman P. R. Rathi left the board in May 2025. The rest of the executive team is professional and, since the Heubach purchase, partly German.

people.name: Rajesh Balkrishna Rathi
people.since: With the company for over three decades; also Chairman since May 2025
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Ajay B. Rathi (a promoter, not on the board)
people.stake: 5.15% at 31 Mar 2026 (FY26 annual report); about 6.3% after converting 9.8 lakh warrants in Jun 2026; promoter group together 9.32%
people.bio: Rajesh Rathi holds a BE (Mechanical) from MIT Pune, a BSc (Chemical) from Ohio University and an MBA from the University of Pittsburgh. He has worked at Sudarshan for more than three decades and led the March 2025 purchase of Germany's Heubach Group, which made it a global pigment maker with a second head office near Frankfurt. He became Chairman in May 2025 in addition to MD. In June 2026 he put in close to ₹100cr to convert his warrants, at a premium to the market price.

people.name: Ashish Vij
people.since: Whole-time Director since May 2018; with the company over 15 years
people.stake: 17,461 shares after ESOP exercise, about 0.02% (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Ashish Vij is a chemical engineer (BE, UDCT, Punjab University) and a certified Six Sigma Black Belt and lean practitioner. He has been with Sudarshan for more than 15 years and on the board as whole-time director since May 2018; the company now lists him as Chief Operating Officer. He is also a director of the listed subsidiary Sudarshan Colorants India (the former Heubach Colorants India). He is not related to any director.

people.name: Nilkanth Natu
people.bio: Nilkanth Natu is a Chartered Accountant and a graduate of the University of Pune. Before joining as CFO in July 2020 he worked at Wipro, Thermax, Automobile Corporation of Goa and Satyam Computer Services, covering planning, reporting, treasury, budgeting and audit. From May 2026 he is also interim CFO of the listed subsidiary Sudarshan Colorants India.

people.name: Dr. Klaus-Dieter Baumgart
people.bio: Dr. Baumgart has more than four decades of international experience in the pigment industry. He is the group's Chief Technology Officer and Managing Director of the German unit Sudarshan Germany Horizons GmbH, and has led the technology integration after the Heubach purchase.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Mandar Velankar resigned on 1 Sep 2026; Amit Deshpande joined as General Counsel (senior management) on 21 Sep 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Jhunjhunwala family: Suresh Jhunjhunwala is Executive Chairman, his son Anirudh is MD & CEO and his son Anuj is Whole-time Director & CFO. Promoters own 71%.

people.name: Suresh Jhunjhunwala
people.since: With JG Chemicals for over 30 years
people.relation: Promoter; father of Anirudh and Anuj Jhunjhunwala
people.stake: 9.95% plus 0.10% through his HUF (Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); family together 71%
people.bio: Suresh Jhunjhunwala holds a B.Com from Calcutta University and has over 50 years of business experience. Before and alongside JG Chemicals he ran businesses in refractories, ceramics, mining, glassware and electrical components. He has been with JG Chemicals for over 30 years and is responsible for strategy and new growth areas.

people.name: Anirudh Jhunjhunwala
people.since: Leads the business; over 20 years in the industry
people.relation: Son of Suresh Jhunjhunwala; brother of Anuj Jhunjhunwala
people.bio: Anirudh Jhunjhunwala holds a B.Com from Calcutta University and an MBA from the University of Warwick. He has more than 20 years of experience in chemicals and specialty chemicals and is responsible for all business activities of the company. He signs the MD & CEO statement in the annual report.

people.name: Anuj Jhunjhunwala
people.since: Director of the company and subsidiaries since 2010; board since Mar 2022
people.relation: Son of Suresh Jhunjhunwala; brother of Anirudh Jhunjhunwala
people.bio: Anuj Jhunjhunwala, born 1983, holds a B.Com from Calcutta University, an MSc in Finance from ICFAI University and an MBA from Said Business School, University of Oxford; he also took a derivatives course at the London School of Economics. He was an investment professional at Greater Pacific Capital in London and a strategy consultant at SEB AG in Frankfurt. He has been a director of the company and its subsidiaries since 2010 and runs finance, treasury and new project development.

companies.changes: No executive changes. Independent director Ashok Bhandari died on 3 Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Arvind Mafatlal Group. The promoter Hrishikesh Mafatlal is Executive Chairman, but the business is run day to day by a hired MD, Anand V. S. (ex-BASF). His son Priyavrata Mafatlal sits on the board as a non-executive director. Promoters own 33.8%.

people.name: Hrishikesh A. Mafatlal
people.since: On the board since 1984; Executive Chairman since Aug 2016 (re-appointed to Aug 2031)
people.relation: Promoter; father of non-executive director Priyavrata Mafatlal
people.stake: 0.47% directly (7.91 lakh shares, FY26 annual report); plus 18.2% as trustee of Gurukripa Trust; promoter group together 33.8%
people.bio: Hrishikesh Mafatlal, aged 71, holds a B.Com (Hons) from Sydenham College (1975) and completed Harvard Business School's Advanced Management Programme in 1993. He chairs the Arvind Mafatlal Group; before becoming NOCIL's Executive Chairman in 2016 he was with Navin Fluorine International. He served 12 years on IIM Ahmedabad's Board of Governors and was Vice Chairman of the Cotton Textiles Export Promotion Council. Shareholders re-appointed him Executive Chairman for five years from August 2026.

people.name: Anand V. S.
people.since: Joined Mar 2023; MD since Aug 2023 (term to Jul 2028)
people.bio: Anand V. S., aged 52, holds a BE in chemical engineering from Siddaganga Institute of Technology, Bangalore and a PGDM in marketing from MDI Gurgaon. He has about 28 years in the chemical industry, mostly across BASF divisions in India and abroad. Before NOCIL he was Managing Director of Chemetall India, a BASF Group company. He was appointed MD from August 2023.

people.name: P. Srinivasan
people.bio: P. Srinivasan, aged 60, holds a B.Com and is a Chartered Accountant. He joined NOCIL in January 2005 from Flamingo Pharmaceuticals and has been with the company since. He is a key managerial person.

people.name: Prasanna Pandit
people.bio: Prasanna Pandit, aged 56, holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from LIT Nagpur and has about 32 years of experience. He joined NOCIL in April 2024 from Gujarat Fluorochemicals and is a key managerial person responsible for plants and technology.

companies.changes: No executive changes. Independent director Vilas Gupte's term ended in May 2026; Sanjiv Lal (ex-MD of Rallis India) and Sabyaschi Patnaik joined as independent directors in May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Part of the RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group. Dr. Sanjiv Goenka is non-executive Chairman and his wife Preeti Goenka is a non-executive director; a hired MD, Nilesh Koul (ex-Hindalco), runs the company. Promoters own 53.4%, mostly through Rainbow Investments (47.4%).

people.name: Nilesh Koul
people.bio: Nilesh Koul is a graduate of G. B. Pant University and holds a PGDBM from IIM Ahmedabad. He has about 28 years of leadership experience in metals, building materials, oil and gas and FMCG at Hindalco, BP, Castrol India and LafargeHolcim, in strategy, sales, manufacturing, digital change and P&L roles abroad. His last job was Senior President and CEO of Hindalco's aluminium downstream business. He replaced Kaushik Roy, who resigned for personal reasons, on 3 Nov 2025.

people.name: Raj Kumar Gupta
people.bio: Raj Kumar Gupta has been CFO and a key managerial person since October 2024 and speaks on the company's results calls. The annual report does not give his education or earlier employers.

people.name: Rohit Maindwal
people.bio: Rohit Maindwal holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from NIT Warangal and has about 32 years of industry experience, including Reliance Industries and JBF RAK LLC. His last role was Senior Executive Vice President at Reliance Industries. He joined on 20 Aug 2026 to run the specialty carbon black business and is designated senior management.

people.name: Vaneet Kumar
people.bio: Vaneet Kumar holds a B.Tech in instrumentation engineering from Punjab Technical University and an M.Tech from IIT Bombay. He has more than 20 years in energy storage, automotive and battery technology at SVOLT Energy Technology, ACME Cleantech Solutions and Great Wall Motors. His last role was SVP & CTO – Battery at Adani New Industries. He joined on 9 Jun 2026 to lead the battery-materials business.

companies.changes: MD Kaushik Roy resigned for personal reasons on 3 Nov 2025 and Nilesh Koul took over. New senior hires: Vaneet Kumar (batteries, Jun 2026) and Rohit Maindwal (specialty blacks, Aug 2026). Company Secretary Kaushik Mukherjee retires on 30 Sep 2026; Ravi Varma takes over from 1 Oct 2026. Independent director R. K. Agarwal left in Jul 2026.

companies.styleNote: The founder Manish Kiri is Chairman & MD; the two whole-time directors are long-serving professionals. Promoters own 41.7% (up from 26.7% in 2023 through warrants), including Anupama Kiri (14.6%), Manish Kiri (8.3%), Hemil Kiri (4.9%) and Aruna Kiri (4.9%).

people.name: Manish Kiri
people.relation: Founder and promoter
people.bio: Manish Kiri, born 1972, holds a BE in electronics and communication from Gujarat University and an MBA from Wayne State University, USA. He founded the company in 1998, set up the Lonsen Kiri joint venture with China's Longsheng in 2008 and bought into DyStar in 2010. He led the long Singapore court fight with Senda over DyStar, which Kiri won. He now drives the move into copper smelting and fertilisers, and chairs ASSOCHAM's Gujarat chemical committee.

people.name: Yagnesh Mankad
people.since: Joined as COO of the dyes division (date not disclosed)
people.bio: Yagnesh Mankad is a mechanical engineer with a postgraduate degree in business management. He has over four decades of experience across engineering, plastics, textiles and chemicals, covering operations, marketing, large projects and corporate affairs. He joined Kiri as Chief Operating Officer of the dyes division and still oversees the whole dyes business.

people.name: Dr. Girish Tandel
people.bio: Dr. Girish Tandel holds an MSc, an MPhil in polymer chemistry and a doctorate in polymer synthesis. He has over 35 years in chemicals, focused on new dyes and process improvement. He has been Kiri's Chief Technology Officer since June 2015 and sits on technical committees of the Bureau of Indian Standards and Gujarat's textile-sector best-practice group.

people.name: Jayesh Vyas
people.bio: Jayesh Vyas is the CFO and a key managerial person who signs the accounts with the Chairman. The annual report does not give his education or earlier employers.

companies.changes: No executive changes found since the FY26 annual report. Independent director Veena Padia left in Sep 2025 and Reema Parikh joined.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Meghmani group, founded by five families (Jayanti Patel, Ashish Soparkar, Natwarlal Patel, Ramesh Patel and Anand Patel). The second generation runs it: Maulik Patel is Chairman & MD and Kaushal Soparkar is Executive Director. Maulik's cousins Ankit, Karana and Darshan Patel sit on the board as non-executive directors; they run sister company Meghmani Organics. Promoters own 68.8%.

people.name: Maulik Patel
people.relation: Promoter; son of Meghmani co-founder Jayanti Patel; cousin of non-executive directors Ankit, Karana and Darshan Patel
people.bio: Holds a BE (Chemical) from Sardar Patel University, Anand, an MS in Chemical Engineering from the University of Southern California and an MBA from Long Island University. He has about 17 years in the chemical industry, all within the Meghmani group. At Epigral he runs operations, project expansions, team building and new product selection, and has led the move from caustic soda and chlorine into derivatives such as CPVC and epichlorohydrin. He has set a goal of about ₹5,000cr revenue by FY31. He is also a non-executive director of Meghmani Organics.

people.name: Kaushal Soparkar
people.relation: Promoter; son of Meghmani co-founder Ashish Soparkar
people.bio: Holds a BS (Chemical) from the University of New Haven and an MS in Engineering Management from Northeastern University, USA. He has about 16 years in the chemical industry. At Epigral he runs finance, IT and human resources. He is also a non-executive director of Meghmani Organics.

people.name: Rakesh Agrawal
people.bio: A chartered accountant with more than 29 years in accounts, finance, taxation, cost management and MIS. Before joining Epigral he held a senior finance and accounts role at a listed company (not named in the filing), covering planning, budgeting, internal control and compliance. He replaced Sanjay Jain, who left in September 2025.

companies.changes: CFO Sanjay Jain resigned with effect from 30 Sep 2025; Rakesh Agrawal became CFO on 10 Nov 2025. No executive changes filed since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: The Dalmia family controls it with 19.9%. Chairman Anurag Dalmia is non-executive; his son Neelabh Dalmia is an executive director for growth projects. Day-to-day the company is run by a long-serving hired team: MD R S Jalan (since 2006) and CFO Raman Chopra, both career Dalmia-group professionals.

people.name: Ravi Shanker (R S) Jalan
people.bio: A commerce graduate (Hons.) and chartered accountant with over four decades of experience. Before GHCL he worked at Modi Investment Corporation, Sanjay Paper and Chemicals, Dalmia Industries, Dalmia (Bros.) and GTC Industries, and was an executive director at Sree Meenakshi Mills. He joined GHCL as Senior Executive Director in 2002 and became MD in 2006, leading its growth in soda ash and, until its demerger, home textiles. He was ranked 29th in the BT–PwC Best CEOs survey in 2017. He is 68 and was paid about ₹14.9cr in FY26, including stock options.

people.name: Raman Chopra
people.since: Joined 2003; CFO since November 2007; director since April 2008
people.bio: A commerce graduate and a rank-holding chartered accountant (FCA). Before GHCL he was Vice President at Dalmia Bros., evaluating group companies and handling new projects. He joined GHCL in 2003 and spent four years as Senior Vice President in the home textiles division before becoming CFO in 2007. He now runs finance, accounts, tax, legal, IT, commercial, the greenfield project, sustainability and risk. He is also a director of GHCL Textiles.

people.name: Neelabh Dalmia
people.since: Executive director; re-appointed for five years from February 2025
people.relation: Promoter; son of non-executive Chairman Anurag Dalmia
people.stake: 0.14% (1,25,401 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 19.9%
people.bio: Holds a BS in Business Administration and an MBA from the Kelley School of Business, Indiana University. He has about 21 years of experience and earlier served as a non-executive director of GHCL. He leads growth projects, including greenfield plants, acquisitions and captive green power. He is an angel investor through the Indian Angel Network and co-chaired a PHD Chamber international affairs committee in 2021. He is 42.

people.name: N N Radia
people.bio: A mechanical engineer (BE) with 43 years of experience. He started as a shift in-charge at Tata Chemicals. He runs GHCL's soda ash operations and was paid about ₹2.2cr in FY26. He is 70.

companies.changes: No director or KMP changes filed with NSE since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: The Agrawal family of Vadodara's Shiva group bought control from INEOS Styrolution in 2022. Rakesh Agrawal, who ran the company as ABS Plastics from 1973 to 2012, is executive Chairman; his sons Rahul (MD) and Vishal (Joint MD, unpaid) run it with a hired technical whole-time director. The family holds 46.2% through Shiva Performance Materials, down from about 62% after a stake sale.

people.name: Rakesh S. Agrawal
people.since: Director since November 2022; ran ABS Plastics (the same company) as MD 1973–2012
people.relation: Promoter; father of MD Rahul Agrawal and Joint MD Vishal Agrawal
people.stake: No direct holding shown; family holds 46.24% through Shiva Performance Materials (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a master's in engineering (chemistry) from Stevens Institute of Technology, USA.
