people.bio: Studied to higher secondary level and has over 35 years across manufacturing, trading, exports, finance and administration. He started the pens business from scratch and grew it, by the company's account, into India's largest writing-instruments brand with over 40% share. He leads marketing, product development and production. He was also Joint MD of Wim Plast before its merger into Cello World, and is a director of many group companies. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is seeking re-appointment.

people.name: Gaurav Rathod
people.role: Joint Managing Director (glass and opalware, modern trade and online)
people.since: Director since incorporation (July 2018); re-appointed Joint MD in 2025
people.relation: Third-generation promoter; son of CMD Pradeep Rathod; nephew of Joint MD Pankaj Rathod
people.stake: 21.48% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), the largest individual holder
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in finance and economics from Bentley University, Massachusetts, and a master's in business strategy from the University of Strathclyde, Scotland. He has about 10 years in the business and started the group's opalware and glassware project from scratch, including what the company calls India's largest and most advanced opalware plant. He also drives modern trade, e-commerce and digital sales. He is a director of the All India Glass Manufacturers' Federation and of many group companies. He was 37 in October 2025.

people.name: Atul Parolia
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Has more than three decades in finance, accounting, tax and corporate strategy, and has been with the Cello Group since 1991. He leads the finance function, including financial planning and capital allocation.

companies.changes: Wim Plast and Cello Consumer Products were merged into Cello World under an NCLT-approved scheme effective 27 May 2026. No change in the executive team since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Built on the late Punamchand Shah's plastics business; his three sons run it and each owns about 23%. Kailesh Shah is Chairman & MD (manufacturing, finance and purchase), Bhupesh Shah handles administration and logistics, and Nilesh Shah handles sales, IT and strategy. Two of the next generation, Akshay (Nilesh's son) and Dhvanit (Kailesh's son), were named senior management in August 2026. The CFO is hired. Promoters own 70.2%.

people.name: Kailesh Shah
people.relation: Promoter; son of founder the late Punamchand Shah; brother of Bhupesh and Nilesh Shah; father of Dhvanit Shah
people.stake: 23.32% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); the three brothers together about 70%
people.bio: A commerce graduate of Lala Lajpatrai College, University of Bombay, with over 40 years in consumer houseware. He has been with the company since it was set up and runs manufacturing, finance and purchasing. He is also a partner in the family firms Chhaya Plastics Industries, Bombay Traders, Pyramid Plastics and B.T. Plastics and Allied Industries. He was named among 'India's Greatest Leaders 2018-19' by AsiaOne. The brothers sold part of their holdings in the August 2025 IPO.

people.name: Bhupesh Shah
people.relation: Promoter; brother of CMD Kailesh Shah and of Nilesh Shah
people.bio: Studied commerce at Lala Lajpatrai College, University of Bombay, and holds a public-speaking diploma from the Nazareth Speakers Academy. He has over 40 years in consumer houseware and has been with the company since it was set up, looking after general administration and logistics. He is a partner in the same four family firms as his brothers.

people.name: Nilesh Shah
people.role: Whole-time Director (sales, marketing, IT and strategy)
people.relation: Promoter; brother of CMD Kailesh Shah and of Bhupesh Shah; father of Akshay Shah
people.bio: A commerce graduate of Lala Lajpatrai College, University of Bombay, with over 40 years in sales, marketing and strategy in consumer houseware, and in IT. He has been with the company since it was set up. He is a partner in the family firms and a director of the subsidiaries All Time Bamboo and All Time Plastics PTE, Singapore. He drew about ₹1.95 crore in FY26 and is 60.

people.name: Manish Gattani
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a commerce degree from Maharshi Dayanand Saraswati University, Ajmer, and over 20 years in finance, accounts and operations. Before joining in June 2015 he worked at Georgia Gullini Fashions, Bella Viesta Apparels and Just Textiles. He runs the finance and operations functions.

people.name: Akshay Shah
people.since: With the company since 2014; senior management since August 2026
people.relation: Son of Whole-time Director Nilesh Shah
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from the University of Mumbai and a postgraduate degree in family-managed business from S P Jain School of Global Management, and has about 12 years with the company. He ran costing and pricing and now runs the supply chain across the three plants, including the new Khatalwada plant, and leads the company's AI projects. His pay (up to ₹1 crore a year from October 2026) is a related-party item at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Dhvanit Shah
people.since: With the company since 2016; senior management since August 2026
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Kailesh Shah
people.bio: Holds a BBA from the Foundation for Liberal and Management Education (FLAME), Pune, and has about 10 years with the company. He manages key customer relationships, has driven new product segments and heads tooling and product design. His pay (up to ₹1 crore a year from October 2026) is a related-party item at the 2026 AGM.

companies.changes: Akshay Shah and Dhvanit Shah were named senior management on 5 August 2026. Vice President – Operations Sanjeev Jain resigned with effect from 5 May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by the Kheruka family (promoters own 64.7%). Non-executive Chairman P.K. Kheruka is the father of Vice Chairman & MD Shreevar Kheruka, a fourth-generation family member. Since 20 May 2026 a long-serving insider, Rituraj Sharma, is CEO and runs day-to-day business and the plants; a hired whole-time director and CFO handle finance. The Kherukas also control Borosil Renewables and Borosil Scientific.

people.name: Shreevar Kheruka
people.since: With the company since 2006; director since January 2016; MD & CEO from February 2020; MD (CEO title passed on) from 20 May 2026
people.relation: Promoter; son of non-executive Chairman P.K. Kheruka
people.stake: 1.70% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); P.K. Kheruka 10.43%; promoter group together 64.7%
people.bio: Holds a B.S. in economics (finance and entrepreneurship) from the Wharton School and a B.A. in international relations from the University of Pennsylvania. He joined the business in 2006 and, after a business crisis, rebuilt it around the Borosil brand, distribution and consumer focus, turning a single-product, single-brand company into a multi-product, multi-brand, multi-channel consumer business. He was named a World Economic Forum Young Global Leader in 2021 and one of the Economic Times '40 under Forty' in 2019. He is also Vice Chairman of Borosil Renewables and a director of Borosil Scientific. He was paid about ₹13.3 crore in FY26, including a ₹5.5 crore incentive. He is 44.

people.name: Rituraj Sharma
people.since: With the company for over 20 years; President, then CEO from 20 May 2026
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A management graduate of the University of Bombay who also did the Senior Management Programme at IIM Ahmedabad. He has spent over 20 years at Borosil across operations, sales, distribution, marketing and strategy, and is credited with much of the consumer business's growth, including new categories, sales transformation and wider distribution. He was President before the board made him CEO in May 2026, with charge of overall business and operations, including the plants.

people.name: Rajesh Kumar Chaudhary
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.stake: 0.05% (63,708 shares including HUF, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: A commerce graduate and chartered accountant with about 28 years in finance, commercial and general management. He has been a whole-time director since February 2020 and is also a director of group company Croton Trading. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is seeking re-appointment. He is 56.

people.name: Anand Sultania
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Heads finance as a key managerial person. Before becoming CFO he was Assistant General Manager – Accounts at group company Borosil Renewables (Bloomberg profile). The annual report gives no further detail.

people.name: Ritesh Kumar
people.since: With the company for over 19 years; senior management since July 2026
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Has more than two decades of industry experience, over 19 years of it at Borosil, leading changes in sales, marketing, distribution and operations. He holds an MBA from IIMT, Greater Noida, and did the Senior Management Programme at IIM Ahmedabad. He was named senior management on 13 July 2026.

companies.changes: Rituraj Sharma became CEO on 20 May 2026 and Shreevar Kheruka's title changed from MD & CEO to MD. Vice President – Operations Manoj Kumar Singh resigned on 31 July 2026. Company Secretary Bhaunik Shah stepped down on 14 August 2026 and Pradeep Joshi took over from 15 August 2026. Ritesh Kumar, Manoj Tiwari, Dev Rishi Bhatnagar and Parag Parekh were named senior management in July–August 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Rajendra Gandhi is MD and owns about 55%; his daughter Neha Gandhi is Executive Director and his wife Sunita Gandhi is a non-executive director. The board is chaired by an independent director. Former TTK Prestige MD Chandru Kalro joined in July 2026 as non-executive Vice Chairman, and a new CFO took over in May 2026. Promoters own 55.8%, and the promoter has pledged part of his stake.

people.name: Rajendra Gandhi
people.relation: Founder and promoter; husband of director Sunita Gandhi; father of Executive Director Neha Gandhi
people.stake: 55.2% (1,82,69,115 shares, FY26 annual report); wife Sunita 0.6%; promoter group together 55.8%
people.bio: A first-generation entrepreneur who founded the company in Bengaluru in 1999 with a small unit making kerosene-wick and LPG stoves, and built it into the Pigeon and Gilma kitchen-appliance brands. He has over 25 years in the industry and runs day-to-day affairs. He holds no other directorships. He drew about ₹1.6 crore in FY26. The annual report does not give his education.

people.name: Neha Gandhi
people.since: Executive Director; re-appointed for five years from 30 September 2026
people.relation: Promoter; daughter of MD Rajendra Gandhi
people.bio: Holds a BBA from Christ University, Bengaluru, and a postgraduate certificate in sales and marketing management from MICA, Ahmedabad. She started as a graduate trainee at Viacom18. At Stove Kraft she first led brand and communication and now runs people, process and technology, including digital transformation. She drew about ₹70 lakh in FY26.

people.name: Subhadeep Pal
people.since: Joined April 2026 as VP-Finance; CFO from 16 May 2026
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com (Hons.) from Patna University and over 23 years in corporate finance, controllership, internal audit, treasury and planning across pharma, consumer goods, foods and energy. Before Stove Kraft he worked at Synokem Pharmaceuticals, Sanofi India and Nestlé India. He replaced Ramakrishna Pendyala as CFO in May 2026.

companies.changes: CFO Ramakrishna Pendyala resigned effective 15 May 2026; Subhadeep Pal became CFO on 16 May 2026. Chandru Kalro (ex-MD of TTK Prestige) joined as non-executive Vice Chairman on 2 July 2026. Chief Growth Officer Mayank Gupta left in February 2026 and Chief Revenue Officer Rohit Mago in November 2025.

companies.styleNote: The founder Suresh Kumar Poddar is Chairman, MD and CEO. His son-in-law Arun Bagaria is the only other executive director, and his daughter-in-law Puja Poddar joined senior management as President in March 2026. The other four directors are independent. Promoters own 58.77%.

people.name: Suresh Kumar Poddar
people.since: Founder (company incorporated 1992); re-appointed CMD & CEO to March 2029
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father-in-law of Whole-time Director Arun Bagaria; father of Manav Poddar and father-in-law of President Puja Poddar
people.stake: 40.46% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter family together 58.77%
people.bio: A science graduate, he founded the company and is credited with building it into India's largest maker of synthetic leather and the only Indian supplier to North American car makers. Under him the company grew from a single coating line making 0.25 million linear metres to six coating lines.Shareholders re-appointed him CMD and CEO for three years from April 2026, to March 2029. He drew ₹2.85cr in FY26. His son Manav Poddar holds a further 15.78% but has no board or management role.

people.name: Arun Bagaria
people.relation: Son-in-law of Chairman & MD Suresh Kumar Poddar; his wife Dolly Bagaria is an Assistant General Manager
people.bio: Aged 53, he is a commerce graduate with an MBA from the University of Strathclyde Graduate Business School, UK, and has 29 years of experience. He has been on the board since June 2007 and handles strategic management alongside the Chairman. He is also a director of the group's subsidiaries in the USA (Mayur Uniquoters Corp. LLC, Futura Textiles Inc.) and South Africa, and of Mayur Tecfab. His current term runs to July 2027, and the 2026 AGM was asked to re-appoint him for five more years from August 2027. He drew ₹1.94cr in FY26.

people.name: Puja Poddar
people.relation: Daughter-in-law of Chairman & MD Suresh Kumar Poddar
people.bio: She holds a B.Com from Sydenham College of Commerce & Economics, Mumbai, and is a certified health coach. The company says she worked for about five years in its colour technology and development work before taking a strategic role reporting to the Chairman, covering R&D, innovation and CSR. She was named President – HR and Administration and designated senior management in March 2026.

people.name: Vinod Kumar Sharma
people.since: CFO (in post through FY25 and FY26)
people.bio: He is the company's CFO and a Key Managerial Personnel, and signs the accounts with the Chairman. He drew ₹94.5 lakh in FY26, up 6.2%. The annual report gives no education or career details for him.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Pawan Kumar Kumawat left in May 2025; Kapil Arora replaced him. Deputy GM-Finance Prahalad Sahai Jangid retired on 2 Sep 2026. Independent director Ratan Kumar Roongta stepped down in Sep 2026 and Vinod Kumar Haritwal joined as an independent director.

companies.styleNote: The founder M. P. Ramachandran is Chairman Emeritus and not on the executive team. His elder daughter M. R. Jyothy is Chairperson and MD. The two other executive directors (operations and IT/HR) and the CFO are long-serving professionals. In 2025 the founder and his wife moved about 41% of the company into two family trusts for succession. Promoters own 62.9%.

people.name: M. R. Jyothy
people.since: With the company since 2004; MD since April 2020; re-appointed CMD from April 2025
people.relation: Elder daughter of founder and Chairman Emeritus M. P. Ramachandran (the company is named after her)
people.stake: 2.82% (1.04 crore shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 62.9%, mostly held through two M. P. Ramachandran family trusts (about 41%)
people.bio: She is a postgraduate in management with a diploma in family managed business administration, and completed the Owner/President Management Programme at Harvard University. She joined in 2004 and worked in marketing and brand communication, rising to chief marketing officer and whole-time director before taking over as MD from her father on 1 April 2020. She now also chairs the board. She has won Zee Business's Woman Entrepreneur of the Year award and was on Forbes Asia's Power Businesswomen list in 2023. Her FY26 pay rose 59% and was 130 times the median employee's.

people.name: Ananth Rao T
people.bio: He holds a Bachelor of Business Management degree and completed the Owner/President Management Programme at Harvard Business School. He has run operations and commercial since 2007, covering procurement, third-party manufacturing, logistics and supply chain, and is credited with cost savings and lower working capital through tighter inventory control. He also oversaw several capacity expansions. His FY26 pay was 72 times the median employee's.

people.name: Ravi Razdan
people.since: Heads IT since 2010 and HR since 2013
people.bio: He holds a B.E. in information technology and a Master of Management Studies in systems. He has led IT since 2010 and HR since 2013, and moved the company from a home-grown ERP to SAP, which SAP used as a global case study. He has appeared on CIO power lists several times and has been cited among top HR leaders by CHRO Asia.

people.name: Pawan Kumar Agarwal
people.bio: He holds a B.Com (Hons) from Calcutta University and is a chartered accountant (fellow), company secretary and cost accountant, with about 30 years in strategy, investor relations, fund raising, M&A, treasury and tax. Before Jyothy he was CFO of Sajjan India, and earlier worked at Kirloskar Oil Engines, VKL Seasoning, Power Exchange India and Thomson Holdings India. He replaced Sanjay Agarwal, who left in August 2024.

companies.changes: No change in directors or key managers announced since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by Kushagra Bajaj's branch of the Bajaj family, but no family member is an executive. Kushagra Bajaj is the non-executive chairman. A hired MD, Naveen Pandey (ex-Marico and Unibic), took over in July 2025, and a long-serving CFO runs finance. Former MD Sumit Malhotra stays on the board as a non-executive director and advisor. Promoters own 43.0%.

people.name: Naveen Pandey
people.stake: nil (not among the director/KMP holdings in the FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Aged 47, he holds a post-graduate programme in management from IIM Indore and a BBA from the University of Lucknow. He has over 24 years in consumer goods and foods. Before joining he was CEO of Unibic Foods India for over four years. Earlier, at Marico, he was EVP & Business Head of the new foods unit, EVP & Sales Head for India, and MD of Marico Bangladesh. He succeeded Jaideep Nandi, whose five-year term ended in June 2025, and runs the company and its subsidiaries. He drew ₹3.93cr in FY26 (nine months).

people.name: Dilip Kumar Maloo
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary, he has over 30 years in finance, treasury and secretarial work. He joined the group in April 1991 and has led finance through the company's growth over the last two decades. He signs the accounts with the MD and attends audit committee meetings.

people.name: Aditya Singh
people.bio: He has over two decades in marketing and business leadership across FMCG and media. Before joining he was Executive Vice President and Head of Marketing at Marico, where he ran large foods and personal care portfolios. He replaced Sanath Pulikkal, who left by 31 March 2026.

people.name: Aakash U Gupta
people.bio: He joined as Head of Finance and was named senior management on 1 July 2025, working under the CFO. The annual report gives no education or career details.

people.name: Anuj Awasthi
people.bio: He has led national sales since joining in June 2021 and is part of the senior management team. The company gives no education or career details.

companies.changes: Rajesh Menon, Head of Supply Chain, Operations & IT, resigned with effect from 21 Aug 2026. Company Secretary Vivek Mishra left on 30 Jun 2026; Jignesh Nagda now signs as company secretary. CMO Sanath Pulikkal left by 31 Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Co-founded in 2016 by husband and wife Varun and Ghazal Alagh, who are the only executive directors. Varun is Chairman and CEO; Ghazal is Chief Innovation Officer. A Peak XV nominee sits on the board. The CFO and business heads are hired professionals, several promoted from within in 2026. Promoters own about 35.5%.

people.name: Varun Alagh
people.relation: Co-founder; husband of Whole-time Director Ghazal Alagh
people.stake: 32.45% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); with his wife about 35.5%
people.bio: He holds a bachelor's in electrical engineering from Delhi College of Engineering (University of Delhi) and a PGDBM from XLRI Jamshedpur. He spent over a decade in FMCG before founding Honasa, including brand roles at Hindustan Unilever, Diageo India (Smirnoff) and Coca-Cola India (the Coke Zero launch). He co-founded the company in 2016 and built Mamaearth, The Derma Co., Aqualogica, BBlunt and Dr. Sheth's. He also sits on the boards of group companies such as BBlunt, BTM Ventures and Honasa Health. In December 2025 he bought about ₹50cr of shares at ₹270.

people.name: Ghazal Alagh
people.role: Co-founder, Whole-time Director & Chief Innovation Officer
people.relation: Co-founder; wife of Chairman & CEO Varun Alagh
people.bio: She holds a bachelor's in computer applications from Panjab University and a software engineering certification from NIIT, and studied art at the New York Academy of Art. Before Honasa she was a corporate trainer at NIIT teaching coding and founded DietExpert.com, a diet-planning website. At Honasa she leads product innovation and brand development and chairs the board's CSR committee.

people.name: Raman Preet Sohi
people.bio: He holds a B.Com from Panjab University and a PGDM in international business from Symbiosis Institute of Management Studies, Pune. Before Honasa he was CFO of Drums Food International (Epigamia) for over a year. Earlier he worked in M&A, corporate planning and investor relations at Dabur and as an investment professional at India Equity Partners. He also acts as the company's chief investor relations officer.

people.name: Nilesh Kotalwar
people.since: CMO from 6 Aug 2026; at Honasa about two years
people.bio: Promoted from Senior Vice President for D2C and online revenue, where he helped build the company's digital commerce. As CMO he leads integrated marketing across all the brands. The company gives no education or earlier career details.

people.name: Nishchay Bahl
people.since: CBO from 8 Sep 2026; SVP Offline Revenue for about three years before
people.bio: Promoted from Senior Vice President for offline revenue, where he scaled the brands in general and modern trade and worked on Project Neev, the push to fix general-trade distribution. He now leads all offline channels. The company gives no education or earlier career details.

companies.changes: Chief Business Officer Yatish Bhargava left on 16 May 2026. In 2026 the company promoted Nilesh Kotalwar to CMO (Aug) and Nishchay Bahl to CBO-Offline (Sep). Karanveer Bajwa (CHRO) and Avinash Dhagat (Chief Supply Chain Officer) remain in senior management.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Malik family with a hired CEO. Founder-chairman Rafique Malik moved from executive to non-executive chairman in September 2024 but still drew ₹6.85cr in FY26. His daughter Farah Malik Bhanji is MD and has been re-appointed to 2032. His daughter Alisha Malik is a whole-time director and President. Aziza Malik, a family relative, is also a President. A hired CEO, Nissan Joseph, runs day-to-day operations with a professional CFO and COO. Promoters own 71.8%.

people.name: Farah Malik Bhanji
people.since: Joined Dec 2000; MD (re-appointed for five years from 1 Apr 2027)
people.relation: Daughter of Chairman Rafique Malik; sister of Whole-time Director Alisha Malik
people.stake: 1.44% in her own name (39.34 lakh shares); 57.15% including shares she holds as trustee of the Aziza Malik and Rafique Malik family trusts (FY26 annual report); promoter group together 71.8%
people.bio: She holds a BA and a BBA in finance from the University of Texas at Austin and attended the Owner/President Management Program at Harvard Business School. She joined the company in December 2000 and worked through several roles before becoming MD, with over 25 years in footwear retail. The company credits her with reshaping the business for a new age of retail. In September 2026 the board re-appointed her MD for five years from April 2027. She drew ₹3.86cr in FY26.

people.name: Alisha Rafique Malik
people.since: Joined Jul 2009; Whole-time Director since 1 Sep 2024
people.relation: Daughter of Chairman Rafique Malik; sister of MD Farah Malik Bhanji
people.bio: She holds a bachelor's in arts (finance) from the University of Northumbria, taught at the Welingkar Institute in Mumbai. She has been with the company since July 2009, about 17 years, and became a whole-time director in September 2024 for a five-year term. She is also a President in senior management. She drew ₹1.63cr in FY26.

people.name: Nissan Joseph
people.bio: He holds an MBA in international business from Western Sydney University and has about 26 years in footwear and sports retail. Before Metro he was with MAP Active in the Philippines, and earlier with Payless Shoes Pty Ltd, Hickory Brands, Crocs and Planet Sports. He joined as CEO in July 2021, before the IPO, and runs day-to-day operations. He drew ₹8.84cr in FY26, including ₹4.45cr from exercising stock options.

people.name: Kaushal Khodidas Parekh
people.bio: Aged 46, he holds a B.Com in financial accounting and auditing and is a chartered accountant and company secretary. Before joining in 2012 he worked at PwC, Ernst & Young and N. M. Raiji & Co. He has about 22 years of experience. He drew ₹4.76cr in FY26, including ₹2.64cr from stock options.

people.name: Mohit Dhanjal
people.bio: He holds a hotel management degree from IHM, a bachelor's in sociology, public administration and political science, and did an executive programme at Cornell. He has about 31 years of experience, and before Metro he was with Reliance Retail. Earlier he worked at ITC, Tata, HUL and Raymond.

people.name: Mohammed Iqbal Hasanally Dossani
people.since: Whole-time Director since June 2021; re-appointed for five years from 25 Jun 2026
people.bio: He holds a B.Com in financial accounting and auditing. He previously worked at Workforce Media Network and Schefata Pharmaceutical & Development Laboratories. He is the director responsible for the company's sustainability and business responsibility policies, and was re-appointed for five years from June 2026. He drew ₹71 lakh in FY26.

people.name: Atul Sinha
people.bio: He has over 24 years in category management, marketing, operations and business management, with more than 11 years in senior roles. He spent over 11 years at CaratLane, most recently as Chief Operating Officer, and nearly 13 years at Hindustan Unilever before that. He joined in June 2026 to run the core footwear business.

companies.changes: New senior hires in 2026: Uttam Kumar as Chief Product Officer (May), Atul Sinha as President – Core Business (June) and Manoj Juneja, ex-CEO of Crocs India, as Chief Business Officer – Sports (June). Farah Malik Bhanji was re-appointed MD from April 2027. Independent director Arvind Singhal left in Aug 2026 and Sonny Iqbal joined.

companies.styleNote: A father-and-son business. Founder Hari Krishan Agarwal is Chairman and MD, and his son Nikhil Aggarwal is Whole-time Director and CEO. Prerna Aggarwal, a family relative, is Chief Innovation Officer. The other four directors are independent. A new CFO from boAt joined in August 2026 after the previous CFO resigned. Promoters own 67.9%.

people.name: Hari Krishan Agarwal
people.since: Founder; on the board of the current company since March 2017
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father of CEO Nikhil Aggarwal
people.stake: 55.85% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); with his son 67.88%
people.bio: He founded the Campus business and has led its growth over three decades into one of India's largest sports and athleisure footwear brands. The company credits him with its focus on design, innovation and youth fashion. He has been a director of the listed company since March 2017 and is its Chairman and MD. He drew ₹7.04cr in FY26, 118 times the median employee's pay.

people.name: Nikhil Aggarwal
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman & MD Hari Krishan Agarwal
people.bio: Aged 41, he holds a B.Sc. in industrial engineering from Purdue University and has attended executive programmes at INSEAD. He has over 18 years in footwear and has been a director since September 2008. As CEO he runs the business day to day, and the company credits him with a pivotal role in making Campus one of India's largest sports and athleisure brands. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and was proposed for re-appointment. He drew ₹3.52cr in FY26.

people.name: Rakesh Thakur
people.bio: Aged 49, he is a Delhi University commerce graduate and chartered accountant with over 22 years in consumer and multinational companies. Before Campus he was Group CFO of Imagine Marketing (boAt), where he worked on profitable growth, cash and working capital, governance and preparing for a public listing. Earlier he held senior finance roles at Hindustan Unilever, GSK Consumer Healthcare, Samsung India and PepsiCo. He replaced Sanjay Chhabra, who left in July 2026.

people.name: Prerna Aggarwal
people.relation: Relative of the promoters (listed in the annual report as a relative of KMP; exact relationship not stated)
people.bio: She is Chief Innovation Officer and part of the senior management team. The company paid her ₹1.49cr in FY26 as a related party. The annual report gives no education or career details.

people.name: Uplaksh Tewary
people.since: COO since 2 May 2026 (earlier Chief Business Officer)
people.bio: He was Chief Business Officer through FY26 and was re-designated Chief Operating Officer in May 2026. The annual report gives no education or career details.

companies.changes: CFO Sanjay Chhabra resigned with effect from 7 Jul 2026; Rakesh Thakur (ex-boAt) became CFO on 17 Aug 2026. Uplaksh Tewary moved from Chief Business Officer to COO in May 2026. A new Senior GM – Investor Relations was appointed in Sep 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder-run. Co-founders Ankit Garg (Chairperson and CEO) and Chaitanya Ramalingegowda (Executive Director) are the only executive directors and are not related. Two investor nominees (one from Peak XV) sit on the board, and five directors are independent. The finance chair has turned over: CFO Navesh Gupta joined in May 2025 and left in December 2025; Parul Gupta took over in February 2026. The founders own 37.0% after the December 2025 IPO.

people.name: Ankit Garg
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to co-founder Chaitanya Ramalingegowda
people.stake: 28.93% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); founders together 37.03%
people.bio: He holds a bachelor's in chemical engineering from IIT Roorkee and has more than 15 years of work experience. Before co-founding Wakefit he worked at Bayer MaterialScience and J. B. Polymers. He leads the company as Chairperson and CEO and took it public in December 2025. He was named in Forbes India's 30 Under 30 (2019) and ET's 40 Under 40 (2024).

people.name: Chaitanya Ramalingegowda
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to Ankit Garg
people.bio: He holds a bachelor's in computer science and engineering from Visveswaraiah Technological University and a post-graduate programme in management from ISB Hyderabad, with over 20 years in consulting and software. He worked as a software engineer at IBM Global Services and Caritor, as a consultant at Cognizant and Deloitte Consulting, and as a director at Zinnov. He earlier promoted two start-ups, Purplegull Services and Flutterby Services, both since struck off. He was named in BW Disrupt's 40 Under 40 in 2020.

people.name: Parul Gupta
people.bio: A chartered accountant and ISB Hyderabad alumna, she also holds bachelor's degrees in law and commerce from Lucknow University. She has nearly 20 years in finance leadership, with earlier roles at Syngene, Myntra, Jabong, Aircel and Airtel. She replaced Navesh Gupta, who was CFO only from May to December 2025.

people.name: Nitesh Prakash
people.role: Senior Vice President – Home Interiors (senior management)
people.bio: He holds a B.Tech and M.Tech in chemical engineering from IIT Bombay and has over a decade in operations and business building. He was VP – Operations at Ola Electric and a Senior Director at Ola, founded the drinks brand O' Be Cocktails, and worked earlier at Foodpanda India and Procter & Gamble. He joined in March 2026 to run the home interiors business.

people.name: Umanath Nayak
people.bio: He holds bachelor's and master's degrees in social work from Mangalore University and has about 17 years in HR. Before Wakefit he worked at Freshmenu (Food Vista India), Gionee India, Papa John's (OM Pizzas and Eats) and Global Franchise Architects.

companies.changes: Senior Manager – Legal Kunal Chandel resigned on 24 Sep 2026. VP – Retail Operations Dibyendu Panda resigned on 10 Apr 2026. CFO Navesh Gupta left on 31 Dec 2025 after seven months.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of the Bata Group, which owns 50.16% through Bata (BN) B.V. No family runs it: the parent appoints professional managers. Two Bata Group finance executives (Group CFO Gerd Graehsler and Shaibal Sinha) sit on the board as non-executive directors; the chairman, Ashwani Windlass, is an independent director. The CEO is changing now: Gunjan Shah finishes his five-year term on 30 Sep 2026, and Sanjay S. Rao (ex-Nike, Zara India) took over as Whole-time Director and CEO on 24 Aug 2026 and becomes MD & CEO on 1 Oct 2026.

people.name: Sanjay S. Rao
people.role: Whole-time Director & CEO (Managing Director & CEO from 1 Oct 2026)
people.since: 24 Aug 2026; MD term 1 Oct 2026 to 23 Aug 2031
people.bio: He holds a BE from the National Institute of Engineering, Mysore, a PGDM from TAPMI and an MBA from INSEAD. He has over two decades in retail and consumer businesses across India, South Asia, China and Europe. He joins from Nike, where he was Senior Director, Nike Retail, for France and Benelux. Before that he spent several years at Inditex, where he helped set up Zara in India through its joint venture with Tata, and then held senior roles across South Asia and China. He was also Country Director for Guess in France. He is an Overseas Citizen of India.

people.name: Amit Aggarwal
people.since: Whole-time director and CFO through FY26
people.bio: A chartered accountant (ICAI, 2002) with an advanced general management certificate from IIM Kolkata, he has over 20 years in finance, strategy and digital transformation in FMCG and direct-to-consumer businesses. He joined Bata India from Sugar Brands, where he was CFO. Earlier he worked at Marico and Nestle India in roles including Head of Finance and Head of Corporate Finance & Internal Audit. He sits on the board as an executive director.

people.name: Ashish Arora
people.role: Head – India Distribution and SEA Wholesale Development (management team)
people.since: In the management team through FY26
people.bio: He leads Bata India's distribution business and wholesale development for South-East Asia. The annual report gives no education or career details.

people.name: Sharad Thakur
people.since: In the management team through FY26
people.bio: He heads e-commerce for India and the Asia-Pacific region. The annual report gives no education or career details.

people.name: Sudakshina Ghosh
people.since: In the management team through FY26
people.bio: She heads human resources. The annual report gives no education or career details.

companies.changes: MD & CEO Gunjan Shah (ex-Britannia) completes his five-year term on 30 Sep 2026; Sanjay S. Rao succeeds him. Chief Strategy & Business Development Officer Badri Beriwal resigned with effect from 14 Sep 2026. Siddarth Madhavan joined as Product and Consumer Lead (North Star) on 21 Sep 2026, and three internal heads (demand planning, commercial planning, marketing) become senior management from 1 Oct 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Gautam family. Rahul Gautam, with the company since 1971, is Chairman and MD; his wife Namita is a whole-time director and his son Tushaar is Vice Chairman and Joint MD. Tushaar's wife, TV journalist Avantika Singh Gautam, joined the board as a non-executive director in August 2026. Long-serving executive Rakesh Chahar is Deputy MD. The hired India CEO left in July 2025 and the role was not refilled. During FY26 Namita and Tushaar moved most of their shares to Rahul. Promoters own 65.4%.

people.name: Rahul Gautam
people.since: With the company since 1971; MD for over three decades; Chairman since Nov 2023; CMD since Nov 2025
people.relation: Promoter; husband of Whole-time Director Namita Gautam; father of Vice Chairman & Joint MD Tushaar Gautam
people.stake: 47.34% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report; up from 11.53% after family transfers); family and Rangoli Resorts together 65.39%
people.bio: He holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from IIT Kanpur and an M.S. in chemical engineering from the Polytechnic Institute of New York. He has been with the company since 1971, served as MD for over three decades, became Chairman in November 2023 and was re-designated Chairman & MD in November 2025. He has over 50 years in PU foam and home comfort products and is Chairman Emeritus of the Indian Polyurethane Association. He drew ₹2.77cr in FY26. The board has proposed re-appointing him for five years from April 2027.

people.name: Tushaar Gautam
people.since: Joined 7 Jan 2002; Vice Chairman & Joint MD since Nov 2025 (MD before that)
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Rahul Gautam and Whole-time Director Namita Gautam; husband of director Avantika Singh Gautam
people.stake: 1.99% (31 Mar 2026, down from 31.32% after transfers within the family)
people.bio: He holds a bachelor's degree from Purdue University, USA, with courses in finance, marketing and operations management. He joined in January 2002, has over 24 years heading production and R&D, and earlier served as CEO of the Indian operations. He oversees operations including the subsidiaries Joyce Foam (Australia) and Interplasp (Spain), and sits on their boards. He moved from MD to Vice Chairman and Joint MD in November 2025 and sits on the audit committee. He drew ₹2.83cr in FY26.

people.name: Namita Gautam
people.since: Whole-time Director since 14 Nov 2003; with the group about 37 years
people.relation: Wife of Chairman & MD Rahul Gautam; mother of Tushaar Gautam
people.bio: She holds a bachelor's in law and a master's in economics from Kanpur University. She has been with the group for about 37 years and a whole-time director since 2003, and has headed human resources, marketing and projects. She now leads CSR through the Sleepwell Foundation and heads special projects. She drew ₹1.56cr in FY26.

people.name: Rakesh Chahar
people.since: Joined 1 Nov 1990; Whole-time Director since Nov 2003; Deputy MD since 5 Aug 2025
people.bio: He has been with the company since 1990 and on the board since 2003, with over 35 years selling and marketing bedding products and PU foam. He heads operations and was made Deputy MD in August 2025. His FY26 pay rose 86% to ₹2.46cr, the highest ratio to median pay among the directors.

people.name: Amit Kumar Gupta
people.since: Group CFO through FY25 and FY26
people.bio: He is the Group CFO and a Key Managerial Personnel, and certifies the accounts with the Chairman & MD. His FY26 pay fell 1.9%. The annual report gives no education or career details.

companies.changes: India CEO Nilesh Mazumdar left on 1 Jul 2025 and was not replaced. CHRO Shaili Tyagi was relieved on 31 Aug 2026. Avantika Singh Gautam (Tushaar's wife) joined the board as a non-executive director on 4 Aug 2026. The board has proposed five-year re-appointments of all four executive directors from April 2027.

companies.styleNote: Run by two branches of the Dua family. Ramesh Kumar Dua is Chairman & MD and Mukand Lal Dua is a whole-time director; the annual report says the two are related. Mukand's son Nikhil is a whole-time director and his son Ritesh is Co-CEO; Ramesh's son Gaurav is Co-CEO and whole-time director. Two more sons, Nitin (retail) and Rahul (manufacturing), are Executive Vice Presidents. Only the Executive Director Sushil Batra and the new CFO are non-family executives. The CFO seat has changed three times since May 2025. Promoters own 71.3%.

people.name: Ramesh Kumar Dua
people.relation: Promoter; related to Whole-time Director Mukand Lal Dua; father of Co-CEO Gaurav Kumaar Dua and EVP Rahul Dua
people.stake: 23.43% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter family together 71.27%
people.bio: He is a co-promoter and the Chairman & MD. The Relaxo brand was launched in 1976 and the company was incorporated in 1984. His pay in FY26 was 135 times the median employee's, the same as Mukand Lal Dua's. Shareholders re-appointed him as a director in August 2025. The FY26 annual report gives no further education or career details.

people.name: Mukand Lal Dua
people.relation: Promoter; related to Chairman & MD Ramesh Kumar Dua; father of Whole-time Director Nikhil Dua, Co-CEO Ritesh Dua and EVP Nitin Dua
people.bio: He is the other co-promoter and a whole-time director, with the same pay as the Chairman in FY26. Shareholders re-appointed him as a director in August 2025. The FY26 annual report gives no further education or career details.

people.name: Gaurav Kumaar Dua
people.since: With the company since 2001; Whole-time Director since Oct 2023; Co-CEO since 1 Apr 2026
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Ramesh Kumar Dua; brother of EVP Rahul Dua
people.bio: He holds an MBA from the University of Wales and has over 25 years at the company in sales and marketing. The company credits him with expanding its market reach, distribution and brand refresh. He became a whole-time director in October 2023 and Co-CEO in April 2026, and the board has proposed re-appointing him to March 2029.

people.name: Ritesh Dua
people.since: Co-CEO since 1 Apr 2026 (earlier Executive Vice President – Finance)
people.relation: Son of Whole-time Director Mukand Lal Dua; brother of Nikhil Dua and Nitin Dua
people.bio: He holds an MBA from FORE School of Management, Delhi, and has over 26 years at the company in finance, HR, IT and exports. He was Executive Vice President – Finance until April 2026, when he was named Co-CEO alongside Gaurav Kumaar Dua. The board has proposed re-appointing him to March 2029.

people.name: Nikhil Dua
people.relation: Son of Whole-time Director Mukand Lal Dua; brother of Co-CEO Ritesh Dua
people.bio: A B.Com graduate who also studied at the International School of Modern Shoemaking in the Czech Republic, he has 29 years at the company. He leads strategy, manufacturing and product development, including capacity expansion and process improvement. His current term ends in September 2026 and the board has proposed re-appointing him to March 2029.

people.name: Sushil Batra
people.bio: A fellow chartered accountant with over 34 years in finance, tax and strategic planning. He was CFO until May 2025, when he gave up that role under a succession plan and stayed on the board as Executive Director. The board has proposed re-appointing him from April 2027 to March 2029. His FY26 pay was 100 times the median employee's.

people.name: Amit Roy
people.bio: Promoted from Senior General Manager – Taxation, he became CFO in April 2026 after Prince Jain, CFO from May 2025, resigned in March 2026. The annual report gives no education or earlier career details.

companies.changes: CFO Sushil Batra handed over in May 2025; his successor Prince Jain resigned on 11 Mar 2026; Amit Roy became CFO on 1 Apr 2026. Gaurav Kumaar Dua and Ritesh Dua became Co-CEOs on 1 Apr 2026. In Aug 2026 the board proposed re-appointing the family executives to March 2029 and added Ashish Nigam (Head – Central Purchase) to senior management.

companies.styleNote: Founder Hemant Jalan has run it as Chairman & MD since it was set up in 2000 and owns about 18%. His son Parag Jalan (about 11%) sits on the board as a non-executive director; promoter Anita Hemant Jalan stepped down as an executive director in May 2024. A veteran paint executive, N.K. Venugopal, is the other executive director, and hired professionals run operations and finance. Promoters own 53.9%.

people.name: Hemant Jalan
people.since: Founder; on the board since March 2000; MD term runs to February 2028
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father of non-executive director Parag Jalan
people.stake: 17.97% (85,67,500 shares, FY26 annual report); son Parag 10.85%; promoter group together 53.9%
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from IIT Kanpur, an M.Sc. from Stanford University and an MBA from the University of Chicago. Before starting Indigo in 2000 he worked with A.F. Ferguson & Co. and the Vedanta group, and he has over 25 years in the paint industry. He built Indigo from scratch into a listed national paint brand. He was paid ₹3.6 crore in FY26 and is an independent director of BSL Limited. He is 68.

people.name: N.K. Venugopal (Narayanankutty Kottiedath Venugopal)
people.since: With the company since April 2003; on the board since February 2016; re-appointed Executive Director from 1 June 2025
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in mechanical engineering from the University of Kerala and a PGDM from IIM Calcutta, and has over 40 years in the paint industry. He worked at Asian Paints and was Deputy General Manager at Sadolin Paints (Oman) in Muscat from 1990 to 2003, and was also associated with Hi-Build Coatings. He joined Indigo in 2003. He was paid about ₹2 crore in FY26. He is 77.

people.name: T.S. Suresh Babu (Thundiyil Surendra Suresh Babu)
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: An engineering graduate with a PGDM and 28 years of experience. He came from Hi-Build Coatings and joined Indigo in August 2012. Until 2026 he was the company's only senior manager outside the board and the statutory officers. He was paid about ₹1.3 crore in FY26. He is 55.

people.name: Chetan Humane
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Holds B.Com and M.Com degrees and has 26 years of experience. He came from Jenson & Nicholson (India) and joined Indigo in September 2001, so he has been with the company for almost its whole life. He was paid about ₹80 lakh in FY26. He is 49.

people.name: Aishwarya Pratap Singh
people.since: Joined 2 January 2026; senior management from FY27
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech and a PGDM and has about 20 years of experience. He joined from ITC Limited in January 2026 and was named senior management for FY27. He is 43.

companies.changes: Aishwarya Pratap Singh (Chief Business Officer) and Srihari Santhakumar (GM Finance, ex-SBI Capital Markets) were named senior management for FY27. No exchange filings of executive resignations since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Kansai Paint Co. of Japan owns 75% and nominates the MD and two non-executive directors; there is no family. The board is chaired by independent director Bhaskar Bhat. The MD, Pravin Chaudhari, is a Nerolac veteran who returned in April 2025 after stints at Pidilite and at Kansai Paint in Japan. Since Japanese nominee Hirokazu Kotera left on 31 March 2026, he is the only executive director. Senior management also includes Jason Gonsalves (corporate planning, IT and materials), Amrit Rekhi (industrial business) and Rohit Malkani (strategy).

people.name: Pravin D. Chaudhari
people.since: Joined 1993; executive director 2008–2018; MD since 1 April 2025 (three-year term to March 2028)
people.relation: Not related to any director; nominee of promoter Kansai Paint Co., Japan
people.bio: An engineer with a master's in management from Mumbai University. He joined Nerolac as a trainee in 1993, built both its consumer and industrial businesses over the years, and was an executive director from 2008. In 2018 he moved to Pidilite Industries to run its pigments and industrial business in India and abroad for about five years. In 2023 he joined Kansai Paint Co. in Japan as an Executive Officer, heading its India business and serving as deputy chief of R&D and procurement, before returning to replace Anuj Jain as MD in April 2025. He is 57.

people.name: Yash Ahuja
people.role: Chief Financial Officer and Chief Risk Officer
people.since: Joined April 2024 as CFO-designate; CFO since 1 August 2025
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com from South City College, Calcutta University, and executive education from the Haas School of Business, UC Berkeley. He has over 24 years in finance and strategy at Panasonic Life Solutions India, Wrigley, Hewlett-Packard, General Electric and SpiceJet. He joined in April 2024 as Senior Vice President – Finance and took over as CFO when P.D. Pai retired on 31 July 2025. He is also the Chief Risk Officer on the board's risk committee.

people.name: Ram Mehrotra
people.role: Chief Business Officer – Decorative Sales and Marketing
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Holds a B.E. in electrical and electronics engineering from Dayalbagh Educational Institute (1991) and an MBA in marketing from Kanpur University (1994), and did IIM Lucknow's CMO programme in 2023. He spent over 25 years at Kansai Nerolac, rising to Vice President (Sales & Marketing) in decorative paints, then led sales and marketing for the paints business at Astral Limited. He rejoined in February 2025 to run house-paint sales and reports to the MD.

companies.changes: Japanese nominee Hirokazu Kotera stepped down as Executive Director on 31 March 2026 at Kansai Paint's direction; no replacement executive director has been named. No executive changes filed since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Now JSW Dulux: JSW Paints bought control from AkzoNobel in December 2025 and owns 61.2%. Parth Jindal, MD of JSW Paints and JSW Cement, became non-executive Chairman in January 2026, and JSW group banker Kaustubh Kulkarni joined as a non-executive director. Day-to-day it is run by Rajiv Rajgopal, a hired professional kept on from the AkzoNobel era as Joint MD & CEO. Both whole-time directors from the AkzoNobel era, CFO Krishna Rallapalli and Rohit Totla, have resigned.

people.name: Rajiv Rajgopal
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer
people.since: Joined AkzoNobel 2013; MD since November 2018; Chairman & MD from November 2023; Joint MD & CEO since 9 January 2026
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: A chemical engineer from the University of Mumbai with an MMS in marketing from SP Jain Institute of Management and Research, who has also attended programmes at Harvard Business School, INSEAD and IMD. He has over 30 years in consumer goods, lubricants and telecom, with leadership roles at Hindustan Unilever, BP/Castrol India and Bharti Airtel. He joined AkzoNobel in 2013 as head of sales and marketing for decorative paints, became India country head in 2014, and ran performance coatings for the Middle East and Africa from 2017. He became MD in 2018 and now runs the company under JSW ownership. He is 58.

people.name: Ritika Chopra
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Leads the people and organisation agenda. She earlier headed HR for the non-platform business at the beauty company Purplle and worked at Amazon on Prime Video and Music in India and as an HR programme leader for Asia-Pacific and Middle East–Africa. She began her career in the Aditya Birla Group's leadership programme in fashion and retail, including as zonal HR head (West) at Pantaloons. She holds an MBA in human resources.

companies.changes: Wholetime Director & CFO Krishna Rallapalli resigned in August 2026 with effect from 14 October 2026, and Wholetime Director Rohit Totla resigned with effect from 17 November 2026, both citing personal and professional reasons; no successor CFO has been announced. HR Director Neelima Kataria left on 6 May 2026 and Ritika Chopra became Head HR. Independent director Hemant Sahai left the board on 2 August 2026. Renamed from Akzo Nobel India to JSW Dulux in March 2026.

companies.styleNote: Co-founder Sanjay Agarwal is Chairman & MD and owns about 31%; his son Apoorv Agarwal is Joint MD and runs sales and marketing. The other co-founder, Gurjit Singh Bains (about 14%), is a non-executive director, and Sirca S.p.A. of Italy, whose brand Sirca licenses, has a representative on the board. Finance is run by a hired CFO. Promoters own 65.2%.

people.name: Sanjay Agarwal
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; father of Joint MD Apoorv Agarwal
people.stake: 31.27% (1,77,60,960 shares, FY26 annual report); son Apoorv 1.95%; promoter group together 65.2%
people.bio: A chartered accountant who co-founded the business and has driven it for over three decades, taking it from an importer of Italian wood coatings to a multi-brand, full-surface coatings company. He oversees finance, strategy and the overall direction of the company, including acquisitions such as the Wembley brand.

people.name: Apoorv Agarwal
people.role: Joint Managing Director (sales, marketing and distribution; investor relations)
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman & MD Sanjay Agarwal
people.bio: A commerce graduate of the University of Delhi with an MBA in finance and marketing from IIPM. He began his career at Sirca wood coatings in Italy in sales and marketing, trained with Italian furniture brands and set up La Tendenza, a showroom for European furniture brands such as B&B Italia, Reflex, Laura Meroni and Simone Cenedese. At Sirca he leads sales and marketing, drives the expansion of the dealer network and presents the quarterly results to investors. He is a director of group company Sirca Industries. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is seeking re-appointment. He is 39.

people.name: Shallu Arora
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: The company's CFO and a key managerial person. The annual report gives no background on her qualifications or earlier employers.

companies.changes: No executive changes filed with the exchanges since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Kajaria family. Founder Ashok Kajaria is Executive Chairman; his sons Chetan (Vice Chairman) and Rishi (MD) are both executive directors, re-designated for five years from October 2025. Chetan's son Kartik heads the tile-adhesive division. All three directors gave up their pay for FY26 and FY27. A hired CFO and COOs run finance, plants and sales. Promoters own 47.69%, mostly through three family trusts.

people.name: Ashok Kajaria
people.since: Founder; on the board since December 1985; Chairman & MD until September 2025, Executive Chairman since October 2025
people.relation: Founder; father of Vice Chairman Chetan Kajaria and MD Rishi Kajaria; grandfather of Kartik Kajaria
people.stake: 0.66% in his own name plus 1.24% through A.K. Kajaria (HUF) (30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together 47.69%, including 8.12% in the Versha Kajaria family trust and 16.24% each in the Chetan and Rishi Kajaria family trusts
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. and studied engineering at UCLA in the US. He founded Kajaria Ceramics in 1985 and grew it from a 1 million sq m tile plant in 1988 into India's largest tile brand, over a career of more than 49 years. The company credits him with launching large-format wall tiles in India and changing how tiles are displayed and marketed. He has been President of the PHD Chamber of Commerce, Chairman of the Indian Council of Ceramic Tiles and Sanitaryware, and a member of FICCI's executive committee. He was Chairman & MD until September 2025 and is now Executive Chairman.

people.name: Chetan Kajaria
people.since: Board since January 2000; Joint MD until September 2025; Vice Chairman since October 2025
people.relation: Son of Chairman Ashok Kajaria; brother of MD Rishi Kajaria; father of Kartik Kajaria
people.stake: 0.90% (14,39,880 shares, FY26 AGM notice); his family trust (CK Trustees) holds another 16.24%
people.bio: Has a BE in petrochemical engineering from Pune University and an MBA from Boston College in the US. He joined the company in 2000 and opened its international-style tile showrooms, which the industry later copied. From 2011 he expanded production beyond North India by buying majority stakes in plants in western and southern India, which cut capex and start-up time. He also brought in digitally printed value-added tiles using Spanish technology. He has chaired the Indian Council of Ceramic Tiles and Sanitaryware and is an independent director of Aditya Infotech, where he chairs the audit committee. He is 51.

people.name: Rishi Kajaria
people.since: Board since July 2003; Joint MD until September 2025; MD since October 2025
people.relation: Son of Chairman Ashok Kajaria; brother of Vice Chairman Chetan Kajaria
people.stake: 1.25% (19,85,716 shares, FY26 AGM notice); his family trust (RK Trustees) holds another 16.24%
people.bio: Has a B.Sc. in business administration from Boston University in the US. He joined in 2003 and built the vitrified-tile business: he first imported vitrified tiles for five years, then started making them at Sikandrabad in 2010 and expanded at Gailpur in 2011. He added more capacity through joint ventures in Morbi, and installed 'Continua Plus' press lines for large glazed vitrified tiles in North and South India. He also led the move into bathware and currently chairs the Indian Council of Ceramic Tiles and Sanitaryware. He is a director of Kajaria Bathware and Kajaria Infrastructure. He is 47.

people.name: Sanjeev Agarwal
people.bio: A commerce graduate and chartered accountant with about 39 years of experience. He joined Kajaria in February 1994 from Orissa Synthetics, where he was deputy manager (finance), and has spent more than 30 years with the company. He is its CFO and a key managerial person, and signs the financial statements with the MD. He is 62.

people.name: Pankaj Sethi
people.bio: A civil engineer (BE) with about 34 years of experience. He joined Kajaria in April 2003 from Kajaria Infotech, where he was a regional manager. He runs marketing and sales as COO (Marketing) and is listed as senior management. He was the highest-paid employee in FY26 at ₹2.80cr (the three family directors took no pay). He is 55.

people.name: Kartik Kajaria
people.relation: Son of Vice Chairman Chetan Kajaria; grandson of Chairman Ashok Kajaria
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in business economics from UCLA. He heads the tile-adhesive division, covering strategy, business development and sales, and oversaw the commissioning of a new tile-adhesive plant. He is listed as senior management; his pay needs shareholder approval because he is a relative of the directors.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Ram Chandra Rawat retired on 31 Mar 2026; Vinit Kumar joined as General Counsel & Company Secretary on 1 Apr 2026. COO (Gailpur plant) Dr Rajveer Choudhary resigned on 23 May 2026; Parag Goel joined as President Operations, Gailpur, on 26 May 2026. CHRO Ashish Goel, hired in February 2026, resigned on 27 Jul 2026. New CMO Siddharth Parida (ex-Goodyear) joined in March 2026 and CDIO Ipininder Singh in April 2026. COO (Marketing) Bhupendra Vyas left in December 2025.

companies.styleNote: Still run by the Gupta family: Jagdish Gupta is MD and his son Manit is a whole-time director. But control is now shared with Aica Kogyo of Japan, which bought 40% in February–June 2026 and is a co-promoter with special rights under a December 2025 shareholders' agreement. Aica has put a whole-time director (Naruhiro Amada) and six non-executive nominees on the board. Another family branch (Pushpa, Dipti and Manav Gupta) sold out; Manav Gupta and whole-time director Sachin Bhatla left the board in February 2026. The chairman since February 2026 has been an independent director (Sunil Kumar Sood, per the March 2026 board list). Promoters (Aica plus the Guptas) own 56.86%, of which the Gupta family holds 16.86%.

people.name: Jagdish Gupta
people.since: Board since October 1991; current MD term July 2024 to July 2029
people.relation: Promoter; father of whole-time director Manit Gupta
people.stake: 11.11% (30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern; 31,64,762 shares at 31 Mar 2026 before part-sale to Aica); Gupta family together 16.86%
people.bio: A graduate who has been on the board since the company's early years in 1991 and is one of its promoters. The company credits him as the main force behind its growth, with deep knowledge of export markets, productivity and cost control. He turned 70 in September 2026, so shareholders are being asked to let him stay on as MD. In June 2026 the board raised his pay to ₹4.2cr a year. He sold part of his stake to Aica Kogyo in 2026 alongside the family's sale of control.

people.name: Manit Gupta
people.since: Board since February 2015; current term to January 2027, re-appointment proposed to January 2031
people.relation: Son of MD Jagdish Gupta
people.stake: 5.75% (9,73,868 shares; FY26 AGM notice and 30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern)
people.bio: Studied chemical engineering at Thapar and has an MBA from Mumbai. He has been a whole-time director since 2015 and runs operations, including production planning, marketing and raw-material buying. In February 2026 he also became the legal 'occupier' of the company's factories under the Factories Act, after whole-time director Sachin Bhatla resigned. He is 38.

people.name: Naruhiro Amada
people.relation: Nominee of co-promoter Aica Kogyo; not related to the Guptas
people.bio: A Japanese national with a bachelor's degree in commerce and about 24 years at Aica Kogyo. He has worked for Aica in New Delhi, Bangkok, Singapore and Jakarta, growing its decorative-laminates business in Asia. Most recently he was Managing Director of Aica Laminates India. Aica nominated him as a whole-time director under its shareholders' agreement, so he is Aica's executive voice in the business. He is 47.

companies.changes: Aica Kogyo bought 27.12% from Pushpa, Dipti and Manav Gupta in February 2026, then more in an open offer and from the family in June 2026, to reach 40%. Whole-time directors Sachin Bhatla (13 Feb 2026) and Manav Gupta (17 Feb 2026) resigned. Aica nominee Naruhiro Amada joined as whole-time director on 17 Jun 2026 with six Aica non-executive directors. The FY26 annual report is a scanned file, so the CFO could not be confirmed.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Somany family of Cera. Founder Vikram Somany is Chairman & MD and his daughter Deepshikha Khaitan is Vice Chairman & Joint MD. A hired Executive Director (Technical) runs the plants and a hired CFO runs finance; sales and marketing are led by hired presidents. Promoters own 54.41%, about 22% of it through Vikram Investment Company.

people.name: Vikram Somany
people.since: Founded the business in 1980; CMD since 2002; current term July 2022 to June 2027
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father of Vice Chairman & Joint MD Deepshikha Khaitan
people.stake: 7.26% (30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together 54.41%, including 22.27% held by Vikram Investment Company
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. and is a Fellow of the Chartered Management Institute (UK). He founded the sanitaryware business in 1980 and has been Chairman & MD and promoter of the listed company since 2002, building Cera into one of India's leading sanitaryware and faucet brands. He chairs the board's CSR committee. He is also a director of Birla Brothers and Asopalav Plantations. He was paid about ₹8.7cr in FY26, 40 times the median employee. He is 77.

people.name: Deepshikha Khaitan
people.since: Board since March 2014; proposed as Joint MD in January 2020; re-appointed Vice Chairman & Joint MD from April 2025
people.relation: Daughter of Chairman & MD Vikram Somany
people.stake: 2.60% (3,35,789 shares per FY26 AGM notice; 30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern)
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. (Hons) in economics and an LLB. She has been on the board since 2014 and leads design, product development and R&D, as well as sales and marketing strategy, channel expansion and profitability. She is a director of the Indian Council of Sanitaryware Manufacturers. She is 51.

people.name: Anupam Gupta
people.since: Whole-time director on three-year terms (exact start date not in the annual report)
people.bio: Has a BE in electrical engineering and an MBA, with more than 30 years in cement, textiles, chemicals and ceramics, including 17 years with the Aditya Birla Group. He oversees all of Cera's manufacturing and is the director responsible for its sustainability (BRSR) reporting. He also receives stock options. He was paid about ₹5.6cr in FY26 including options.

people.name: Vikas Kothari
people.since: CFO since April 2023 (joined mid-2022 as Deputy CFO)
people.bio: A chartered accountant with more than 20 years of experience when appointed. He worked at Reliance Industries for 4 years, Birla Century (Aditya Birla Group) for 7 years and the French multinational BIC for 8 years. He joined Cera as Deputy CFO in 2022 and took over as CFO in April 2023 when Rajesh B. Shah retired. His background is in financial planning, reporting, risk and running new plant projects.

people.name: Sandeep Abraham
people.since: Named senior management in the FY26 annual report
people.bio: Leads sales and growth strategy and is one of the company's five named senior managers. The company does not publish his education or earlier career.

people.name: Rahul Jain
people.since: Named senior management in the FY26 annual report
people.bio: Leads marketing and is one of the company's five named senior managers. The company does not publish his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: Ramesh Baliga, Chief Business Officer – Polymers and Emerging Business India (hired February 2025), resigned with effect from 30 Sep 2026. Executive Director Ayush Bagla resigned in December 2023.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Somany family. Shreekant Somany is Chairman & MD and his son Abhishek is MD & CEO (re-appointed for three years from June 2026). Shrivatsa Somany, also Shreekant's son, heads the bathware business. A hired CEO runs the tile business and a hired CFO runs finance. Promoters own 55.20%, mostly through three family trusts.

people.name: Shreekant Somany
people.since: In the company's employment since September 1992
people.relation: Promoter; father of MD & CEO Abhishek Somany and bathware head Shrivatsa Somany
people.stake: 0.35% (1,41,625 shares, FY26 annual report); he is also trustee of the Srijan Family Trust (10.25%); promoter group together 55.20% (30 Jun 2026)
people.bio: A science graduate (B.Sc.) with about 55 years of experience; before Somany he was President of Hindustan Sanitaryware & Industries (now HSIL). As Chairman & MD he built Somany into a well-known tile, sanitaryware and bath-fittings brand. The company credits him with its 'VC Shield' tile technology, the first Indian tile patent under the Indian Patent Act, and the American Ceramic Society gave him its Corporate Technical Achievement award. He was paid ₹5.2cr in FY26. He is 77.

people.name: Abhishek Somany
people.since: Joined 1995; in current employment since March 2001; MD & CEO re-appointed from 1 Jun 2026 for three years
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Shreekant Somany; brother of Shrivatsa Somany
people.stake: 0.11% in his own name plus 4.52% as karta of Abhishek Somany (HUF) (19,01,075 shares together, FY26 annual report); also trustee of the Shakthi Family Trust (23.83%)
people.bio: A BBA and third-generation entrepreneur. He trained at Kanoria Chemicals and at Pilkington Tiles in the UK in 1993–95 and joined Somany in 1995 as a management trainee. He rose to President of Domestic Marketing, then Executive Director and MD, and now runs day-to-day operations, product design, sales and marketing. He is a past chairman of the Indian Council for Ceramic Tiles and Sanitaryware and of CII Northern Region, a founder and past chairman of the Confederation of Construction Products and Services, and a member of the CII National Council. He was the company's best-paid person in FY26 at ₹6.6cr. He is 54.

people.name: Shrivatsa Somany
people.since: Listed as senior management at 31 Mar 2026
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Shreekant Somany; brother of MD & CEO Abhishek Somany
people.stake: 0.35% (30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); also trustee of the Sanrakshith Family Trust (10.25%)
people.bio: He heads the sanitaryware and bath-fittings business and is part of the company's named senior management. The annual report gives no further details of his education or career.

people.name: Amit Sahai
people.bio: An MBA with about 37 years of experience. Before joining Somany in July 2018 he was CEO of Snowcem Paints. He runs the tile business, which is most of the company's sales, and is a key managerial person. He was paid ₹3.2cr in FY26. He is 59.

people.name: Sailesh Raj Kedawat
people.bio: A chartered accountant with about 29 years of experience. He was CFO of MIRC Electronics (Onida) before joining Somany in September 2022. He is a key managerial person and co-signs the CEO/CFO certificate with the MD. He is 52.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Ambrish Julka left on 7 May 2025; Anuj Kalia took over on 8 May 2025. HR head Atish Bhattacharya left on 2 Feb 2026; Biju Sebastian became Head – HR on 29 Jan 2026. No other top-level changes filed since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Run by a group of promoter families (Bhajanka, Agarwal and Khemani) who also control Star Cement. Eight of the fourteen directors are executives. Sajjan Bhajanka is Chairman & MD, Sanjay Agarwal is CEO & MD, and Prem Kumar Bhajanka and Vishnu Khemani are also MDs; Sajjan's son Keshav and Sanjay's daughter Nikita are executive directors, and promoter-group member Rajesh Kumar Agarwal is an executive director too. Ajay Baldawa (Executive Director, Technical) is the main hired director; hired CEOs run MDF/particle board (Sumant Wattas) and laminates (Vishu Goel). Promoters own 71.83%.

people.name: Sajjan Bhajanka
people.since: Leading the company since 1986; CMD re-appointed from April 2026 to March 2031
people.relation: Promoter; father of Executive Director Keshav Bhajanka
people.stake: 10.90% (2,42,14,037 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 71.83% (30 Jun 2026)
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Dibrugarh University, Assam, with more than 46 years in plywood, ferro silicon and cement. He has led Century since 1986 and oversees production, finance and treasury. He is also Chairman & MD of Star Cement, the largest cement maker in the North East. He is President of the Federation of Indian Plywood & Panel Industry, a former President of the Bharat Chamber of Commerce, and chairs the research advisory committee of the government plywood research institute (IPIRTI). He received the Padma Shri in 2025 for trade and industry. He is 74.

people.name: Sanjay Agarwal
people.since: Co-founder; CEO & MD re-appointed for five years from July 2026
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; father of Executive Director Nikita Bansal
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Calcutta with about 39 years of experience. The company names him, with the late Hari Prasad Agarwal, as its founder. As CEO & MD he built the CenturyPly brand and runs sales, marketing, IT and HR. He is also MD of Star Cement and a director of several group companies. He is a former President of the Merchants' Chamber of Commerce and a founding trustee of Kalyan Bharti Trust, which runs The Heritage School and Heritage Institute of Technology in Kolkata. He is 65.

people.name: Prem Kumar Bhajanka
people.relation: Promoter; the annual report says he is not related to the other directors
people.bio: A commerce graduate with about 46 years in the plywood industry. He set up the company's plants in Haryana, Assam, Gujarat and Myanmar, and is known in the company for building plants in remote, hard-to-reach places. He runs timber buying and four manufacturing units, including the Myanmar plant. He is also an MD of Star Cement. He is 68.

people.name: Vishnu Khemani
people.relation: Promoter; not related to the other directors
people.bio: A commerce graduate with long experience in plywood. He set up the company's plywood and veneer plant in Chennai and runs its South India business, where he built the 'Sharon Ply' brand into the region's best-known plywood name. He helped plan the company's move into particle board and MDF, and is a director of Century MDF. He is 74.

people.name: Keshav Bhajanka
people.since: Current five-year term from January 2026 to January 2031
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Sajjan Bhajanka
people.bio: Has a degree in accounts and finance from Warwick University, UK (2010). He scaled up the decorative (laminates and veneer) business, brought in modern supply-chain systems and led the entry into MDF, Exteria and flooring. He is a whole-time director of Century Panels and a director of Star Cement and Century Ports. He is 37.

people.name: Nikita Bansal
people.since: Current term to January 2027; re-appointed for five years from February 2027
people.relation: Daughter of CEO & MD Sanjay Agarwal
people.bio: Has a degree in economics with a minor in business and mathematics from New York University. She worked in the company in an executive role before joining the board. She leads the Century Doors product line and drives internal change: goal-setting, employee engagement and internal communications. She is 37, with about 15 years of experience.

people.name: Arun Kumar Julasaria
people.bio: The company's CFO and a key managerial person; he signs the accounts and writes the CFO's review in the annual report, and sits on the risk management committee. He was paid ₹76.1 lakh in FY26. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: Senior President Ratan Rajkhowa (productivity and administration) resigned on 1 Aug 2026. Chief Digital Officer Bhargab Dutta left on 31 Mar 2026 and Dr Sandip Pradhan became Chief Digital & Information Officer. Laminates CEO Anup Mangaserri left in May 2025 and was replaced by Vishu Goel. Shareholders re-appointed Sanjay Agarwal, Ajay Baldawa and Nikita Bansal at the 16 Sep 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Run by Rajesh Mittal's branch of the Mittal family. Rajesh Mittal is Chairman & MD and his son Sanidhya is Joint MD. The only hired top executive on the board, Joint MD & CEO Manoj Tulsian, left on 30 April 2026 and has not been replaced, so the family now runs the business directly with a hired CFO and sales head. Greenlam and Greenpanel are run by other branches of the same family. Promoters own 51.93%, mostly through Shakuntala Safeinvest (37.46%).

people.name: Rajesh Mittal
people.since: Board since November 1990 (founder); current term from January 2026
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father of Joint MD Sanidhya Mittal
people.stake: About 0.01% in his own name, 0.13% through Rajesh Mittal & Sons HUF and 9.38% held on behalf of the Trade Combines partnership (30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together 51.93%
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Dibrugarh University, Assam. He began by setting up a saw mill at Tizit in Nagaland through Green Timber Industries, then a plywood unit there in the 1980s that grew into Greenply. He has been with the company since it was set up in 1990 and has more than 35 years of experience in finance, factory operations, administration, sales and marketing. He is the director in charge of the company's sustainability reporting. He was paid ₹2.3cr in FY26. He is 63.

people.name: Sanidhya Mittal
people.since: Board since February 2018; current term from February 2023
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Rajesh Mittal
people.stake: 0.06% (30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); co-trustee with his father of the Mittal Business Holdings Trust (4.71%)
people.bio: A commerce graduate (B.Com.) with more than 9 years in sales, marketing, finance and factory operations. The company credits him with setting up new plants, raising output at existing ones and opening new markets, and with driving its push into new products and efficiency. He is an independent director of Signpost India and a director of the Greenply–Samet furniture-hardware joint venture and other group companies. He is 34.

people.name: Sanjiv Keshri
people.bio: A chartered accountant (2002) with about 23 years of experience, including more than 7 years in CFO and leadership roles working closely with promoters and boards. His experience is in fund-raising, treasury, project finance, dealing with banks and rating agencies, investor relations and M&A; he has also worked with insolvency professionals. He replaced Nitinkumar Kalani, who left in April 2025, and is also the company's investor-relations officer.

people.name: Bharath Rao
people.bio: A mechanical engineer with a PGCM from XLRI and more than 28 years of experience. He has held senior sales strategy and operations roles at Century Plyboards, Formica India, Asian PPG, Castrol India and Escorts, and came to Greenply from Pidilite Industries. He leads sales and is named senior management.

companies.changes: Joint MD & CEO Manoj Tulsian resigned for personal reasons and left on 30 Apr 2026; he stays on as an adviser and no new CEO has been named. EVP HR Manish Bhatia left in January 2026 (Nagendra Acharya took charge). New in 2026: Ashok Jaiswar (SVP Marketing, February) and Kunal Handa (CIO, March); VP Marketing Yatnesh Pandey left in March. Earlier churn: chief digital officer Srinivas Tata (June 2025) and chief sales officer Indranil Roy (September 2025) resigned.

companies.styleNote: The Daga family controls and sits at the top: Mahendra K. Daga (about 87) is Executive Chairman and his son Madhur Daga is MD. Day-to-day running is delegated to a hired CEO, Aditya Gupta (since 2018, extended to 2031), with a hired CFO. Promoters own 65.92%.

people.name: Mahendra K. Daga
people.since: Promoter; current term to March 2027, re-appointed to March 2030 at the August 2026 AGM
people.relation: Promoter; father of MD Madhur Daga
people.stake: 21.00% in his own name plus 3.23% through Mahendra Kumar Daga (HUF) (30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together 65.92%
people.bio: A B.A. with more than five decades in the ceramics industry. The company describes him as an entrepreneur and technocrat who has built, commissioned and run tile plants and ceramic refractories at several locations. He chairs the board's finance and borrowing committee. Shareholders re-appointed him for three more years from April 2027 by special resolution in August 2026. He is about 87.

people.name: Madhur Daga
people.relation: Son of Chairman Mahendra K. Daga
people.bio: A promoter-executive director on the board since 1998 and now Managing Director. He writes the MD's letter in the annual report, signs the accounts and chairs the board's CSR committee. His pay in FY26 was about 24 times the median employee's. The company's filings do not give his education or earlier career.

people.name: Aditya Gupta
people.since: March 2018; term extended from August 2026 to July 2031
people.bio: A B.Tech from IIT Bombay with a post-graduate diploma in marketing and finance from IIM Bangalore, and about 35 years of experience in leading companies.
