people.name: Gautam Kumar Pal
people.since: On the board since January 2018; MD 2022–2024; whole-time director since October 2024
people.bio: A chemical engineer (B.Tech) with an MBA in production and marketing from Amity University and a doctorate in management, he has about 22 years with the company. He heads the Birkoni plant in Chhattisgarh, which makes the specialty fats, and is in charge of manufacturing and quality. He was Managing Director from November 2022 until October 2024, when Ashish Saraf became Chairman & MD.

people.name: Ashok Jain
people.since: Whole-time director since 15 November 2022; re-appointed to November 2028
people.bio: A chartered accountant, he has spent over ten years in senior finance roles at the company and is both its CFO and a whole-time director. Shareholders re-appointed him for three years from November 2025.

people.name: Deep Saraf
people.relation: Not in the promoter group; the company does not disclose any relation to the promoters
people.bio: He has been with the company since it began and has about 21 years of experience. He leads operations at the Birkoni plant and directs business development strategy.

people.name: Sandeep Agrawal
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from BIT Durg who completed a management programme at XLRI Jamshedpur, he has over 25 years in operations. He held leadership roles, including plant management, at Vedanta, Bunge India and Britannia before joining Manorama.

companies.changes: No change in executive directors or KMP since the FY26 annual report. Independent director Mudit Kumar Singh's term ended on 5 September 2026 and Dr. Rohini Tiwari was appointed in his place.

companies.styleNote: Founder A. Indra Kumar is Chairman & MD and his son A. Venkata Sanjeev is an executive director. His other son, A. Nikhilesh, is a non-executive director of the listed company and executive director of the shrimp-processing subsidiary Avanti Frozen Foods. His brother-in-law N. Ram Prasad sits on the board as a non-executive director. C. Ramachandra Rao, with the group for 42 years, is Joint MD. Promoters own 43.2% (June 2026), with no pledge. Thailand's Thai Union owns 24.2% and is represented on the board (its group treasurer Yongyut Setthawiwat is a director). The board chairman, J.V. Ramudu, is independent. Executive pay is high: the CMD earned ₹52.1cr in FY26, mostly profit commission.

people.name: A. Indra Kumar
people.since: On the board since January 1993 (founder); re-appointed from 1 July 2026
people.relation: Promoter; father of Executive Director A. Venkata Sanjeev and director A. Nikhilesh; his sister is married to director N. Ram Prasad
people.stake: 6.11% (83,30,700 shares) directly plus 6.01% through his HUF (March 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 43.2%, the largest part through Srinivasa Cystine Pvt Ltd (26.64%)
people.bio: A chemical engineer, aged 64, he began in 1986 as general manager of Srinivasa Cystine, an export unit making the amino acid L-cystine from human hair, and became its MD in 2002. He has led Avanti for about 28 years, building it into India's largest shrimp-feed maker with over half the market, plus hatcheries and shrimp processing for the US, Europe, Canada and Japan. The company credits him with training farmers in better shrimp-farming practice and setting up testing labs for them. He is also a director of Nava Limited. He was paid ₹52.1cr in FY26, of which ₹45.7cr was profit commission.

people.name: C. Ramachandra Rao
people.since: With the group for 42 years; on the board since September 1994; Joint MD since August 2006; re-appointed from 1 April 2027
people.bio: A chartered accountant, company secretary and law graduate, aged 73, he has 50+ years of experience, including in government and public-sector undertakings. He has been with the company since it began and was involved in setting up its first shrimp-feed plant. He has been executive director, company secretary and CFO, and Joint MD since 2006. He gave up the CFO role on 31 May 2026 to focus on new projects and group policies, but remains Joint MD and company secretary. He was paid ₹33.9cr in FY26, mostly profit commission.

people.name: A. Venkata Sanjeev
people.since: Re-appointed for five years at the August 2024 AGM
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman & MD A. Indra Kumar; brother of A. Nikhilesh
people.stake: 0.52% (7,10,700 shares) directly (March 2026, FY26 annual report); Sanjeev Agrovet Pvt Ltd, a promoter-group company, holds another 3.11%
people.bio: He is a key managerial person and the board lists his skills as technical and administrative/HR. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career. He was paid ₹9.8cr in FY26, including ₹7.6cr of profit commission.

people.name: A. Nikhilesh Chowdary
people.role: Executive Director, Avanti Frozen Foods (subsidiary); Non-executive Director of Avanti Feeds
people.since: Director of Avanti Feeds since 28 May 2025
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman & MD A. Indra Kumar; brother of A. Venkata Sanjeev
people.bio: He is the executive director of Avanti Frozen Foods, the shrimp processing and export subsidiary. The FY26 report credits that board with diversifying customers to Japan, Europe, Korea, Canada and the Middle East, and pushing value-added products. He joined the listed company's board as a non-executive director in May 2025. His education and earlier career are not disclosed.

people.name: B. Santhi Latha
people.since: 1 June 2026 (with the company for over 15 years)
people.bio: A chartered accountant with about 30 years of experience, she has been with Avanti for over 15 years across accounting, finance, tax, audit, risk, budgeting, CSR and HR. She set up the company's risk and compliance department in 2011–12 and became General Manager (Finance & Accounts) in July 2020. She was promoted to CFO as part of succession planning when C. Ramachandra Rao gave up the role.

companies.changes: B. Santhi Latha replaced C. Ramachandra Rao as CFO on 1 June 2026; he stays Joint MD and company secretary. The board re-appointed A. Indra Kumar as CMD from 1 July 2026 and C. Ramachandra Rao as Joint MD from 1 April 2027.

companies.styleNote: A one-man, family-controlled business: Manish Mimani is Chairperson and Managing Director and the only executive director. His wife Madhu Mimani and, since March 2026, his son Devansh Mimani sit on the board as non-executive directors. A small salaried team (CFO, Chief Commercial Officer, company secretary, HR and operations heads) reports to him. Promoters own 65.7% (June 2026), mostly through Srivaru Agro Pvt Ltd (58.9% at March 2026), with no pledge.

people.name: Manish Mimani
people.since: 1994 (joined the family flour business); director since incorporation in March 2000
people.relation: Promoter; husband of director Madhu Mimani and father of director Devansh Mimani
people.stake: 5.01% directly (20,25,443 shares, March 2026, down from 8.27% after selling in FY26; plus 2,95,314 shares bought on 30 March 2026 that settled in April), with his HUF 0.05%; promoter group together 65.7%, mainly Srivaru Agro Pvt Ltd (58.87%) (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Aged about 52, he joined M/s Ganesh Flour Mills, a proprietary concern, in 1994. He turned it into a company in 2000 and has run it since, building the Ganesh brand of packaged atta, flours, spices and snacks in eastern India. The company listed on the NSE and BSE on 29 September 2025. He is also a director of the promoter companies Srivaru Agro and Srivaru Polypacks and of Backbone Sales. He is paid ₹3cr a year, and shareholders are being asked to keep that level until March 2027 even if profits are inadequate. He attended all 13 board meetings in FY26.

people.name: Amit Tapadia
people.bio: He is the company's CFO and a key managerial person, and signs its financial statements. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career. He was paid ₹32 lakh in FY26, up 9%.

people.name: Abhishek Pareek
people.bio: He is listed as senior management in charge of commercial matters. The company does not publish his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: On 16 March 2026 Devansh Mimani (son of the MD) joined the board as a non-executive director and Rajiv Nitin Mehta as an independent director, replacing independent director Sunil Chandiramani and non-executive director Rohit Mantri. No change in KMP since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Pune-based VH (Venkateshwara Hatcheries) group, founded in 1971 by the late Dr. B.V. Rao. Three siblings lead it: B. Balaji Rao is Managing Director and the only executive director, his sister Anuradha J. Desai is non-executive Chairperson and his brother B. Venkatesh Rao is non-executive Vice-Chairman. Anuradha Desai's husband Jitendra Desai and daughter Uttara Desai are also non-executive directors. Day-to-day finance and operations rest with long-serving staff; the CFO has been with the company since 1981. Promoters own 56.1% (June 2026), mainly through Venkateshwara Hatcheries Pvt Ltd (51.61%), with no pledge.

people.name: B. Balaji Rao
people.since: Not disclosed in the annual report
people.relation: Promoter family; brother of Chairperson Anuradha J. Desai and Vice-Chairman B. Venkatesh Rao
people.stake: 0.03% (4,492 shares, March 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 56.1%, mainly Venkateshwara Hatcheries Pvt Ltd (51.61%)
people.bio: He joined the family business young. The group says he leads its production of SPF (specific-pathogen-free) eggs, processed chicken and nutrition products. He is the company's only executive director. The listed company paid him only about ₹46 lakh in FY26; he also draws pay from the parent Venkateshwara Hatcheries. His education and earlier career are not disclosed.

people.name: J. K. Handa
people.bio: He holds an M.Com and, aged 67, has 45 years of experience, all of it at Venky's, which he joined in 1981. As CFO he certifies the accounts with the MD and sits on the board's risk management committee. He was paid about ₹86 lakh in FY26.

people.name: N. K. Toshniwal
people.bio: A commerce graduate, aged 69, with 36 years of experience, he joined from M.P. Glychem Industries in 1989. He heads material purchasing. He was the company's highest-paid employee in FY26 at ₹2.5cr, far more than the MD's pay from the listed company.

companies.changes: No change in directors or KMP since the FY26 annual report. Brig. Govindarajan Srinivasan (Retd.) joined as an independent director.

companies.styleNote: An Agarwal family company from Bikaner. Founder-chairman Shiv Ratan Agarwal died on 23 April 2026; his son Deepak Agarwal is now Chairman and MD, and Deepak's wife Shweta is a whole-time director. They are the only executive directors. Day-to-day operations, finance and sales are run by hired professionals (COO, CFO, a long-serving finance president). At March 2026 the founder, his HUF and Deepak held 72.4% between them; promoters hold 73.9% in all.

people.name: Deepak Agarwal
people.since: Board since January 2002; Chairman since April 2026
people.relation: Son of the late founder Shiv Ratan Agarwal; husband of Shweta Agarwal
people.stake: 14.30% plus 0.01% via Deepak Agarwal HUF (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); family together 72.4% at that date, including the late founder's 33.70% and his HUF's 24.41%
people.bio: Holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Management (Family Managed Business) from S.P. Jain Institute of Management & Research, Mumbai. He has over 24 years in the food business, focused on ethnic snacks and sweets, and has run day-to-day operations and the plants, including subsidiaries. He led the company's listing on BSE and NSE, the first ethnic-snacks company from Bikaner to go public, and drove the move to SAP and Darwinbox systems. He became Chairman after his father's death in April 2026 and was re-appointed CMD for three years from February 2027. He also sits on the boards of group and subsidiary companies such as Bikaji Foods Retail, Petunt Food Processors, Bikaji Foods International USA and Ariba Foods. He was paid ₹7.91cr in FY26.

people.name: Shweta Agarwal
people.relation: Wife of the Chairman & MD Deepak Agarwal; daughter-in-law of the late founder
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's and a master's degree in English from Maharshi Dayanand Saraswati University, Ajmer. She has over 19 years in the food business and focuses on market development, brand management and new product launches. The company credits her with pioneering work on product innovation and marketing strategy. She is re-appointed as whole-time director for three years from February 2027. She was paid ₹2.64cr in FY26.

people.name: Manoj Verma
people.bio: Holds a BA from Agra University and a diploma in marketing management. He has over 27 years in sales, marketing and business operations, including leadership roles at Colgate-Palmolive (India) and Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities. At Bikaji he runs operations as the senior hired executive and is named a key managerial person. He holds employee stock options.

people.name: Rishabh Jain
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Veer Narmad South Gujarat University, Surat, and a chartered accountant. He has over 17 years in finance; before Bikaji he was a manager in investment banking at Intensive Fiscal Services. He handles financial planning, budgeting and capex planning, and speaks for the company on results calls. He holds employee stock options.

people.name: Shambhu Dayal Gupta
people.bio: Holds bachelor's and master's degrees in commerce from the University of Rajasthan. He has been with the company since 1992 and handles government relations, statutory approvals, banking, tax, litigation and CSR. He is one of the longest-serving managers and sits on the board's finance committee with the MD and CFO.

companies.changes: Founder-chairman Shiv Ratan Agarwal died on 23 April 2026; Deepak Agarwal became Chairman and MD. Three sales and export heads were named senior management from 21 May 2026. No CFO or COO change since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Tati family of Hyderabad. Balakrishna Tati is Chairman and MD and his son Sai Teja is a whole-time director; the CFO is the only other key executive. The promoter group is unusual: besides the Tati family (about 16.9%), it includes Singapore-based Chin Corp Holding (13.2%) and the two non-executive directors Vishal Jethalia and Mohit Rathi (about 4.4% together). The whole group held only about 34.5% before new promoter warrants.

people.name: Balakrishna Tati
people.relation: Promoter; father of Sai Teja Tati
people.stake: 13.50% (1,97,69,586 shares, FY26 AGM notice); Tati family about 16.9% (with Sai Teja, Padma and Sruti Tati); whole promoter group about 34.5%. He is to get 27 lakh of the new promoter warrants.
people.bio: A commerce graduate with a Post Graduate Diploma in International Trade, per the AGM notice. He has more than 36 years in the coffee and hot-beverages business and built Vintage Coffee's plants around Probat roasters, automated extraction and aroma-recovery systems, which let it make custom blends at scale. He took the company from 6,500 t to 11,000 t of spray-dried and agglomerated instant coffee in FY26 and is now building a 5,500 t freeze-dried plant in Telangana. He is up for re-appointment as MD for five years from July 2027, and was paid ₹1.2cr in FY26.

people.name: Sai Teja Tati
people.since: Board since March 2025; whole-time director since June 2025
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD Balakrishna Tati
people.stake: 1.66% (24,27,025 shares, FY26 AGM notice); to get 7 lakh new promoter warrants
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering and is 27. He joined the board as a non-executive director in March 2025 and was made a whole-time director in June 2025. The company says he works on business strategy, technical and engineering operations, and relationships with customers and partners. He was paid ₹36.7 lakh in FY26.

people.name: Yarkali Kranthi Kumar
people.bio: A chartered accountant with an MBA in finance, aged 42. Before becoming CFO of the listed company in July 2021 he worked at Vintage Coffee Private Limited, the operating subsidiary that has since been merged into it. He handles finance, accounts, tax and compliance, and speaks on the results calls.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Akash Jain left in October 2025; Prachi Karwa took over from 3 January 2026. No change in the MD or CFO since the annual report. The AGM votes on 42 lakh warrants to the promoter group.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Sameer Kothari, whose Vanity Case Group bought control from Goa's Dempo Group in 2013, is Managing Director and runs the company. Shrinivas Dempo, chairman of the Dempo Group, stays on the board as a non-executive promoter director. The chairman, Shashi Kalathil, is not a promoter. Below the MD sits a large hired team: an executive director for operations and supply chain, a group CFO and presidents for each business line. The annual report says no director is related to another. Promoters own 61.85% (June 2026).

people.name: Sameer R. Kothari
people.since: Took control in 2013; current MD term runs May 2022 to May 2027
people.relation: Promoter (Vanity Case Group); no director is related to another, per the FY26 annual report
people.stake: 10.1% directly (1,20,75,915 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report). His holding company Vanity Case India, which held about 38.9%, was merged into HFL in May 2026 and its shares passed to its own shareholders. Promoters together 61.85% (June 2026).
people.bio: A chartered accountant with an MBA from Cornell University. He is the promoter of the Vanity Case Group, a contract manufacturer founded in 2001, and has over 20 years in manufacturing. In 2013 the group bought control of Hindustan Foods from the Dempo Group and turned it from a small food packer into one of India's most diversified FMCG contract makers, across food and beverages, home and personal care, ice cream, footwear and health products. He has since folded the group's other businesses into HFL, most recently the Vanity Case holding company. He has personally guaranteed loans for some plants (Hyderabad, Baddi, Nashik), and chairs the board's CSR and risk committees.

people.name: Ganesh T. Argekar
people.bio: Holds a BSc in chemistry and a diploma in materials management from the Indian Institute of Materials Management. He heads the supply chain of both the Vanity Case Group and HFL and had over 23 years of managerial experience when he joined the board. He presents the operational review on results calls and gives the board quarterly business presentations.

people.name: Mayank Samdani
people.bio: A chartered accountant with experience across finance, accounts, audit, legal and compliance. Before HFL he held leadership roles with the Future Group and the Ashok Piramal Group. He is a key managerial person, sits on the risk management committee and speaks on results calls.

people.name: Sanjiv Chatterjee
people.bio: Has 35 years in manufacturing and supply chain, including senior roles at Hindustan Unilever and Lipton across operations, procurement, quality and global contract manufacturing. He joined in January 2026 to run the food and beverages business, which management expects to deliver record results.

people.name: Sanjay Sehgal
people.bio: A chemical engineer from IIT Delhi with 42 years of experience across industries and countries. He has worked with Hindustan Unilever, Sandoz and Hindalco, with postings across Asia-Pacific and Brazil.

people.name: Manoj Patani
people.bio: A chemical engineer from UDCT Mumbai (now ICT) with an MBA in finance and marketing from ISB Hyderabad. He has over 20 years in manufacturing and industrial automation and has led business strategy, commercial operations and marketing.

people.name: Sunil Plakkat
people.bio: A chemical engineer with 34 years in plant and corporate manufacturing roles. He previously held leadership positions at Asian Paints, PPG Asian Paints, ICI, Rallis and Atul.

companies.changes: Non-executive director Nikhil Vora (Sixth Sense Ventures) resigned on 23 Sep 2026. Chairman Shashi Kalathil moves from independent to non-independent director after two independent terms. The corporate quality and R&D head left in November 2025. No MD or CFO change.

companies.styleNote: A Chennai family business. Founder Junaid Ahmed is Chairman and MD; his father Iqbal Ahmed and his wife Asma Syed are whole-time directors. All three were partners in the predecessor firm, Freshara Picklz Exports, started in 2015. A hired CFO, COO and company secretary sit below them. The family holds about 59.7% in the three directors' names; promoters together about 62.6%.

people.name: Junaid Ahmed
people.relation: Founder; son of Iqbal Ahmed; husband of Asma Syed
people.stake: 34.4% (80,75,000 shares, FY26 AGM notice); family directors together about 59.7%; promoters about 62.6%
people.bio: An engineering graduate of the College of Engineering, Guindy (Anna University) with an MBA from the University of Liverpool. He was a partner in Freshara Picklz Exports, the firm that became the company, and has run it since it started in 2015. He leads strategy, business development and the main customer and supplier relationships, and took the company to its NSE SME listing in October 2024. He also sits on the boards of two Spanish companies, Conservas Selectas Españolas and Gandin Invest. He is up for re-appointment as CMD for five years from November 2026, at ₹7.5 lakh a month.

people.name: Iqbal Ahmed
people.relation: Father of Junaid Ahmed; father-in-law of Asma Syed
people.bio: An engineering graduate of the College of Engineering, Guindy (Anna University), born in 1957. He was the founding investor-partner of Freshara Picklz Exports and has been with the company since it started. He oversees building the infrastructure and expanding operations. Because he turns 70 during his new five-year term from November 2026, shareholders are asked to approve it by special resolution.

people.name: Asma Syed
people.since: Partner in the predecessor firm; whole-time director since November 2023
people.relation: Wife of Junaid Ahmed; daughter-in-law of Iqbal Ahmed
people.bio: A postgraduate from Anna University, Chennai, born in 1988. She was a partner in Freshara Picklz Exports and has been with the company since it started. She leads customer relationships and client engagement with its overseas buyers. She is up for re-appointment for five years from November 2026.

people.name: Mohammed Yousuf (Ganiva Mohammed Yousuf)
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Madras. Before Freshara he worked in finance and accounts at I & W Innovation from 2007 to 2012. He was named CFO in March 2024, ahead of the IPO, and handles the company's accounts.

people.name: Suru Venkata Ramesh
people.bio: Named as Chief Operating Officer in the FY26 annual report's leadership team. The report gives no further background on him.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Ajay Kumar Rana left on 31 Dec 2025; Priyadharshini B took over from 1 Jan 2026. The AGM (30 Sep 2026) votes to re-appoint all three family directors for five years from 23 Nov 2026. Promoter warrants were issued at ₹168.

companies.styleNote: The Bector family of Ludhiana runs it. Anoop Bector is MD; his sons Ishaan (breads) and Suvir are whole-time directors, and his wife Rashmi is a vice president. His mother Rajni Bector, the founder, is Chairperson Emeritus; the board chairman is independent. Since 2022 a hired CEO, Manu Talwar, runs day-to-day operations, with a new outside CFO from August 2026. Family executives were paid about 11% of FY26 profit. Promoters own 49.0%, mostly through Anoop and three family trusts.

people.name: Anoop Bector
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairperson Emeritus Rajni Bector; husband of Rashmi Bector; father of Ishaan and Suvir Bector
people.stake: 20.46% in his own name plus 9.77% via the AB Family Trust and 3.27% via Anoop Bector HUF (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter family together about 49%
people.bio: A commerce graduate from S.C.D. Government College, Ludhiana (Panjab University). He did McDonald's international supply-chain training in Singapore in 2001. He has over 30 years in the business and is strongest in supply chain, trade marketing and dealing with regulators. The Economic Times named him 'Business Knight of Punjab' in 2015, and since June 2023 he has sat on the board of management of Punjab Agricultural University.

people.name: Manu Talwar
people.bio: A commerce graduate and chartered accountant, aged 62, with over 30 years in consumer businesses. He started in finance and became CFO, working at Voltas and Pepsi, then set up business processes at Coca-Cola India as it bought bottlers and went on to run a Coca-Cola business. He later led businesses at Airtel and Viom, handling crises such as Coca-Cola's 2003 pesticide scare and Viom's 2012 licence cancellations. As CEO of the family-owned Luxor he moved it to professional management, and he also worked with Lenskart. At Bectors he owns the margin targets and leads results calls.

people.name: Ishaan Bector
people.relation: Son of MD Anoop Bector; brother of Suvir Bector; grandson of Rajni Bector
people.stake: 0.01% in his own name plus 7.76% via the IB Family Trust (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a BA from Michigan State University, USA, and attended the Indian School of Business's programme for family businesses. He heads the breads and bakery business (English Oven), supervising its development and expansion. He is also a director of Bakebest Foods, a family company. He was paid ₹3.6cr in FY26.

people.name: Suvir Bector
people.relation: Son of MD Anoop Bector; brother of Ishaan Bector
people.stake: 0.01% in his own name plus 7.76% via the SB Family Trust (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a BA (Hons) in management with marketing from the University of Exeter and a master's in global supply chain management from Cass Business School, City University London. He works on marketing, supply chain and customer relationships.

people.name: Parveen Kumar Goel
people.bio: A commerce graduate from S.C.D. Government College, Ludhiana (Panjab University) and a chartered accountant. A long-serving finance executive, he has been on the board since 2008 and covers finance, tax and stakeholder relations. He was also acting CFO from May 2025 until August 2026, and chairs the CSR and risk committees.

people.name: Anshul Rastogi
people.bio: Has nearly 20 years in finance, covering controllership, business partnering and strategic planning at global Fortune 500 companies. Before joining he was CFO of RAK Ceramics India, and earlier worked with consumer companies such as Versuni (the former Philips domestic appliances business). He took over the CFO role from Parveen Kumar Goel.

people.name: Rashmi Bector
people.relation: Wife of MD Anoop Bector; mother of Ishaan and Suvir Bector
people.bio: A BA graduate who has worked in the company since 1999 and is listed among its highest-paid employees. She leads business development.

companies.changes: Anshul Rastogi became CFO on 7 Aug 2026; Parveen Kumar Goel, acting CFO since May 2025 (after Arnav Jain left), is now only a whole-time director.

companies.styleNote: A founder-family company from Secunderabad. Founder G.V. Bhaskar Rao (over 75) is Chairman and MD; his wife Vanaja Devi (over 70) and son Dr G. Pawan are whole-time directors, and his daughter Dr G. Madhushree is a non-executive director. Two brothers from the wider promoter group, C. Vamsheedhar and C. Mithun Chand, are also whole-time directors; the annual report says they are not related to the Gundavaram family. Mithun Chand is the public face on results calls. There is no hired CEO, and the CFO post has been vacant since July 2026. Directors and the family trusts hold 60.5%.

people.name: G.V. Bhaskar Rao
people.relation: Founder; husband of Vanaja Devi; father of Dr G. Pawan and Dr G. Madhushree
people.stake: 9.68% in his own name, plus 19.61% each as trustee of the Pawan and Madhushree Private Trusts (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); Gundavaram family about 57.2%; promoters 60.5%
people.bio: A graduate in agricultural science who founded Kaveri Seed in 1976 and built it into one of India's leading hybrid-seed companies. He oversees overseas production, R&D, production planning and business development. He has been named among India's top 100 CEOs, and the company has been on Forbes Asia's 'Best Under a Billion' list. He also set up Kaveri University and funds rural education and health work. Shareholders are voting on a new five-year term from November 2026 by special resolution, as he is over 75; he was paid about ₹7.9cr a year.

people.name: G. Vanaja Devi
people.since: Co-promoter, with the company since its start
people.relation: Wife of the Chairman; mother of Dr G. Pawan and Dr G. Madhushree
people.bio: A co-promoter who has been with the company since it began. She leads its CSR work in farming, education, health, drinking water and rural development, and assists the MD in running the company. She is being re-appointed for five years from November 2026 by special resolution, as she is over 70; she was paid about ₹4.9cr a year.

people.name: Dr G. Pawan
people.since: With the company for over two decades
people.relation: Son of the Chairman and Vanaja Devi; brother of Dr G. Madhushree
people.stake: 4.03% in his own name (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); a family trust in his name holds a further 19.61%, with his father as trustee
people.bio: A doctor by training: MBBS from Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College, Karnataka, residency in internal medicine at Cook County Hospital, Chicago, and a fellowship in haematology and oncology at Montefiore Medical Centre, New York. He has worked with the company for over 20 years and focuses on strategy, long-term business plans, research and operations, including its expansion at home and abroad.

people.name: C. Mithun Chand
people.relation: Promoter-group member; brother of C. Vamsheedhar; not related to the Gundavaram family
people.bio: A group promoter who has worked at Kaveri since the mid-2000s. He oversees corporate governance, financial planning, investor relations and general administration, and has worked on operations, market development and partnerships at home and abroad. He leads the results calls, and with the CFO post vacant he is the main voice on the numbers. He is being re-appointed for five years from November 2026; he was paid about ₹2.4cr a year.

people.name: C. Vamsheedhar
people.relation: Promoter-group member; brother of C. Mithun Chand; not related to the Gundavaram family
people.bio: A group promoter whom the company credits with over three decades of experience. He has driven marketing strategy, product development and oversight of research, and has led the company's digital work to reach farmers and improve efficiency. He is being re-appointed for five years from November 2026; he was paid about ₹2.4cr a year.

companies.changes: CFO K.V. Chalapathi Reddy (CFO since February 2019) retired on 31 July 2026; the company said a successor would be announced, and none had been named by the Q1 call on 14 August. The AGM votes on new five-year terms for all four promoter whole-time directors and the CMD from 15 Nov 2026.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by the Patel family's Zydus group: Zydus Lifesciences owns about 57.6% and the Zydus Family Trust about 12.0% (69.6% in all). Dr Sharvil Patel, MD of Zydus Lifesciences, is the non-executive chairman and attends some calls. The business is run by a hired CEO, Tarun Arora, the only executive director, with a hired CFO and functional heads under him. No family member holds an executive role here.

people.name: Tarun Arora
people.since: Has led the business as CEO for more than 10 years
people.stake: about 0.005% (15,000 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: An engineering graduate from the University of Delhi with a PGDBM from the Institute of Management Technology, Ghaziabad. He has about 31 years of work experience and has run Zydus Wellness for over a decade, during which the business grew more than five times, largely through acquisitions: Heinz India's brands (Complan, Glucon-D, Nycil) in 2019 and the UK-based Comfort Click in 2025. He is also a whole-time director of the main operating subsidiary, Zydus Wellness Products, and was paid ₹9.4cr in FY26 across the two companies.

people.name: Umesh V. Parikh
people.bio: Has over 30 years in finance, starting in 1993. Before becoming CFO he worked within the Zydus group as VP Finance and Company Secretary at Zydus Hospira Oncology, and earlier held finance roles at GE and Rapicut Carbides. At Zydus Wellness he runs finance and IT, acts as chief risk officer, and his work has centred on accounting, integrating acquisitions and business analysis. He speaks on results calls with the CEO.

companies.changes: Chief Marketing Officer Arijit Sengupta resigned with effect from 18 Sep 2026. Manish Lal took over global demand and supply from October 2025; the R&D head left in July 2025. Apurva Diwanji joined as an independent director in May 2026. No CEO or CFO change.

companies.styleNote: A Karuturi family company from Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh. Founder K. Satyanarayana Murthy is Executive Chairman, his son K. Subrahmanya Chowdary is both Managing Director and CFO, and Chowdary's wife Neelima Devi is a whole-time director. There is no separate hired CFO; the only other key managerial person is the company secretary, and calls are handled by the MD and an accounts manager. Promoters own 72.6%, with no pledge.

people.name: Karuturi Subrahmanya Chowdary
people.since: Re-appointed MD for five years from December 2025
people.relation: Son of Executive Chairman K. Satyanarayana Murthy; husband of Neelima Devi
people.stake: 30.86% (96,43,828 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoters together 72.63%
people.bio: Has over 25 years in the aquaculture business. As MD and CFO he runs the company's strategy, finance and operations, and leads its marketing to overseas buyers, mainly in the US. He is the company's main spokesman on results calls. Holding both the MD and CFO roles leaves no independent finance head, which investors should note.

people.name: Karuturi Satyanarayana Murthy
people.since: Founder (Apex Exports, 1997); re-appointed for five years from December 2025
people.relation: Founder; father of MD K. Subrahmanya Chowdary; father-in-law of Neelima Devi
people.bio: Has over three decades in aquaculture. He founded Apex Exports in 1997, which became Apex Frozen Foods, and has guided its strategy, business development and overall management since. Under him it became one of India's leading exporters of processed shrimp.

people.name: Karuturi Neelima Devi
people.since: Re-appointed for five years from February 2026
people.relation: Wife of MD K. Subrahmanya Chowdary; daughter-in-law of the Executive Chairman
people.bio: Holds a BSc from Andhra University and has over 14 years in the aquaculture business. She handles administration, contributes to strategic and operating decisions, and chairs the board's CSR committee.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the annual report. All three family directors were re-appointed for five years during FY26.

companies.styleNote: A Hadvani family company from Rajkot. Founder Bipin Hadvani is Chairman and MD, his wife Dakshaben is an executive director and their son Raj is whole-time director and CEO. Shivangi Raj Hadvani, listed as a family related party, is chief of staff. The CFO and chief business officer are hired professionals. Promoters own 81.5%; Bipin Hadvani has pledged shares equal to 8.42% of the company to Tata Capital.

people.name: Bipinbhai Vithalbhai Hadvani
people.since: Entered the namkeen trade in 1994; founded Gopal Gruh Udyog in 1999
people.relation: Founder; husband of Dakshaben Hadvani; father of Raj Hadvani
people.stake: 55.00% (6,85,54,556 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), of which 1,05,00,000 shares (8.42% of the company) are pledged to Tata Capital; family with Gopal Agriproducts about 81.5%
people.bio: Has over 30 years in the ethnic snacks trade. He entered the namkeen business in 1994 and in 1999 started Gopal Gruh Udyog, supplying snacks to the local Rajkot market. He built it into India's largest maker of gathiya, selling in 10 states and 2 union territories through over 5 lakh shops, and listed it in March 2024. He chairs the board's CSR and risk committees. In FY26 he pledged a further 47 lakh shares, taking his pledge to 8.42% of the company.

people.name: Raj Bipinbhai Hadvani
people.relation: Son of the Chairman and Dakshaben Hadvani
people.bio: Holds an MBA in entrepreneurship and family business from NMIMS, Mumbai. As CEO he runs new product development and growth strategy, and has overseen exports of Gopal Namkeen to more than 75 countries. He signs the company's results and CEO/CFO certificates with the CFO.

people.name: Dakshaben Bipinbhai Hadvani
people.relation: Wife of the Chairman; mother of Raj Hadvani
people.bio: Holds a BA in sociology from Saurashtra University, Rajkot. She has been with the company since 2015 and works on human resources. She is also on the boards of the family company Gopal Agriproducts, which holds 11.8% of Gopal Snacks, and the Gopal Snacks Foundation.

people.name: Rigan Hasmukhrai Raithatha
people.bio: A commerce graduate from M.P. Shah Commerce College, Jamnagar, and a chartered accountant. Before Gopal he worked in accounts and finance at Reliance Industries, Nayara Energy, the Adani Group and CG Power and Industrial Solutions. He replaced Mukesh Kumar Shah, who left in January 2025, and speaks on results calls.

people.name: Naveen Gupta
people.bio: Named in the FY26 annual report's management team. Per his public profile, he holds a PGDBA in marketing from Symbiosis and previously worked at Bikaji Foods, Good2Great Industries and Karbonn Mobiles.

people.name: Shivangi Raj Hadvani
people.relation: Hadvani family member, listed as a related party; her salary was put to shareholders for approval
people.bio: Named as chief of staff and one of the company's two senior management personnel in the FY26 annual report. The report gives no further background.

companies.changes: No board or senior-management changes in FY26 or since the annual report. The CFO changed in March 2025 (Mukesh Kumar Shah to Rigan Raithatha).

companies.styleNote: A Tamboli-family company. Chetan Tamboli, a third-generation owner, is Chairman & MD. His son Rushil is a whole-time director and his daughter Vidhi Merchant is a non-executive director. Two long-serving professionals run operations and finance as executive directors. Promoters own 45%, a small part of it pledged.

people.name: Chetan M. Tamboli
people.since: Whole-time Director since September 1991; CEO since 2003; Chairman since August 2016; board re-appointed him MD for five years from September 2026
people.relation: Promoter; father of Whole-time Director Rushil Tamboli and director Vidhi Merchant

He has been a whole-time director since 1991 and has over four decades in the steel-casting business. He was Vice Chairman & MD before becoming Chairman in 2016, and has been CEO since 2003, handling strategy, finance and foundry operations. He has chaired the Board of Governors of Government Engineering College, Bhavnagar, since 2014, and is an independent director of Mukesh Babu Financial Services. He is 66.

people.name: Rushil C. Tamboli
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Chetan Tamboli; brother of director Vidhi Merchant
people.stake: 0.49% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); he received the shares from within the family during the year
people.bio: A graduate in industrial engineering from Pennsylvania State University, USA. He joined Steelcast as a management trainee in August 2011 and rose to whole-time director. He ran a Six Sigma project to cut fuel use in heat treatment, headed the heat-treatment section and the shell-moulding foundry, and helped develop new parts and cut man-hours per tonne. He now co-manages day-to-day operations with his father.

people.name: Ashutosh H. Shukla
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from M.S. University with a postgraduate diploma in business administration. He has 37 years of experience across several firms and has been with Steelcast since 1997. He runs operations at all the plants and also heads human resources. He joined the board as an executive director in January 2023 for five years. He is 63.

people.name: Subhash R. Sharma
people.bio: Holds a master's in commerce, is a cost accountant (ICMAI) and a qualified company secretary. He joined Steelcast in 2016 and is CFO, handling bank finance, audits, accounts and investor meetings. He also oversees secretarial work, stores, administration and security. He became an executive director in January 2023 for five years. He is 60.

companies.changes: No change in directors or KMP since the annual report. The board re-appointed Chetan Tamboli as MD for five years from 1 Sep 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 1978 by Bhadresh Shah, who owns 58.47% and has been Chairman & MD since the non-executive chairman Rajendra Shah stepped down in April 2026. His daughters Khushali Solanki and Bhumika Shodhan sit on the board as non-executive directors. A long-serving whole-time director and a hired CFO complete the executive team. Promoters own 58.49%.

people.name: Bhadresh K. Shah
people.since: Founder (1978); MD; Chairman since 21 April 2026; re-appointed MD to September 2031
people.relation: Founder; father of non-executive directors Khushali Solanki and Bhumika Shodhan
people.stake: 58.47% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 58.49%
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in metallurgy from IIT Kanpur. He set up the business in 1978 as Ahmedabad Induction Alloys and has over 55 years in making high-chrome wear-resistant castings such as grinding media, mill liners, diaphragms and vertical-mill parts for the cement, thermal power and mining industries. He built AIA into a global supplier, listed in 2005, with a focus on process improvement, new products and international quality standards. He became Chairman in April 2026, and shareholders re-appointed him MD for five years from 1 October 2026.

people.name: Yashwant M. Patel
people.bio: A science graduate (B.Sc., chemistry) with long experience in production, administration, human resources and accounts. He has been a whole-time director since November 2010. The company says he chaired CII Gujarat in 2012–13 and sits on the endowment committee of IIT Gandhinagar. He is an independent director of Ratnamani Metals & Tubes. He is 82 and is not related to any other director.

people.name: Viren K. Thakkar
people.bio: A chartered accountant. Before joining AIA he was CFO of GTPL Hathway, the cable-TV and broadband company. He became AIA's CFO and a key managerial person in August 2019.

people.name: Kunal D. Shah
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering from Nirma Institute of Technology and an M.S. in information systems from Stevens Institute of Technology, USA. He has been with AIA since December 2002 and heads corporate affairs as a senior manager (not a board member). He is also an independent director of Harsha Engineers, founding trustee of The Lightship Initiative, and has his own consulting firm, Theoden Ventures.

companies.changes: Chairman Rajendra Shah (non-executive) resigned on 20 Apr 2026 and Bhadresh Shah became Chairman. Executive Director (Commercial) B. F. Shah resigned on 17 Mar 2026. Shareholders re-appointed Bhadresh Shah as MD at the 15 Sep 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: A Garg-family company started in Ludhiana in 1979 making forged bicycle pedals. Founder Paritosh Kumar is Chairman & MD, his son Ashish Garg is MD and runs the business day to day, and Ashish's wife Megha Garg is a whole-time director. Hired professionals run finance, plants and marketing. The family owns about 78.5%, most of it through the Garg Family Trust (40.33%).

people.name: Ashish Garg
people.relation: Son of Chairman Paritosh Kumar; husband of Whole-time Director Megha Garg

As MD he leads business operations, financial performance, growth strategy, investments and product development, including the move to 8,000- and 14,000-tonne presses for larger industrial forgings.

people.name: Megha Garg
people.since: Whole-time Director since September 2021; board re-appointed her to September 2031
people.relation: Wife of MD Ashish Garg; daughter-in-law of Chairman Paritosh Kumar
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in economics from the University of Nottingham, UK, and has about 10 years in the industry. She is responsible for digital marketing, customer engagement and ESG. The board re-appointed her for five years from 29 September 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

people.name: Pankaj Kumar Goyal
people.bio: A commerce graduate and fellow chartered accountant (ICAI) with 24 years of finance experience in manufacturing. He has been with Happy Forgings since 2013 and handles financial strategy, reporting, fundraising, capital allocation, risk and tax.

people.name: Narinder Singh Juneja
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate diploma in mechanical engineering (machine tools operation and maintenance) from YMCA Institute of Engineering, Haryana. He has over five decades of industrial experience and oversees manufacturing processes.

people.name: Patwinder Singh
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. from Guru Nanak Dev University and an MBA from CSM Institute of Graduate Studies, with 30 years in operations and marketing. Since joining in 2016 he has run production and operations at one of the plants.

people.name: Mangesh Shantaram Purandare
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in industrial engineering and an MBA from the University of Pune, with nearly 30 years of marketing in auto components. Since joining in 2019 he has led new business development in India and abroad.

companies.changes: No change in directors or KMP since the annual report. The board re-appointed Megha Garg as whole-time director from 29 Sep 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

companies.styleNote: Run by two brothers: Vidyashankar Krishnan is Chairman & MD and K. Venkatramanan is Joint MD, both on the board since 1997. Vidyashankar's wife Sumita, a chartered accountant, is a non-executive director. Two long-serving professionals sit on the board as Director – Commercial and Director – Operations, and a new CFO joined in April 2026. Promoters own about 56.3%. The largest holder is Synmax Consultants and Trading (24.01%), a company where Sumita is a director.

people.name: Vidyashankar Krishnan

people.relation: Promoter; brother of Joint MD K. Venkatramanan; husband of director Sumita Vidyashankar
people.stake: 11.27% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); his wife Sumita holds 65,600 shares; promoter group together about 56.3%
people.bio: A postgraduate in engineering from IIT Madras with about 36 years of experience, over three decades of it in forging. He has been on the board since 1997 and MD since 1999. He led the big expansion at the Viralimalai plant, set up the Padappai plant, and set up wind-farm and solar sites, along with later expansions and acquisitions. He is a director and former president of the Association of Indian Forging Industry and holds directorships in seven other companies.

people.name: K. Venkatramanan
people.since: Board since April 1997; Joint MD since February 1999
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Chairman & MD Vidyashankar Krishnan

He has led marketing and export growth, and the company credits him with a 20-fold rise in export sales. He holds directorships in three other companies.

people.name: Ramnath Nagarajan
people.since: With the company about 24 years; on the board since April 2024
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant who has been with MM Forgings for about 24 years. He runs the overall marketing function and has helped grow export markets. He joined the board as Director – Commercial for five years from April 2024 and is a director of the subsidiaries DVS Industries, Suvarchas Vidyut and Abhinava Rizel. He is 59.

people.name: Krishnakumar Raman
people.since: Joined April 2022; on the board since April 2024
people.bio: Holds an M.S. in engineering from IIT Madras, a postgraduate certificate in business management from XLRI, and training in production and project planning in the UK. He joined in April 2022 and runs operations, reporting to the Chairman & MD. He joined the board as Director – Operations in April 2024. He is about 52.

people.name: R. Raghunathan
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant with over 30 years in finance across manufacturing, engineering, healthcare and services. He was CFO of Chettinad Cement and Wheels India, and Group CFO of Archean Chemical Industries and Trivitron Healthcare. He has worked on IPOs, mergers, divestments and restructuring, and has managed debt and funds of over ₹1,200cr.

companies.changes: CFO R. Venkatakrishnan (CFO since 2014) resigned for health reasons and R. Raghunathan took over on 1 Apr 2026. Company Secretary Chandrasekar S resigned on 14 Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Ponnavolu-family company, incorporated in 1982. P. Deepak is MD & CEO and the only executive director. P. Divya, a relative, is a non-executive director and holds 18.57%. The chairman, Vinod K. Dasari, is an independent director. Promoters own 74.87%, all held by Deepak, his HUF and Divya.

people.name: S.K. Sivakumar
people.bio: Srikalathi Sivakumar was appointed CFO in February 2020 and also serves as company secretary and compliance officer. He is the key managerial person for finance, compliance and investor contact.

companies.changes: No change in executives since the annual report. Non-executive director D. Sesha Reddy, on the board since 1982, chose not to seek re-appointment and retires at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Pratik P. Dukande

companies.styleNote: A young Lohia-family company set up in January 2020 and listed on the BSE SME platform in July 2025. Two brothers run it: Himanshu Lohia is MD and also CFO, and Subodh Lohia is whole-time director. Himanshu's wife Saundarya, a chartered accountant, is a non-executive director. There is no separate finance head. Promoters own about 70%; they also took part in the August 2026 warrant issue.

people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce (international business) from the University of Wollongong, Australia. He has been a director and promoter since the company was set up in January 2020 and has taken it from trading railway-grade materials to an RDSO-approved maker of railway safety castings. He leads strategy, finance, marketing, sales and administration, and is driving the new bogie and coupler plant at Haridwar. He is 29.

people.name: Subodh Lohia
people.relation: Promoter; brother of MD Himanshu Lohia
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce (international business) from Middlesex University, UK. He has been a director and promoter since January 2020 and handles finance, production and operations, with about six years of experience in production and finance. He is 26.

companies.changes: No change in directors since the annual report. Anshu Singh was appointed Company Secretary during FY26. Promoters subscribed to warrants allotted on 31 Aug 2026; stakes after conversion are not yet disclosed.

companies.styleNote: A founder-run business. Founder Sharad Khandelwal is the only executive director (MD). His wife Vidhi Khandelwal is a non-executive director and co-promoter. The couple own 15.73% each directly, and their company Amiable Electronics a further 46.64% (March 2026); promoters held 74.8% by mid-2026 after selling some shares. The chairperson is an independent director. One governance oddity: the internal auditor for FY26 was the company's own Head of Accounts (India), Ashita Pandya, rather than an outside firm.

people.name: Sharad Khandelwal
people.relation: Founder and promoter; husband of director Vidhi Khandelwal
people.stake: 15.73% (31 March 2026, FY26 annual report); with his wife and their company Amiable Electronics 78.1% then, promoters 74.8% by mid-2026
people.bio: A commerce graduate with over 30 years in the information and communication technology (ICT) trade. He founded Electronics Bazaar in 2016 to refurbish and resell used laptops, desktops and other devices at a time when the business was largely unorganised; the trading business of his company Amiable Electronics was moved into GNG in 2020. He built it into a group that refurbished about 727,000 devices in FY26 and sells in 46 countries through subsidiaries in the UAE and the US. He took the company public in July 2025. He is the only executive on the board and was paid ₹3.43cr in FY26.

people.name: Raakesh Jagdish Jhunjhunwala
people.since: KMP as of the FY26 annual report
people.bio: The company's CFO and one of its three key managerial personnel, alongside the MD and the company secretary. He co-signs the CEO/CFO certificate on the accounts with the MD. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career, and we found no other reliable source for them.

people.name: Kushlesh Ramesh Sadhu
people.bio: Named by the company as senior management with the title Chief Product Officer. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: No change in directors or KMP during FY26. Promoters cut their holding from 78.7% (September 2025) to 74.8% by mid-2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by two families, the Choudharys and the Pansaris, who have led it since 1989. Krishna Kumar Choudhary is Chairman and his relative Keshav Choudhary a whole-time director; Sureshkumar Pansari is Vice-Chairman and his son Kapal Pansari is MD. The two families are not related to each other. Day-to-day running has been handed to a hired CEO, ex-NVIDIA executive Rajesh Goenka, who joined the board in February 2026. Promoters own 64.0% through personal holdings, family HUFs and family trusts.

people.name: Krishna Kumar Choudhary
people.relation: Promoter; related to whole-time director Keshav Choudhary
people.stake: 2.18% directly plus 8.76% through his HUF (31 March 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group 64.0%
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over three decades in IT distribution. With Sureshkumar Pansari he built Rashi Peripherals into one of India's larger value-added distributors of computers, components and accessories for brands such as Dell, Intel, AMD and NVIDIA. He chairs the board and holds no directorships in other public companies. Shareholders re-appointed him at the September 2025 AGM.

people.name: Sureshkumar Pansari
people.since: Board since 15 December 1989; re-appointed to 30 September 2030
people.relation: Promoter; father of MD Kapal Pansari
people.stake: 5.67% directly plus 2.51% through his HUF (31 March 2026, FY26 annual report); he is also a trustee of the Kapal and Chaman Pansari family trusts
people.bio: A commerce graduate (Rajasthan University, 1975) and chartered accountant, aged 72, with more than four decades in the technology trade. He has been with the company since 1989 and is credited with building its distribution network and brand relationships, which reach small shops across India. He also sits on group companies such as PV Lumens and Concept Electronics and on the Singapore subsidiary. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is standing for re-election.

people.name: Kapal Suresh Pansari
people.relation: Promoter; son of Vice-Chairman Sureshkumar Pansari
people.stake: 6.21% (31 March 2026, FY26 annual report), up from 4.68% a year earlier
people.bio: A second-generation owner and an alumnus of S. P. Jain Institute of Management & Research, Mumbai. As MD he has led the company's expansion, diversification and modernisation; the latest step is the July 2026 purchase of 67% of VDA Infosolutions for ₹368.5cr, with the rest to follow over three years. He has won industry awards including NCN's Leading ICT Entrepreneur and a YE Forum Young Entrepreneur of the Year. His brother Chaman Pansari also holds 6.21%.

people.name: Keshav Krishna Kumar Choudhary
people.relation: Promoter; relative of Chairman Krishna Kumar Choudhary
people.stake: nil directly: his 73,92,000 shares (11.22%) were moved to the MKC Family Trust during FY26
people.bio: A second-generation owner with an electrical-engineering degree from the University of California, San Diego, and over 10 years in technology infrastructure and operations. He leads strategic projects, and has delivered large IT-infrastructure projects in India, with a focus on international logistics, process improvement and automation.

people.name: Rajesh Goenka
people.since: Whole-time Director & CEO from 3 February 2026 (to 2 February 2031)
people.stake: 15,000 shares, about 0.02% (31 March 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: A professional manager with over two decades in the ICT industry. Before Rashi he held senior marketing roles at NVIDIA covering India, the Middle East and Africa. He leads the business as CEO and joined the board as a whole-time director in February 2026, approved by shareholders in April 2026. He has won the ET Edge Most Promising Business Leader of Asia award and Intel's 2023 Partner Award (Hall of Fame CXO).

people.name: Himanshu Kumar Shah
people.since: KMP as of the FY26 annual report
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant (ICWA), both from 1997, with over 25 years in finance, strategy and business transformation across IT distribution, infrastructure, FMCG, manufacturing and media. He runs financial management, capital allocation, fund-raising and business planning. He was named CFO of the Year at the South India Business Leader of the Year Awards 2025.

companies.changes: Rajesh Goenka became Whole-time Director & CEO on 3 February 2026. Company Secretary Hinal Shah and Compliance Officer Tejas Vyas resigned in November 2025; Arvind Bajoria replaced both from 8 November 2025. Keshav Choudhary's shares moved to the MKC Family Trust during FY26. Independent director Dr Indumati Gopinathan joined on 3 February 2026.

companies.styleNote: The Kabra family runs it. Basant Kabra has been Chairman & MD since 1991, and his son Shiva Kabra is Joint MD; his daughter Ritu Joshi is a non-executive director. The CFO and company secretary are hired professionals. Promoters, including the family company Silver Plastochem (22.2%), own about 53%.

people.name: Basant Kabra
people.relation: Promoter; father of Joint MD Shiva Kabra and director Ritu Joshi
people.stake: 4.49% plus 2.24% held as 'Basant Kumar Kabra' (31 March 2025, FY25 annual report); promoter group 52.98%
people.bio: A chemical engineer with more than four decades running the company, which he has led as Chairman & MD since 1991. He built Control Print into an Indian maker of coding and marking printers and their inks and consumables, used to print dates and batch codes on packaged goods. He was 79 at the time of the FY25 report and was paid ₹7.60cr that year, up 92% on the year.

people.name: Shiva Kabra
people.since: Joint MD (marketing, business development and strategy)
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman & MD Basant Kabra, brother of director Ritu Joshi
people.stake: 9.93% (31 March 2025, FY25 annual report), the largest individual holding
people.bio: A graduate in economics and mathematics from Grinnell College, USA, with an MBA from INSEAD, France. He has over 15 years in marketing, business development and strategy and oversees these areas at Control Print; he writes publicly on security inks and anti-counterfeiting. His FY25 pay was 18 times the median employee, against 179 times for his father.

people.name: Jaideep Barve
people.since: KMP as of the FY25 annual report
people.bio: The company's CFO and a key managerial person alongside the two MDs and the company secretary. His pay rose 14.5% in FY25. The annual report and the company website do not give his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: Promoter Pushpa Kabra died on 4 May 2025; her 8.76% was awaiting transmission at the FY25 report. The FY26 annual report was not yet on the exchange when this was written, so stakes are as of 31 March 2025; promoters were still about 53% in 2026.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Gopal Srinivasan branch of the TVS family. Gopal Srinivasan, a third-generation TVS family member, is non-executive Chairman and, since the December 2025 merger of his holding company TVS Investments into the company, owns 59.71% directly. His wife Srilalitha Gopal is Managing Director. The company also pays a family-nominated firm a brand fee of up to 1% of net sales for use of the TVS name. The CFO and business heads are hired professionals.

people.name: Srilalitha Gopal
people.since: Director since 10 November 2011; MD since 11 May 2018
people.relation: Promoter group; wife of Chairman and promoter Gopal Srinivasan
people.stake: 60 shares, about 0.00% (FY26 annual report); her husband owns 59.71%, promoter group 59.77%
people.bio: A computer-science engineering graduate from IISc Bengaluru, aged 58. She joined the board in November 2011 and became MD in May 2018, leading efforts to lift profitability and grow new businesses. She has also been MD of Harita Techserv, a group design-engineering and staffing firm, since 2008 and holds both roles. She is a director of TVS Wealth and TVS-Alpha Finance and of several family charitable foundations. She was paid ₹1.21cr in FY26 and is up for re-appointment at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: A. Kulandai Vadivelu
people.since: KMP as of the FY26 annual report
people.bio: The company's CFO and one of its three key managerial personnel with the MD and company secretary; he co-signs the CEO/CFO certificate on the accounts. His pay was 18 times the median employee in FY26, up 4%. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

people.name: C. Balaji
people.bio: Heads the products and solutions business, which sells the company's printers, keyboards, point-of-sale and other IT products. The annual report names him as senior management but does not give his education or earlier career.

people.name: Ramachandran Prebagar
people.role: Chief Revenue Officer – FSS and IMS
people.bio: Heads revenue for the FSS and IMS service businesses, in which the company provides after-sales and IT services for brands and enterprises. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: EMS business head Sathya Doraisamy resigned on 30 September 2025, and CHRO Nageshwar Rao on 24 April 2026. Independent directors M. Lakshminarayan and M. F. Farooqui retired in May 2025; Kamal Pant joined. TVS Investments merged into the company on 19 December 2025, so Gopal Srinivasan now holds his 59.71% directly; shareholders approved matching changes to the articles in April 2026.

companies.styleNote: Anupam Ghosh, who ran the condom business before the company took it over in 2024, is Promoter & MD and owns 61.99%. Reshant Ghosh, also a promoter, is Whole-time Director. Promoter Sonia Ghosh left the board in October 2025, and Amartya Ghosh served briefly as an additional whole-time director (October 2025 to February 2026). The report does not state how the Ghoshes are related. Some assets, loans and a factory lease still sit with promoter-linked entities, and the company has approved further related-party dealings with Anupam Ghosh.

people.name: Anupam Ghosh
people.since: Ran the business before the company took it over in 2024; MD since
people.relation: Principal promoter
people.bio: Has over 25 years of experience in healthcare products. He ran the operations of the condom business, including strategy and business development, before it was taken over by the listed company in 2024. His areas of work include leadership, HR, strategic planning, product development and business development. The company says he holds a patent on the machines it builds in-house. He was honoured with a leadership award in March 2026, and has a 75% interest in a related party with which the company deals.

people.name: Reshant Ghosh
people.relation: Promoter-family member; the report does not specify his link to Anupam Ghosh
people.bio: Founder and director of Anondita Healthcare and Rubber Products India, a subsidiary. He has about three years of experience in marketing and works on market analysis, marketing strategy and distributor engagement, and has helped build a pan-India network of distributors and retailers for the company's own brands.

companies.changes: Whole-time Director Sonia Ghosh (a promoter) resigned on 29 October 2025. Amartya Ghosh was an additional whole-time director from 22 October 2025 until 12 February 2026. Company Secretary Nutan Agrawal left in November 2025 and Bhawna Bisht took over on 1 December 2025. Sunita Naithani is CFO. In August 2026 the board approved a rights issue at ₹950 a share.

companies.styleNote: Founded by Rajesh Khakhar, who started a small dental lab in 1989; he is Chairperson & Whole-time Director. His nephew Sameer Merchant (Khakhar is his maternal uncle) is MD & CEO; both have been directors since 2004. Promoters and promoter group own 41.77% (Khakhar 16.95%, Merchant 15.79%, Jigna Rajesh Khakhar 7.84%). Private-equity investor OrbiMed holds 22.39%. The CFO is Dharmesh Dattani.

people.name: Rajesh Vrajlal Khakhar
people.since: Founder (dental lab, 1989); director since 8 July 2004; current term 16 August 2024 to 15 August 2029
people.relation: Founder and promoter; maternal uncle of MD & CEO Sameer Merchant
people.stake: 16.95% (93,17,526 shares, FY26 annual report); promoters and promoter group together 41.77%
people.bio: Aged 57, he completed higher secondary education at Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics, Mumbai, and has more than 37 years in the business. He started a small dental laboratory in 1989 and incorporated Laxmi Dental Export in 2004, building it into an integrated dental products company making crowns and bridges, clear aligners (Illusion), dental materials and children's dental products for India, the USA, the UK and Europe. He was featured by Forbes India in 2021. He is a director of the subsidiaries Bizdent Devices, Laxmi Dental Lab USA, Signature Smiles Dental Clinic and Glaze Dental Depo. He was paid ₹93 lakh in FY26.

people.name: Sameer Kamlesh Merchant
people.since: Director since 8 July 2004; MD & CEO for five years under the August 2024 approval
people.relation: Promoter; nephew of Chairperson Rajesh Khakhar
people.bio: Born in 1982, he completed the dental mechanic course at SDM College of Dental Sciences & Hospital, Dharwad, and has more than 20 years in the business. He has led the company's push into digital dentistry, and won the 'Technical Finesse' award from Bitein in 2018 and an award from the EURO Dental Academy in 2024. He was paid ₹93 lakh in FY26.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Nupur Joshi stepped down in October 2025; Suman Saha took over on 16 January 2026. Arun B. John was re-designated Chief Revenue Officer – Illusion Dental in March 2026. Other senior managers: Dharmesh Dattani (CFO), Amrish Desai (VP, Head of Operations USA & India; holds 2.01%) and Sarfaraz Merchant (VP, domestic lab operations). No KMP changes announced since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Rajendra Ravi Shanker Mishra, with the company since incorporation, is Managing Director and the only named promoter shareholder, with 65.21%. His wife Jyotsna Jawahar was Whole-time Director & CFO until she resigned on 27 August 2026 for maternity reasons; no new CFO has been announced. A hired CEO, Dipankar Ghoshal, joined in January 2026. The board has approved up to ₹50cr of FY27 dealings with Guardian Technologies (formerly Osel Technology), a promoter-group company.

people.name: Rajendra Ravi Shanker Mishra
people.since: With the company since incorporation; MD term to 15 January 2027, re-appointment to January 2030 proposed
people.relation: Promoter; husband of former Whole-time Director & CFO Jyotsna Jawahar
people.bio: Holds a diploma in computer science engineering from the BSF Institute of Technology. He has been with OSEL since it was set up and is responsible for overall supervision, risk and business development. He heads the LED display division and has over 19 years of experience in LED screen manufacturing and hearing-aid development. In August 2026 the board proposed re-appointing him as MD for three years from January 2027.

people.name: Dipankar Ghoshal
people.bio: Has more than two decades of leadership experience in telecom, direct-to-consumer and consumer technology businesses, with a focus on scaling multi-business companies and on P&L delivery. The company says his recent work has been in AI-driven digital transformation and emerging-market strategy. He was appointed CEO and a key managerial person in January 2026, alongside new heads for the hearing-aid business and government and defence sales. The appointment filing does not name his previous employers.

people.name: Mukesh Kumar Sinha
people.since: Current term to 15 January 2027; re-appointment to January 2030 proposed
people.bio: Holds a BSc from Ranchi University and a diploma in industrial relations and personnel management. He has more than 30 years in healthcare, medical technology and electronics, with earlier roles at Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Allergan India and HOYA Medical India, where he was Managing Director for India and South Asia. He heads OSEL's hearing-aid division.

companies.changes: Whole-time Director & CFO Jyotsna Jawahar (the MD's wife) resigned on 27 August 2026; no successor CFO has been announced. Dipankar Ghoshal became CEO in January 2026, when Deepak Kumar Sharma (Business Head – Hearing Aid) and Capt. Vivek Dobhal (VP Sales – Government & Defence) also joined. Ajay Thakur was appointed Independent Advisor from June 2026. Ms. Diksha is Company Secretary.

companies.styleNote: The Baid family founded the company in 1995 and the promoter group owns 62.23%. Himanshu Baid is MD, Rishi Baid is Joint MD and Vishal Baid is an executive director; the annual report says they and the non-executive director Jugal Kishore Baid, 84, are related to each other but does not spell out how. The chairman, D.R. Mehta, is a non-executive, non-promoter director. A hired executive runs Asia-Pacific and India since June 2026.

people.name: Himanshu Baid
people.relation: Founder and promoter; related to Joint MD Rishi Baid, Executive Director Vishal Baid and director Jugal Kishore Baid
people.stake: 7.80% (79,07,624 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 62.23%
people.bio: Aged 58, he holds a bachelor's in electronics and communication engineering from Karnatak University, Dharwad, and has over 29 years in medical devices. He founded Poly Medicure in 1995 to make affordable, high-quality devices and leads its global operations, sales and growth; the company now sells in over 125 countries. He won the EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2024 award (healthcare and life sciences). He is Vice President of NATHEALTH and Co-Chair of the FICCI Medical Devices Committee, and sits on the boards of Exicom Tele-Systems and Aditya Infotech.

people.name: Rishi Baid
people.relation: Promoter; related to MD Himanshu Baid, Executive Director Vishal Baid and director Jugal Kishore Baid
people.bio: Aged 54, he holds a BS and an MS in mechanical engineering from West Virginia University, USA, and has over 28 years in medical-device engineering, manufacturing and R&D. He leads engineering, product innovation, automation, manufacturing and regulatory compliance, and has built the company's patent portfolio across several countries. He received the Prime Minister's Innovation Award in 2016.

people.name: Vishal Baid
people.since: Joined 1 June 2011; Executive Director from 6 May 2025 for five years
people.relation: Promoter group; related to Himanshu, Rishi and Jugal Kishore Baid
people.bio: Aged 51, he is a chartered accountant with over 26 years of experience. He joined Poly Medicure in 2011 and was Senior President – Sales & Marketing before joining the board in May 2025. He is responsible for marketing, corporate finance and manufacturing at the Jaipur plants. He chaired CII Rajasthan in 2020–21 and is a member of EO and YPO.

people.name: Pankaj Kumar Gupta
people.since: Joined 18 February 2008; Executive Director from 8 August 2025 for five years
people.bio: Aged 51, he completed a four-year tool engineering course at the Institute of Tool Room Training (ITTUP) and has about 36 years in medical devices and manufacturing. He specialises in precision tooling, production planning, automation, lean manufacturing and supply chain. He joined the company in 2008 and the board in August 2025.

people.name: Indranil Mukherjee
people.role: CEO – Asia Pacific and India Business
people.bio: A chemistry graduate from St. Xavier's College, Ranchi, with an MBA from Bhopal University; he also attended IIM Calcutta's senior management programme and INSEAD Singapore. He has over 30 years in medical technology. He spent his early career at B. Braun in India, moved to its German headquarters as Global Sales Manager in 2010, then became Regional Head of Hospital Care for Asia-Pacific in Penang, and later MD of B. Braun India, where he led a turnaround across three plants and over 2,000 staff. He was then Group CEO of Translumina Therapeutics, a cardiovascular implants company.

companies.changes: Indranil Mukherjee joined as CEO – Asia Pacific and India on 1 June 2026. Deputy Company Secretary Ravi Prakash resigned from 10 August 2026. Mukulika Baid left the board in May 2025. Other senior managers: Naresh Vijayvergiya (CFO since April 2020), Avinash Chandra (Company Secretary), Rahul Gautam (Corporate Strategy) and Abhinav Gera (VP HR, from October 2025).

companies.styleNote: Founded in Jammu in 1999 by husband and wife Atul Modi (Chairman & MD) and Namrata Modi (Whole-time Director & CFO), who own 37.52% and 36.03%. Their son-in-law Vaibhav Munjal is Director & Chief Marketing Officer, and their daughter Niharika Modi (an IBM executive) is a non-executive director. The only outside executive on the board is R&D director Dr Sai Kalyan Surapaneni. Atul Modi had a medical emergency in June 2026 that delayed the results call; he is recovering. Three independent directors' terms ended in March–April 2026 and three new ones were appointed.

people.name: Atul Modi
people.relation: Co-founder; husband of Namrata Modi; father of Niharika Modi; father-in-law of Vaibhav Munjal
people.bio: Aged 72, he holds a BE in mechanical engineering and co-founded Prevest in Jammu in 1999 with his wife to make dental materials that dentists worldwide could afford. He has 27 years with the company and has built it from a small Jammu manufacturer into an exporter of dental biomaterials. He was paid about ₹1.4cr in FY26. He had a medical emergency in June 2026 that forced the results call to be postponed; the CFO and whole-time director led it instead.

people.name: Namrata Modi
people.since: Co-founder; director since 5 May 1999; re-appointed to 20 December 2028
people.relation: Co-founder; wife of Atul Modi; mother of Niharika Modi; mother-in-law of Vaibhav Munjal
people.bio: Aged 68, she holds an MBA and co-founded the company in 1999. She runs finance and accounts, including reporting, budgeting, cash flow, planning and compliance. She was re-appointed as whole-time director for three years from December 2025. She was paid about ₹1.4cr in FY26.

people.name: Vaibhav Munjal
people.relation: Son-in-law of Atul and Namrata Modi (husband of Niharika Modi)
people.bio: Aged 42, he holds a BE in mechanical engineering and an MBA. He worked at Samsung India before joining Prevest in April 2023. As CMO and an executive director he runs marketing; besides salary he earns a 2% commission on domestic sales above ₹20cr. He was paid about ₹1.36cr in FY26.

people.name: Dr Sai Kalyan Surapaneni
people.since: Board since 21 December 2020; re-appointed to 20 December 2028
people.bio: Aged 48, he holds BDS and MDS degrees and has over two decades in biomedical research, product development and translational innovation. He leads Prevest's R&D, sets its long-term research strategy, works with academic and industry partners and builds its patent portfolio. He is also a director of the subsidiary Denvisio Biomed. His pay exceeded the legal limit by ₹11.38 lakh over FY25–FY26 because profits were inadequate, and the 2026 AGM was asked to waive recovery.

companies.changes: Independent directors Nikhil Bobade and Sudeep Murthy (March 2026) and Pardeep Gandotra (April 2026) completed their terms; Piyush Gupta, Abhijeet Haridas (April 2026) and Sukhen Pal Babuta (May 2026) joined. The company secretary resigned in April 2026 and Pratul Gupta was appointed on 27 May 2026. Chairman & MD Atul Modi had a medical emergency in June 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Kolkata family business run by Sanjive Sehgal (Chairman & MD, an executive since 1983) and his son Aryan Sehgal (Whole-time Director). The two named promoters own 47.28% (Sanjive 26.98%, Aryan 20.30%). A non-executive nominee director (Ramanathan Subramanian Arun Kumar) also sits on the board. Santosh Kumar Agarwal is CFO as well as Company Secretary.

people.name: Sanjive Sehgal
people.since: Executive director since July 1983; MD since July 2018
people.relation: Promoter; father of Whole-time Director Aryan Sehgal
people.stake: 26.98% (1,43,54,248 shares, FY26 annual report); promoters together 47.28%
people.bio: Holds a BSc from St. Xavier's College, Kolkata, and has over 40 years in the industry, covering production, development, marketing and distribution of plastic labware. He has been an executive director of Tarsons since July 1983 and became Managing Director in July 2018. Shareholders re-appointed him as a director at the 24 September 2026 AGM when he retired by rotation.

people.name: Aryan Sehgal
people.since: Executive director from September 2014; Whole-time Director since July 2018
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Sanjive Sehgal
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in management from the University of Manchester, UK. He has more than 10 years in the industry, with experience in domestic and international business development, marketing, strategy, operations, P&L management and partnerships. He joined the board as an executive director in September 2014 and became Whole-time Director in July 2018.

people.name: Mani Kalyan Dusi
people.bio: Holds an MSc in biochemistry (university first rank) from Andhra University and completed executive leadership education at INSEAD. He has over 18 years in life sciences, pharmaceuticals and academic markets across Asia-Pacific. Before Tarsons he was Associate Director and Head – Commercial Enablement (APAC) at Merck Life Science, and earlier held leadership roles at Merck Life Science and Thermo Fisher Scientific. He won Merck's AAA award for marketing leadership. He was hired as Head – Revenue (India & APAC) and is now listed as Global Head – Revenue & Growth.

companies.changes: Mani Kalyan Dusi joined as a senior manager in May 2026. Head of HR Subhra Sankar Bose left on 15 June 2026. Independent director Girish Vanvari resigned in February 2026 and Vinesh Kriplani joined. Sanjive Sehgal was re-appointed as a director at the September 2026 AGM. Other senior managers: Santosh Kumar Agarwal (CFO & Company Secretary) and Lakshmananarayanan Balakrishna Reddy (VP – Operations).
