companies.styleNote: Founded in 2016 by two brothers: Dr Vikas Agarwal, a dentist, is Chairman & MD, and Sandeep Aggarwal is Whole-time Director and, since May 2026, also CFO. Two dentists, Dr Akanksha Aggarwal and Dr Rohan Bhatt, sit as non-executive directors. Two former promoter-group members (Manish Kumar, Nakul Varshney) were reclassified as public shareholders in October 2025. Key finance and secretarial jobs have turned over: the CFO left in March 2026 and the company secretary in July 2026.

people.name: Dr Vikas Agarwal
people.relation: Founder; brother of Whole-time Director & CFO Sandeep Aggarwal
people.stake: Not disclosed in the FY26 annual report
people.bio: A dental surgeon who studied at the Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences, New Delhi, and practised before founding the company in 2016 to fix the difficulty dentists faced in buying supplies. He is the product mind behind dentalkart.com and stays closely involved in product evaluation and category strategy. Under him the company grew into India's largest online-first dental procurement platform, serving about 1.4 lakh dental professionals, and in FY26 he led its entry into digital dentistry and more own-brand products.

people.name: Sandeep Aggarwal
people.role: Co-founder, Whole-time Director & Chief Financial Officer
people.since: Board since 29 August 2016; CFO from 26 May 2026
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Chairman & MD Dr Vikas Agarwal
people.stake: 23.85% (41,36,750 shares at 31 March 2026; 23.65% after warrant conversion in May 2026)
people.bio: Born in 1990, he holds a B.Tech in computer science and engineering from The LNM Institute of Information Technology, Jaipur. He has been on the board since the company was set up in 2016 and leads finance, technology and operations. He built DentalKart's fulfilment network, batch-traceability and quality systems and its technology platform, and steered the company through its listing. He took on the CFO role in May 2026 after the previous CFO resigned. He is also a director of Smileworks and Waldent Innovations.

companies.changes: CFO Gaurav Agarwal resigned on 24 March 2026; Sandeep Aggarwal became CFO on 26 May 2026. Company Secretary Nidhi resigned effective 31 July 2026. Independent director Ravi Parmeshwar resigned effective 7 August 2026. On 7 August 2026 the board proposed Sandeep Aggarwal's re-appointment on retirement by rotation at the 10th AGM.

companies.styleNote: There is no promoter group; the company is widely held. It is still led by its original team: co-founder Manish Gupta is Chairman and CEO, and early investor Dr Sanjay Parikh is an executive director. Co-founder Dr Rajesh Nair sits on the board as a non-executive director but also runs client work in the US subsidiary. The company says none of its directors or senior managers are related to each other.

people.name: Manish Gupta
people.role: Chairman, Executive Director & Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from IIT (BHU) Varanasi and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad. He has led Indegene from a 1998 start-up to a supplier to several of the world's top 20 drug companies, and took it public in May 2024. He has led more than 15 acquisitions that added medical, technology and clinical skills. He was a finalist for the EY Entrepreneur of the Year award and has alumni awards from IIT-BHU and IIM Ahmedabad. He sits on no other listed company board.

people.name: Dr Sanjay Suresh Parikh
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in electrical engineering from IIT Bombay, a master's in clinical engineering from Case Western Reserve University and a PhD in biomedical engineering from Johns Hopkins. He was an initial investor in Indegene and has helped set its strategy since the start. He has over 35 years of experience across pharma, medical devices and healthcare in developed and emerging markets, covering strategy, business development and operations. He has also taught as visiting faculty at IIT Bombay's biomedical engineering school.

people.name: Suhas Prabhu
people.bio: A B.Com graduate of Mangalore University and a chartered accountant. Before Indegene he worked at Sasken Communication Technologies. He joined Indegene in October 2005 as Senior Manager, Finance and rose through the finance team to become CFO in November 2022, ahead of the 2024 listing.

people.name: Dr Rajesh Bhaskaran Nair
people.role: Non-Executive Director; President of US subsidiary Indegene, Inc. (senior management)
people.since: Director since Oct 1998; heads Indegene, Inc. since Sep 2005
people.stake: 9.1% before the May 2024 IPO (RHP); current figure not given in the FY26 report
people.bio: A doctor by training (MBBS, University of Kerala) with a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad. He has been on Indegene's board since its first year, 1998, and was an executive director until February 2016, when he became non-executive. He is still paid as a senior manager because he runs the US subsidiary Indegene, Inc., where he has been President since 2005.

people.name: Viveksheel Ghai
people.role: Executive Vice President – Enterprise Commercial Solutions, Indegene, Inc.
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in civil engineering from IIT Bombay and a master's in marketing management from NMIMS Mumbai. Before Indegene he worked at Satyam Computer Services, International Data Management and Unilinx. He joined the US subsidiary in April 2011 as Senior Vice President, Business Development and now runs its enterprise commercial-solutions business.

people.name: Anand Kiran Nijegal
people.bio: Holds bachelor's and master's degrees in pharmacy from Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra. He joined Indegene in September 2000 as Head, Scientific Solutions and has led global operations as Executive Vice President since October 2010, which makes him one of the longest-serving members of the team.

people.name: Gaurav Kapoor
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in pharmacy from Bangalore University. He joined Indegene in February 2000 as Manager, Marketing and Business Development and moved to the US subsidiary as Executive Vice President in August 2017. He has spent more than 25 years with the company.

companies.changes: No changes in senior management during FY26. Jill DeSimone and Neeraj Bharadwaj joined the board in Jan 2026 as non-executive directors. Sameer Lal (EVP, Enterprise Medical, Indegene, Inc.) is also named senior management but is left out here to keep the list to seven.

companies.styleNote: The Lal family controls the company (about 53%) and two family members are still executive directors: Dr Arvind Lal as Executive Chairman and his wife Dr Vandana Lal as whole-time director in charge of lab quality. Day-to-day business is run by a hired CEO, Shankha Banerjee, and a hired Group CFO. Their daughter Dr Archana Lal Erdmann is a non-executive director (1.8%), and their son Anjaneya Lal (2.0%) is not on the board.

people.name: (Hony) Brig Dr Arvind Lal
people.relation: Promoter; husband of Dr Vandana Lal; father of director Dr Archana Lal Erdmann and of Anjaneya Lal
people.bio: Holds an MBBS from the University of Poona and a diploma in clinical pathology from the Armed Forces Medical College, where he is in the Hall of Fame. He built Dr Lal PathLabs into one of India's largest lab chains, and brought the first College of American Pathologists (CAP) accreditation to Indian lab services. He received the Padma Shri in 2009 and was the first civilian doctor given an honorary Brigadier's rank in the Armed Forces Medical Services. He chairs FICCI's Swasth Bharat public-health task force and runs the ALVL Foundation, a charity. Aged about 76; the AGM in July 2026 was asked to re-appoint him for another five years from April 2027.

people.name: Dr Vandana Lal
people.relation: Promoter; wife of Dr Arvind Lal; mother of Dr Archana Lal Erdmann
people.bio: An MD in pathology and a distinguished alumna of Lady Hardinge Medical College, University of Delhi, trained in quality assurance. She is the company's Chief Technical Officer and runs quality control across its labs; the group has 53 NABL-accredited labs and two CAP-accredited labs. She set up the National Reference Lab in Delhi and regional reference labs in Kolkata, Bengaluru and Mumbai, and started the transplant immunology department in 1990 after training in Sweden. During COVID she chaired the NABL technical committee that fast-tracked accreditation of RT-PCR labs. Aged about 70.

people.name: Shankha Banerjee
people.bio: An engineering graduate of Delhi College of Engineering with a management degree from SP Jain Institute, Mumbai. He spent about 14 years at Castrol India and BP Lubricants, rising to global market-space manager, and then was President, Sales & Marketing for the Middle East and Africa at Pidilite Industries. He joined Dr Lal PathLabs in July 2014 as regional COO and moved up through Chief Growth Officer, COO and CEO of associate and group companies. He became CEO in May 2024 after Bharath Uppiliappan resigned.

people.name: Ved Prakash Goel
people.role: Group Chief Financial Officer & CEO – International Business
people.since: Group CFO; re-designated to add international business in Aug 2024
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a law degree (LLB) and senior leadership programmes at IIM Ahmedabad and ISB. He has over 28 years of experience across manufacturing, mining, engineering, infrastructure and healthcare services. As finance head he led the company's 2015 IPO and its acquisitions, including Suburban Diagnostics in Mumbai in 2021. Since August 2024 he also runs the international business (Nepal, Bangladesh and other overseas units).

people.name: Jai Prakash Meena
people.since: Listed as senior management as of 31 Mar 2026
people.bio: Named as Chief Operating Officer in the company's list of senior management in the FY26 annual report. The report does not give his background, and we could not source it from the company.

companies.changes: No change in key managers during FY26. From 30 Apr 2026, Chief Scientific Officer Dr Reena Nakra and Chief Lab Management Officer Dr Saloni Khera were added to senior management. Other named senior managers: Munender Soperna (Group Chief Information & Digital Officer), Manoj Kumar Garg (Group CHRO), Vinay Gujral (Company Secretary).

companies.styleNote: The Shah family controls the company with 48.9% (Metz Advisory LLP 30.3%, two family trusts 18.2%, Ameera Shah 0.35%). Ameera Shah, who built the chain, is Chairperson and a whole-time director, but day-to-day running passed to a hired Managing Director, Surendran Chemmenkotil, in June 2025. Her father and founder Dr Sushil Shah, her sister Dr Aparna Rajadhyaksha and her husband Hemant Sachdev sit on the board as non-executive directors.

people.name: Ameera Shah
people.since: Took over her father's lab in 2001
people.relation: Promoter; daughter of founder Dr Sushil Shah; sister of director Dr Aparna Rajadhyaksha; wife of director Hemant Sachdev
people.stake: 0.35% directly (7,27,380 shares, 31 Mar 2026); promoter group together 48.9%
people.bio: Studied finance at the University of Texas at Austin and later completed Harvard Business School's Owner-President Management Program. She worked briefly at Goldman Sachs in New York before returning to India in 2001 to take over her father's single pathology lab in South Mumbai. She turned it into Metropolis, a national lab chain, and took it public in 2019. She was the company's executive head until mid-2025; since June 2025 a hired MD runs operations.

people.name: Surendran Chemmenkotil
people.since: Joined as CEO Jan 2023; MD since Jun 2025
people.stake: About 0.07% (1,35,464 shares, 31 Mar 2026); also holds RSUs
people.bio: Has over 36 years of experience across office automation, telecom and healthcare. Before Metropolis he was Managing Director and CEO of Airtel Networks in Nigeria, Airtel Africa's largest business, and held senior roles at Bharti Airtel and Xerox India. He joined Metropolis as CEO in January 2023 and was made Managing Director for three years from 1 June 2025.

people.name: Sameer Patel
people.role: Chief Financial Officer (also heads commercial, infrastructure, legal and secretarial)
people.bio: A chartered accountant with more than 20 years of experience. He started his career at Deloitte and later held senior finance roles at the Aditya Birla Group and at Restaurant Brands Asia (Burger King India). He joined Metropolis as CFO in February 2025, after the previous CFO, Rakesh Agarwal, left in November 2024.

companies.changes: Dr Nilesh Shah moved from President – Internal Assurance to an advisory role in May 2026 and is no longer senior management. The company also names 12 other senior managers, including Dr Kirti Kazi (Chief Scientific & Innovation Officer), Alangadan Kannan and Bhoopendra Rajawat (regional Chief Business Officers), Pinakin Shah (CIO) and Dr Monika Prabhakar (Group Head – Lab Operations, since June 2025).

companies.styleNote: A Tantia family business of the Kolkata-based GPT Group. The family owns control through the promoter company GPT Sons (65.6% as of FY25); individual family members hold only token shares. Surgeon Dr Om Tantia, a founding promoter, is Chairman and Managing Director; his son Anurag Tantia is an executive director; his wife Dr Aruna Tantia and fellow promoter Shree Gopal Tantia sit on the board as non-executive directors. Another son, Dr Mridul Tantia, works in the hospitals as Vice President, and his daughter-in-law Dr Niharika Tantia is a paid consultant.

people.name: Dr Om Tantia
people.relation: Promoter; husband of director Dr Aruna Tantia; father of Anurag Tantia and Dr Mridul Tantia
people.stake: 300 shares (nil in % terms, 31 Mar 2026); family controls 65.6% through GPT Sons
people.bio: A surgeon with more than 41 years in Indian healthcare. He is a known bariatric and metabolic surgeon, heads the minimal-access and bariatric surgery department of the ILS hospitals and has been the group's Medical Director. He has been named a Surgeon of Excellence by the Surgical Review Corporation (USA) and is a Fellow of the Association of Surgeons of India. He was Managing Director while fellow promoter Dwarika Prasad Tantia was Executive Chairman, and became Chairman as well after Mr Tantia's death in August 2025.

people.name: Anurag Tantia
people.relation: Son of Dr Om Tantia and Dr Aruna Tantia; brother of Dr Mridul Tantia
people.bio: Holds a Bachelor of Science in Management with honours from the University of Illinois. He has more than 13 years of experience in hospital management, including running the company's day-to-day operations. He signs the company's accounts with the CFO and company secretary.

people.name: Kriti Tantia
people.bio: A B.Com graduate of the University of Calcutta and a chartered accountant who ranked 38th in the all-India CA exam in 2003. She has more than 20 years of experience in finance and accounting in the healthcare and infrastructure businesses. The company's disclosures do not name her as a relative of any director.

companies.changes: Executive Chairman and promoter Dwarika Prasad Tantia died on 17 Aug 2025; Dr Om Tantia became Chairman and Managing Director. Shree Gopal Tantia joined the board in Sep 2025 as a non-executive director. Dr Mridul Tantia was made Vice President in Feb 2026. Debashis Dhar, Senior Vice President and Chief Business Development Officer, resigned on 2 Apr 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Dr S P Vasireddi is Executive Chairman and his daughter Harita Vasireddi has been Managing Director since 2013. Co-promoter Harriman Vungal is executive director for operations. Promoters together own 30.3%. Executive director Satya Sreenivas Neerukonda is married to the company secretary, Sujani Vasireddi; the company does not class him as a promoter or as a relative of the founder.

people.name: Dr S P (Sivalinga Prasad) Vasireddi
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father of MD Harita Vasireddi
people.bio: Holds a PhD in chemistry and an honorary DSc, with nearly five decades in the industry; the company calls him the father of India's contract research and testing industry. He founded Vimta and was Chairman and MD until July 2013, then Executive Chairman to June 2018 and non-executive Chairman to June 2023, before taking the executive role again. He has sat on national scientific bodies, including the FSSAI Central Advisory Committee and the governing board of NABL, and helped set up the VIMTA-UNIDO South-South cooperation training centre. Aged 78; shareholders were asked in June 2026 to re-appoint him for five more years to June 2031.

people.name: Harita Vasireddi
people.since: Joined 1995; MD since Jul 2013 (current term to Jul 2029)
people.relation: Promoter group; daughter of the founder, Dr S P Vasireddi
people.bio: Holds a B.Pharm from Mysore University and an MBA in operations management from Boston College, USA. She joined Vimta in 1995 as executive assistant to the Managing Director and moved up through operational and management roles before becoming MD in 2013. She has about 28 years of experience in contract research and testing. She is also an independent director of Avantel Ltd, a listed company.

people.name: Harriman Vungal
people.relation: Co-promoter (not related to the Vasireddi family by any disclosed tie)
people.bio: Holds a D.Tech from Toronto. He is a co-promoter and has been an executive director since the company was set up in 1990, serving as its technical director. He brings expertise in laboratory operations and regulatory compliance and has about 47 years of experience. Aged 74.

people.name: Satya Sreenivas Neerukonda
people.relation: Husband of Company Secretary Sujani Vasireddi
people.bio: Holds a B.Pharm from Nagpur University and an MBA in marketing from the University of Oklahoma. He worked as a quality assurance engineer at IMPAC Medical Systems in Mountain View, California, before joining Vimta, where he rose from manager to Global Senior Vice President and head of business development. He focuses on winning clients and growing the business, and has about 26 years of experience in India and the US.

people.name: Siva Rama Krishna Kambhampati
people.bio: Appointed CFO by the board in January 2025, effective 6 March 2025, after the previous CFO, D R Narahai Naidu, left in December 2024. The annual report does not give his earlier background.

companies.changes: No change in key managers since the annual report. Shareholders were asked at the June 2026 AGM to re-appoint Dr S P Vasireddi as Executive Chairman from 1 Jul 2026 to 30 Jun 2031.

companies.styleNote: Thyrocare is controlled by Docon Technologies, part of PharmEasy's parent API Holdings, which owns 51% after selling about 10% in October 2025 and another 9.9% on 13 August 2026; since 17 August 2026 none of its shares are pledged. The company is run by hired managers: Chairman, MD and CEO Rahul Guha is also MD and CEO of API Holdings. The parent's nominees sit on the board as non-executive directors. No directors are related to each other.

people.name: Rahul Franklin Guha
people.role: Chairman, Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer
people.since: MD & CEO since May 2022 (re-appointed to May 2032)
people.bio: An engineering graduate of the University of Mumbai with a PGDM from IIM Bangalore. He spent 17 years at Boston Consulting Group, where as Senior Partner he led the healthcare and life sciences practice in India. Earlier he co-founded and ran Nautilus Software and was Chief Technology Officer at ValuePay.com. He is also MD and CEO of API Holdings (PharmEasy), the ultimate parent. In May 2026 the board re-appointed him for five more years from May 2027.

people.name: Vikram Gupta
people.bio: A B.Com graduate of Delhi University and a chartered accountant since 2004, with over 20 years in strategy, business finance, fund-raising and governance. Before Thyrocare he was head of corporate financial planning and analysis at Rebel Foods, where he worked on its recent fund-raise. Earlier he held senior finance roles at Tata Play Fiber and Vodafone Idea. He replaced Alok Kumar Jagnani, who moved to the board as a non-executive director in July 2025.

people.name: Dr Ramesh Kinha
people.bio: A pathologist (MBBS, MD in pathology) with senior management programmes at IIM Nagpur and ISB, and an NABL assessor. He has over 17 years in diagnostics. Just before Thyrocare he was Group Director, Laboratory Services at Vijaya Diagnostic Centre, and earlier held leadership roles at Apollo Health & Lifestyle, Medall Healthcare, Metropolis Healthcare and SRL.

people.name: Rajdeep Panwar
people.bio: Holds an M.Sc in biochemistry and a B.Sc in medical laboratory technology, with more than 21 years running diagnostic networks, lab operations and sales. Most recently he was Director at GHL Pharma & Diagnostics (Medanta Labs), where he built its lab and pharmacy business in North India. Earlier he held roles at Apollo Diagnostics, Dr Lal PathLabs, Ortho Clinical Diagnostics (Johnson & Johnson), Quest Diagnostics India, Sitaram Bhartia Institute and Pathnet India.

companies.changes: CFO Alok Kumar Jagnani stepped down in Jul 2025 (now a non-executive director); Vikram Gupta took over. Parent nominees Dharmil Sheth and Dr Dhaval Shah left the board on 7 May 2026, replaced by API Holdings executives Uday Patel Kadam and Gaurav Verma. During FY26, Chief Commercial Head Nitin Chugh and VPs Amit Bhola and Harinder Singh resigned.

companies.styleNote: Founder Dr S Surendranath Reddy is Executive Chairman, his daughter Suprita Reddy is Managing Director and CEO, and his son Sunil Chandra Kondapally is an executive director. His wife S Geeta Reddy sits on the board as a non-executive director. The family owns about 52.5%. The finance and secretarial seats have turned over often: four CFOs in about 16 months, and two company secretaries have left in 2026.

people.name: Dr S Surendranath Reddy
people.relation: Promoter; husband of director S Geeta Reddy; father of Suprita Reddy and Sunil Chandra Kondapally
people.bio: A radiologist: MBBS from Sri Venkateswara University and MD in radiology from Osmania Medical College, Hyderabad. He founded Vijaya and has over 40 years of experience, building it into what the company calls South India's largest integrated diagnostic chain. He is a life member of the Indian Radiological and Imaging Association and has received an Abbott award for leadership in in-vitro diagnostics and a Healthcare Entrepreneur of the Year award (2019).

people.name: Suprita Reddy
people.relation: Promoter group; daughter of the founder and of director S Geeta Reddy; sister of Sunil Chandra Kondapally
people.bio: A commerce graduate of Osmania University with over 23 years at Vijaya. As MD and CEO she runs strategy, clinical quality, operations and expansion. She has won ABP's Women Leadership Award in Healthcare and is involved in rural education and healthcare work.

people.name: Sunil Chandra Kondapally
people.relation: Promoter group; son of the founder and of director S Geeta Reddy; brother of Suprita Reddy
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from Florida State University and has over 24 years in healthcare. At Vijaya he has worked across operations, quality accreditation, finance, marketing and expansion of the network. He also founded Trikona Pharmaceuticals and earlier founded QPS Bioserve India.

people.name: Narasimha Raju K A
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 20 years in finance, who started at S R Batliboi & Co (the Ernst & Young affiliate) and has worked in healthcare, diagnostics, renewable energy and real estate. He was Vijaya's CFO from March 2021 to March 2025 and ran its IPO during the pandemic. He then was CFO of the Yashoda Group of Hospitals before returning to Vijaya in July 2026.

people.name: Sivaramaraju Vegesna
people.bio: Appointed Chief Operating Officer in February 2026 and named as senior management. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: CFO turnover: S Ramachandra Reddy (interim) left Feb 2026; Ankit Shah was CFO from Feb 2026 and resigned effective 24 Jul 2026; Narasimha Raju K A returned as CFO on 9 Jul 2026. Company secretary Hansraj Singh left in Mar 2026; his successor Naga Vasudha Tadepalli joined Jun 2026 and resigned on 26 Aug 2026. CTO Sai Siva Prasad resigned (left 8 Aug 2026); Dr Venkata Naresh Yallapragada joined as Chief Information Officer on 2 Sep 2026. Independent director Dr Manjula Anagani left the board on 21 Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by two of its founding promoters, who are not related to each other: Dr Somnath Chatterjee (Chairman and Joint MD) and Ritu Mittal (Joint MD and CEO). Promoters together own about 41%: Ritu Mittal 15.9%, Satish Kumar Verma 10.8% (a non-executive director), Sarla Kejriwal 9.2% (inherited from the late co-promoter Kishan Kumar Kejriwal) and Dr Chatterjee 5.1%. The company says no directors are related to each other.

people.name: Dr Somnath Chatterjee
people.relation: Promoter (not related to the other promoters)
people.bio: A doctor with an MBBS from the University of Calcutta, registered with the West Bengal Medical Council. He has been with Suraksha since it was set up and has more than 32 years of experience in medicine and diagnostics. He shares executive charge with Ritu Mittal as Chairman and Joint MD.

people.name: Ritu Mittal
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer
people.relation: Promoter (not related to the other promoters)
people.stake: 15.9% (82,95,437 shares, 31 Mar 2026) – the largest single shareholder
people.bio: A B.Com graduate of the University of Calcutta with more than 28 years in the medical and diagnostics business. She has been with Suraksha since it was set up and, as Joint MD and CEO, runs the business day to day; she signs the company's filings and its annual code-of-conduct declaration.

people.name: Dinesh Gupta
people.bio: A B.Com graduate of the University of Calcutta and a chartered accountant since 2011, with over 14 years in finance, including planning, analysis and strategy. Before Suraksha he was Assistant General Manager at Saranyu Power Trading, part of India Power Corporation. Earlier he worked as an assistant manager at Genpact in Kolkata and as a finance and accounts analyst at Maersk Global Services.

people.name: Niren Kaul
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from Pandit Ravishankar Shukla University and an MBA from the University of Pune. He has over 22 years of experience, including at Bharti Hexacom and Bharti Infratel.

companies.changes: Group CFO K S Ravindra, in the job from Mar 2025, resigned in Mar 2026 and left on 31 May 2026; Dinesh Gupta joined as CFO on 24 Aug 2026. Company Secretary Mamta Jain left on 15 Jul 2026. OrbiMed's nominee director Arun Sadhanandham left the board in Jun 2025. Other senior managers: Sangeeta Chakraborty (GM, Operations) and Balgopal Jhunjhunwala (Regional Business Head).

companies.styleNote: A Dubey family company (formerly Kilpest India, Bhopal). Brothers Dhirendra Dubey (Chairman and MD) and Nikhil Kuber Dubey (whole-time director and CFO) run it; their mother Mithla Dubey, aged 79, is a non-executive director and the largest shareholder (12.4%). The family and its companies (Mithala Laboratories 9.6%, a family HUF 2.3%) own at least 37% between them. There is no separate CEO or independent CFO.

people.name: Dhirendra Dubey
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Nikhil Kuber Dubey; son of director Mithla Dubey
people.stake: 8.4% (7,24,098 shares, 31 Mar 2026); family and its companies at least 37%
people.bio: Leads the company as Chairman and MD and signs its annual code-of-conduct declaration. Under him the company, which sells TRUPCR molecular test kits, bought in August 2025 Coris BioConcept of Belgium, a maker of rapid tests for antibiotic resistance, its first acquisition after a long search. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

people.name: Nikhil Kuber Dubey
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Dhirendra Dubey; son of director Mithla Dubey
people.bio: Serves as both a whole-time director and the company's CFO, and co-signs the CEO/CFO certificate on the accounts with his brother. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: No change in key managerial personnel during FY26. Company Secretary is Navneet Kaur.

companies.styleNote: Founder Vikram Vuppala is Chairman and Managing Director. For its IPO the company named him and its private-equity backers (Edoras 28.3%, Bessemer 8.7%, Investcorp funds 5.8%, Healthcare Parent 5.8%) as promoters; together they hold about 58%. Mr Vuppala himself owns 9.8%. The funds have nominee directors on the board. A hired Group CEO, Rohit Singh, runs operations. No directors are related to each other.

people.name: Vikram Vuppala
people.since: With the company since Dec 2009 (founded 2010); Chairman since Jul 2025
people.relation: Founder and promoter
people.stake: 9.8% (98,24,227 shares, 31 Mar 2026); promoter group together about 58%
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech from IIT Kharagpur and an MBA from Chicago Booth. Before NephroPlus he worked at McKinsey & Company, ZS Associates and Abbott Laboratories, and he has over 21 years in consulting and healthcare. He founded NephroPlus in Hyderabad in 2010 with co-founder Kamal Shah; it runs dialysis clinics in India and overseas markets such as the Philippines, Uzbekistan and Nepal. He leads its global expansion, partnerships and governance. In July 2025 he was re-appointed MD for five years and also made Chairman.

people.name: Kamal D Shah
people.bio: Co-founded NephroPlus with Vikram Vuppala. He has been on dialysis himself for more than 28 years, and the company says his experience as a patient shapes its focus on patient dignity and care. He is not on the board or in the list of key managerial personnel.

people.name: Rohit Singh
people.bio: Was Chief Operating Officer of the company before the board made him Group CEO and a key managerial person in May 2025. The annual report does not give his earlier background.

people.name: Prashant Goenka
people.role: Group Chief Financial Officer & Chief Risk Officer
people.since: Joined May 2024; also CRO since Apr 2026
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical and electronics engineering and a master's in economics from BITS Pilani, and an MBA from Chicago Booth. He is a certified Six Sigma Master Black Belt and spent over 20 years in financial services in the US, the Philippines and India, at banks including HSBC, Bank of America and JP Morgan Chase. He joined NephroPlus in May 2024 and runs finance, strategy, administration, secretarial and technology; he was also made Chief Risk Officer in April 2026.

people.name: Sukaran Singh Saluja
people.role: Chief Executive Officer – India and Nepal
people.bio: Named as senior management, heading the India and Nepal business. The annual report does not give his earlier background.

companies.changes: Rohit Singh became Group CEO in May 2025. Company Secretary Gulshan Goyal was replaced by Kishore Kathri in Jul 2025. CFO Prashant Goenka also became Chief Risk Officer in Apr 2026. No KMP changes announced since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Biocon owns 52.4% (promoter group 52.7%), and Biocon's founder Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw chairs Syngene. She moved from non-executive to Executive Chairperson on 1 Apr 2026 because of the leadership changes. Day-to-day running is by a hired MD and CEO: Siddharth Mittal, Biocon's former MD and CEO, took over on 1 Jul 2026 from Peter Bains. Director Prof Catherine Rosenberg is her sister-in-law; no other directors are related.

people.name: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
people.relation: Founder of promoter Biocon; sister-in-law of director Prof Catherine Rosenberg
people.bio: A first-generation entrepreneur with nearly five decades in biotechnology, she founded Biocon and is its Executive Chairperson. She has received the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan, the French Legion of Honour, EY World Entrepreneur of the Year and the Order of Australia. She sits on the boards of Narayana Hrudayalaya and Trent in India and PureTech Health, and on bodies such as MIT Corporation and Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. She took an executive role at Syngene from April 2026, which the company linked to changing business needs and the leadership changes.

people.name: Siddharth Mittal
people.bio: Has close to three decades of business leadership experience. He spent 13 years at Biocon, first as Chief Financial Officer and then as Managing Director and CEO, where he helped expand its global presence, win key regulatory approvals and launch its GLP-1 drugs in major overseas markets. He joined Syngene as MD and CEO on 1 July 2026, saying his first priorities are sharper selling, better delivery and cost discipline to restore growth.

people.name: Deepak Jain
people.role: Chief Financial Officer (also supply chain, legal and secretarial)
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com from Calcutta University and over 25 years of experience. He started at Ernst & Young India, held leadership roles at Procter & Gamble, and was India CFO for Apple and for First Advantage. Before Syngene he was CFO of Ather Energy for four years. At Syngene he also runs supply chain, legal and secretarial.

people.name: Abhijit Zutshi
people.bio: A licensed pharmacist with an MBA and Harvard Business School executive education, with 27 years in pharma sales. He began as a product specialist at Wyeth Lederle (now Pfizer) and then spent nearly 25 years at Biocon, moving to the US in 2006 to lead North American operations. Most recently he was Chief Commercial Officer of Biocon's generics business, covering both drug substances and finished drugs.

people.name: Dr Jayashree Aiyar
people.bio: A molecular pharmacologist with a PhD in immunology from AIIMS, New Delhi and post-doctoral work at Caltech and UC Irvine. She led drug-discovery programmes at AstraZeneca, Merck, Ambrx and Theravance in the US and at Jubilant Biosys in India, and has over 30 publications and two patents. She joined Syngene in 2016 to lead discovery biology and now sets its scientific strategy.

people.name: Alok Mehrotra
people.role: Chief Quality, Engineering and Safety Officer
people.bio: Holds an M.Tech in chemical (food) technology from Harcourt Butler Technological Institute and has over 25 years in manufacturing, quality and safety. He worked at Dr Reddy's, Reckitt Benckiser, Pepsi Foods and Godrej Foods, and was most recently Head of Global Quality Management at Dr Reddy's. At Syngene he runs quality and compliance and the company's facilities.

people.name: Maninder Kapoor Puri
people.bio: Has nearly three decades in HR across biopharma, IT services and consulting. She was CHRO of Biocon, Global CHRO of Mastek (40+ countries), and held senior roles at Accenture and Firstsource Solutions. She joined Syngene as CHRO in May 2026.

companies.changes: MD & CEO Peter Bains resigned in Mar 2026 and left on 30 Jun 2026; Siddharth Mittal replaced him on 1 Jul 2026. Interim CCO Caroline Hempstead left Mar 2026; CHRO Andrew Webster and SynVent head Dr Kenneth Barr left Apr 2026. Independent director Kush Parmar resigned on 29 Jul 2026. Head of Corporate Affairs Pramuch Goel resigned on 21 Sep 2026. New Executive Committee members in Aug 2025: Ajay Tandon (strategy), Gaurav Kushwaha (CTO), Dr Mrinal Kammili (clinical research), Dr Subhendu Kumar (chemistry).

companies.styleNote: Founder-run. Promoter Sriram Natarajan is CEO and an executive director; his wife Sangeetha Sriram is executive director for operations; co-promoter Dr Chandrasekhar Nair, is executive director and Chief Technology Officer. Their son Shiva Sriram is President, Business Development. Before the 2026 IPO the promoters held about 46.7% (the Srirams through Exxora Trading LLP 41.2%, Dr Nair 5.4%).

people.name: Sriram Natarajan
people.relation: Promoter; husband of Sangeetha Sriram; father of Shiva Sriram
people.stake: nil directly; with his wife controls Exxora Trading LLP, which held 41.2% before the IPO (RHP)
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc in botany and an M.Phil in botany from Delhi University and an M.Sc in plant physiology from Tamil Nadu Agricultural University. He has 35 years in developing, making and selling diagnostic devices and kits in India and abroad, and earlier co-founded Tulip Diagnostics, where he was a director. As CEO he runs business management and strategy. He shared the Economic Times Healthcare Award 2021 for COVID-19 research with Dr Nair and was named Businessperson of the Year 2025 (medium company) by BioSpectrum. Aged 67.

people.name: Dr Chandrasekhar Bhaskaran Nair
people.relation: Co-promoter (not related to the Srirams)
people.stake: 5.4% (61,09,850 shares, held jointly with Anita Angela Chandrasekhar; pre-IPO, RHP)
people.bio: Holds bachelor's and master's degrees in engineering (chemistry) from BITS Pilani and a PhD from the School of Bio Sciences and Technology at VIT University. He has 34 years in translational research and earlier headed engineering and computer sciences at the Vittal Mallya Scientific Research Foundation. He leads Molbio's research and development. He won the Infosys Prize 2021 in engineering and computer science. Aged 58.

people.name: Sangeetha Sriram
people.relation: Promoter; wife of Sriram Natarajan; mother of Shiva Sriram
people.stake: nil directly; designated partner of promoter Exxora Trading LLP
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc from Sri Venkateswara University and an M.Sc in botany from Delhi University. She oversees operations and administration and has five years of experience in the diagnostics sector. Aged 66.

people.name: Shiva Sriram
people.relation: Son of Sriram Natarajan and Sangeetha Sriram
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc in biochemistry from Delhi University and a master's in biochemical engineering from University College London. He joined Molbio in April 2018 and leads business development; he is also a director of Prognosys Healthcare and of OptraScan. He was paid ₹40.1 million in FY26, the highest of the senior managers listed.

people.name: Manan Bimal Khokhani
people.role: President – Finance & Accounts and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: A B.Com graduate (H.L. College of Commerce, Gujarat University) and a chartered accountant with 15 years in finance and accounts. He worked at Larsen & Toubro, Thermo Fisher Scientific India and Worley Services India before joining Molbio in December 2025.

people.name: Indraneil Borkakoty
people.role: President – Corporate Strategy, M&A and Investor Relations
people.bio: A Delhi University arts graduate with a PGDM from International Management Institute, New Delhi. He is a career investment banker: executive director at Kotak Mahindra Capital, and managing director at Nomura, IDFC Securities and Jefferies India. He joined Molbio in May 2024 to lead strategy, acquisitions and investor relations.

people.name: Dr Kuldeep Singh Sachdeva
people.bio: A doctor (MBBS, Delhi University) with an MBA in healthcare administration and diplomas in hospital management and disaster preparedness. He joined the central health service in 1988 and retired from the Health Ministry in 2021, having been Deputy Director General at the National AIDS Control Organisation; he was then regional director of The Union's South-East Asia office (TB and lung disease). At Molbio he handles strategy and government partnerships.

companies.changes: CFO Manan Khokhani joined in Dec 2025, ahead of the IPO. No KMP changes announced on NSE since listing.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Rajendra Mutha is Chairman and a whole-time director; promoters own about 27% (Mr Mutha 24.75% and his company Krsnaa Diagnostics (Mumbai) 2.4%). Managing Director Yash Mutha is not related to him, the company says, and a hired Group CEO, Mitesh Dave, runs operations. No directors are related to each other. There is no permanent CFO: the long-time CFO left in Jan 2026 and an interim CFO has been in place since Apr 2026. Fund Phi Capital owns 15.4%; the board also has a nominee director.

people.name: Rajendra Mutha
people.relation: Promoter
people.stake: 24.75% (80,29,920 shares, 31 Mar 2026); with his company, promoters about 27.1%
people.bio: A certified pharmacist registered with the Maharashtra State Pharmacy Council, with over three decades in healthcare. As promoter and Chairman he sets the company's strategy, and he heads the board's operations committee and its CSR committee. Under him the company has focused on affordable diagnostics across many parts of India, mainly through government partnerships, and has begun a retail business.

people.name: Yash Mutha
people.since: Joined 2017; director since Jan 2019; MD since Feb 2025
people.relation: Not related to any director or KMP, per the company
people.bio: A B.Com graduate of the University of Pune and a chartered accountant, who has also passed the Certified Fraud Examiner (USA) and CISA exams. He has over 20 years in strategy, operations and business management. He joined Krsnaa in 2017, oversaw key operating functions, joined the board in 2019 and became Managing Director in February 2025. Aged 45.

people.name: Mitesh Dave
people.bio: Appointed Group CEO in May 2024, after the previous CEO, Prashant Deshmukh, lasted from February to July 2024. He signs the company's CEO/CFO certificate with the interim CFO. The annual report does not give his earlier background.

people.name: Chandra Prakash Singh
people.bio: Named interim CFO in April 2026 after Pawan Daga, CFO since November 2020, resigned in January 2026. The annual report does not give his background.

companies.changes: CFO Pawan Daga resigned on 19 Jan 2026; Chandra Prakash Singh is interim CFO from 17 Apr 2026. Executive director Pallavi Bhatevara retired from the board on 25 Apr 2026. Independent directors Chhaya Palrecha and Rajiv Verma left in Apr 2026; Raju Venkatraman (founder of Medall) and Jessie Paul joined.

companies.styleNote: Now renamed Health X Platform Ltd. Promoter Banwari Lal Mittal is Chairman and Managing Director and also runs the main operating subsidiary, Sastasundar Healthbuddy, as its Executive Chairman, MD and CEO. His wife Abha Mittal and co-promoter Ravi Kant Sharma sit on the board as non-executive directors. The promoter group owns 74.9%.

people.name: Banwari Lal Mittal
people.since: With the company since May 2005; current MD term to Jun 2028
people.relation: Promoter; husband of director Abha Mittal
people.bio: A chartered accountant, company secretary and cost accountant (FCA, FCS, FCMA). He has been with the company since May 2005 and is its largest shareholder. He also serves as Executive Chairman, MD and CEO of the material subsidiary Sastasundar Healthbuddy, which pays his salary; he takes no pay from the listed company. He was re-appointed MD and CEO for three years from July 2025. Aged 57.

people.name: Lokesh Agarwal
people.bio: A chartered accountant who came from Sastasundar Healthbuddy, the group's operating subsidiary, where he is also CFO and which pays his salary. He became CFO of the listed company in February 2025. Aged 40. The annual report gives no earlier career details.

companies.changes: No change in key managers or senior management during FY26. Company Secretary Pratap Singh (with the group since 2009) is the only other named key manager.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Tyagi family that founded it. Dr Ajay Kumar Tyagi is Chairman and Whole-time Director, his brother Dr Kapil Kumar is MD, and his son Yatharth Tyagi is a Whole-time Director. A hired team (Group CEO, COO and CFO) runs day-to-day operations and finance. The wives of the two brothers are also large holders; promoters own about 55.8%.

people.name: Dr Ajay Kumar Tyagi
people.relation: Promoter; brother of MD Dr Kapil Kumar; father of Whole-time Director Yatharth Tyagi
people.stake: 30.59% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); his wife Dr Neena Tyagi 0.62%, down from 6.47% a year earlier
people.bio: Holds an MBBS from LLRM Medical College, Meerut, and a diploma in orthopaedics from King George's Medical College, Lucknow. Before private practice he worked with the Directorate of Health & Family Welfare, Government of Uttar Pradesh. He co-founded Yatharth and leads its growth strategy, investments and business ties as it expanded across Delhi-NCR and beyond. He also sits on several family companies, including AKS Medical & Research Centre, Ramraja Multispeciality Hospital and Pristine Infracon. His wife cut her stake sharply during FY26.

people.name: Dr Kapil Kumar
people.relation: Promoter; brother of the Chairman; uncle of Yatharth Tyagi
people.stake: 12.62% (June 2026 shareholding pattern), with about 42% of his shares pledged; his wife Dr Manju Tyagi 11.96%
people.bio: An orthopaedic surgeon and alumnus of SN Medical College, Agra. He worked at several hospitals in Delhi before co-founding Yatharth. He has been with the company since it began and oversees the day-to-day running of the group's hospitals. He is also involved in several social and healthcare initiatives.

people.name: Yatharth Tyagi
people.relation: Son of the Chairman; nephew of the MD
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in business and management and a master's in international health management from Imperial College London. He joined the company in 2019 and the board in 2021. As the next generation of the family, he works on strategy, business development and expansion, and on bringing in new technology and care models.

people.name: Amit Kumar Singh
people.bio: Has more than 20 years in hospital operations, strategy, quality, business development and cost control. Before Yatharth he held leadership roles at BLK Hospital, Centre for Sight, Point Hospitals and Raksha Medicare. He is the company's CEO and a key managerial person.

people.name: Nitin Gupta
people.role: Group Chief Operating Officer & President – Finance
people.bio: A chartered accountant and IIM Lucknow alumnus with about 24 years of experience, 19 of them in healthcare. He specialises in finance, turnarounds, mergers, fund raising and governance. Before Yatharth he was Group CFO at Asian Hospitals and Group Finance Controller at Agilus Diagnostics.

people.name: Pankaj Prabhakar
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 24 years in accounting, budgeting, planning and internal controls, including IPO work and acquisitions. Before Yatharth he held finance leadership roles at Asian Institute of Medical Sciences, Max Healthcare and Artemis Healthcare.

people.name: Ashutosh Kumar Jha
people.role: Group Chief – Strategy, M&A and Investor Relations
people.bio: An IIT and IIM alumnus with more than 20 years across healthcare and other industries, focused on strategy, acquisitions, fund raising and investments. Before Yatharth he held leadership roles at Artemis Hospital, Max Healthcare, Bosch, Maruti Suzuki and a private equity firm. He replaced Neeraj Vinayak, who left in May 2025.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report. Ramesh Krishnan (ex-CEO South Asia, Parkway Pantai) joined as an independent director in November 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founder Dr Ramesh Kancharla is Chairman and MD, and co-promoter Dr Dinesh Kumar Chirla is a Whole-time Director; both were reappointed for five years from August 2026. His son Dr Adarsh Kancharla is a non-executive promoter director. A hired CEO (since January 2026) and a new CFO (September 2026) run operations and finance. Promoters own about 49.8%.

people.name: Dr Ramesh Kancharla
people.relation: Founder; father of non-executive director Dr Adarsh Kancharla
people.stake: 31.03% (FY26 annual report); son Adarsh 6.02% and Kancharla Family Trust 5.13%
people.bio: A paediatrician and paediatric gastroenterologist with an MBBS from Sri Venkateswara University and an MD in paediatrics from Mangalore University. He is a member of the Royal College of Physicians (UK) and trained in paediatric gastroenterology, hepatology and nutrition at King's College Hospital, London. He founded Rainbow and opened its first children's hospital in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, in 1999, and has grown it into a network of 24 hospitals. Awards include the Times Health lifetime achievement award (2022) and Financial Express Healthcare Leader of the Year (2024).

people.name: Dr Dinesh Kumar Chirla
people.since: On the board since 2005 (promoter); reappointed to August 2031
people.relation: Co-promoter; not related to the Kancharlas
people.stake: 6.53% (FY26 annual report), plus 1.02% through the Sai Geeta Dinesh Trust (June 2026 shareholding pattern)
people.bio: A neonatologist and paediatric intensivist with an MBBS and MD in paediatrics from Marathwada University and a DM in neonatology from Bombay University. He is a Fellow of the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health (UK) and trained in Australia and the UK. As Director of Intensive Care he built Rainbow's newborn and child intensive-care services and one of India's largest neonatal emergency transport networks. He has written over 75 research papers and held leadership roles in the National Neonatology Forum and the Indian Academy of Pediatrics.

people.name: Abrarali Dalal
people.bio: Has over 25 years in healthcare, covering hospital operations, turnarounds, growth strategy and network management. Before this role he was Managing Director and CEO of Sahyadri Hospitals in Maharashtra. He had earlier worked at Rainbow and at Fortis Healthcare. As CEO he runs Rainbow's growth, operations and expansion.

people.name: Sudarshan Patodia
people.bio: A chartered accountant and gold medallist with nearly 20 years in finance across healthcare, retail and FMCG. He spent about 14 years at ITC in treasury, planning, internal audit and business finance roles. He then was Vice President – Finance at Vishal Mega Mart, where he worked on its IPO, and later CFO of Centre for Sight, handling treasury, investor relations, fund raising and acquisitions.

people.name: Dr Preetham Kumar Poddutoor
people.role: Director – New Initiatives, Acquisitions and Medical Supply Chain
people.since: With Rainbow for over 20 years; elevated during FY26
people.bio: Completed his postgraduate training in paediatrics at Osmania Medical College with a fellowship in neonatology, and holds an executive MBA from the Indian School of Business. With Rainbow for over two decades, he now runs the supply chain, acquisitions and new initiatives while still practising as a consultant.

companies.changes: CFO Vikas Maheshwari resigned for personal reasons from 31 August 2026; Sudarshan Patodia joined as Group CFO on 23 September 2026. Chief Strategy & Growth Officer Srinath Metla, appointed in FY26, resigned from 5 September 2026. Anshuman Jaiswal was made Chief Legal Officer in July 2026.

companies.styleNote: A father-and-son company. Founder Dr Ajay Thakker, who set up the first Thane hospital in 2007, moved from Chairman & MD to Chairman & Whole-time Director in July 2026. His son Dr Ankit Thakker is MD & CEO. The family's other relatives, including the Chairman's brother-in-law Devang Gandhi, are in the promoter group. Promoters own about 40.9%.

people.name: Dr Ajay Thakker
people.since: Founder; Chairman & MD until July 2026, then Chairman & Whole-time Director for five years
people.relation: Founder; father of MD & CEO Dr Ankit Thakker
people.stake: 20.74% (FY26 annual report); family and group entities together about 40.9%, including Western Medical Solutions LLP 8.70%, Ankit 6.67% and Kirtika Thakker 2.03%
people.bio: Holds an MBBS from Grant Medical College, University of Bombay, and a diploma in medical radio-diagnosis from Topiwala National Medical College. He has more than 40 years in medicine and healthcare. He began with a scan and imaging centre in Thane about three decades ago and founded Jupiter's Thane hospital in 2007, followed by Pune (2017), Indore (2020) and Dombivli. He has been responsible for the overall management of the company. In July 2026 he gave up the MD title and became Chairman and Whole-time Director, leaving day-to-day leadership to his son.

people.name: Dr Ankit Thakker
people.since: With the company since 2014; executive director since June 2016; Joint MD & CEO from July 2025
people.relation: Son of the Chairman, Dr Ajay Thakker
people.stake: 6.67% (FY26 annual report); his wife Nikita Thakker 0.02%
people.bio: A medical doctor with a master's in management from the London School of Economics. He joined Jupiter in 2014 and the board as an executive director in 2016. He was made Joint MD and CEO for five years from July 2025 and now leads the company as MD and CEO. In July 2026 a Jupiter pharmacy subsidiary bought Sulcus, a company he and Kirtika Thakker owned, for ₹3.78cr at an independent valuation; investors should watch such related-party deals.

people.name: Harshad Purani
people.role: Chief Financial Officer; President – Administration and Head of CSR
people.since: Joined September 2007; CFO again from July 2026
people.bio: Holds a commerce degree from K.P.B. Hinduja College, University of Bombay, and an international executive MBA from United Business Institutes, Brussels. He has been with Jupiter since September 2007 and oversees administration across all its hospitals. He was CFO until May 2025, when Sivasis Sen took over. He returned as CFO on 31 July 2026 after Mr Sen resigned.

people.name: Aditya Gupta
people.bio: Has over 32 years of experience in medical devices, healthcare financing, corporate strategy and sales leadership. He brings experience in mergers, capital deployment and building healthcare platforms. He was named senior management in May 2026.

people.name: Dr Tushar Patil
people.since: With Jupiter about 16 years; SMP from May 2026
people.bio: Holds a medical degree from MUHS (2007) and a master's in health and hospital management from Dr D.Y. Patil (2010). He has been with Jupiter for about 16 years and earlier ran its Indore hospital. He now runs the new Dombivli hospital, which is still loss-making, and was named senior management in May 2026.

companies.changes: CFO Sivasis Sen, appointed in May 2025, resigned for personal reasons from 31 May 2026; Harshad Purani returned as CFO on 31 July 2026. Non-executive director Dr Bhaskar Shah resigned in May 2026. Dr Ajay Thakker became Chairman & Whole-time Director from 17 July 2026.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by the Kanwar family of Apollo Tyres through Constructive Finance, which owns 58.4% (about 45% of that stake is pledged). Chairman Onkar Kanwar, his son Neeraj Kanwar and daughter Shalini Kanwar Chand are all non-executive directors. The hospital is run by a hired MD, Dr Devlina Chakravarty, who is not related to them. IFC owns about 12%.

people.name: Dr Devlina Chakravarty
people.bio: A radiologist (MD, DNB, DMRD) trained at Mumbai University, with fellowships in head, neck and body imaging at the University of Berlin, UCLA and Brigham & Women's Hospital; she also holds a diploma in hospital administration. She was senior faculty and a radiology programme director at Delhi hospitals before joining Artemis in 2007. She now runs the company as its only executive director. In FY26 her pay included ₹44.4cr of stock-option perquisites, which made her a sizeable shareholder.

people.name: Sanjiv Kumar Kothari
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 30 years in finance and accounts. He has spent more than 20 years with the Apollo (Kanwar) group and has been at Artemis since September 2013. Earlier he worked at UltraTech Cement, Gujarat Perstorp and the Modi group.

people.name: Dr Vishal Arora
people.bio: Holds a BDS, a postgraduate diploma in hospital and health management from IIHMR Jaipur, and completed a senior leadership programme at IIM Ahmedabad. He has more than 14 years in healthcare operations, strategy and cost control. Before Artemis he worked at PwC, QRG Medicare, Medanta and the Asian Institute of Medical Sciences.

people.name: Dr Manju Aggarwal
people.role: Chief of Medical Services & Chairperson – Nephrology
people.bio: Holds an MBBS from Lady Hardinge Medical College, an MD in internal medicine from Maulana Azad Medical College, a DNB in nephrology, a fellowship from the University of Minnesota and an MBA in healthcare administration from FMS Delhi (2008). She has about 30 years in nephrology, transplants and critical care. She spent 17 years at Indraprastha Apollo before joining Artemis in 2012.

people.name: Flt Lt Saras Malik
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate degree in physics from Delhi University, business management training from MDI and a postgraduate qualification in hospital management from Symbiosis. Served eight years in the Indian Air Force and more than five years at Fortis Healthcare, with about 23 years in HR and administration, about 10 of them at Artemis.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report. Rudra Narayan Acharjee joined as Head of Investor Relations, M&A and Growth Strategy in September 2025. Tapan Mitra (May 2026) and Dr Girdhar Gyani (August 2026) joined as independent directors.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 2000 by cardiac surgeon Dr Devi Prasad Shetty, who is Chairman and Whole-time Director. His son Viren Shetty is Executive Vice-Chairman, and another son, Dr Anesh Shetty, is a non-executive director who runs the UK and Cayman businesses. Day-to-day management sits with a long-serving insider, MD & Group CEO Dr Emmanuel Rupert, who is not family. The Shetty family owns about 63%, and a UK loan requires them to keep at least 51%.

people.name: Dr Devi Prasad Shetty
people.relation: Founder; husband of Shakuntala Shetty; father of Viren, Varun and Anesh Shetty
people.stake: 11.66% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); wife Shakuntala Shetty 34.80%, and sons Viren, Varun and Anesh 5.00% each
people.bio: A cardiac surgeon with over 40 years of experience. He earned his MBBS from the University of Mysore in 1978 and a master's degree in 1982, and received a fellowship from the Royal College of Surgeons of England in 2009. He founded Narayana Hrudayalaya in 2000, pioneered paediatric heart surgery in India and inspired Karnataka's Yeshasvini micro-insurance scheme for farmers. He received the Padma Shri (2003) and Padma Bhushan (2012) and chairs the Board of Governors of IIM Bangalore. He also holds a US patent on software for following clinical protocols, and is still the public face of the group.

people.name: Viren Prasad Shetty
people.since: With the company since 2004; Executive Vice-Chairman since April 2022
people.relation: Son of the Chairman; brother of Dr Anesh Shetty and Dr Varun Shetty
people.bio: Holds a civil engineering degree from RV College of Engineering, Bengaluru, and an MBA from Stanford Graduate School of Business. He joined in 2004 and helped design and build key hospitals, including the Mazumdar Shaw Medical Center and the Jaipur and Ahmedabad hospitals. He was Executive Director and Senior Vice President – Strategy from 2012, and Whole-time Director and Group COO from 2019. Since April 2022 he has been Executive Vice-Chairman, giving strategic direction and grooming the next generation of leaders.

people.name: Dr Emmanuel Rupert
people.bio: A physician and alumnus of Banaras Hindu University. He joined Narayana Health in 2000 and held senior clinical and institution-building roles before taking charge in 2019. He has led several new and acquired hospitals to profitability, and the group became the first major Asia-Pacific network to get JCI enterprise-level accreditation under him. He is driving the group's digital and AI push and its large postgraduate training programme.

people.name: Sandhya Jayaraman
people.bio: A chartered accountant with close to 20 years at the Unilever and Wipro groups before joining Narayana. Her roles there covered business partnering, audit and risk, ethics, controllership, planning and analysis, shared services and supply-chain finance. She joined Narayana as Group CFO in December 2021 and was named Most Innovative CFO at the Business Leadership Awards 2022.

companies.changes: No KMP changes since the FY26 annual report. In FY26 the Group Chief Marketing Officer (Ashish Bajaj) and the CIO left; Jagadeesh R joined as Group Chief Digital Officer & CIO in October 2025. R. Venkatesh is Group COO.

companies.styleNote: Founder Dr Naresh Trehan, a heart surgeon, is Chairman & MD and also heads its Heart Institute as chief cardiac surgeon. Group CEO Pankaj Sahni, an ex-McKinsey hire, is married to Dr Trehan's daughter Shyel; another daughter, architect Shonan Purie Trehan, joined the board as a non-executive director in March 2026. Dr Trehan owns 33.0%, which is the whole promoter stake.

people.name: Dr Naresh Trehan
people.role: Chairman & Managing Director; Chairman, Heart Institute and Chief Cardiac Surgeon
people.since: Board since August 2004; Chairman & MD since June 2007 (founder)
people.relation: Founder; father of non-executive director Shonan Purie Trehan; father-in-law of Group CEO Pankaj Sahni
people.stake: 33.00% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); other family members and trusts hold almost nothing
people.bio: Holds an MBBS from the Faculty of Medicine, University of Lucknow, and is certified in thoracic and cardiac surgery by the American Board of Thoracic Surgery. He trained and worked as a Fellow in Thoracic Surgery at New York University Medical Centre (Bellevue, University Hospital and Manhattan V.A. Hospital). He founded Medanta and has been Chairman & MD since 2007, while still leading its Heart Institute. He received the Padma Shri (1991), Padma Bhushan (2001) and the Dr B.C. Roy Award (2005). Investors should note how much the brand rests on him.

people.name: Pankaj Sahni
people.since: With Medanta for over 12 years; on the board since January 2023
people.relation: Son-in-law of the Chairman (married to his daughter Shyel Trehan); brother-in-law of Shonan Purie Trehan
people.stake: 1,03,000 shares, about 0.04% (FY26 annual report), plus 15,000 share units granted under the 2024 incentive plan
people.bio: A chartered accountant with an MBA from the Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University. Before Medanta he was an Associate Principal at McKinsey & Company in New York and New Delhi. He has been with Medanta for more than 12 years, working across every part of its operations. As Group CEO he runs all hospital operations and guides strategy and growth. He was paid about ₹5.2cr in FY26.

people.name: Yogesh Kumar Gupta
people.bio: A chartered accountant with about 27 years in finance, accounting and commercial roles across pharma manufacturing, retail and healthcare. Before Medanta he was CFO of Sheares Healthcare India, overseeing its investee companies. Earlier he was Senior Vice President – Finance at Max Healthcare, where he led the move to a digital finance function. He became Medanta's CFO in February 2024.

people.name: Kedar Apte
people.since: Joined April 2026; senior management from May 2026
people.bio: Has over 23 years of experience at three companies: Unilever, BP/Castrol and Mahindra. His work spans beauty, energy and retail, with a focus on customer experience, brand building and distribution. He joined Medanta in April 2026 to lead marketing and growth.

companies.changes: Kedar Apte (Chief Marketing & Growth Officer) and Jagdeep Singh (General Counsel) joined senior management in May 2026; the previous General Counsel, Richa Singh, resigned from 20 May 2026. No change in the MD, CEO or CFO.

companies.styleNote: A family of eye surgeons runs it. Chairman Dr Amar Agarwal is a non-executive promoter director; his sons Dr Adil (CEO) and Dr Anosh (COO) are whole-time directors, and their first cousins Dr Ashvin (Chief Clinical Officer) and Dr Ashar (Chief Business Officer) are in senior management. Dr Amar's wife, Dr Athiya Agarwal, is also a promoter. The family owns about 32.3%, with shares up to 11.9% of the company pledged for an ICICI loan; TPG (through Hyperion) and Temasek (through Claymore and Arvon) together own about 43%.

people.name: Dr Adil Agarwal
people.relation: Son of Chairman Dr Amar Agarwal and Dr Athiya Agarwal; brother of Dr Anosh; first cousin of Dr Ashvin and Dr Ashar
people.bio: Holds an MBBS from Sri Ramachandra Medical College, Chennai, an MS in ophthalmology from Sri Ramachandra University and an MBA from Stanford University. He has been with the company since 2010 and leads it as CEO. He is also a director of Dr Agarwal's Eye Hospital (the listed subsidiary being merged in), Aditya Jyot Eye Hospital and Dr Thind Eye Care, which the company is buying out.

people.name: Dr Anosh Agarwal
people.relation: Son of Chairman Dr Amar Agarwal; brother of Dr Adil; first cousin of Dr Ashvin and Dr Ashar
people.bio: Holds an MBBS from Sri Ramachandra University, an MS in ophthalmology from Annamalai University and an MBA from Harvard Business School. He has been with the company since 2010 and runs its operations as COO. He is also a director of Aditya Jyot Eye Hospital, Elisar Life Sciences and other private companies.

people.name: Dr Ashvin Agarwal
people.relation: Nephew of the Chairman; first cousin of Dr Adil and Dr Anosh; brother of Dr Ashar
people.bio: Holds an MBBS from Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, Karnataka, and an MS in ophthalmology from Annamalai University. He joined the company as a consultant in 2011 and leads clinical work as Chief Clinical Officer. He received the Secretariat Award from the American Academy of Ophthalmology in 2021. He is also a director of the group's Africa businesses (Orbit Health Care in Mozambique, Uganda, Tanzania, Ghana and Madagascar).

people.name: Dr Ashar Agarwal
people.relation: Nephew of the Chairman; first cousin of Dr Adil and Dr Anosh; brother of Dr Ashvin
people.bio: Holds an MBBS and an MS in ophthalmology from Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, Karnataka, and an MBA from the Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University. He did an observational fellowship at the Moran Eye Center, Utah, and is a surgical fellow of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Glasgow. He joined in 2016 and now leads business development as Chief Business Officer.

people.name: Yashwanth Venkat
people.bio: Holds a chemical engineering degree from Anna University and a PGDM from IIM Bangalore. Before joining, he worked at IBM India, Murugappa Management Services, Intellect Design Arena, Scope International, Cognizant and VA Tech Wabag. He has more than 14 years in finance, strategy and acquisitions, and joined Dr Agarwal's Eye Hospital in May 2018 before becoming group CFO.

people.name: Rahul Agarwal
people.relation: Not a member of the promoter family
people.bio: Holds a PGDM from IIM Lucknow. He has over 21 years in healthcare and financial services, with earlier roles at Maruti Udyog, CitiFinancial, Standard Chartered Bank, Johnson & Johnson, Bard India Healthcare and Hill-Rom India. He joined in April 2022 to run hospital operations.

people.name: Dr Vandana Jain
people.bio: A gold medallist in ophthalmology with an MBBS and master's in ophthalmology from the University of Delhi and an MBA from Stanford. She co-founded Advanced Eye Institute, which the company bought in December 2019. She has more than 13 years in ophthalmology and became Chief Strategy Officer in February 2024.

companies.changes: No executive changes in FY26 or since. Independent director Sanjay Anand's term ended on 29 September 2026. The merger of the listed subsidiary Dr Agarwal's Eye Hospital is expected around mid-November 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Dr Bhaskara Rao Bollineni is Chairman & MD, his son Dr Abhinay Bollineni is Executive Director & CEO, and his other son Adwik Bollineni became an executive director in May 2026. Long-time insider Anitha Dandamudi is a whole-time director but is not family. Promoters own about 32.5%; the founder has pledged about 13% of his shares against personal loans, and the family is putting in ₹600cr through warrants.

people.name: Dr Bhaskara Rao Bollineni
people.relation: Founder; father of Dr Abhinay Bollineni and Adwik Bollineni
people.stake: 25.02% (June 2026 shareholding pattern), with 13.3% of his shares pledged; family and Bluebridge Capital together about 32.5%
people.bio: A cardiothoracic surgeon (MBBS, MS, DNB in cardiothoracic surgery) with more than 30,000 operations over 30 years. He founded Mahavir Cardiovascular Centre and then set up KIMS in 2004 with 300 beds, building it into a network of over 6,000 beds. He was one of the chief architects of Andhra Pradesh's Aarogyasri health scheme for the poor in 2007. CRISIL reports he has pledged shares for about ₹750cr of personal loans, partly to fund loans to promoter-owned companies.

people.name: Dr Abhinay Bollineni
people.relation: Son of the Chairman; brother of Adwik Bollineni
people.bio: Holds an MBBS from Deccan Medical College, Hyderabad (2010). He joined KIMS in 2013 and handles administration, finance and expansion. He set up the Kondapur hospital in 2014 and later units in Ongole, Vizag, Anantapur and Kurnool, led the purchase of Sunshine Hospitals and took KIMS outside the Telugu states to Nagpur and Nashik. He oversaw the 2021 stock-market listing and was named to BW's 40 Under 40 in 2019.

people.name: Adwik Bollineni
people.since: On the board as a non-executive promoter director; executive director from May 2026
people.relation: Son of the Chairman; brother of Dr Abhinay Bollineni
people.bio: He is on the governing body of the Aditya Educational Society, which runs the Great Eastern Medical School and hospital in Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh. The company credits him with that college's success, including accreditation from the Royal College of Surgeons of England. He was a non-executive promoter director until May 2026, when the board made him an executive director.

people.name: Anitha Dandamudi
people.relation: Professional director; not related to other directors
people.bio: Holds a diploma in business management from ICFAI and ISO 9001/9004 auditing certifications. Before KIMS she was Vice President – Administration at e-Talent Software. She has spent more than 20 years at KIMS and oversees corporate operations, risk management and patient relations, and led the hospitals to NABH, NABL and other accreditations.

people.name: Sachin Ashok Salvi
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 20 years in finance, reporting and compliance, including IPO work. He began his career at SD Khanolkar & Co., Mumbai, and was later Finance Controller and CFO at the Thyrocare group. At KIMS he handles finance and regulatory work with SEBI, RBI and tax authorities.

companies.changes: Adwik Bollineni was re-designated from non-executive to executive director in May 2026. The CFO, Company Secretary and Chief Risk Officer were named senior management in May 2026. No resignations since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: Founder Dr Vikram Shah, a knee-replacement surgeon, is Chairman & MD and the only executive on the board; the other six directors are independent. He takes no salary as MD but is paid professional fees (₹9.9cr in FY26). His son Shanay Shah is President. In September 2026 shareholders voted down Shanay's appointment as a whole-time director, a rare rejection; he stays on as President. The family, its trust and Zodiac Mediquip own about 74.3%.

people.name: Dr Vikram Shah
people.since: Founder (returned to India 1993); reappointed to March 2030
people.relation: Founder; father of President Shanay Shah
people.stake: 7.41% directly, plus 34.79% held by the Shah Family Trust through him as trustee (March 2026 shareholding pattern); with Zodiac Mediquip 29.21% and family members, promoters own about 74.3%
people.bio: Holds an MBBS and a master's in orthopaedic surgery from B.J. Medical College, Ahmedabad, with further training from AO Basic (London), F.A.O.A.A. (Switzerland) and F.A.S.I.F. (Germany). He returned to India in 1993 and built Shalby into a hospital chain known for joint replacement. He popularised his 'Zero Technique', which cut knee-replacement surgery time from 2.5 hours to 22 minutes and hospital stays from 15 days to 3. He received the Times Man of the Year award (2018) after 1,00,000 joint replacements and FICCI's Healthcare Personality of the Year (2023).

people.name: Shanay Shah
people.since: With the company since October 2013; President since October 2019
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD
people.bio: Holds a BSc (Hons) in accounting and finance from the University of Warwick and a master's in international health management from Imperial College London, and is a CFA charterholder. He joined in 2013 and oversees international business, strategy, finance, HR and investor relations. The board made him a whole-time director in August 2026, but shareholders rejected the appointment at the September 2026 AGM, so he left the board and continues as President.

people.name: Dr Nishita Shukla
people.bio: Group COO and one of the company's named senior managers. A regular invitee to the audit committee and the company's contact for its sustainability report. The annual report gives no education or earlier career details.

people.name: Amit Kumar
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a master's in financial management and over 18 years in EdTech, mobility and telecom. Before Shalby he was Senior Vice President – Finance Controller at Leadership Boulevard, a school EdTech company, and earlier CFO of ECOS (I) Mobility & Hospitality. He has also worked at Telenor, the Tata group and Bharti Airtel. He replaced Amit Pathak, who left in October 2025.

companies.changes: CFO Amit Pathak resigned in October 2025; Amit Kumar joined in November 2025. Shareholders rejected Shanay Shah's appointment as whole-time director at the AGM, so he ceased to be a director on 10 September 2026 but remains President. Deepak Anand, CEO of the implant subsidiary Shalby Medtech, resigned from 4 September 2026. Independent director Vijay Kedia resigned in April 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Patanjali (Patu) Keswani was Chairman & MD from 2002 to September 2025. Since 1 October 2025 he has been Chairman & Executive Director, and a hired MD, Neelendra Singh (ex-Adidas India), runs day-to-day operations. Shareholders approved Keswani becoming a non-executive chairman from 1 April 2027, after which the company will be promoter-owned but professionally run. His son Aditya Keswani sits on the board as a non-executive director. Promoters own 22.3%; the largest holder, promoter company Spank Management Services, holds 21.1%.

people.name: Patanjali Govind Keswani
people.since: 2002 (founder); Chairman & MD 2002–Sep 2025; Chairman & Executive Director from 1 Oct 2025 to 31 Mar 2027
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father of non-executive director Aditya Madhav Keswani
people.stake: 30,000 shares directly (under 0.01%); promoter company Spank Management Services, of which he is a director, holds 21.12%; promoter group together 22.33% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from IIT Delhi and a postgraduate diploma in management from IIM Calcutta. He joined the Tata Administrative Service in 1983 and spent 17 years with the Tata group, ending as Senior Vice President of the Taj Group of Hotels, where his roles included COO for business hotels. He then worked at A.T. Kearney as an associate consultant and director in India before founding Lemon Tree Hotels in 2002. He built it into India's largest mid-market hotel chain and took it public in April 2018. He also draws pay as an executive director of Fleur Hotels, the subsidiary jointly owned with Dutch pension investor APG. He is in the FHRAI Hall of Fame (2010). Shareholders approved on 18 September 2026 that he steps back to non-executive chairman from 1 April 2027.

people.name: Neelendra Singh
people.stake: Not disclosed; granted 30 lakh share appreciation rights in FY26
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. from Kirori Mal College, University of Delhi, and a master's in business administration from IMT Ghaziabad. He began his career at Shoppers Stop and later worked at Arcus and Hutchison. He joined Adidas in 2005 as regional manager for West India, became retail director for India in 2010, ran group retail for South Korea until 2014 and was a senior vice president for global direct-to-consumer and franchise in Germany until 2019, before returning as MD of Adidas India. He brings about 26 years of consumer and retail leadership rather than hotel experience. At Lemon Tree he leads day-to-day operations and all business functions.

people.name: Kapil Sharma
people.since: With the group since 2004; Executive Director & CFO from 1 October 2025 (five-year term)
people.stake: Not disclosed; granted 15 lakh share appreciation rights in FY26
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Delhi and a chartered accountant, with over 28 years in accounting, finance and investing. He has been with Lemon Tree since 2004 and led its capital raising, mergers and acquisitions, project financing and the 2018 IPO. He was elevated to the board as Executive Director & CFO in October 2025. He oversees finance, strategy, technology, legal, secretarial and procurement.

people.name: Vishvapreet Singh Cheema
people.stake: Not disclosed; granted 10 lakh share appreciation rights in FY26
people.bio: A hotel-management graduate from IHM Lucknow with a commerce degree from IGNOU; he also studied at the Oberoi Centre for Learning & Development and attended an INSEAD senior-leadership programme. He has about 29 years in hospitality. Before joining he was Director of Operations for South West Asia at IHG, overseeing about 50 hotels with some 8,000 rooms across India and neighbouring countries. Earlier he worked with Oberoi Hotels, IHHR Hospitality, Radisson, Marriott and P&O Cruises. At Lemon Tree he oversees hotel operations, human resources and revenue management.

people.name: Saurabh Shatdal
people.role: Managing Director & CEO, Fleur Hotels (material subsidiary); Senior Management Personnel
people.since: 1 August 2025 (SMP); Fleur MD & CEO from 1 October 2025
people.bio: Runs Fleur Hotels, the subsidiary that owns most of the group's hotels and in which Dutch pension investor APG is a partner. He has about 27 years in capital raising, land acquisition, deal structuring and hotel operations. Just before joining he was Managing Director for Capital Markets & Land and India head of retail at Cushman & Wakefield. Earlier he worked at CBRE and Regus, and in hotels at ITC Hotels, InterContinental, Le Méridien and The Leela.

companies.changes: Keswani moves from executive to non-executive chairman on 1 April 2027 (approved at the 18 Sep 2026 AGM). Company Secretary Pawan Kumar Kumawat resigned on 24 Sep 2026, effective 23 Nov 2026. Kartikeya Kumar Singh joined as Chief Digital & Transformation Officer in June 2026. CEO of the managed & franchised division Vilas Pawar retired on 31 Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: The Oberoi family runs the company. Arjun Singh Oberoi is Executive Chairman and his cousin Vikramjit Singh Oberoi (son of the late P.R.S. Oberoi) is MD & CEO. The annual report says no directors are related under the Companies Act definition, which does not count cousins. Promoters own 32.8% (31 Mar 2026). Two large outside holders are Reliance Strategic Business Ventures (18.8%) and ITC (16.1%); Nita Ambani is a non-executive director. The family is in a Delhi High Court dispute over P.R.S. Oberoi's will, and the court has restrained transfers of shares linked to his estate.

people.name: Arjun Singh Oberoi
