people.since: Joined corporate office 1996; MD – Development from April 2015; Executive Chairman since 4 May 2022 (term to 3 May 2027)
people.relation: Promoter family; nephew of the late P.R.S. Oberoi and cousin of MD & CEO Vikramjit Singh Oberoi
people.stake: 1.15% (71,72,199 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 32.84%
people.bio: A graduate of the University of Buckingham, UK. He joined EIH's corporate office in 1996 and has spent about three decades in the group's hotel business. He was Managing Director – Development from April 2015, leading new hotel projects and their execution, and became Executive Chairman in May 2022 after P.R.S. Oberoi stepped down. He also chairs EIH Associated Hotels. The annual report lists his expertise as developing and executing new hotel projects, general administration and governance. He is a party, with Vikramjit, to the Delhi High Court dispute challenging P.R.S. Oberoi's will.

people.name: Vikramjit Singh Oberoi
people.since: Board since December 1993; MD & CEO since 1 April 2015 (current term 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2029)
people.relation: Son of the late P.R.S. Oberoi; cousin of Executive Chairman Arjun Singh Oberoi
people.stake: 0.90% (56,09,896 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 32.84%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in science from Pepperdine University, California. He joined the EIH board as a non-executive director in December 1993 and has spent over 25 years in hospitality, including as whole-time director and later MD of EIH Associated Hotels from 1997 and 2005. He became MD & CEO of EIH in April 2015. The annual report lists his expertise as hotel operations, guest relations and general administration. His sister Natasha Oberoi is also a party in the family dispute over their father's estate.

people.name: Vineet Kapur
people.bio: A chartered accountant (1997) with an executive MBA from the Indian School of Business (2014). He has over 29 years in finance and accounts at Mahindra & Mahindra (automotive and farm), CRH plc, United Technologies and Carrier India, General Motors and Deloitte. Just before joining EIH he was Group Finance Controller at the CK Birla Group from June 2022. He replaced Kallol Kundu, who left in September 2024 after six years as CFO.

people.name: Mohit Nirula
people.role: Chief Operating Officer, Oberoi & Trident Hotels
people.since: September 2023 (rejoined; first joined the group in 1986)
people.bio: A graduate of the Institute of Hotel Management, New Delhi, he joined the Oberoi School of Hotel Management as a management trainee and won its gold medal in 1988. Over about 31 years with the group he worked in eight cities, including Mauritius and Egypt, as general manager, dean of the Oberoi school and Senior Vice President in the CEO's office. He left to be CEO of Columbia Pacific Communities, a senior-living operator, and returned as COO in September 2023. He oversees operations, sales, marketing and revenue management for all Oberoi and Trident hotels.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report (July 2026). Arjun Singh Oberoi's term as Executive Chairman ends on 3 May 2027, so a renewal is due.

companies.styleNote: Co-promoted by the Saraf family and Hyatt. Arun Kumar Saraf is Chairman & MD and his son Varun Saraf is CEO; his wife Namita Saraf is a non-executive director. Hyatt's Two Seas Holdings (38.8%) is a co-promoter but only sits on the board through two non-executive Hyatt nominees. The Saraf entities hold 38.8% (Saraf Hotels 34.6%, Juniper Investments 4.1%); promoters together own 77.5%. At the August 2026 AGM, 60.6% of institutional votes cast opposed Arun Saraf's reappointment, though it passed with 92.4% overall.

people.name: Arun Kumar Saraf
people.since: Board since July 1998; with the company since the Grand Hyatt Mumbai project in 1997; reappointed for 1 Mar 2027 to 28 Feb 2030
people.relation: Promoter; father of CEO Varun Saraf and husband of non-executive director Namita Saraf
people.stake: Nil directly (FY26 AGM notice). He is sole beneficiary of the trust that owns Saraf Hotels (34.64%) and owns 91.84% of Juniper Investments (4.12%), per the IPO prospectus and FY26 annual report
people.bio: Holds a BA in business economics from UCLA. He has over 40 years in hotel development and was involved in building and running Hyatt Regency Kathmandu, Yak & Yeti in Nepal, and Hyatt Regency hotels in Kolkata, Chennai and Delhi. In 1997 he partnered with Hyatt to build the Grand Hyatt Mumbai, finished in 2004, then added Hyatt Regency Ahmedabad and Andaz Delhi with Hyatt Delhi Residences. He leads the 'Juniper 2.0' plan to double rooms and EBITDA by FY30 and says IPO money cut debt from about 6x to 1x EBITDA. He turns 70 during his new term, which needed a special resolution. He drew ₹9.5cr basic salary plus ₹4.1cr commission in FY26.

people.name: Varun Saraf
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Arun Kumar Saraf and non-executive director Namita Saraf
people.stake: Not disclosed in the FY26 annual report; named in the promoter group
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in arts from Tufts University, USA, where he studied economics, political science and philosophy. He returned to India in 2006 to join the family business and founded Chartered Hotels to build Hyatt-branded hotels in smaller cities; it now runs hotels in Hampi, Raipur and Lucknow with about 450 rooms and became a Juniper subsidiary in 2023. He is also managing director of Chartered Hotels. As CEO he runs overall operations and has led project and asset management for about 17 years.

people.name: Amit Saraf
people.relation: Not related to the directors, per the IPO prospectus
people.bio: Holds an MBA from Gauhati University. He has been with the company since 1998 and has worked on developing all its hotels over about 25 years. He heads business development, including acquisitions, pre-construction approvals, commercial leasing and corporate affairs, and is a director of promoter company Juniper Investments. Since CFO Tarun Jaitly left on 15 July 2026, he has overseen the finance function jointly with the company secretary until a new CFO is hired.

people.name: P. J. Mammen
people.bio: Holds a diploma in hospitality management from the Educational Institute of the American Hotel & Lodging Association. Before Juniper he worked with The Indian Hotels Company (Taj). He joined Juniper in October 2017 and leads the asset-management team, which oversees the operating hotels and serviced apartments run by Hyatt.

people.name: Sandeep Joshi
people.role: VP – Finance & Accounts, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer (interim CFO duties)
people.since: Company Secretary; a key managerial person listed in the FY26 annual report
people.bio: Company secretary and head of finance and accounts. After the CFO resigned, the company said he and President Amit Saraf would jointly oversee the CFO's responsibilities until a new CFO is appointed. The annual report gives no further background on him.

companies.changes: CFO Tarun Jaitly resigned on 29 June 2026 (effective 15 July 2026) for an outside opportunity; no new CFO had been named by 29 Sep 2026. Arun Saraf was reappointed Chairman & MD at the 27 Aug 2026 AGM for March 2027 to February 2030.

companies.styleNote: Part of the K Raheja Corp group. The promoter brothers Ravi C. Raheja and Neel C. Raheja sit on the board as non-executive directors and hold no executive role; the chair is an independent director. A hired MD & CEO, Shwetank Singh, has run the company since February 2026, succeeding Sanjay Sethi, who is now a non-executive director. Promoters own about 67% (Neel Raheja 4.72% and Ravi Raheja 2.36% directly, the rest through family members and group companies).

people.name: Shwetank Singh
people.since: Joined 2 August 2023 as Chief Growth & Strategy Officer; Executive Director from 24 October 2024; MD & CEO since 1 February 2026
people.stake: 1,00,800 shares (about 0.05%) plus 1,03,270 options outstanding (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech from IIT and an MBA in finance and marketing from the Faculty of Management Studies. He has about 25 years in hospitality, real estate, strategy and business operations. Before Chalet he oversaw asset management of Hilton, Marriott and Taj hotels at Golden Sands LLC in Dubai, and was Vice President of Development & Asset Management at InterGlobe Hotels. Earlier he worked at Tata Steel, Citi Financial, IIDC and Premier Inn. He joined Chalet in 2023 to lead growth and strategy, joined the board in 2024 and took over as MD & CEO when Sanjay Sethi retired.

people.name: Nitin Khanna
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant with over 25 years of experience. Before Chalet he was CFO of Inorbit Malls, another K Raheja group company, where he ran financial strategy. At Chalet he leads finance, including funding the roughly ₹3,000cr capex plan for FY27–FY29.

people.name: Gaurav Singh
people.bio: Has about 26 years in hotels. He began in food and beverage at ITC Hotels, then worked at The Oberoi Amarvilas, Agra, and The Oberoi Udaivilas, Udaipur, as executive assistant manager for F&B. He was later Resident Manager at The Leela and multi-property Vice President & GM at JW Marriott Kolkata. Just before Chalet he was briefly President at Table Space, a flexible-office company. He runs hotel operations.

people.name: Manoj Agarwal
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary with a B.Com (Hons) and an LL.B. He has 23 years in hospitality, real estate and infrastructure, covering business development, asset management, acquisitions, corporate finance, M&A advice and fund-raising. Just before Chalet he was Chief Operating Officer – Hospitality at Brigade Hotel Ventures, where he ran nine hotels operated by Marriott, Accor and IHG plus clubs and convention centres, and oversaw design and construction.

companies.changes: Sanjay Sethi retired as MD & CEO on 31 Jan 2026 and became a non-executive director; Shwetank Singh took over on 1 Feb 2026. Manoj Agarwal joined from Brigade Hotel Ventures as Chief Growth & Product Officer on 20 Jul 2026. Gautam Mehra joined as an independent director on 17 Jul 2026.

companies.styleNote: Co-promoted by Panchshil Realty's Atul Chordia and Blackstone. Chordia is Chairman & Executive Director; the CEO, CFO and heads of construction and legal are long-time Panchshil group managers rather than family members. Blackstone (32.4% through two funds) is represented by non-executive director Asheesh Mohta. Chordia's side holds about 39.9% (Premsagar Infra Realty 37.3%, Chordia 1.65%, his HUF 0.99%); promoters together own 72.3%. No directors or managers are related to each other.

people.name: Atul I. Chordia
people.relation: Promoter; founder of Panchshil Realty
people.stake: 1.65% directly and 0.99% through his HUF; promoter company Premsagar Infra Realty, of which he has been a director since 1992, holds 37.28% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Founder of Panchshil Realty in Pune. He completed the first year of a commerce degree at Ness Wadia College of Commerce, Pune, and has over 31 years in real estate. He has been a director of Premsagar Infra (formerly Premsagar Hotels) since 1992 and of Ventive since 2002, and brought The Ritz-Carlton Pune, JW Marriott Pune and Conrad Maldives into the portfolio. He led the company to its IPO in December 2024 with Blackstone as co-promoter. He oversees overall operations and management. His awards include Hoteliers Award 2019 Developer of the Year.

people.name: Ranjit Batra
people.since: CEO at listing (2024); earlier Executive Vice President in the Panchshil group for over a decade
people.bio: Holds a hotel-management diploma from The Oberoi Centre of Learning and Development and Hotelconsult SHCC, Switzerland. He began his career with The Oberoi Group and has about 35 years in hotels, having worked in India, the US, New Zealand and Switzerland. He was Executive Vice President at Panchshil group company A2Z Online Services for over a decade, handling hotel development, asset management, design and acquisitions. As CEO he runs Ventive's hotels in India, the Maldives and Sri Lanka with operators including Marriott, Hilton, Minor and Atmosphere Core.

people.name: Paresh Bafna
people.since: CFO since 2 September 2024; with the Panchshil group since April 2006
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Ness Wadia College of Commerce, Pune, and a fellow chartered accountant. He has completed executive programmes at ISB-Kellogg (Global Advanced Management), Harvard Business School (Disruptive Strategy) and ISB (Real Estate Management). He was joint CFO of Panchshil group company A2Z Online Services from April 2006 and helped take Ventive public. He leads financial planning, capital allocation and risk management.

people.name: Amit Sachdeva
people.bio: Has more than 25 years in luxury and upscale hotels, with senior roles at Marriott, Accor, Starwood, Oberoi Hotels and The Imperial, New Delhi. His last role was General Manager of JW Marriott Mussoorie Walnut Grove Resort & Spa. He oversees operating performance, efficiency and guest experience across the portfolio.

people.name: Santosh Kolekar
people.since: 2 September 2024; with the Panchshil group since 1996
people.bio: Holds a diploma in civil engineering from Latthe Education Society Polytechnic, Sangli. He worked at Panchshil Engineering from 1996 to 2005 and then as Executive Vice President for site execution at A2Z Online Services. He helped build JW Marriott Pune and The Ritz-Carlton Pune, and now runs Ventive's construction projects.

companies.changes: Amit Sachdeva (Head of Operations) and Aishwarya VR (Investor Relations) were named senior management in May 2026; Percy P. Muncherji joined as Head – Design on 3 Aug 2026 after a delay. In May 2026 the board approved moving 11 shareless Panchshil entities out of the promoter group.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by Canada's Brookfield, whose funds held 75.9% at 31 March 2026 through several Dubai (DIFC) holding companies. There is no founding family in the business; Brookfield acquired The Leela in 2019. A hired hotelier, Anuraag Bhatnagar, runs it as Whole-time Director & CEO and is the only executive on the board. Deepak Parekh is the independent chairman; the other directors are non-executive or independent.

people.name: Anuraag Bhatnagar
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from the University of Delhi and a diploma in hotel management, catering and nutrition from the Board of Technical Education, Delhi. He also completed Marriott's Ascent leadership programme at UNC Kenan-Flagler and an executive programme at IIM Bangalore. He has over 35 years in hotels, starting with EIH (The Oberoi Group) and later at Starwood Hotels & Resorts India, which became part of Marriott International. He joined The Leela in 2020 and led it through its 2025 IPO. He is the only executive on the board.

people.name: Ravi Shankar
people.role: Head – Asset Management & Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com from the University of Delhi and a law degree from Manav Bharti University, Solan. He has over 20 years in finance, starting at RSM & Co. in New Delhi. He was CFO of Meraas Hotels and Resorts and of Abjar Hotels International in the Gulf, and Regional Director for openings in Asia Pacific at Starwood Hotels, and also worked with Le Méridien and Marriott. He joined The Leela in January 2020 and runs finance and asset management.

people.name: Vikram Rajaram Choubal
people.role: Senior Vice President – Technical Services (Senior Management)
people.bio: A marine engineer officer with a UK Certificate of Competency. Before The Leela he was VP Engineering (West) at EIH, VP Engineering at Market City Resources, VP Projects at Indian Hotels (Taj) and VP Project Management at Marriott Hotels India. He heads engineering and technical services, which covers the new hotels the company is building.

people.name: Sougata Kundu
people.role: Senior Vice President – Legal & Compliance (Senior Management)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in social and legal sciences and an LL.B. from the University of Pune. He was VP – Legal/Litigation at OYO Hotels and Homes and earlier worked at the law firms JSA, Desai & Diwanji and Vaish Associates, and at PwC. He heads legal and compliance.

companies.changes: Isha Goyal, SVP & Head of HR, resigned for personal reasons with effect from 9 Jul 2026 and is no longer senior management; no successor had been announced by 29 Sep 2026.

companies.styleNote: Taken over out of insolvency in October 2023 by Loko Hospitality, a vehicle of two Hyderabad real-estate groups: the Kondareddy family (Anirudh Group) and S.P. Reddy (Terminus Group). Ravinder Reddy Kondareddy is MD & CEO and draws no salary. Two relatives, Anirudh Reddy Konda Reddy and Kondareddy Sukanya, are non-executive directors; the annual report calls the three 'immediate relatives' without giving the exact relationship. S.P. Reddy is a non-executive director. Loko held 84.1% at 31 March 2026; the September 2026 rights issue went only to public shareholders, which cuts Loko to about 74%. The chairman is an independent director.

people.name: Ravinder Reddy Kondareddy
people.relation: Promoter group; 'immediate relative' of directors Anirudh Reddy Konda Reddy and Kondareddy Sukanya (annual report)
people.stake: No direct holding disclosed; promoter Loko Hospitality held 84.11% at 31 Mar 2026, of which director Anirudh Reddy is beneficial owner of about 64.37% and S.P. Reddy about 14.87% of Viceroy's equity (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: An electronics engineering graduate (BE) from RV College of Engineering, Bangalore. He is a real-estate entrepreneur who built the Anirudh Group, which has developed over 500 acres of property across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka and owns residential and commercial buildings in Hyderabad and Bangalore. He is also a director of Sembmarine Kakinada, Loko Hospitality and several Anirudh Group companies. He took charge when Loko's resolution plan for Viceroy was approved in 2023 and draws no remuneration. In 2026 a regulator compounded a company-law lapse with a penalty on the company and on him as MD, which was paid.

people.name: Venkata Krishna Reddy Puli
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 15 years in audit, financial strategy and governance across manufacturing, trading and IT/ITES. He started in audit and assurance at a Big Four firm and then spent 12 years in senior finance roles at a large legal-process-outsourcing company, running financial operations, risk and planning.

people.name: Pradyumna Kodali
people.bio: An engineering graduate from BITS Pilani. He worked on strategic financial management and analysis at Credit Suisse and in international hotel operations at OYO. He was Viceroy's CFO after the takeover and moved to COO in June 2025 to oversee hotel operations.

companies.changes: Pradyumna Kodali moved from CFO to COO and P.V. Krishna Reddy became CFO on 1 Jun 2025. Kondareddy Sukanya joined the board on 14 Nov 2025, the day Pooja Reddy Konda Reddy left it. The statutory auditor's resignation was disclosed on 1 Aug 2026. A ₹105.8cr rights issue was allotted on 15 Sep 2026 to non-promoter shareholders only.

companies.styleNote: A Baljee family company. Founder Chander K. (C.K.) Baljee is Chairman & MD; his son Keshav Baljee became a whole-time director in February 2026, and his other son Arjun Baljee is President. His wife Sunita Baljee, a co-founder, is a non-executive director. Promoters own about 64% (31 Mar 2026), with C.K. Baljee holding 38.95% himself.

people.name: Chander K. Baljee
people.relation: Founder; husband of director Sunita Baljee; father of Whole-time Director Keshav Baljee and President Arjun Baljee
people.stake: 38.95% (1,06,82,035 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 64%
people.bio: A management graduate of IIM Ahmedabad and a certified hotel administrator from the American Hotel & Lodging Association. He has over five decades in the hotel industry and founded Royal Orchid Hotels, which runs hotels under the Royal Orchid and Regenta brands. He is featured in the IIM Ahmedabad book 'Stay Hungry Stay Foolish' on 25 entrepreneurs. He leads the plan to take the chain from about 7,700 keys past 11,000.

people.name: Keshav Baljee
people.since: Whole-time Director from 14 February 2026 (earlier a non-executive director)
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD C.K. Baljee; co-promoter
people.bio: Studied at the Doon School and then the University of Pennsylvania's Jerome Fisher Program, earning degrees in computer engineering and in finance from Wharton. He worked as an investment banker in New York and later took an MBA from ISB Hyderabad. He was CEO of Smaaash Entertainment, an indoor entertainment chain, and founded Kensington Villas, a luxury villa developer, where he is a designated partner. He moved from non-executive to whole-time director in February 2026.

people.name: Arjun Baljee
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD C.K. Baljee; promoter group
people.bio: Has over 20 years across real estate, technology, start-ups and hospitality. He was appointed President in March 2024, and his pay was set at ₹10 lakh a month from February 2026. The annual report gives no further detail on his education or earlier employers.

people.name: Amit Jaiswal
people.since: CFO as per the FY26 annual report
people.bio: Has over 30 years in finance across manufacturing and hotels. He signs the CEO/CFO certification with the Chairman. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: Keshav Baljee became Whole-time Director on 14 Feb 2026. Padmini V. Krupanidhi became Company Secretary on 25 May 2026. No executive exits announced since the FY26 annual report (September 2026).

companies.styleNote: The hotel arm of Brigade Enterprises, which owns 74.1%. Founder M.R. Jaishankar is non-executive chairman (since December 2025). His daughter Nirupa Shankar is Managing Director and also Joint MD of Brigade Enterprises; she is paid by the parent, not by this company. His nephew Amar Mysore is a non-executive director. A hired hotelier, Vinay Gupta, joined as CEO on 17 August 2026.

people.name: Nirupa Shankar
people.since: Has overseen Brigade Group's hotel, office and retail portfolios for about 16 years
people.relation: Daughter of Non-Executive Chairman M.R. Jaishankar; cousin of director Amar Mysore
people.stake: 50 shares, with beneficial interest held by Brigade Enterprises (FY26 annual report); parent Brigade Enterprises holds 74.09%
people.bio: Has spent about 16 years running Brigade Group's hotel, office and retail businesses and is Joint Managing Director of the listed parent, Brigade Enterprises. She conceived several award-winning restaurants and bars in Bengaluru, including HIGH Ultra Lounge, Glass Kitchen & Bar and the Art Café. She set up Brigade's real-estate start-up accelerator REAP in 2016 and launched its flexible-office brand BuzzWorks in 2019. The company's filings do not state her education. She draws remuneration from the parent company rather than from this company.

people.name: Vinay Gupta
people.bio: A hotelier with over 30 years of experience running large hotel portfolios for owners, developers and brands. He was the first general manager of Brigade's first hotel about 20 years ago. Later, at InterGlobe Hotels and Accor, he led the repositioning of a 22-hotel portfolio, and at SAMHI he ran more than 25 hotels branded by Marriott, Hyatt and IHG. Earlier he was general manager at hotels in India and Australia for Hilton, Accor and Mirvac, and held roles in the UAE.

people.name: Ananda Natarajan
people.since: CFO since 1 October 2024; with the Brigade group since 2008
people.bio: Has been with the Brigade group since 2008 and completed an executive programme at IIM Kozhikode. He became CFO in October 2024, ahead of the July 2025 IPO. He handles funding of the planned ₹3,600cr capex, about 60% of which is to be borrowed.

people.name: Arindam Mukherjee
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech (Hons) in civil engineering from IIT Kharagpur and has worked with Brigade since 2009. He heads engineering, which covers the design and construction of the company's new hotels.

companies.changes: COO Manoj Agarwal left on 16 Jul 2026 (resignation announced 28 Apr 2026) and joined Chalet Hotels. Vinay Gupta joined as CEO and key managerial person on 17 Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Mahindra Group company: Mahindra & Mahindra owns 66.74% (31 Mar 2026). It is run by a Mahindra Group professional, MD & CEO Manoj Bhat, the only executive on the board. C.P. Gurnani is non-executive chairman, and Mahindra Group executives Anish Shah and Ruzbeh Irani are non-executive directors. No directors are related to each other, and no Mahindra family member holds an executive role here.

people.name: Manoj Bhat
people.stake: Nil (FY26 annual report); 15,113 company stock options vested, plus options in parent M&M
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech from IIT Bombay and a PGDM from IIM Bangalore. He began his career in finance and strategy roles at HCL Perot Systems across several countries. He was CFO of Tech Mahindra, running finance and secretarial functions across 160 subsidiaries, and led its M&A and corporate planning. He then became Group CFO of Mahindra & Mahindra before moving to Club Mahindra as MD & CEO in May 2024. He also sits on the boards of the Finnish subsidiary Holiday Club Resorts and of Pininfarina.

people.name: Rajiv Vimal
people.bio: A chartered accountant and a commerce graduate from St. Xavier's College, Kolkata, with over 20 years in finance across manufacturing and services. Just before joining he was CFO of PPG Asian Paints, the joint venture of PPG Industries and Asian Paints, where he led finance, accounting, tax, internal audit, legal compliance and CSR. Before that he spent over 13 years at Vodafone in senior finance roles, including Head of Finance for its MPCG circle.

companies.changes: CFO Vimal Agarwal left on 30 Jun 2026 for another role in the Mahindra Group; Rajiv Vimal took over on 1 Jul 2026. Other senior managers named in the FY26 annual report include Ashutosh Pandey (Chief Business Officer – Vacation Ownership), Mahesh Iyer (Chief Business Officer – Leisure Hospitality), Julian Ayers (Chief Resorts Officer) and Manish Goel (Chief Projects Officer); their backgrounds are not disclosed.

companies.styleNote: There is no promoter: the June 2026 shareholding pattern shows only foreign investors (44.6%), domestic institutions (17.4%) and the public (38.0%). Ashish Jakhanwala, on the board since December 2010, is Chairman, MD & CEO and leads a management team that has mostly been together since 2011–2012. Hotelivate founder Manav Thadani, also on the board since 2010, is a non-executive director holding 0.44%. No directors or managers are related to each other.

people.name: Ashish Jakhanwala
people.stake: Not found in the documents reviewed (the FY26 annual report file on NSE could not be opened)
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from the University of Delhi, a hotel-management diploma from the National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology, and a PGDM from the International Management Institute, New Delhi. He worked as a consultant at Pannell Kerr Forster and then as Director – Development at InterGlobe Hotels; Accor gave him its Gold Bernache award in 2009. He has led SAMHI since 2010, building a portfolio of branded business hotels bought or built and run by Marriott, Hyatt and IHG. He co-chaired FICCI's tourism committee in 2018.

people.name: Rajat Mehra
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com from Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Khalsa College, University of Delhi, and a management diploma from IGNOU. Before SAMHI he was Executive Vice President – Finance at Religare Corporate Services. He has run SAMHI's finances since 2012, including the IPO and the ongoing push to cut net debt from about 3.2x to 2.5x EBITDA by FY28.

people.name: Gyana Das
people.role: Executive Vice President – Corporate Strategy & Head of Investments
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in architecture from VNIT Nagpur and a master's in city planning from IIT Kharagpur. He worked at InterGlobe Hotels before joining SAMHI in 2011. He leads corporate strategy and hotel acquisitions and investments.

people.name: Sanjay Jain
people.role: Senior Director – Corporate Affairs, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
people.bio: A company secretary and cost accountant with a B.Com (Hons) from the University of Delhi. He worked at Consortium Finance, and the company's investor presentation also lists Beekman Helix India and DLF among his past employers. He handles corporate affairs, secretarial work and compliance.

companies.changes: No KMP or senior-management changes announced on NSE between April and 29 Sep 2026. The September 2026 AGM notice sought approval to raise up to ₹750cr of equity.

companies.styleNote: Part of Coimbatore's Lakshmi group. Promoter Sanjay Jayavarthanavelu is Chairman and MD and has run the company for about three decades; his son Jaidev sits on the board as a non-executive director (he moved from executive to non-executive in FY25). Day-to-day divisions are led by long-serving professional managers. Promoters and group companies own 30.8%.

people.name: Sanjay Jayavarthanavelu
people.since: Board since February 1993; MD term runs to March 2027 and has been renewed for five more years from April 2027
people.relation: Promoter; father of Jaidev Jayavarthanavelu (non-executive director)
people.stake: 1.33% (1,42,291 shares, FY26 annual report); he also has a 16.60% beneficial interest together with others; promoter group 30.8% (June 2026)
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate degree in business administration from Philadelphia University, USA, specialising in management and finance. He joined the board in 1993 and has nearly three decades of experience across textile machinery, machine tools, foundry, aerospace, logistics and finance. As Chairman and MD he is responsible for the overall management of the company. He is also a director of other Lakshmi group firms, including The Lakshmi Mills, Super Sales India, Lakshmi Cargo, Chakradhara Aerospace and Cargo and Rhodius Abrasives in Germany. His FY26 pay was about ₹15.8cr. Investors should note related-party purchases from group company Lakshmi Electrical Control Systems, where a relative of his holds shares.

people.name: M Sankar
people.since: Joined LMW in August 1985; board since October 2023
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech degree. He has about four decades of experience in strategy, sales, marketing, manufacturing, R&D and supply chain, almost all of it at LMW, which he joined in 1985 after working at Star Marketing and Services. He joined the board as whole-time director in October 2023 and is responsible for the overall operations of the company. He chaired the Textile Machinery Manufacturers Association of India for 2023–25 and has sat on CII's textile committees. The board has re-appointed him for three more years from October 2026 and asked shareholders to let him continue past age 70 in December 2027.

people.name: V Senthil
people.bio: A commerce graduate and chartered accountant (B.Com, ACA). He joined LMW in January 2015 and previously worked at LMW Textile Machinery (Suzhou), the company's Chinese subsidiary, according to the FY26 annual report. He is the company's CFO and a key managerial person.

people.name: S Rajasekaran
people.bio: Holds a diploma in textile technology, AMIE, an M.Tech and a diploma in business management. He joined LMW in 1986 after working at VR Textiles and has about four decades with the company. He heads the textile machinery division, LMW's largest business, and is part of senior management.

people.name: N Krishna Kumar
people.since: Joined July 1983; current role from 1 August 2026
people.bio: Holds BE and ME degrees and has been with LMW since 1983. He was President of the Foundry and Advanced Technology Centre (aerospace) in FY26 and was redesignated President – Strategy Office from August 2026 when the Chief Strategy Officer retired. He remains part of senior management.

people.name: R Chandrashekar
people.role: Head – Foundry and Advanced Technology Centre
people.since: Joined March 2022; senior management since 20 May 2026
people.bio: Holds BE and MBA degrees. He joined LMW in March 2022 from Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone. He was named head of the foundry and the Advanced Technology Centre, which houses the fast-growing aerospace parts business, in May 2026.

companies.changes: Chief Strategy Officer K Soundhar Rajhan retired on 31 July 2026. Siva Arvinth Ganga, President of the machine tool division, left on 31 December 2025. R Chandrashekar became head of Foundry and ATC in May 2026, and N Krishna Kumar moved to the strategy office in August 2026. The CMD's re-appointment from April 2027 goes to shareholders.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 1979 by Mahendra Patel, who is Chairman and MD; co-promoter Chandrakant Patel is Joint MD. Chandrakant's son Varun sits on the board as a non-executive director. A hired CEO runs the business day to day: long-time CEO Apurva Kane retires on 30 September 2026 and Rajashekar Venkat, an outsider, takes over. Promoters own 62.45%.

people.name: Mahendra Patel
people.since: Founder (company set up 1979); on the board since September 1994
people.relation: Founder and promoter
people.stake: 21.17% (52,09,191 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group 62.45%
people.bio: Holds a diploma in mechanical engineering and a master's degree in industrial engineering and administration from the Cranfield Institute of Technology, UK. He set up Mamata to build machines for plastics processing and flexible packaging, and has over four decades in the engineering industry. He has shaped the company's product and export strategy and has been recognised by bodies such as the All India Plastics Manufacturers' Association.

people.name: Chandrakant Patel
people.since: With the company and on the board since March 1990
people.relation: Promoter; father of Varun Patel (non-executive director)
people.stake: 2.34% (5,75,550 shares, FY26 annual report); Bhagvatiben Chandrakant Patel, also in the promoter group, holds 8.04%
people.bio: An engineering graduate from L.D. College of Engineering, Ahmedabad. He worked at other engineering firms before joining Mamata in 1990 and has over 41 years of industry experience. He leads customer-facing work: sales, marketing and customer service. He is also a director of Mamata Energy Private Limited.

people.name: Rajashekar Venkat
people.role: Group President; Chief Executive Officer from 1 October 2026
people.bio: Has over 27 years in capital equipment across packaging machinery, industrial and pharmaceutical machinery, printing technology and analytical instruments. He held senior roles at multinationals including Kennametal, Markem-Imaje, Mettler Toledo and Domino Printing, leading growth and business turnaround across Asia and the Middle East and North Africa. He joined Mamata as President and takes over as CEO on 1 October 2026. He is not related to any director.

people.name: Dipak Modi
people.bio: Has over 33 years of experience, about 26 of them at Mamata, according to the FY26 annual report. As CFO he runs finance, treasury and risk. The company does not publish his qualifications.

companies.changes: CEO Apurva Kane, with the company since 1986, retires on 30 September 2026; Rajashekar Venkat becomes CEO on 1 October 2026. Independent director Ruchita Patel resigned from 1 June 2026 for personal reasons; Prachi Shah joined the board as an independent director in May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Parakramsinh Jadeja is Chairman and MD; fellow promoters Sahdevsinh Jadeja and Vikramsinh Rana are whole-time directors. The board says no two directors are related, but the design head, Vijaysinh Zala, is the CMD's brother-in-law. Another promoter, Anilkumar Virani (14.45%), has no board role. Promoters own 62.55%.

people.name: Parakramsinh Jadeja
people.since: Started his first business in 1987; partner in Jyoti Enterprise from 1989; board since March 2003
people.relation: Founder and promoter; brother-in-law of Vijaysinh Zala (Executive Head – Design)
people.stake: 26.91% (6,11,88,760 shares, FY26 annual report); also owns 84.27% of promoter firm Jyoti International LLP, which holds 3,67,48,995 shares; promoter group 62.55%
people.bio: Studied to the 10th standard (matriculation). He started his first business in 1987 and grew it into one of India's leading machine-tool makers with a global presence; he has over 37 years in the industry. He is responsible for all strategic decisions and, with the whole-time directors, oversees manufacturing, sales, marketing and quality. He is a director of the Indian Machine Tool Manufacturers' Association and Neo Rajkot Foundation. His FY26 pay was ₹1.2cr.

people.name: Sahdevsinh Jadeja
people.since: Partner in Jyoti Enterprise from 1989; board since March 2003
people.relation: Promoter; the company says he is not related to the other directors
people.bio: An undergraduate. He has been with the business as a partner of Jyoti Enterprise since 1989 and a director since 2003. As a whole-time director he helps run day-to-day operations. His FY26 pay was ₹72 lakh.

people.name: Vikramsinh Rana
people.relation: Promoter; the company says he is not related to the other directors
people.bio: An undergraduate. He has been a director since 2003 and is a whole-time director and promoter. He sits on the board's stakeholder and risk committees. His FY26 pay was ₹42 lakh.

people.name: Kamlesh Solanki
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from Saurashtra University, Rajkot. He joined Jyoti in 2004 as finance manager and became CFO in April 2015, and saw the company through its January 2024 listing.

people.name: Vijaysinh Zala
people.relation: Brother-in-law of the CMD; in the promoter group
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Sardar Patel University. He joined Jyoti in 2004 and leads product design, including the company's 5-axis machines. He is part of senior management.

people.name: Vijay Pratap Singh
people.bio: Named senior management in FY26 as Chief Strategic and Transformation Officer. The company has not published his background.

companies.changes: Independent director Prasad Naga left the board in October 2025; Prafulla Shenoy, formerly of IDBI and SIDBI, joined as an independent director in January 2026. Promoter Anilkumar Virani has pledged shares equal to 6.7% of the company for a personal loan.

companies.styleNote: A Rajkot family business. Founder Rupesh Mehta is Chairman and MD and his younger brother Nikesh is Whole-time Director and CEO; Rupesh's wife Riyaben is a non-executive director. Both brothers are paid monthly consultancy fees rather than salaries. The Mehta family owns 73.2%.

people.name: Rupesh Mehta
people.since: Founder; board since December 2003 (group began as Macpower Industries in 1985)
people.relation: Founder; brother of Nikesh Mehta; husband of Riyaben Mehta (non-executive director)
people.stake: 31.57% (31,53,526 shares, FY26 annual report); wife Riyaben 18.14%; family together 73.22%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from Saurashtra University. He founded the company and already had more than 25 years in the machine-tool industry by 2018. He still owns Macpower Industries, a proprietorship that trades with the company. He has been president of the Rajkot machine tools body, treasurer of the local chamber of commerce and a director of the Rajkot Engineering Association, and served as an executive director of the Indian Machine Tool Manufacturers' Association. He sets strategy and runs the business overall. He was re-appointed MD for five years from October 2025 and is paid a consultancy fee of ₹3 lakh a month plus GST.

people.name: Nikesh Mehta
people.relation: Promoter; brother of the CMD
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from Saurashtra University. He has been a director since 2003 and has spent his career in machine tools, looking after the machine shop, applications and purchasing. He is now CEO and was re-appointed whole-time director for five years from October 2025. He is paid a consultancy fee of ₹2 lakh a month plus GST.

people.name: Vishal B. Mehta
people.bio: He is the company's CFO and a key managerial person, and signs the financial statements with the CEO. The company has not published his qualifications or background, or said whether he is related to the promoters.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Kishor Kikani resigned on 22 August 2026; Sujeet Kateliya was appointed Company Secretary from 24 August 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Sharad B Pitti is Founder & Chairman (an executive, whole-time director) and his son Akshay S Pitti is Managing Director & CEO. The day-to-day businesses are run by hired COOs and a chartered-accountant CFO. The promoter family and its holding company own about 54%.

people.name: Sharad B Pitti
people.since: Founder (operations began 1987); Chairman & MD until May 2024, then Founder & Chairman
people.relation: Founder; father of Akshay S Pitti
people.stake: 11.79% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 54.2%, including 28.45% through Pitti Electrical Equipment Pvt Ltd
people.bio: Sharad Pitti founded the company and built it into one of India's main makers of electrical-steel laminations, with more than four decades in the industry. He was Chairman & Managing Director until May 2024, when he handed the MD role to his son and was re-designated Founder & Chairman while staying a whole-time director. He also chairs the family's holding companies, Pitti Electrical Equipment, Pitti Holdings and Pitti Components. He and his wife Madhuri own the registered office and some factory land, which they lease to the company. The annual report and the company website give no details of his education.

people.name: Akshay S Pitti
people.since: 2004 (joined as whole-time director); MD & CEO since 2024
people.relation: Son of the Founder & Chairman Sharad B Pitti
people.bio: Akshay Pitti joined the company's leadership in October 2004 as a whole-time director and trained across its functions before taking charge. The company credits him with moving it from loose laminations to high-value stator and rotor assemblies and in-house machining, closing old units, building the large Aurangabad plant and making the Bagadia Chaitra and Dakshin Foundry acquisitions. He is Managing Director & CEO and chairs both subsidiaries. The company website and filings do not give his education.

people.name: M Pavan Kumar
people.bio: Pavan Kumar is a Fellow Chartered Accountant with about 19 years of work in banking, finance, accounts and tax. He has worked across power, steel, leather and textile companies. He joined Pitti in 2017 as General Manager – Finance and became Chief Financial Officer in November 2022. He runs finance strategy and treasury.

people.name: Sandip Agarwala
people.bio: Sandip Agarwala holds a post-graduate diploma in business management. He joined Pitti in May 2013 and has worked in marketing, business development and operations. As COO of the motor and generator components business, the company's core laminations and assemblies line, he runs production and delivery for that division.

people.name: Rishab Gupta
people.bio: Rishab Gupta has an MBA and more than ten years in manufacturing. His work covers supply chain, capital buying, factory automation, technology upgrades and ERP. He was Chief Procurement & Technology Officer before being named COO of machined components and enterprise sourcing in April 2025, after the previous COO of that business, Varun Agarwal, resigned.

people.name: Chaitra Sundaresh
people.bio: Chaitra Sundaresh is a commerce graduate with more than 20 years in electrical laminations. He co-owned and ran Bagadia Chaitra Industries, a lamination and die-cast rotor maker in Tumakuru, Karnataka, which Pitti bought in May 2024 (now Pitti Industries). He stays Managing Director of that unit and joined Pitti's senior team as Deputy COO.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the annual report. Independent director N Vinod Kumar resigned on 26 Aug 2026 for health reasons. Varun Agarwal, COO of machined components, left in April 2025.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Kirit Gala is Chairman & Managing Director and his son Smeet Gala, also a named promoter, is Vice President – Marketing & Sales. Two long-serving professionals from the old Gala group are whole-time directors. Aarti Industries' Rajendra Gogri sits on the board as a non-executive director. The Gala family owns about 55%.

people.name: Kirit Vishanji Gala
people.since: 2009 (MD since incorporation); CMD term to Nov 2028
people.relation: Promoter; father of Smeet Kirit Gala
people.stake: 21.84% (FY26 annual report); promoter family together about 55%
people.bio: Kirit Gala holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering (1984) and a master's in management studies (1986), both from the University of Bombay, and did a short course at IMD, Switzerland in 2022. He has been Managing Director since the company was set up in 2009 and took over the business of the older Gala Precision Technology. He runs strategy and marketing. He received the Pride of Welingkar award in 2023 and speaks on professional entrepreneurship and change management.

people.name: Balkishan Jalan
people.bio: Balkishan Jalan is a commerce graduate of the University of Bombay (1989) and a chartered accountant (1994). He joined the older Gala Equipments (later Gala Precision Technology) in 1998, where he was chief operating officer, and has been with this company since it was set up. He oversees operations, finance and general management. He won an SAP ACE Excellence award in 2010.

people.name: Satish Kotwani
people.bio: Satish Kotwani holds a diploma in mechanical engineering (1991) and diplomas in materials management (1992) and marketing management (1996), and has attended executive programmes at IIM Bangalore and ISB. He worked at Born Marketers from 1993 and joined Gala Equipments in 1995 as a business-development manager. He has about 30 years in marketing and runs global business development and sales.

people.name: S Giridhar (Giridhar Srinivasan)
people.since: Nov 2023 (with the company 2014–2021 and again from 2022)
people.bio: Giridhar Srinivasan is a commerce graduate of the University of Bombay (1987) and a chartered accountant (1993), with about 27 years in finance. He was Vice President – Finance and Accounts at Gala from 2014 to 2021, rejoined in that role in April 2022 and was promoted to CFO in November 2023. He runs accounts, finance and tax.

people.name: Smeet Kirit Gala
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD Kirit Gala; a named promoter
people.bio: Smeet Gala holds a B.Tech in production engineering from VJTI, University of Mumbai (2016). He joined the company in April 2021 as Associate Vice President – Marketing and Sales and is now listed as Vice President – Marketing & Sales in senior management. He is one of the two named promoters and is also a director of Workamp Spaces and Slate Workspaces.

people.name: Avadhut Panshikar
people.since: COO since April 2023 (joined the Gala group 2006)
people.bio: Avadhut Panshikar holds a diploma (1993) and a bachelor's degree (1996, Shivaji University) in mechanical engineering. He worked at SKF India, Mahindra & Mahindra and Bharat Bijlee before joining Gala Precision Technology in 2006. He rejoined Gala in 2014 after a short break, became Vice President – Operations in 2018 and Chief Operating Officer (disc springs and related products) in April 2023.

companies.changes: No changes in executives since the annual report (May 2026). A second COO, Rajendra Deshpande, is listed in senior management; the company gives no profile for him.

companies.styleNote: Third-generation promoter Pratik Patel is Chairman & Managing Director; his uncle Suresh Patel is an executive director and his cousin Rahul Patel sits on the board as a non-executive director. The German partner Axel Schutte (Schuette group) is a non-executive director with about 3.9%. The Patel–Amin family owns about 43%.

people.name: Pratik Patel
people.since: Director since about 1995; MD, now Chairman & MD
people.relation: Promoter (third generation of the founding family); nephew of Suresh Patel; cousin of director Rahul Patel; father of promoter Harsh Patel
people.stake: 12.05% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 43.2% (June 2026)
people.bio: Pratik Patel holds a bachelor's degree in production engineering from Sardar Patel University, Gujarat and an MBA in finance from Devi Ahilya University, Indore. The business was started in 1948 by Jashbhai Patel and run by the second generation before him. He has been a director since the mid-1990s, working mainly in marketing, product development and design, and the 2017 listing document credits him with the company's acquisitions and new products. He and the then chairman L. D. Amin personally guaranteed the company's bank loans at the time of the 2017 listing.

people.name: Suresh Patel
people.since: Feb 2023; re-appointed for two years from 14 Feb 2026
people.relation: Promoter group; uncle of Pratik Patel
people.bio: Suresh Patel is a member of the promoter group and has more than four decades of experience in running businesses, especially overall management, quality production and acquisitions, according to the company's February 2026 filing. He was first appointed executive director in February 2023 and was re-appointed in February 2026 for two more years. The company's filings do not give his education.

people.name: Dharmendra Jain
people.since: CFO; with the company since about 2006
people.bio: Dharmendra Jain is a Fellow Chartered Accountant and holds a B.Sc. from Mohanlal Sukhadia University, Udaipur. He has worked at Jash since about 2006 and, at the 2017 listing, already had more than 25 years in finance and accounts. He signs the company's accounts as CFO.

people.name: Bhuvanesh Pandey
people.since: Listed as senior management in FY25 and FY26
people.bio: Bhuvanesh Pandey is named as Chief Operating Officer in the company's senior management list. The annual report does not give a profile of him, and no filing with his background was found.

companies.changes: Suresh Patel was re-appointed executive director for two years from 14 Feb 2026. Independent director Vishwapati Trivedi left in Aug 2025 and Rakesh Bhawsar joined. No change in CFO or COO.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Tarak Patel is Managing Director, and since May 2026 the group is run by a Group CEO, Gregory Gelhaus, who is his brother-in-law and the son-in-law of promoter Ashok Patel. Ashok Patel, MD from 1988 to 2015, is now a non-executive director. The board is chaired by an independent director, Prakash Apte. The Patel family owns about 25%.

people.name: Tarak Patel
people.since: MD since June 2015; executive director since 2007; joined 2005
people.relation: Promoter; son of Ashok Patel; brother-in-law of Group CEO Gregory Gelhaus
people.stake: 1.16% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 25.2%
people.bio: Tarak Patel has a BA in economics from the University of Rochester, USA and an MBA jointly awarded by Columbia Business School, London Business School and HKU Business School. Before joining GMM Pfaudler in 2005 as Vice President – Sales and Marketing he worked at Universal Consulting, a Mumbai strategy consulting firm. He became an executive director in 2007 and Managing Director in June 2015, and shareholders re-appointed him for five years from May 2025. He took on the CEO's duties when Aseem Joshi left in September 2025. He is on the boards of Ready-Mix Concrete Ltd and ReefWatch Marine Conservation and chairs Charutar Arogya Mandal.

people.name: Gregory Gelhaus
people.since: Group CEO since 21 May 2026; joined May 2025 as Group Chief Transformation Officer
people.relation: Son-in-law of promoter Ashok Patel; brother-in-law of MD Tarak Patel
people.bio: Gregory Gelhaus holds a BBA in accounting from the University of Michigan's Ross School of Business and an MBA in finance and marketing from Wharton, and is a New York CPA. He was chief operating officer for Asia Pacific and Central Europe at Global Blue, where he sat on the executive committee, and earlier worked at PwC, Alvarez & Marsal and Kirkham Group. He joined GMM Pfaudler in May 2025 to run its Global Transformation Program and was made Group CEO in May 2026 under a new single-CEO structure. Because he is a promoter relative, his pay needs shareholder approval as a related-party office of profit.

people.name: Ankit Nayyar
people.role: Deputy CFO; Group CFO from 4 Nov 2026
people.bio: Ankit Nayyar is a chartered accountant with a B.Com from Shri Ram College of Commerce and a master's in accounting and finance from Manchester Business School. He was CFO of PI Health Sciences, where he ran global finance and M&A, and helped integrate Monsanto into Bayer in India. Earlier he worked at Pfizer, Morgan Stanley Capital and Tata AIG Life. He joined as Deputy CFO in May 2026 and takes over as Group CFO after the Q2 FY27 results on 4 November 2026.

people.name: Massimo Serapioni
people.bio: Massimo Serapioni holds a BBA and a master's in information, media and technology management from the University of St. Gallen, and a master's in international business strategy from the Stockholm School of Economics. Before GMM Pfaudler he was General Manager of the plastics recycling business at Coperion, where he led the purchase and integration of a German company. He has headed the corrosion-resistant technologies (glass-lined equipment) division since September 2025.

companies.changes: Group CFO Alexander Poempner resigned on 15 Sep 2026; he steps down after the Q2 results on 4 Nov 2026 and Ankit Nayyar takes over. Thomas Kehl, CEO of the international business, retired on 31 Aug 2026. Gregory Gelhaus became Group CEO in May 2026, after CEO Aseem Joshi left in Sep 2025. Manish Shah and Ulf Wittmann stopped being senior management in May 2026 in a reorganisation.

companies.styleNote: The Lalbhai family (Arvind group) controls the company, mainly through Aura Securities, and owns about 41%. No family member works in management: Punit Lalbhai has been non-executive Chairman since November 2025 (taking over from his father Sanjay Lalbhai), and his brother Kulin Lalbhai is a non-executive director. The business is run by a hired MD & CEO, Reginaldo Dsouza, who came from Godrej.

people.name: Reginaldo Dsouza
people.since: CEO since Oct 2022; MD since 6 Jul 2024
people.bio: Reginaldo Dsouza is a mechanical engineer (1997) and holds a PGPX from Great Lakes Institute, Chennai. He spent about 25 years at Godrej & Boyce, mostly in its process-equipment division, working across sales and marketing, operations, supply chain, IT and business excellence; in his last role he led sales and marketing, estimation and IT and ran new-business projects with profit-and-loss responsibility. He joined Anup as CEO in October 2022, replacing Rishi Roop Kapoor, and was made Managing Director in July 2024.

people.name: Nilesh Hirapara
people.bio: Nilesh Hirapara is a chartered accountant. Before Anup he was Head – Finance, Controlling & Treasury at AIA Engineering, and earlier worked at Larsen & Toubro. His experience covers finance and accounts, treasury, MIS, internal audit, compliance and SAP roll-outs. He became CFO in April 2023, replacing Bhavesh Shah.

people.name: Vikram Khandelwal
people.since: Listed as senior management in FY26
people.bio: Vikram Khandelwal is named Chief Operating Officer in the company's senior management list. The annual report and exchange filings do not give his background.

people.name: Dineshkumar Patel
people.bio: Dinesh Patel holds a diploma and a B.E. in mechanical engineering, and is an ASME Authorized Inspector and ASNT Level II in radiography, ultrasonic, magnetic-particle and dye-penetrant testing. He has more than 24 years in inspection of pressure vessels and heat exchangers for oil refining, power and energy projects, and is a lead auditor for ISO 9001. He joined senior management as Chief Quality Officer in May 2025.

people.name: Kunal Shah
people.bio: Kunal Shah is a commerce graduate with a master's in labour welfare from Gujarat University and a certificate in strategic management from XLRI. He has more than 24 years in human resources, covering hiring, pay structures, career planning, performance management and staffing greenfield projects. He joined as Chief Human Resource Officer in May 2025.

companies.changes: No changes in executives since the annual report (July 2026). Rudolph Mathias, appointed Chief Marketing Officer in Aug 2025, left in Oct 2025. Punit Lalbhai replaced his father Sanjay Lalbhai as Chairman in Nov 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founder Krishan Lalit Bansal is Chairman & Managing Director. His daughter-in-law Shikha Bansal and his daughter Shruti Aggarwal are whole-time directors; his wife Ashima Bansal stepped down from the board in April 2025. The Bansal family owns about 70%, with Krishan Lalit Bansal alone holding about 51%.

people.name: Krishan Lalit Bansal
people.since: 1988 (founder); CMD term renewed from Apr 2022 for five years
people.relation: Founder; husband of promoter Ashima Bansal; father of Shruti Aggarwal; father-in-law of Shikha Bansal
people.stake: 50.82% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 70.2%
people.bio: Krishan Lalit Bansal holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh. He started a partnership, Development Engineers, in 1986 and has run DEE since it was incorporated in 1988, building it into a maker of prefabricated process piping, with a side business in biomass power. His other ventures include DEE Group Trust and DDE Piping Components, a promoter company. The Faridabad Industrial Association named him Business Leader of the Year in 2011 and gave him a Lifetime Achievement Award in 2016. He sold shares in the company's 2024 IPO.

people.name: Shikha Bansal
people.since: Dec 2020; re-appointed from 1 Nov 2025 to Oct 2030
people.relation: Daughter-in-law of the Chairman & MD; sister-in-law of Shruti Aggarwal
people.bio: Shikha Bansal holds a B.Com from the University of Delhi and an M.Com from Himachal Pradesh University. She joined the company in December 2020 as a whole-time director. She is also Managing Director of the Thailand subsidiary, DEE Piping Systems (Thailand), and oversees group strategy, operations, international business, HR and marketing across India and Southeast Asia, including budgeting and management reporting.

people.name: Shruti Aggarwal
people.since: Board since Apr 2025; with the company since 2011
people.relation: Daughter of the Chairman & MD Krishan Lalit Bansal
people.bio: Shruti Aggarwal holds a B.Com from the University of Delhi, is a Chartered Financial Analyst (ICFAI) and has a PGDM in finance from Shri Ram Institute of Management, plus an executive certificate in business finance from IIM Raipur. She joined DEE in 2011 as a senior manager in operations, became Vice-President (Operations) in 2023 and joined the board in April 2025, when her mother Ashima Bansal stepped down. She runs the Indian operations, with a focus on project execution, planning, budgeting and forecasting.

people.name: Pankaj Agarwal
people.since: COO since Jul 2023; with the company since 1994
people.bio: Pankaj Agarwal joined DEE in July 1994 as marketing manager and has worked there for more than 30 years. He was made Chief Operating Officer, customer relations, in July 2023 and is part of the core management team. The 2024 prospectus lists his qualification as the senior school certificate (science) from Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi.

people.name: Brham Prakash Yadav
people.bio: Brham Prakash Yadav is a chartered accountant and cost accountant with more than 30 years in finance, mostly at multi-plant auto-component makers. He was CFO and a board member of the listed Munjal Auto Industries from May 2020, and before that AVP-Finance at Hema Engineering Industries (2014–2020), where he ran finance for six plants. Earlier he held finance roles at Omax Autos, SIAC SKH Cabs, Krishna Maruti and Lifelong. He has worked on IPOs, private equity and bank fund-raising.

companies.changes: CFO Sameer Agarwal resigned on 5 Jan 2026 for personal reasons; Brham Prakash Yadav took over on 7 Jan 2026. Ashima Bansal resigned as a whole-time director on 14 Apr 2025. The subsidiaries' CEOs, Krisanakorn Triwattanathongchai (Thailand) and Balwan Singh Jangra (Malwa Power), are also listed as senior management; the company gives no profiles for them.

companies.styleNote: The Puri family controls Isgec. Aditya Puri is Managing Director; his father Ranjit Puri, who guided the company for decades, is non-executive Chairman. Two long-serving professionals, Kishore Chatnani (also CFO) and Sanjay Gulati, are Joint Managing Directors. The promoters, including The Yamuna Syndicate, own about 62.4% with no pledge.

people.name: Aditya Puri
people.since: Joined as Controller of Finance; MD, re-appointed for five years from 1 May 2026
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman Ranjit Puri
people.stake: 6.21% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 62.4%
people.bio: Aditya Puri holds a BA (Hons) from St. Stephen's College, Delhi and an MA in economics from Cambridge University. He has more than 35 years with the group, joining Isgec as Controller of Finance and rising to Managing Director. He is also Managing Director of the wholly owned sugar subsidiary Saraswati Sugar Mills and sits on the boards of other group companies. Shareholders re-appointed him MD until April 2031.

people.name: Kishore Chatnani
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Chief Financial Officer
people.since: With the company since 1998; whole-time director from June 2021; Joint MD since Oct 2025
people.bio: Kishore Chatnani holds a B.E. in industrial production engineering from Nagpur University and an MBA in finance from IMS, Indore University. He has more than 35 years in finance, treasury, investment management and M&A, and has been with Isgec since 1998. He joined the board as a whole-time director in 2021, was re-designated Joint Managing Director in October 2025 and re-appointed for five years from June 2026, while staying CFO. He also sits on the boards of other group companies.

people.name: Sanjay Gulati
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Head, Manufacturing Units
people.since: Whole-time director from June 2021; Joint MD since Oct 2025
people.bio: Sanjay Gulati holds a B.E. in industrial production engineering from SGSITS, Indore. He has more than 35 years across marketing, exports, manufacturing, projects and planning, HR and greenfield projects. He heads Isgec's manufacturing units and is also Managing Director of Isgec Hitachi Zosen, the joint venture with Hitachi Zosen. He was re-designated Joint Managing Director in October 2025 and re-appointed for five years from June 2026.

companies.changes: Since the annual report: Gaurav Sharma joined as Business Head – Global Industrial Services and Solutions (3 Aug 2026), Rajesh Goyal as Chief Supply Chain Officer – Project Business (15 Sep 2026), and Chief HR Officer Radhika Arora resigned (21 Sep 2026). Chief Strategy Officer Anup Bhargava retired in Feb 2026. Two independent directors finished their terms in 2025.

companies.styleNote: Three generations of the Khemka family run the company: Hari Shanker Khemka is Chairman and whole-time director, his son Aditya Khemka is Managing Director and built the CP PLUS brand, and Aditya's son Ananmay Khemka is a whole-time director. Aditya's brother Rishi Khemka is a promoter but not in management. The family owned about 74.7% in June 2026, before the September 2026 share placement.

people.name: Aditya Khemka
people.since: About 30 years in the business; MD
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman Hari Shanker Khemka; father of Ananmay Khemka; brother of promoter Rishi Khemka
people.stake: 31.53% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 74.7%
people.bio: Aditya Khemka studied commerce at Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University and has a post-graduate diploma in international business from FORE School of Management, New Delhi. He has about 30 years in IT and video surveillance and is credited with building the CP PLUS brand. At the company he runs growth strategy, operations, investments and core product development. Under a 2024 family agreement he votes on behalf of the other family shareholders and nominates the family's directors. He was named Business World's Security Man of the Year in 2023.

people.name: Hari Shanker Khemka
people.relation: Promoter; father of MD Aditya Khemka and of Rishi Khemka; grandfather of Ananmay Khemka
people.stake: About 0.00% held directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); the family holds through its members and the Hari Khemka Business Family Trust
people.bio: Hari Shanker Khemka took the final exam for a B.Sc. in chemistry at Hindu College, Delhi University. He has about 30 years in IT and electronic video surveillance. As Chairman and a whole-time director he handles legal matters, administration and strategic planning. He has received several Rotary Club Delhi Premier awards.

people.name: Ananmay Khemka
people.since: Joined Jul 2020; whole-time director since 23 Sep 2024
people.relation: Son of MD Aditya Khemka; grandson of Chairman Hari Shanker Khemka
people.bio: Ananmay Khemka holds a bachelor's degree in global management from Regent's University, London. He joined the company in July 2020 as manager – strategy and business development, working in the internet-of-things business, and was made a whole-time director in September 2024 for five years. He is one of the named promoters.

people.name: Yogesh Chand Sharma
people.bio: Yogesh Chand Sharma is a commerce graduate of Delhi University and a Fellow Chartered Accountant with more than 28 years in finance. Before joining in January 2011 he was general manager (finance) at Rohan Motors and Allied Motors, and earlier worked at Allied Nippon, Techno Foto and the CA firm Singhal Associates. He runs financial strategy and planning.

people.name: Sanjay Gogia
people.bio: Sanjay Gogia holds a bachelor's degree in electronics engineering from the University of Lucknow and joined the company straight after, in April 2000. He has spent more than 24 years in sales there and leads sales strategy across all products and regions. He was paid about ₹2.9cr in FY25.

people.name: Anup Nair
people.bio: Anup Nair holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Mumbai and an MBA from Deakin University. He has more than 21 years in IT distribution and security, and before joining in June 2016 was a project consultant at IndusInd Entertainment and director (corporate alliances) at Neoteric Infomatique. He handles the sales team, strategy and key initiatives.

people.name: Monika Sharma
people.role: Senior Vice President – R&D & Product Development
people.bio: Monika Sharma holds a B.Com from Delhi University and an MBA from Southern Taiwan University. She first worked for the company as a general manager in 2011, served as legal representative of its Shenzhen and Hong Kong subsidiaries, and rejoined in January 2021. She runs research and product development.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the annual report (July 2026). Non-executive director Atul B. Lall resigned on 25 May 2026. A September 2026 share placement of about ₹1,500cr lowers the family's stake below the June figure.

companies.styleNote: The promoter group, led by the Khaitan family (Williamson Magor group companies) and the promoter company Firstview Trading (29.6%), owned about 46% at March 2026. No promoter works in management: Amritanshu Khaitan has been non-executive Chairman since April 2026, and Aditya Khaitan left the board in March 2026. The company is run by a hired Managing Director, Ranjit Lala, with a whole-time director for operations and long-serving executives.

people.name: Ranjit Pamo Lala
people.since: MD; re-appointed for two years from 15 May 2025 to May 2027
people.bio: Ranjit Lala holds a B.E. in machine tool engineering and a master's in marketing management, and has attended management programmes at leading institutes. He has about 37 years in engineering companies. Before Kilburn he was Managing Director of Aerzen Machines India for about seven years, where he ran the business and set up a new factory. At Kilburn he is responsible for overall management and is not related to any director.

people.name: Anil Somshekar Karnad
people.since: Re-appointed for two years from 1 Apr 2025 to Mar 2027
people.bio: Anil Karnad holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering from Mumbai University. He has worked across oil and gas, fertilisers, power and chemicals, and at Kilburn runs day-to-day operations: production, quality, engineering, procurement, subcontracting, and site erection and commissioning.

people.name: Sachin Vijayakar
people.since: CFO since 2019; with the company since 1985
people.bio: Sachin Vijayakar is a commerce graduate who has worked at Kilburn since 1985, according to a company investor presentation. He is the company's Chief Financial Officer and signs its accounts.

people.name: Maqsood R. Kazi
people.bio: M. R. Kazi holds a diploma in mechanical engineering and has worked at Kilburn since 1986, according to a company investor presentation. He was Vice President – Marketing and is now President – Marketing, and is part of the senior management team.

companies.changes: Nitin Varadkar (Purchase Head) and Dinesh Nikam (Project Head) were added to senior management on 14 Aug 2026. Company Secretary Arvind Bajoria resigned in Sep 2025 and Abhijit Mehta replaced him in Nov 2025. Amritanshu Khaitan became Chairman in April 2026 after Aditya Khaitan resigned in March 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Madan Mohan Mohanka became non-executive Chairman in February 2025; his son Mehul Mohanka runs the company as Managing Director & Group CEO. The rest of the top team is hired. The Mohanka family owns about 67.5%, mostly through Nihal Fiscal Services (49.9%) and family trusts; Madan Mohan Mohanka holds 7.3% directly.

people.name: Mehul Mohanka
people.since: With the company for about two decades; MD & Group CEO
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman Madan Mohan Mohanka
people.stake: 0.28% held directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 67.5%
people.bio: Mehul Mohanka holds a B.Com from the University of Calcutta and an MBA from the University of Pittsburgh, and completed the Advanced Management Program at Harvard Business School. He has worked at Tega for about two decades, across sales and operations, and now leads the group, including the June 2026 purchase of Molycop, which roughly doubled its size. He is President of the Indian Chamber of Commerce, chairs the CII's mining and construction equipment division, co-chairs its national mining committee, and earlier chaired the CII West Bengal state council.

people.name: Ravi Narayan Joshi
people.bio: Ravi Narayan Joshi is a chartered accountant and law graduate with more than 21 years in finance. He spent about 15 years in the Vedanta group, including Hindustan Zinc and the group's management assurance team, and was then Deputy CFO at Balkrishna Industries. His work has covered treasury, fund-raising, structured finance, M&A, tax, cost control and ESG. He joined Tega as CFO in August 2026, as it takes on the debt from the Molycop deal.

people.name: Manoj Kumar Sinha
people.bio: Manoj Kumar Sinha holds a bachelor's degree in engineering from Sambalpur University. Before joining Tega in September 2015 he worked at Tata Engineering and Locomotive Company (now Tata Motors), New Holland Tractors (India) and Sterling Generators. He runs Tega's global manufacturing operations.

people.name: Pratik Basu Roy
people.role: President – Product Management, Global Sales, Marketing and R&D
people.bio: Pratik Basu Roy holds a bachelor's degree in engineering from Mangalore University and a post-graduate management degree from NMIMS, Mumbai. He has worked at Siemens Wind Energy, Maruti Suzuki, Wockhardt, Suzlon Energy, Birla Tyres and the Varroc Group, in roles covering business P&L, strategy, M&A and post-merger integration, sales and investor relations. He joined Tega in November 2023.

people.name: Vinay Grover
people.bio: Vinay Grover is a B.Tech graduate with more than 30 years in mining, mineral processing, crushing and screening. He worked at Metso Minerals (India) before joining Tega in 2003, and has since held sales, business-development, channel and product roles, with work in Canada, Latin America, Europe and India. He was President – Global Sales before being named Global Head of Sales, a senior management post, from September 2026.

people.name: Shiraj Chakraborty
people.since: Listed as senior management in FY26
people.bio: Shiraj Chakraborty has a bachelor's and a master's in statistics from Delhi University and an MBA in HR from Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, Pune. He started in 2000 as an HR management trainee at GlaxoSmithKline Consumer Healthcare and later worked at RoundGlass Wellbeing, Greaves Cotton, Viacom18 and Kohler, before an HR advisory and consulting role and then joining Tega.

companies.changes: CFO Sharad Kumar Khaitan resigned effective 5 May 2026 to pursue opportunities outside the group; Shyama Prasad Ganguly was interim CFO until Ravi Narayan Joshi joined on 6 Aug 2026. Vinay Grover was named Global Head of Sales from 1 Sep 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Ravalnath Shende is Chairman & Managing Director; his wife Rajashri and their daughters Devashree Nampurkar and Rucha Shende are whole-time directors. A retired naval commodore, Sunil Kaushik, is the one non-family whole-time director. The founding couple own about 44.6%.

people.name: Ravalnath Gopinath Shende
people.relation: Founder; husband of Rajashri Shende; father of Devashree Nampurkar and Rucha Shende
people.bio: Ravalnath Shende holds a bachelor's degree in production engineering from VJTI, University of Bombay (1983). He founded the company and has been a director since it was incorporated in 2006. His experience covers sales, manufacturing, operations, planning, finance and compressor manufacturing. He has received the GS Parkhe award for innovation in entrepreneurship and the Brig SB Ghorpade award for MSMEs in defence manufacturing.

people.name: Rajashri Ravalnath Shende
people.since: Director since 2006; whole-time director since 2021, re-appointed Feb 2026
people.relation: Co-founder; wife of the Chairman & MD; mother of Devashree Nampurkar and Rucha Shende
people.bio: Rajashri Shende holds a diploma in electronics and telecommunication engineering (1986). She is a founding member of the company, has been a director for about 20 years and became a whole-time director in 2021. The board re-appointed her as a whole-time director in February 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

people.name: Devashree Vishwesh Nampurkar
people.relation: Promoter; daughter of the Chairman & MD and Rajashri Shende; sister of Rucha Shende
people.bio: Devashree Nampurkar holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering from Shivaji University, Kolhapur (2010) and an MSc in business and management from the University of Strathclyde (2012). She joined the company in 2016 as Manager – Sales & Marketing and has about 13 years in sales, marketing and business strategy. She joined the board in May 2024.

people.name: Rucha Ravalnath Shende
people.relation: Daughter of the Chairman & MD and Rajashri Shende; sister of Devashree Nampurkar
people.bio: Rucha Shende is a mechanical engineer with a background in HVAC, plumbing and fire-protection design, working in the field since 2019 on institutional, healthcare, laboratory and public-sector projects using Revit and AutoCAD. She was appointed to the board as a whole-time director in February 2026, and her appointment was put to shareholders at the August 2026 AGM.

people.name: Commodore Sunil Kaushik, NM, VSM (Retd.)
people.bio: Sunil Kaushik holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from Jawaharlal Nehru University, an M.Phil, an M.Sc in defence and strategic studies, and a post-graduate diploma in industrial engineering. He served more than 35 years in the Indian Navy, where he led warship-building projects and worked on project planning and contract management. He joined the board as a whole-time director in November 2024.

people.name: Abhijeet Govind Saoji
people.bio: Abhijeet Saoji holds a B.Tech in agricultural engineering and had about 15 years in manufacturing when he was made CEO in November 2023. The 2025 IPO prospectus lists no previous employer for him. The company gives no further background.

people.name: Manoj Mahavir Kothale
people.bio: Manoj Kothale is a chartered accountant. He was appointed CFO in November 2023, and at the time of the 2025 IPO had a little over four years of experience in finance, banking and tax; his previous employer is listed as LV Dairys, Patas.

companies.changes: Rajashri Shende and Rucha Shende were appointed whole-time directors on 23 Feb 2026. Company Secretary Ashwini Godbole was replaced by Tanmay Pethkar during FY26. No executive changes found since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Run by its three Indian co-promoters, all ex-engineering-company men: Arvind Kamath is Chairman, Dipak Bharuka is CEO and Goutam Rampelli is a whole-time director. They are business partners, not a family. Promoters own about 68%: the promoter company Mascot Capital & Marketing (Kamath is a director) about 32.5%, the Korean founder JNK Global (formerly JNK Heaters) about 18%, Bharuka 8.9% and Rampelli 8.3%. JNK Global's CEO Kim Bang-hee sits on the board as a non-executive director.

people.name: Arvind Kamath
people.relation: Promoter; director of promoter company Mascot Capital & Marketing
people.stake: Individual stake not found; promoter company Mascot Capital & Marketing, where he is a director, holds about 32.5% (latest shareholding pattern); promoters together about 68%
people.bio: Arvind Kamath holds a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering from NIT Surathkal. Before JNK he worked with Sulzer Pumps India and was associated with Chetra Seals, Mascot Flowtech and Mascot Global. He has been with JNK India since 16 August 2010 and the company credits him with driving its diversification beyond fired heaters. He is also a director of Mascot Capital & Marketing and other Mascot group companies.

people.name: Dipak Bharuka
people.relation: Co-promoter (not related to the other promoters)
people.bio: Dipak Bharuka has an M.E. in machine design from IIT Roorkee and an executive MBA in project management from SP Jain Institute of Management & Research. He spent 12 years at Larsen & Toubro, leaving as Assistant General Manager. At JNK he is the CEO and a whole-time director.

people.name: Goutam Rampelli
people.relation: Co-promoter (not related to the other promoters)
people.bio: Goutam Rampelli spent over 36 years with L&T Hydrocarbon Engineering & Construction, working in marketing, business development, project execution and strategic planning. He joined JNK in 2015 and is a co-promoter and board member. The company credits him with strong negotiation skills and a wide industry network.

people.name: Anand Agarwal
