people.bio: Anand Agarwal is a chartered accountant with about 20 years of experience across EPC, infrastructure, industrial parks and oil and gas. He was named interim CFO and key managerial personnel from 12 March 2026, after the previous CFO Pravin Sathe resigned in December 2025.

companies.changes: CFO Pravin Sathe resigned effective 16 Dec 2025; Anand Agarwal is interim CFO from 12 Mar 2026 (no permanent CFO named yet).

companies.styleNote: Promoter Prakash Agarwal has been Managing Director since 2002 and is the only promoter on the board; three hired executive directors run finance, operations and projects. Promoter group holds 70.8%. His daughter Aanya Agarwal works in the company. The group also controls Hindusthan Udyog and Bengal Steel Industries.

people.name: Prakash Agarwal
people.relation: Promoter; father of Aanya Agarwal (employee)
people.bio: Prakash Agarwal, 55, is a mechanical engineer (BE) with about 31 years of experience. He came from the promoter group's Hindusthan Udyog, joined WPIL's board as a non-executive director in 2000 and became Managing Director on 1 July 2002; shareholders re-appointed him from 1 November 2025. The company lists his strengths as marketing, new products, turnarounds, international marketing and setting up new operations; WPIL's overseas pump subsidiaries in South Africa, Australia, the UK and Italy (Gruppo Aturia) were all added during his tenure. He is also a non-executive promoter director of Hindusthan Udyog. He drew ₹2.94cr in FY26.

people.name: K. K. Ganeriwala
people.bio: K. K. Ganeriwala, 63, holds a B.Com (Hons) and LLB and is a qualified cost accountant (FCMA) and company secretary (FCS), with about 41 years in finance: planning, fund raising, investor relations, tax, M&A and restructuring. He was a non-executive director for five years before becoming Executive Director in 2007, covering finance, accounts, tax and legal. He sits on the boards of the overseas subsidiaries (Aturia, Mather & Platt SA, APE Pumps, Sterling Pumps) and of promoter-group companies including Hindusthan Parsons. Re-appointed from 1 November 2025.

people.name: Brahma Prakash Khare
people.bio: Brahma Prakash Khare holds an M.E. in mechanical engineering and has about 46 years in the pump industry across design, quality assurance and manufacturing. He headed WPIL's Ghaziabad business unit for more than 15 years before joining the board as Executive Director (Operations).

people.name: Debraj Roy
people.bio: Debraj Roy holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering, an M.E. in production and a PGCBM, with 30-plus years managing large engineering projects, including quality and contract management. He became Executive Director (Projects) in April 2024.

people.name: U. Chakravarty
people.bio: U. Chakravarty is a fellow company secretary (FCS-5127) and is the company's General Manager (Finance) and Company Secretary, listed among key managerial personnel. WPIL does not name a separate CFO.

companies.changes: No KMP changes after the FY26 annual report found. Prakash Agarwal and K. K. Ganeriwala re-appointed from 1 Nov 2025; B. P. Khare from 1 Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Pramod Chaudhari stays on as executive Founder Chairman & Mentor, but day-to-day the company is run by a hired Managing Director, Ashish Gaikwad (ex-Honeywell), with Sachin Raole as Joint MD & CFO. Their son Parth Chaudhari is a non-executive director; Pramod's wife Parimal Chaudhari left the board in August 2025. Promoters own 32.8%.

people.name: Pramod Chaudhari
people.role: Founder Chairman & Mentor – Praj Group (Whole-time Director)
people.since: 1983 (founder); current executive term from 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2030
people.relation: Founder; husband of Parimal Chaudhari and father of Parth Chaudhari (non-executive director)
people.stake: 24.97% (FY26 annual report); with wife Parimal (7.83%) the promoters hold 32.81%
people.bio: Pramod Chaudhari is an IIT Bombay graduate (1971, later named a Distinguished Alumnus) and attended Harvard Business School's Advanced Management Program in 1995. A first-generation entrepreneur, he founded Praj in 1983 and built it into India's largest biofuel technology company, with more than 1,000 installations in over 100 countries. He moved from non-executive chairman back to an executive role from July 2025; shareholders approved this by special resolution because he is over 75. He chairs the governing board of COEP Technological University, Pune, and founded the Indian Federation of Green Energy. His awards include the George Washington Carver Award (2020) and the William C. Holmberg lifetime award (2022).

people.name: Ashish Gaikwad
people.since: 3 February 2025 as MD-designate; MD from 1 July 2025 (term to 31 January 2030)
people.bio: Ashish Gaikwad holds a B.E. (Hons) in electrical and electronics engineering from BITS Pilani. He spent about three decades at Honeywell, starting as an automation and process control engineer and working in India, South-East Asia, Asia Pacific and the USA; for over seven years he was Managing Director of the listed Honeywell Automation India. Under him Honeywell Automation was named Business Standard's Star MNC of the Year 2019, and Fortune India listed him among top wealth creators in 2021. He replaced long-time CEO & MD Shishir Joshipura at Praj in July 2025.

people.name: Sachin Raole
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Chief Financial Officer
people.since: JMD & CFO from 30 April 2026 (earlier CFO & Director – Resources)
people.bio: Sachin Raole is a chartered accountant and cost accountant with about 31 years in finance and accounts: M&A, divestments, restructuring, treasury and tax. Before Praj he worked with RPG group companies, including KEC International, RPG Cables and RPG Life Sciences. At Praj he was CFO & Director – Resources, also overseeing HR, materials, IT, legal and secretarial, and was elevated to Joint Managing Director & CFO for five years from 30 April 2026. He is on the boards of the main subsidiaries, including Praj GenX, Praj HiPurity and Praj Americas.

people.name: Anant Bavare
people.bio: Anant Bavare is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and one of the four key managerial personnel named in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: CEO & MD Shishir Joshipura retired on 30 June 2025; Ashish Gaikwad took over as MD on 1 July 2025. Sachin Raole became Joint MD & CFO from 30 April 2026. Senior executive Ajay Pratap Singh (VP & Business Head) left in September 2025.

companies.styleNote: A Seth family business: Chairman Lalit Seth is a whole-time director and his two sons hold the other top jobs, Rishi Seth as Managing Director and Gautam Seth as Joint MD and CFO. There are no hired executives on the board. Promoters own 72.7% (22.75% directly by family members and 49.91% through family companies such as HPL India, HPL Electronics and HPL Holdings).

people.name: Lalit Seth
people.relation: Promoter; father of Rishi Seth and Gautam Seth
people.bio: Lalit Seth has more than 56 years in the electrical industry and heads the HPL group as its Chairman. The company credits him with its transformation into a maker of meters, switchgear, lighting, wires and cables, and with building its reputation for quality and technology. He is one of three family executives on the board and did not take a pay rise in FY26.

people.name: Rishi Seth
people.since: Managing Director; retired by rotation and stood for re-appointment at the 24 September 2026 AGM
people.relation: Son of Lalit Seth; brother of Gautam Seth
people.bio: Rishi Seth holds an MBA in finance and has over 31 years in the electrical industry. As Managing Director he sets strategy and leads diversification, including EPC and green-energy projects, and he oversees the institutional and government business, which includes the smart-meter orders from power utilities. The company credits him with making HPL one of the leading smart-meter makers.

people.name: Gautam Seth
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Chief Financial Officer
people.since: Joint MD; also CFO since March 2022
people.relation: Son of Lalit Seth; brother of Rishi Seth
people.bio: Gautam Seth is a commerce graduate and a qualified chartered accountant with over 29 years in the electrical industry. As Joint Managing Director he oversees the group's overall running and administration and leads sales and marketing. He also became CFO and key managerial personnel in March 2022, so the finance function reports to a family member.

people.name: Vivek Kumar
people.bio: Vivek Kumar is the Company Secretary and the only key managerial personnel from outside the Seth family named in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: No board or KMP changes in FY26 or since the annual report. Independent director Rashmi Vij was re-appointed from 11 May 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Khurana family company: brothers Pushkar Khurana (Executive Chairman, runs the overseas business from Dubai) and Puneet Khurana (Managing Director) are the sons of the late founder Prem Kumar Khurana. A hired CEO, N. P. Gupta (ex-Jamna Auto), joined in July 2026. Promoters own about 67.4%, including Suman Khurana 24.4% and the family firm Khurana Gases 15.9%.

people.name: Pushkar Khurana
people.since: Board since September 1994; Executive Chairman since 14 November 2019
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late founder Prem Kumar Khurana; brother of MD Puneet Khurana
people.stake: 9.13% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 67.4%
people.bio: Pushkar Khurana, 54, is a commerce graduate from Mumbai University with an MBA from the USA, and recently completed Harvard Business School's Owner/President Management programme. He has been with the EKC group for about three decades and oversees its international business as Managing Director of the Dubai subsidiary EKC International FZE. He also sits on the boards of the subsidiaries in Egypt, Europe and the US (CP Industries) and of family companies such as Khurana Gases. He retired by rotation and stood for re-appointment at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Puneet Khurana
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late founder Prem Kumar Khurana; brother of Chairman Pushkar Khurana
people.bio: Puneet Khurana, 53, is a commerce graduate and completed a business management course at Mumbai University; he has about 30 years in the business. He opened export markets for the company's CNG cylinders in Iran, Malaysia, Thailand and Bangladesh and built relationships with vehicle makers such as Bajaj Auto, Tata Motors, Mahindra and Eicher, and with city gas companies such as MGL, IGL, Adani and Torrent. The company cites his expertise in innovation and R&D in cylinders, and he is a director of Calcutta Compressions & Liquefaction Engineering, Next Gen Cylinder and CP Industries Holdings.

people.name: Narender Prasad Gupta
people.bio: N. P. Gupta is a mechanical engineer (Institution of Engineers, India) with an MBA from IMT Ghaziabad and a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. He has more than 25 years of leadership experience in automotive and manufacturing, including senior roles at Jamna Auto Industries and Hero Motors. His areas are strategy, operations, lean manufacturing, supply chain and business transformation. CEO Insights named him among the top 10 Indian manufacturing CEOs in 2024.

people.name: Sanjiv Kapur
people.since: CFO; whole-time director since 26 May 2025 (term ends 31 October 2026)
people.bio: Sanjiv Kapur, 65, is a chartered accountant with over 42 years in finance roles across manufacturing industries including textiles, steel, auto ancillaries and industrial products. As CFO he also handles legal and other corporate matters. He was made a whole-time director in May 2025 and retires on 31 October 2026, after which the board wants him to stay on as a non-executive director from 1 November 2026.

people.name: Vishal Totla
people.bio: Vishal Totla is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and one of the company's key managerial personnel.

companies.changes: N. P. Gupta joined as CEO on 1 July 2026. CFO Sanjiv Kapur retires on 31 October 2026 and is proposed as a non-executive director from 1 November 2026; no successor CFO had been announced as of late September 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Patel family company run by two brothers' branches: Himanshu Patel is Managing Director and his son Harsh Patel is whole-time director; his brother Nilesh Patel sits on the board as a non-executive director and Nilesh's son Aalap Patel is an executive director. Promoters own 65.6%, almost all held by these four. The chairman, Yatish Parekh, is an independent director.

people.name: Himanshu Patel
people.relation: Promoter; father of Harsh Patel; brother of Nilesh Patel; uncle of Aalap Patel
people.bio: Himanshu Patel is an electrical engineer (B.E., University of Bombay, 1976) with about 49 years in the chemicals and engineering business. The company credits him with shaping its strategy and operating framework and guiding its long-term growth. He joined the board with the other family directors on 31 December 2016 and, as MD, certifies the accounts together with the CFO.

people.name: Harsh Patel
people.since: Director since 31 December 2016; whole-time director since 1 October 2022
people.relation: Son of MD Himanshu Patel; nephew of Nilesh Patel; first cousin of Aalap Patel
people.bio: Harsh Patel, born 1977, is a chemical engineer from the University of Mumbai with an MBA from Seattle University. He has more than 25 years in the chemicals and engineering business and drives product innovation, operations and expansion. He is also a director of family companies including Kinam Engineering Industries, Kinam Process Equipments, HLE Engineers and Yashashvi Rasayan, some of which do business with HLE Glascoat.

people.name: Aalap Patel
people.relation: Son of Nilesh Patel; nephew of Himanshu Patel; first cousin of Harsh Patel
people.bio: Aalap Patel holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering from the University of Pune and an MBA in global management from Thunderbird School of Global Management. He has over 14 years of industry experience and works on strategic planning and operations. He chairs the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Amit Kalra
people.bio: Amit Kalra has about 22 years of experience in P&L management and corporate transformation. He was already part of HLE Glascoat's senior management, working on its strategic transformation, before being named CFO from 25 September 2026. His first task is to steer the ongoing restructuring and deal with the sharp margin fall seen in Q1 FY27.

people.name: Achal Thakkar
people.bio: Achal Thakkar is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and one of the company's key managerial personnel.

companies.changes: CFO Naveen Kandpal resigned effective 3 July 2026; Amit Kalra (from within senior management) became CFO on 25 September 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Kandula family: Nageswara Rao Kandula is Managing Director, his wife Krishna Veni Kandula and his brother Ramakrishna Kandula are executive directors. A second promoter family, the Katragadda brothers, has one executive and one non-executive director. Japan's AGI group, a strategic investor, has its CEO Yasuyuki Ikeda on the board as an executive nominee director. Promoters own 60.5%; the chairman is independent.

people.name: Nageswara Rao Kandula
people.relation: Promoter; husband of Krishna Veni Kandula; brother of Ramakrishna Kandula
people.bio: Nageswara Rao Kandula holds a diploma in business management and an MBA, both in finance, from the Indian School of Business Management and Administration. He has been with the company since it was set up and has more than a decade of experience in glass lining, engineering and allied industries. The annual report lists his strengths as strategy, finance and capital allocation, and precision manufacturing. He led the company through its January 2025 stock market listing and its later rename from Standard Glass Lining Technology to Standard Engineering Technology. He is also a director of the family's Standard Group of Companies and Standard C2C Engineering.

people.name: Ramakrishna Kandula
people.relation: Promoter; brother of MD Nageswara Rao Kandula
people.stake: 22.09% directly (March 2026 shareholding pattern); also a partner in promoter firms S2 Engineering Services (9.44%) and Standard Holdings (2.31%)
people.bio: Ramakrishna Kandula, 48, passed Parts I and II of the Technicians Engineering Examination of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers. He has more than 14 years in making stainless steel and nickel-alloy equipment; his listed strengths are manufacturing and shop-floor operations. He is Managing Director of the main subsidiary, S2 Engineering Industry, and a partner in S2 Engineering Services. He stood for re-appointment by rotation at the 18 September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Krishna Veni Kandula
people.relation: Promoter; wife of MD Nageswara Rao Kandula
people.stake: 18.64% (March 2026 shareholding pattern); also a partner in promoter firms S2 Engineering Services and Standard Holdings
people.bio: Krishna Veni Kandula, 45, holds an MBA and a graduate diploma in management, both in finance, from the Indian School of Business Management and Administration. She has been with the company since incorporation and has about 14 years in glass lining and engineering, covering general management and administration. She is a director of many family companies, including S2 Engineering Industry, Standard Flora, CPK Engineers Equipment and Standard Scigenics. She stood for re-appointment by rotation at the 18 September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Venkata Mohana Rao Katragadda
people.relation: Promoter group; brother of non-executive director Venkata Siva Prasad Katragadda (not related to the Kandulas)
people.bio: Venkata Mohana Rao Katragadda holds a diploma in mechanical engineering from Tamil Nadu's State Board of Technical Education and passed the chartered engineer examination of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers (India). Before joining he was Deputy Chief Engineer at The Jeypore Sugar Company, and he has over three decades in construction and engineering. His listed strengths are mechanical engineering, project execution and industrial operations, and he chairs the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Yasuyuki Ikeda
people.bio: Yasuyuki Ikeda is Chief Executive Officer of Japan's AGI Group (Asahi Glassplant), a glass-lined equipment and chemical-processing company that invested in Standard, and he sits on the board as the AGI investors' nominee. He holds a diploma from The American School in England (TASIS) and has over 25 years in engineering and chemical processing. He is also a director of AGI's Indian ventures, including AGI Glassplant India, ATR-Asahi Process Systems and GL Hakko Technology.

people.name: Anjaneyulu Pathuri
people.since: 18 July 2022 (joined 4 March 2022 as Associate VP, Finance)
people.bio: Anjaneyulu Pathuri is a chartered accountant (associate member of ICAI). He worked in audit and assurance at S.R. Batliboi & Associates, G.M. Kapadia & Co. and M. Anandam & Co., and was an Assistant General Manager in finance at Aurobindo Pharma. He joined Standard in March 2022 and has been CFO of both the company and its main subsidiary since July 2022.

people.name: Kallam Hima Priya
people.since: Associated with the company since 1 October 2021
people.bio: Kallam Hima Priya is an associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and holds an LL.B. from Osmania University. She has been with the company since October 2021 and is also company secretary of the main subsidiary.

companies.changes: No KMP changes found after the FY26 annual report. Independent director Uma Maheswara Rao Kancherla joined on 14 May 2026; Venkata Siva Prasad Katragadda became a non-executive director on 4 August 2025.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of Belgium's John Cockerill SA, which owns about 70.4% (it sold roughly 6% in December 2025 and is set to rise to about 72% if pending convertible preference shares convert). There is no family: the parent sends its own executives, and the Managing Director, Frederic Martin, is also a group vice-president. The chairman, Francois-David Martino, is a non-executive group nominee. The MD is the only executive director.

people.name: Frederic Martin
people.bio: Frederic Martin holds a master's degree in mechanical engineering from ENSAM (Arts et Metiers, France) and has over 35 years in the ferrous and non-ferrous metals industry. Before John Cockerill he worked with Fives Stein, Shanghai Stein Heurtey and Durmech Engineering. He joined the group in 2005 as General Manager of CMI Thermline, became VP Operations, ran the Beijing operation for seven years from 2009 and then spent four years in Salem, USA; from 2021 he was Vice President of the Metals business line in Belgium. He moved to India to replace Michael Kotas and continues as Vice President Metals of John Cockerill Industry.

people.name: Deepak Prabhakar Chindarkar
people.bio: Deepak Chindarkar was appointed CFO and key managerial personnel from 24 August 2026. The company says he brings over 36 years of international finance leadership experience. He replaced Marc Dumont, who moved to the same role at another John Cockerill group company.

people.name: Nidhi Salampuria
people.bio: Nidhi Salampuria became Company Secretary and Compliance Officer on 19 December 2025, after Haresh Vala resigned in September 2025.

companies.changes: MD Michael Kotas resigned on 31 July 2025; Frederic Martin took over on 1 August 2025. CFO Marc Dumont left on 31 July 2026 for another group company; Deepak Chindarkar became CFO on 24 August 2026. Company Secretary Haresh Vala left in September 2025; Nidhi Salampuria replaced him in December 2025.

companies.styleNote: Three co-founder relatives run it and own almost equal stakes: brothers Chandrakant Patel (Chairman & MD) and Rajendra Patel (Joint MD), and their cousin Vipul Patel (Joint MD). Promoters held 69.7% before the ₹190cr preferential issue approved in August 2026 (₹180cr from Japan's Galilei Holdings), which would take them to roughly 61% once the shares are issued. A hired CEO, M. Srinivas Reddy (ex-Blue Star), joined in November 2025.

people.name: Chandrakant P. Patel
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; brother of Rajendra Patel; cousin of Vipul Patel
people.stake: 23.08% (FY25 annual report, March 2025); three promoters together 69.71%
people.bio: Chandrakant Patel is a co-founder of the business, which began in 1989, and has more than 34 years in refrigeration. He heads sales and service, marketing, finance, legal and R&D. He gives the closing remarks on investor calls. The August 2026 Galilei Holdings deal he presides over as Chairman also creates a joint venture, Ice Make Horeca, in which Galilei holds 60% and Ice Make 40%.

people.name: Rajendra P. Patel
people.since: Director since 31 March 2009; Joint MD since 5 September 2017
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; brother of Chandrakant Patel; cousin of Vipul Patel
people.bio: Rajendra Patel, born 1970, trained as a diesel mechanic (ITI) at M.P. Shah College, Ahmedabad. He has over 27 years in refrigeration and heads production of cold-room panels and refrigerated containers, along with quality control, design and dispatch.

people.name: Vipul I. Patel
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; cousin of Chandrakant and Rajendra Patel
people.bio: Vipul Patel, 50 in 2025, has over 27 years in the refrigeration industry. He heads purchasing, accounts, production of refrigeration equipment, quality control, HR and IT.

people.name: M. Srinivas Reddy
people.bio: M. Srinivas Reddy is an engineering graduate with an MBA and completed the Senior Executive Programme at London Business School. He has over three decades of experience and was Executive Vice President – Corporate Strategy & Business Development at Blue Star before joining. He was an elected member of the CII Maharashtra State Council for 2024-25. His brief is to drive growth, widen the product range and lead the company's next phase of expansion.

people.name: Ankit P. Patel
people.bio: Ankit Patel is the CFO and presents the financial results on the company's earnings calls. The company does not publish a detailed profile of him, and he is not listed as a relative of the promoters in the related-party disclosures.

people.name: Mandar B. Desai
people.bio: Mandar Desai has been the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer since March 2019.

companies.changes: M. Srinivas Reddy joined as CEO on 14 November 2025. In August 2026 the board approved a preferential issue of 23,67,573 shares at ₹802.51 (₹180cr from Galilei Holdings, ₹10cr from others). The FY26 annual report was not available online, so stakes are from March 2025.

companies.styleNote: A Patil family company founded by brothers Yogesh Patil (Chairman & MD) and Vivek Patil (Whole-time Director). Yogesh's daughter Durva and Vivek's son Shatanik sit on the board as non-executive directors. Long-time CFO Vinayak Parab moved up to executive director in August 2026. Promoters and their family own about 67.7%, split almost equally between the two brothers.

people.name: Yogesh Vishwanath Patil
people.since: Founding promoter; Chairman & MD since 31 May 2024
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Vivek Patil; father of Durva Patil (non-executive director)
people.stake: About 5.5 million shares, roughly 29% (promoters' annual disclosure, 31 March 2026); promoter group together about 67.7%
people.bio: Yogesh Patil, one of the two founding brothers, completed higher secondary education and has more than 29 years of experience in production, commercial and finance roles in the heat-exchanger industry. He runs the company's commercial and finance functions and became Chairman and Managing Director in May 2024, ahead of the company's listing on NSE Emerge.

people.name: Vivek Vishwanath Patil
people.since: Founding promoter; Whole-time Director since 31 May 2024
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Yogesh Patil; father of Shatanik Patil (non-executive director)
people.stake: About 5.5 million shares, roughly 29% (promoters' annual disclosure, 31 March 2026)
people.bio: Vivek Patil holds a postgraduate diploma in boiler and process equipment design and engineering. He has more than 29 years of experience in design, marketing and administration, and runs the company's design and marketing functions.

people.name: Vinayak Uttam Parab
people.since: Executive director from 26 August 2026 (CFO from March 2024 to 25 August 2026)
people.bio: Vinayak Parab holds a B.Com from Mumbai University and has more than 20 years in finance and corporate management, including financial planning and control, budgeting, fund raising and risk management. He was CFO from March 2024, through the listing, and stepped down as CFO in August 2026 to take a board seat as an executive director with wider responsibilities; his appointment needs shareholder approval at the AGM.

people.name: Hitesh Dnyaneshwar Haldankar
people.bio: Hitesh Haldankar is a finance professional with over 17 years in finance and accounts. He was Senior Manager – Finance & Accounts at the company before being promoted to CFO, and earlier held senior finance roles elsewhere, including as a finance head.

people.name: Madhura Kamalakar Gaidhani
people.bio: Madhura Gaidhani is an associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (membership A78000) and is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

companies.changes: CFO Vinayak Parab stepped down as CFO on 25 August 2026 and joined the board as an additional executive director from 26 August 2026; Hitesh Haldankar became CFO the same day. An additional independent director, Sandeep Bodake, was also appointed.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Ador Group's promoter family. Ninotchka Malkani Nagpal is Executive Chairman and Aditya Malkani is Managing Director; both are named promoters. The family holding company J.B. Advani & Co. owns 45.2%, and the promoter group together owns 53.8% (March 2026). The annual report says no two directors are 'relatives' under the Companies Act. Another promoter, Dr Deep Lalvani, chairs the holding company and sits on the board as a non-executive director.

people.name: Ninotchka Malkani Nagpal
people.relation: Promoter-group member of the Ador Group family
people.bio: Holds an MBA in finance from Imperial College London and a B.Sc. in business and economics from Lehigh University, USA. She began her career at Alliance Capital Asset Management in New York. She has worked across Ador Welding and other Ador Group companies for over 27 years, mainly in finance, strategy and governance. She was chairman of Ador Fontech and of J.B. Advani & Co., the group's parent, and now guides the combined business after Ador Fontech merged into Ador Welding. She became Executive Chairman on 19 November 2019.

people.name: Aditya T. Malkani
people.relation: Promoter-group member of the Ador Group family
people.bio: Holds an MBA in finance from the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad, and a BA in economics from Oberlin College, Ohio. He joined the Ador Group in 2002 and worked in international business, corporate marketing, strategy and new business projects before becoming Managing Director in September 2020. The board re-appointed him for another three years from 14 September 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the July 2026 AGM. He also sits on the board of Batliboi Ltd.

people.name: Krishnamurthy Suryanarayan
people.bio: A commerce graduate and chartered accountant with over 25 years in finance. He started in 1996 as an audit manager at RPG Life Sciences, then worked at Godrej Consumer Products, where he was CFO of its Africa operations. He joined CEAT in July 2020 to head business partnering, and was later CFO of Astec LifeSciences. At Ador he was Head – Corporate Strategy (a key managerial person from May 2025) and became CFO on 15 August 2026.

people.name: Lajpat Yadav
people.role: Chief Operating Officer – India Welding Business
people.bio: A mechanical engineer with an MBA from the Birla Institute of Management & Technology, Delhi, and 33 years in the welding industry. He was appointed COO after the Ador Fontech merger and runs the India welding business, the maintenance and repair division, and the welding, cutting and automation division.

people.name: Mustafa Faizullabhoy
people.bio: Named by the company as a key managerial person from 7 May 2025, heading international operations; exports were about 13% of FY26 sales. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: CFO Surya Kant Sethia resigned on 30 July 2026 after 11 years and left on 14 August 2026; Krishnamurthy Suryanarayan became CFO & Head – Strategy from 15 August 2026. Smaller senior changes: Vinit Mangrulkar joined as VP – Sales (July 2026); Pradnya Iyer became Head – HR and V.M. Bhide was redesignated Chief Compliance Officer & Company Secretary (August 2026).

companies.styleNote: A Garg family business, set up in 1982 by former Larsen & Toubro professionals including N.K. Garg. His son Prashant Garg is Chairman & Managing Director and the only executive director. Prashant's mother Chitra Garg and brother Dr Nitin Garg (a practising neurosurgeon) are non-executive directors. Prashant's wife Neelu Garg works in the company as General Manager – Procurement. Promoters own about 70%. There has been no CEO since Ramesh Kumar N left in February 2026.

people.name: Prashant Garg
people.relation: Promoter; son of director Chitra Garg, brother of director Dr Nitin Garg, husband of GM – Procurement Neelu Garg
people.stake: 27.96% (FY26 annual report); with his mother (16.38%) and brother (19.78%) 64.1%, promoter group about 70%
people.bio: Holds an engineering degree from Nagpur University and an MBA from Saïd Business School, University of Oxford. He joined the company in November 2003 and has about 22 years in the welding and wear-protection industry. He became Managing Director in March 2020 and led the company to its stock-market listing in October 2024. He runs day-to-day operations, new product development and the addition of new technology and product lines, and sits on the boards of the overseas subsidiaries.

people.name: Abhishek Mehta
people.bio: A chartered accountant who also holds a law degree from Nagpur University. Before joining he spent over ten years in the insurance and banking sector. He joined in July 2020 as General Manager – Finance and Accounts and became CFO on 29 June 2023.

people.name: Manoj Kumar Srivastava
people.bio: Holds a diploma in mechanical engineering from the Institute of Engineering and Rural Technology, Allahabad. He has over three decades in sales and marketing at several engineering companies, and joined Diffusion in October 2016.

people.name: Shreekant Premkhede
people.bio: Holds an engineering degree from Nagpur University. He joined as a trainee sales engineer in July 1998 and has spent his whole career of more than two decades at the company, becoming Vice President – Marketing in 2022 and later Senior Vice President – Operations.

people.name: Ajay Urkude
people.role: Senior Vice President – Sales & Marketing (PAN India)
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from J.R.N. Rajasthan Vidyapeeth University. He has worked at the company since 2003 and has more than two decades in the engineering sector.

companies.changes: CEO Ramesh Kumar N (joined February 2025 from CG Power) resigned with effect from 6 February 2026; no new CEO has been named, so the Chairman & MD runs the business directly.

companies.styleNote: Founder Dr A.J. Prasad, now 80, is Chairman & Managing Director. His daughter Kavita Prasad Aluru and her husband M.S.S. Srinath are executive directors. The founder's granddaughter Deeksha Mikkilineni is a non-executive director. Promoters own 59.1%, of which 51.3% sits in the Aluru Family Private Trust with Kavita as trustee. The founder took ₹56cr of profit commission in FY26 on top of ₹1.2cr of pay. The CFO and electronics head are hired professionals.

people.name: Dr Aluru Jagadish Prasad
people.relation: Founder; father of Kavita Prasad Aluru, father-in-law of M.S.S. Srinath, grandfather of director Deeksha Mikkilineni
people.stake: 0.97% in his own name (FY26 annual report); promoter group 59.1%, mostly through the Aluru Family Private Trust (51.3%)
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech from IIT Kharagpur, an MS in management from MIT and a doctorate in international business from Columbia University. Before starting the business he was at the Administrative Staff College of India. He founded HBL in 1977 to make aircraft batteries for the defence forces, and built it into a maker of specialised batteries, electronics and the Kavach train-safety system. He has been on the board since 1986 and was re-appointed Chairman & MD at the 2025 AGM. His FY26 pay was ₹1.17cr plus ₹56cr of commission linked to profit.

people.name: Kavita Prasad Aluru
people.relation: Daughter of the founder; wife of M.S.S. Srinath
people.stake: 3.53% (FY26 annual report); she is also trustee of the Aluru Family Private Trust, which holds 51.3%
people.bio: A commerce graduate who joined the board in 2000 and was an executive director until August 2023. She has focused on exports, international marketing, finance and banking, internal control and governance. The board made her an executive director again for five years from 1 July 2026, citing the larger scale of the business and succession planning; shareholders approved this at the 26 September 2026 AGM. She will oversee exports, finance, banking and governance.

people.name: M.S.S. Srinath
people.relation: Son-in-law of the founder; husband of Kavita Prasad Aluru
people.bio: Holds a BA (Hons) in economics. He became an executive director in May 2024 and works mainly on marketing and administration. His FY26 pay was about ₹0.9cr.

people.name: Sairam Edara
people.bio: A US CPA (Arizona State Board of Accountancy) who is also a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and the Institute of Company Secretaries of India, and a law graduate from Osmania University. Before joining in March 2023 he was Group CFO of the Archean group. His FY26 pay was ₹1.15cr.

people.name: M.V.V. Vidyasagar
people.bio: An electrical and electronics engineer (BE) who joined in April 2011 from Axiom Consulting, where he was Director (Operations). He heads the electronics group; his FY26 pay was ₹1.41cr.

companies.changes: Kavita Prasad Aluru moved from non-executive to executive director from 1 July 2026 (approved by shareholders on 26 September 2026). No change in senior management in FY26.

companies.styleNote: Part of the INOX Group of Pavan Kumar Jain, who is the non-executive Chairman. His son Siddharth Jain and daughter-in-law Ishita Jain are non-executive directors; Siddharth was paid ₹3.9cr of commission in FY26 and oversees group strategy. Promoters own about 75%: Siddharth 37.3%, Pavan 16.4% and Ishita 4.2% in their own names. Day-to-day, the company is run by long-serving professionals: Executive Director Parag Kulkarni, CEO Deepak Acharya and CFO Pavan Logar, all with the company since 1992–93.

people.name: Parag Kulkarni
people.bio: Holds a mechanical engineering degree from the College of Engineering, Goa, and a master's in management studies from Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies, Mumbai. He joined on 16 July 1992 and has about 30 years in cryogenic engineering and high-vacuum technology. He is the only executive on the board and oversees strategic growth, engineering development, business expansion and new-energy strategy.

people.name: Deepak Acharya
people.bio: Holds a mechanical engineering degree from Nagpur University (NIT Nagpur) and an M.E. in mechanical engineering from the University of Roorkee (now IIT Roorkee). He is a certified welding inspector, a fellow of the Indian Institute of Welding, and has diplomas in marketing, finance and international welding. Before joining in 1992 he was a welding application specialist at Advani Oerlikon. He has 35+ years in operations, strategy, product development and technology transfer. His FY26 pay was ₹1.86cr.

people.name: Pavan Logar
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Rajasthan University who is both a chartered accountant and a company secretary. He was deputy manager for accounts and taxation at Mangalam Cement before joining in 1993 as a manager. He was Company Secretary from December 1993 to July 2022 and is now CFO, with 35+ years in accounts and taxation.

people.name: Tushar Zope
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in petrochemical engineering from Maharashtra Institute of Technology and has over 33 years in process-plant engineering and project management across refineries, petrochemicals, hydrogen and air separation. He joined in 2024 from Worley Services India, where he was an associate director.

people.name: Savir Julka
people.bio: Holds a mechanical engineering degree from the Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda, a PG diploma in marketing and sales management, and has attended an IIM Ahmedabad management programme. He was an area manager at Mekaster Group before joining in December 1997, and has 30+ years in technical sales and marketing.

people.name: Vijay Kalaria
people.bio: Holds a mechanical engineering degree from Sardar Patel University and PG diplomas in marketing and computer management. He was an assistant manager (marketing) at Jord Engineers India before joining in January 1999, and has 35+ years in marketing and sales.

people.name: Sudhir Sethi
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in physics and a master's in social welfare from the Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda. He was senior works manager at Gujarat Reclaim and Rubber Products before joining in September 2007, and has 35+ years in human resources.

companies.changes: No changes to directors or key managerial personnel announced since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Murugappa Group, whose family and group firms own 38.9%. M.M. Murugappan, a Murugappa family member, is the non-executive Chairman; his son Muthu Murugappan (CEO of E.I.D. Parry) is a non-executive director. The business is run by Managing Director Sridharan Rangarajan, a career group finance executive, who is the only executive director. Business heads run abrasives, ceramics, electrominerals and refractories.

people.name: Sridharan Rangarajan
people.stake: About 0.15% (2,88,364 shares, FY26 annual report); also holds stock options
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant with a commerce degree from Madurai University, and 40 years in finance across manufacturing, banking, contracting and distribution. Before joining he was CFO of Timken's Indian operations. He joined CUMI as CFO in June 2011, became President and Group CFO of the Murugappa Group in January 2018, and returned as CUMI's Director – Finance and Strategy in April 2021. He became Managing Director on 3 August 2023, succeeding N. Ananthaseshan. He sits on the boards of several Murugappa Group companies and was earlier a director of Timken India.

people.name: Sriram Seshadri
people.bio: A cost and management accountant (CIMA UK, CGMA USA and ICMAI) with over 30 years in automotive and industrial manufacturing. He was CFO of Woco India and of Delphi TVS Technologies, Director – Finance at Tenneco India, and most recently Vice President – Business Controller at Endurance Technologies. He became CFO on 7 September 2026, filling a post left empty for almost a year.

people.name: Srikanth C
people.bio: Holds an MBA in marketing and has about 40 years of experience. He joined in May 2024 from Wendt (India), a maker of super-abrasives, to run CUMI's abrasives business.

people.name: M.V. Sivakumaran
people.bio: Holds M.Sc., M.Tech and MBA degrees and has 29 years of experience. He joined the Murugappa Group in July 1996 and now heads the electrominerals business, which includes the Russian subsidiary VAW.

people.name: Prathap Kumar
people.bio: A mechanical engineer with 24 years of experience, who has been with the Murugappa Group since July 2001. He heads industrial ceramics, the growth business the company is investing in most heavily.

people.name: Raghavendra Pai
people.role: Business Head – Super Refractories and Prodorite
people.bio: Holds an M.Tech in chemical engineering and has 29 years of experience. He joined in June 2005 from Schunk Carbon Technology and heads the refractories business.

people.name: Shyam C. Raman
people.bio: Holds a PGDM from IIM Kolkata and has 41 years of experience. He joined in July 2024 from Cholamandalam MS General Insurance, a Murugappa Group company.

companies.changes: CFO Sushil Bendale resigned in September 2025; the post stayed vacant until Sriram Seshadri joined on 7 September 2026. Head of IT Ajit Kolhe left in June 2026.

companies.styleNote: A first-generation business set up in 2017 by Santosh Kumar Yadav, a farmer's son from Rajasthan and a former Lloyd Electric employee. He is Chairman & MD; his wife Anju Devi is a whole-time director; his brother Manohar Lal is a non-executive director. The couple owned 70.8% at March 2026 (Anju 38.1%, Santosh 32.7%); after the post-year-end share placement promoters own about 66%. The finance team is hired: a new CFO, Pawan Nawal, joined in May 2026.

people.name: Santosh Kumar Yadav
people.relation: Founder; husband of Anju Devi, brother of director Manohar Lal
people.stake: 32.66% (FY26 annual report, before the 2026 share placement); with his wife 70.8%
people.bio: Holds a diploma in business management from the Institute of Management Technology (distance learning), Ghaziabad, and a diploma in mechanical engineering from the Rajasthan Board of Technical Education. He worked at Lloyd Electric & Engineering before starting KRN, and has over 20 years in making heat exchangers and refrigeration units. He has been on the board since the company was set up in 2017 and took it public in 2024. The board re-appointed him for five years from 9 May 2026 and raised his salary to ₹1.26cr a year from April 2026.

people.name: Anju Devi
people.relation: Co-promoter; wife of the Chairman & MD, sister-in-law of Manohar Lal
people.stake: 38.13% (FY26 annual report, before the 2026 share placement); with her husband 70.8%
people.bio: Has secondary-school education and was a resident consultant at Lloyd Electric from 2012 to 2014. She has managed human resources since the company began and has been a director since incorporation. She was re-appointed whole-time director for five years from 9 May 2026; her FY26 pay was ₹60 lakh.

people.name: Pawan Nawal
people.bio: A chartered accountant with an MBA in finance and over 20 years in business finance. He was CFO of Pashupati Laminators and Jaipur Rugs, and head of finance at SB Constantia (SB Packaging), TAFE Motors and Tractors (Eicher Engines) and Rockman Industries. Earlier he worked at Grasim Industries, Videocon D2H and Huawei. He became CFO on 15 May 2026.

people.name: Vivek Chauhan
people.role: Senior General Manager – Operations (purchase, sales and marketing)
people.bio: Named by the company as senior management, covering purchase, sales and marketing (listed on the company's website as Senior GM – Operations). No further background is disclosed.

people.name: Basti Ram Yadav
people.role: Senior General Manager – Process Engineering & Maintenance
people.bio: Named by the company as senior management, in charge of process engineering and maintenance at the Neemrana plant. No further background, or any family link, is disclosed.

people.name: Sonu Gupta
people.bio: Was CFO through FY26 and was redesignated General Manager – Finance on 15 May 2026, when Pawan Nawal took over as CFO. He remains part of senior management.

companies.changes: CFO Sonu Gupta stepped down as CFO on 14 May 2026 (now GM – Finance); Pawan Nawal became CFO on 15 May 2026. Jitendra Kumar Sharma became Company Secretary on 28 April 2026. The MD and whole-time director were re-appointed for five years from 9 May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Udaykumar Parekh, one of four partners who started the business as a Rajkot partnership in 2006, is Chairman & MD and owned 73.3% at March 2026. His brother-in-law Paras Parekh (husband of his sister) is Whole-time Director & CFO, and his sister Dharmi Parekh is a non-executive director. A hired COO and Chief Revenue Officer, both joined in 2024–25, complete the senior team.

people.name: Udaykumar Arunkumar Parekh
people.relation: Founder; brother of director Dharmi Parekh, brother-in-law of Whole-time Director & CFO Paras Parekh
people.bio: Holds a mechanical engineering degree from V.V.P. Engineering College, Rajkot (Saurashtra University) and a diploma in mechanical engineering from the Gujarat Technical Examinations Board. He was a sales executive at Jyoti CNC Automation before co-founding the business as a partnership firm in 2006; it became a company in 2021 and listed in 2026. He runs day-to-day operations, has about 19 years in precision machining, and is also CEO and President of the US subsidiary, Omnitech Group Inc.

people.name: Paras Mukundrai Parekh
people.relation: Brother-in-law of the Chairman & MD (married to his sister) and of director Dharmi Parekh
people.stake: Negligible (1 share before the IPO, per the prospectus)
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from J.C. Education Trust Commerce College, Junagadh (Saurashtra University) and an MBA from the Sinhgad Institute of Business Administration and Research, Pune. He was an assistant manager at Kotak Mahindra Bank in Ahmedabad and a deputy manager at HDFC Bank in Rajkot. He joined in 2014 as Vice President – Finance and Accounts and became Whole-time Director & CFO on 2 September 2024. He is also Vice President, Treasurer and Secretary of the US subsidiary, and has about 18 years in banking and precision engineering.

people.name: Haresh T. Akhja
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in production engineering from Bhavnagar University and a diploma in fabrication technology. Before joining on 1 April 2025 he was Associate Vice President at Praj Industries, and earlier worked at Ahmed Mansoor Al-Aali, Ramsis Engineering, Thermax (deputy manager – production) and Larsen & Toubro. He oversees supply chain and procurement.

people.name: Bhavin Prahalad Acharya
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate diploma in computer applications from the Tata Unisys education centre in Mumbai. He was VP – Marketing at Goodluck Engineering (a unit of Goodluck India) and earlier worked at Ambica Steels. He joined on 2 September 2024 and runs sales, marketing and brand development.

companies.changes: Listed in 2026. No change in key managerial personnel or senior management in FY26, and none announced since.

companies.styleNote: A Kheruka family company. Pradeep Kumar Kheruka, with the company since it began, is Executive Chairman and was paid ₹12.4cr in FY26. His son Shreevar Kheruka is non-executive Vice Chairman and runs the sister company Borosil Ltd. A hired CEO, Melwyn Moses (since December 2024), runs operations, and Sunil Roongta is Whole-time Director & CFO. Promoters own 56.0%.

people.name: Pradeep Kumar Kheruka
people.relation: Promoter; father of Vice Chairman Shreevar Kheruka
people.bio: Has been with the company since it was set up and has over five decades in the glass industry. He knows both soda-lime flat glass and borosilicate glass manufacturing, and has set up plants and sold glass in India and abroad. He won the EY Entrepreneur of the Year award in the manufacturing category in 2022. His FY26 pay was ₹12.4cr, up 46% on FY25.

people.name: David Melwyn Moses
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from A.K. College of Engineering who has completed Harvard Business School's senior executive leadership programme. He has nearly 30 years in manufacturing, supply chain and operations, and has run up to 31 plants and more than 6,000 people. He joined on 2 December 2024 from UPL, where he was global HSE head and global formulations head; earlier he worked at Merisant, Zeneca/Syngenta, PepsiCo India and REIL Products. His FY26 pay was ₹2.75cr.

people.name: Sunil Roongta
people.since: 2024 (whole-time director); over a decade in the Borosil Group
people.bio: A chartered accountant, cost accountant and company secretary with over ten years in senior roles in the Borosil Group, including running finance and commercial work at the manufacturing plant. He is CFO and joined the board as whole-time director on 27 May 2024. In May 2026 the board re-appointed him as whole-time director from 27 May 2027 to 22 July 2029, subject to shareholder approval.

people.name: Ajay Singh
people.bio: A mechanical engineer with an MBA in operations and marketing, and over 26 years in plant leadership in float glass, glass processing and continuous-process manufacturing. He held senior roles at Guardian Industries and was most recently Plant Director at Gerresheimer in India. He joined on 21 January 2026 to run the Bharuch plant, after the previous plant head left in June 2025.

people.name: Jeetendra Sehgal
people.bio: Named by the company as senior management, heading business research and development. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: Ashok Jain stepped down as whole-time director on 31 July 2025 and stays as a non-executive director. Company Secretary Ravi Vaishnav left in November 2025 (replaced by Kishor Talreja). Plant head Anoj Singh left in June 2025; the company is taking legal action to recover a loan from him. HR head Dilip Acharya ceased to be senior management in July 2026 but stays an employee.

companies.styleNote: A Rathi–Talesara family business from Udaipur, set up in 1990. Chairman Virendra Prakash Rathi and his son Vinay Rathi (MD) run it. Vinay's son Aryan and two cousins, Hemant Rathi and Akhil Maheshwari, run divisions or sales. Co-promoter Pratap Singh Talesara and his nephew Ankit Talesara are non-executive directors. Promoters own about 65.7% after the August 2026 IPO. The CFO, Priyanka Menaria, is a long-time employee rather than a family member.

people.name: Vinay Rathi
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman Virendra Prakash Rathi, father of Aryan Rathi, cousin of Hemant Rathi and Akhil Maheshwari
people.stake: 28.86% after the IPO (prospectus, August 2026); promoters together about 65.7%
people.bio: Holds an engineering degree in electrical and electronics from Mangalore University and a postgraduate diploma in management from T.A. Pai Management Institute, Manipal. He has over 29 years in engineering and has been with the company since 2003; he became a director in September 2019. As MD he runs marketing, sales, market research and product development. He won the 'Best Young Entrepreneur' award at the D&B–Axis Bank SME awards in 2012. He also sits on the boards of group firms including Pyrosens Technologies, Accurate Optoelectronics, Tempsens Measurement and Control, and Victura Tempsens Technologies.

people.name: Virendra Prakash Rathi
people.relation: Promoter; father of MD Vinay Rathi, grandfather of Aryan Rathi, uncle of Hemant Rathi and Akhil Maheshwari
people.stake: 14.91% after the IPO (prospectus, August 2026); a Rathi family trust holds another 9.1%
people.bio: Holds an electrical engineering degree from Bhopal University and has over 36 years in engineering. He has been a director since the company was set up in 1990 and is responsible for its technology, factories and global tie-ups. He received a national award for small-enterprise entrepreneurship from the MSME ministry in 2010, a distinguished-alumnus award from MANIT Bhopal in 2024, and a lifetime achievement award from the Udaipur Chamber of Commerce in 2026. He is also a director of Pyrotech Electronics and Pyrotech Control (India).

people.name: Priyanka Menaria
people.bio: A chartered accountant (FCA) with a commerce degree from Mohan Lal Sukhadia University, Udaipur, and over 12 years in finance. She joined the company in July 2016 and became CFO on 7 April 2025, ahead of the IPO.

people.name: Hemant Rathi
people.relation: Nephew of Chairman Virendra Prakash Rathi (son of his brother); cousin of MD Vinay Rathi
people.bio: Holds a diploma in electronics engineering and has over 24 years in the electrical industry. He joined in May 2002 and has headed the sensor division since January 2007. He is in charge of sales for all divisions except heaters and of new product development.

people.name: Akhil Maheshwari
people.relation: Nephew of Chairman Virendra Prakash Rathi (son of his sister); cousin of MD Vinay Rathi
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in electronics and communication engineering from Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and has over 20 years in the electrical industry. He joined in June 2006 and has run the heater division since March 2008, covering custom heating solutions from design to delivery.

people.name: Narendra Khamesra
people.bio: Holds a B.Com (Hons) from Mohanlal Sukhadia University and is a Graduate Gemmologist (Gemological Institute of America). He has over 17 years in the electrical industry and has led marketing and production of the cable business since May 2009.

people.name: Aryan Rathi
people.relation: Son of MD Vinay Rathi; grandson of Chairman Virendra Prakash Rathi
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. from Texas A&M University and has about two years of work experience. He joined in May 2024 and runs sales and business development outside India. His FY26 pay was about ₹1.1cr, about three times that of any other senior manager named in the prospectus.

companies.changes: Listed on the stock exchanges in August 2026; no management changes announced since.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 2015 by Manoj Patil, a former automation engineer. He is Chairman & MD; his wife Aarti Patil is an executive director (HR and admin) and his brother Prafulla Patil is executive director & CFO. A third brother, Vijay Patil, is Director (Operations) and heads design. Promoters own about 69%. Manoj and Aarti were paid ₹1.8cr and ₹1.7cr in FY26 and also receive ₹2.3cr each in factory rent from the company. Firms linked to relatives supplied about ₹4.5cr of services in FY26.

people.name: Manoj Pandurang Patil
people.relation: Founder; husband of Aarti Patil, brother of Prafulla and Vijay Patil
people.stake: 55.67% (FY26 annual report); with his wife and brother 68.7%
people.bio: Holds a diploma in mechanical engineering (Maharashtra Board of Technical Examinations, 1998). He was a projects engineer at Finearc Systems, Pune (1998–2005) and then assistant manager – projects at Precision Automation and Robotics India (PARI) from 2005. He started Fine Automation Robotics India in 2013 and has led Patil Automation since 2015, with over 25 years in the automation industry. He took the company public on the NSE SME platform in June 2025. His FY26 salary was ₹1.8cr, and he also earns rent on the factory.

people.name: Aarti Manoj Patil
people.relation: Co-promoter; wife of the Chairman & MD, sister-in-law of Prafulla Patil
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. from Amravati University (1999). She has been on the board since 2015 and runs HR and administration; she held no job before joining the company. Her FY26 salary was ₹1.68cr, and she also earns rent on the factory.

people.name: Prafulla Pandurang Patil
people.relation: Co-promoter; brother of the Chairman & MD and of Vijay Patil
people.bio: Holds a diploma in mechanical engineering (Maharashtra Board of Technical Examinations, 1994). He spent about 16 years running die-shop operations at Bharat Forge, Hindustan Motors and Neepaz V Forge (1995–2011). He has overseen accounts and finance at the company since 2015 and became Executive Director & CFO in August 2024. His FY26 pay was ₹36 lakh.

people.name: Vijay Pandurang Patil
people.relation: Brother of the Chairman & MD and of Prafulla Patil
people.bio: Holds a diploma in production technology (2000) and has about 17 years in automation. He started at Precision Automation and Robotics India in 2007, was head of technical at Fine Automation (2011–16), and joined in 2016 as head of mechanical design. He now heads the design team; his FY26 pay was ₹34 lakh.

people.name: Sanjaya Kumar Patra
people.role: Chief Management Officer (business development and IT)
people.bio: Holds an engineering degree from NIT Bhopal (Barkatullah University, 1994) and a master's in marketing management from Pondicherry University. He began as a service engineer at Mahindra & Mahindra (1995–98) and held management roles at Hyundai Motor India, Maruti Udyog, Bajaj Allianz, Renault Nissan Technology, Volkswagen, FCA India and Go Digit General Insurance. He joined in October 2024 to run business development and IT.

people.name: Sandeep Chaudhari
people.bio: Holds a diploma in mechanical engineering (2004) and has about 19 years in production and project execution. He worked at MIRC Electronics (Onida), ARM Welders (senior manager – projects, 2006–14), Fine Automation Robotics and Shard Motor Industries before joining in 2016. He runs plant operations.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Niharika Singhal resigned on 7 May 2026; Vishakha Pathak replaced her. No other management changes announced since the June 2025 listing.

companies.styleNote: A joint venture of the Suri family (36.8%), Denso (20%) and Suzuki (12%). Shradha Suri Marwah, daughter of the late Lalit Suri (founder of Bharat Hotels / The LaLiT), is Chairperson & MD. Her mother Dr Jyotsna Suri, who runs The LaLiT hotels, is a non-executive director. Denso and Suzuki appoint nominee directors. A long-serving professional, Parmod Duggal, is Executive Director & CEO.

people.name: Shradha Suri Marwah
people.relation: Promoter; daughter of the late Lalit Suri and of director Dr Jyotsna Suri
people.stake: 8.56% in her own name (FY26 annual report); Suri family and its companies together 36.8%
people.bio: Holds an economics degree from Hindu College, Delhi University, a master's in management from the University of Leeds, and a master's in economics and information systems from the London School of Economics. She joined Subros in 2001, became Managing Director in 2008 and Chairperson & MD in 2021. She was President of the auto-parts industry body ACMA for 2023–25, sits on CII's national council and the Maruti Suzuki supplier association's executive committee, and represents the family on the board of Rohan Motors, a large Maruti dealer. She is also an independent director of Sona BLW Precision Forgings.

people.name: Parmod Kumar Duggal
people.bio: A chartered accountant, company secretary and cost accountant with over 30 years of experience. In about two decades at Subros he has worked in costing, marketing, IT, HR, plant operations and joint-venture management, and led new business and diversification. He became Executive Director and CEO on 31 March 2021. His FY26 pay was about ₹1.9cr.

people.name: Hemant Kumar Agarwal
people.bio: Became CFO in March 2021, taking over from Manoj Sethi. The company does not publish further background on him. His FY26 pay was about ₹1.2cr.

people.name: Amit Kumar Parashar
people.bio: Named by the company as senior management, running operations. The annual report gives no further background.

people.name: Srinivasulu Dampur
people.bio: Named by the company as senior management, heading the technical centre. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: No change in executive management since the FY26 annual report. Denso replaced its nominee director Tomoaki Yoshimori with Akihiro Deguchi on 7 August 2026. Shareholders are asked to let Dr Jyotsna Suri stay on as a non-executive director past age 75.

companies.styleNote: A one-man founder business. Nilesh Patel turned his sole proprietorship, M/s Vilas Transcore, into the company and owns 73.05% himself. His daughter Natasha Patel is a paid non-executive director. The only other executive director is Vipulkumar Patel (not related), who handles accounts and finance. The CFO post changed hands twice in FY26, and the Company Secretary post has been vacant since July 2026. Nilesh also owns 98.7% of Atlas Transformers India, a related party the company deals with.

people.name: Nilesh Jitubhai Patel
people.relation: Founder; father of director Natasha Patel
people.bio: Holds a diploma in electrical engineering and has about 30 years in the electrical sector. He founded Vilas Transcore as a proprietorship and has been a director since the company was incorporated in November 2006, running the whole business. Under him it grew from transformer laminations into core-coil assemblies, toroidal, nanocrystalline and amorphous cores, radiators and copper conductors. He was paid ₹4.2cr in FY26 (₹35 lakh a month) and was re-appointed for five years from 1 March 2026, with room for his salary to rise to ₹50 lakh a month. He is a director of nine other companies and owns 98.7% of Atlas Transformers India.

people.name: Vipulkumar Rameshbhai Patel
people.bio: Holds an M.Com and a B.Ed. He worked at Pooja Services before joining in April 2008, and has looked after accounts, finance and tax since. He became a whole-time director in March 2023 and was re-appointed for five years from March 2026. He gave up the CFO role in May 2025 but took it back in November 2025 when his successor left. His pay is about ₹1.1 lakh a month.

people.name: Kalpesh Shah
people.bio: Holds an MBA and has 20 years of experience. He joined in December 2006 from Gilbert & Maxwell and is among the company's best-paid employees.

people.name: Pinky Shah
people.bio: Holds MCA and MBA degrees and has 20 years of experience. She joined in April 2007 from Gilbert & Maxwell and heads marketing.

people.name: Mahesh Shinde
people.bio: A science graduate with 33 years of experience. He joined in February 2025 from Vidhya Wire and runs the plant.

companies.changes: CFO churn in FY26: Vipulkumar Patel stepped down as CFO in May 2025, Jagat Mazmudar held the post from May to November 2025, and Vipulkumar Patel took it back on 13 November 2025. Company Secretary Gandhali Paluskar resigned on 10 July 2026 and no replacement has been named yet.

companies.styleNote: A Chennai family business run by two brothers, set up in 1998 as Air Flow Equipments (India). Venkatesan Dakshinamoorthy is Chairman & MD and his younger brother Manikandan Dakshna Moorthy is Joint MD; they own 27.1% each (54.2% together). Venkatesan's son Sathishkumar is a whole-time director and Manikandan's wife Nandhini is a non-executive director. Both joined the board in July 2024, ahead of the September 2025 SME listing. Company disclosures on the promoters' backgrounds are thin.

people.name: Venkatesan Dakshinamoorthy
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Joint MD Manikandan Dakshna Moorthy, father of Whole-time Director Sathishkumar Venkatesan, brother-in-law of director Nandhini Manikandan
people.bio: Aged about 61 and a graduate, he has been with the company since it was incorporated in December 1998 and has more than two decades of technical and operations experience. He sets strategy and oversees execution across the business. His FY26 pay was ₹75 lakh. The company's filings give no details of his degree or any earlier employer.

people.name: Manikandan Dakshna Moorthy
people.relation: Promoter; brother of the Chairman & MD, husband of director Nandhini Manikandan, uncle of Sathishkumar Venkatesan
people.bio: Holds an engineering degree from the University of Madras and has about 20 years with the company, which he joined in August 2005. The company says he leads the management team and drives growth; he also chairs the CSR committee. His FY26 pay was ₹75 lakh.

people.name: Sathishkumar Venkatesan
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD; nephew of the Joint MD and of Nandhini Manikandan
people.bio: Aged about 35, he holds an engineering degree from Sathyabama University and an MSc from Coventry University. He joined the company and its board on 24 July 2024, is named a promoter, and supports day-to-day operational decisions. His FY26 pay was ₹24 lakh.

people.name: P.S. (Papa Sanjeevi) Karunakaran
people.bio: Aged about 60, he holds a master's degree in commerce and has over 13 years in accounts. He became CFO on 1 July 2024, before the IPO.

people.name: Mohan Gandhi
people.bio: An engineering graduate, aged about 56, who joined on 1 January 2026 from Sieges Spintech Equipments to run plant operations. He is the best-paid employee outside the board (₹48 lakh a year).

companies.changes: No executive changes announced since the FY26 annual report. Company Secretary Thygarajan Sivakumar (named in the 2025 prospectus) has since been replaced by Haraprasad Rout. Several new department heads joined in late 2025 and early 2026 (plant operations, HR, design).

companies.styleNote: Run by the Chowdhary family, which founded it in 1997. Founder J.P. Chowdhary is Executive Chairman, his son Umesh is Vice Chairman and MD, and Umesh's son Prithish is a Deputy MD. Umesh's wife Rashmi Chowdhary sits on the board as a non-executive director and holds 7.52%. A long-serving professional, Anil Kumar Agarwal, is the other Deputy MD. Promoters own 40.46% (31 March 2026).

people.name: Jagdish Prasad (J.P.) Chowdhary
people.since: Director since 1997 (founder); Executive Chairman since January 2007
people.relation: Founder; father of Umesh Chowdhary; grandfather of Prithish Chowdhary
people.stake: 0.05% (70,700 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 40.46%
people.bio: Holds a B.Com. He is the founder and promoter of the Titagarh Group, with about 63 years in the railway and heavy engineering industry, and is known as a turnaround specialist who took over ailing companies. He built the company from a small wagon maker set up in 1997 into a rail mobility group spanning freight wagons, metro and passenger coaches, propulsion, bridges and shipbuilding. He has been President of the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) and of the All India Organisation of Employers, and was on the Central Board of Trustees of the EPFO. He is 85, and the AGM on 30 September 2026 is being asked to re-appoint him as Executive Chairman for five more years from January 2027, on pay of up to 5% of net profit.

people.name: Umesh Chowdhary
people.since: Re-appointed Vice Chairman & MD from 1 October 2025
people.relation: Son of Executive Chairman J.P. Chowdhary; husband of director Rashmi Chowdhary; father of Deputy MD Prithish Chowdhary
people.stake: 0.06% (77,530 shares, FY26 annual report); his wife Rashmi 7.52%; promoter group together 40.46%
people.bio: He has about 28 years of experience in the business and runs the company day to day as Vice Chairman, MD and CEO. He has chaired CII's Eastern Region and CII's National Committee on Railways, and has sat on the boards of the West Bengal industrial development and power distribution companies. He has been Honorary Consul of Switzerland in Kolkata since 2010. Italy made him a Knight of the Order of the Star of Italy for his work on India–Italy ties. The company credits him with its move into metro and passenger trains.

people.name: Prithish Chowdhary
people.since: Director since January 2021; Deputy MD since 15 May 2024
people.relation: Son of Vice Chairman & MD Umesh Chowdhary and Rashmi Chowdhary; grandson of J.P. Chowdhary
people.bio: Holds the International Baccalaureate from Institut Le Rosey in Switzerland and a B.Com from St. Xavier's College, Kolkata. He joined the board as a non-executive director in January 2021. He then became a whole-time director in charge of marketing and business development, and Deputy CEO of the passenger rail vertical. He was made Deputy MD in May 2024. He was also given the job of building the new shipbuilding and maritime, and safety and signalling verticals. He is in his mid-20s and is the third generation of the family in management.

people.name: Anil Kumar Agarwal
people.since: Joined the company about 1999; CFO from December 2006; Director (Finance) & CFO from May 2019; Deputy MD since FY24
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: Holds a B.Com (Honours) from Calcutta University and is a chartered accountant (FCA) and cost accountant (ACMA). He began his career with the company and has spent about 27 years there. He was CFO from December 2006, joined the board as Director (Finance) and CFO in May 2019, then ran the freight rail business as Deputy MD & CEO before becoming Deputy MD in 2025. He now covers finance, operations, legal and business development. He is 51, and the 2026 AGM is being asked to re-appoint him for three more years from May 2027.

people.name: Saurav Singhania
people.since: Group Finance Controller from June 2015; Joint CFO November 2022; CFO since 20 December 2023
people.bio: A chartered accountant (FCA). He has spent his career in finance, accounts, strategy, planning and fund raising. He joined as Group Finance Controller in June 2015 and was made Joint CFO in November 2022. He became CFO in December 2023, taking over from Anil Kumar Agarwal.

people.name: Bhavesh Jethwa
people.role: Head of Operations (COO), Passenger Rail Systems
people.bio: He was brought in to run the passenger rail (metro and Vande Bharat) business after its CEO left. He has over 25 years in the railway and metro industry, with leadership roles at Alstom, Bombardier and Mahindra & Mahindra. He worked on India's Namo Bharat (RRTS) regional rail project. His strengths are project execution, business development and rolling-stock technology.

companies.changes: Vijay Subramanian stepped down as CEO of Passenger Rail Systems on 2 September 2026; Bhavesh Jethwa took over as Head of Operations (COO) of the passenger business. Saket Kandoi left the board as Director & CEO (Shipbuilding & Maritime Systems) on 13 February 2026, when the shipbuilding business moved into the wholly owned subsidiary Titagarh Naval Systems. Aditya Purohit has been Company Secretary since 1 June 2025.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Poddar family's Adventz group. Promoter Saroj Kumar Poddar, 80, is Executive Chairman. His son Akshay Poddar was made Co-Chairman in May 2026 but stays non-executive. Day-to-day work is run by professionals: MD Sudipta Mukherjee (ex-Titagarh), Vice Chairman Indrajit Mookerjee, and Executive Directors U.V. Kamath (electrical/railway electrification) and A.K. Vijay. Promoters own 48.34% (31 March 2026).

people.name: Saroj Kumar Poddar
people.since: Joined 1 January 2006; re-appointed for five years from 25 September 2025
people.relation: Promoter; father of Co-Chairman Akshay Poddar (non-executive)
people.stake: 6.04% in his own name; 6.97% including his HUF and family trust (31 March 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 48.34%
people.bio: A gold medallist in commerce from Calcutta University. He chairs the Adventz group, which includes Zuari Agro Chemicals, Paradeep Phosphates and Chambal Fertilisers. He set up group joint ventures with Hettich, Touax, Wabtec and Mitsubishi, and was founding chairman of Gillette India from 1984 to 2013. He has been President of FICCI and of the International Chamber of Commerce in India, and sat on the boards of IIT Kharagpur and the RBI's local board. He was the company's highest-paid executive in FY26, at ₹5.6cr.

people.name: Sudipta Mukherjee
people.since: Joined 1 June 2023; re-appointed MD for five years from 1 June 2026
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate degree in management from IISWBM, Kolkata. He also has a production management certificate from AOTS Japan, an executive programme from Carnegie Mellon's Tepper School, and a Fulbright fellowship. He has about 28 years of experience in rolling stock, logistics, railway parts, foundry, and bridges and structures. Before Texmaco he was a Whole-time Director at rival Titagarh Wagons (now Titagarh Rail Systems).

people.name: Indrajit Mookerjee
people.since: Independent director from 2019; executive since 2 April 2020 (first as MD); re-appointed for one year from 2 April 2026
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech (Honours) in chemical engineering from IIT Kharagpur and an MS in chemical engineering from Georgia Tech, USA, and attended an executive programme at Columbia University. He was Managing Director of Lorch Welding Products. He has been President of the American Chamber of Commerce in India and chaired CII's Bengaluru chapter. He joined the board as an independent director in 2019, became MD in 2020 and is now Vice Chairman. He is 78 and now serves on one-year terms.

people.name: Udyavar Vittal (U.V.) Kamath
people.since: With the company since 1 April 2017 (Bright Power merger); Executive Director since June 2020
people.bio: An electrical engineer who graduated from MIT Manipal in 1986. He was a founder director of Bright Power Projects, a railway electrification contractor that merged into Texmaco. He has about 39 years in railway electrification and electrical engineering services. Bright Power is now Texmaco's Infra Electrical division, which had its best year in FY26 with ₹610cr of revenue. He was the second-highest-paid executive in FY26, at ₹3.7cr, mostly variable pay.

people.name: Ashok Kumar (A.K.) Vijay
people.since: Joined 17 October 2001; re-appointed for one year from 1 January 2026
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary with about 49 years of experience in finance. He came from Hindusthan Engineering & Industries. He has been with the company since 2001 and sits on its board as an executive director. He is 73.

people.name: Shibu Mathews
people.bio: A chartered accountant with 26 years in finance leadership roles at MRF, Bharti Airtel and ITC. His experience covers treasury, financial planning and strategy, business finance, risk management, working capital, capital allocation and internal controls. He took over after the previous CFO resigned in August 2026.

people.name: Avijit Mitra
people.bio: A mechanical engineer with training in foundry technology and about 34 years of experience. He joined Texmaco in October 2021 from Ashok Iron Works. He runs the steel foundry business and is one of three people the company names as senior management.

companies.changes: CFO Kishor Kumar Rajgaria resigned for personal reasons and left on 31 August 2026; Shibu Mathews became CFO on 5 September 2026. Akshay Poddar was named Co-Chairman (non-executive) on 12 May 2026. Sandeep Kumar Sultania has been Company Secretary since 1 April 2025.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Lohia family. Brothers Vivek Lohia (MD) and Vikash Lohia (Deputy MD) lead the company, and Vivek's wife Ritu Lohia and Shradha Lohia hold senior management roles. Their father Murari Lal Lohia is a promoter (3.57%) but not on the board, and there is no named board chairman. Long-serving professionals Abhishek Jaiswal (CEO) and Swapan Kumar Chaudhury run operations and the wagon plants. Promoters own 68.3% (31 March 2026), including 19.24% held by the Slovak wagon maker Tatravagonka, a co-promoter.

people.name: Vivek Lohia
people.since: Director since 25 March 2021; MD since 30 May 2022
people.relation: Promoter; son of Murari Lal Lohia; brother of Deputy MD Vikash Lohia; husband of President Ritu Lohia
people.stake: 1.82% (77,96,540 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 68.3%
people.bio: A graduate of the Wharton School, USA. He has more than 20 years of experience in rail transport, logistics and industrial management. He has been MD since May 2022 and is responsible for the finance function and key customer relationships. He chairs ASSOCHAM's National Railway Council and co-chairs FICCI's transport infrastructure committee. He is also Honorary Consul of the Slovak Republic, the home country of co-promoter Tatravagonka. He is 52.

people.name: Vikash Lohia
people.since: Whole-time Director from 30 May 2022, now designated Deputy MD
people.relation: Promoter; son of Murari Lal Lohia; brother of MD Vivek Lohia
people.stake: 2.67% (1,14,26,473 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 68.3%
people.bio: A graduate of the Wharton School, USA. He has more than 25 years of experience, including about 15 years in the wagon industry. He leads the company's commercial operations and business development. He is a member of FICCI, CII and the Indian Chamber of Commerce. He is 51.

people.name: Abhishek Jaiswal
people.since: With the company since 1992; Whole-time Director since 14 September 2017
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in production engineering and a diploma in business management. He has been with the company since 1992, over 30 years, and first led its operations division. As Whole-time Director and CEO he sets and carries out strategy, allocates capital and oversees the executive team. He is 57 and retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM, seeking re-appointment.

people.name: Swapan Kumar Chaudhury
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate engineering degree from IIT Kharagpur. He has over 40 years of experience in wagon manufacturing. He leads the company's wagon plants and its push for world-class manufacturing practice, and the company credits him with a role in its wagon exports. He is 67.

people.name: Vinod Agarwal
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary with over 17 years in finance. Before joining he was CFO of India Carbon, and earlier held finance and commercial roles at Birla Tyres, Dalmia Cement, Eastman Exports and Bhushan Steel. He has completed ICAI's Business Leadership Development Programme. He filled a two-month gap after the previous CFO, Sanjiv Keshri, left in July 2025.

people.name: Ritu Lohia
people.relation: Wife of MD Vivek Lohia
