people.bio: Holds a master's degree in finance and economics from the London School of Economics. She began her career at Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu. The company lists her as President of the container business among its senior management, and its leadership page says she also oversees administration and human resources.

people.name: Shradha Lohia
people.relation: Promoter-group member of the Lohia family (exact relation not disclosed)
people.bio: Holds a degree from Lady Shri Ram College, New Delhi, and has attended management programmes in Nepal and Singapore, including at the National University of Singapore. She heads administration and human resources at the Kolkata corporate office. She is a trustee of the Nepal- and India-based MC Group and is active in philanthropy and CSR work.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the annual report. Vinod Agarwal became CFO on 24 September 2025, after Sanjiv Keshri resigned in July 2025. Two new independent directors joined on 9 July 2026, and Mark Stevenson (ex-acting CEO of European railcar lessor VTG) joined as a non-executive director on 15 December 2025. The corporate office moved to 16 Taratala Road, Kolkata, from 16 July 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 2009 by Mohit Vohra and run with his cousins, the Dhawan brothers. After the August 2026 IPO the promoter group owns about 57.7%. Vohra (21.6%) guides strategy as a non-executive director and is also MD of the listed sister company Quadrant Future Tek. Amit Dhawan (non-executive) oversees sales, and Sumit Dhawan (non-executive) handles sourcing. The day-to-day MD is a hired engineer, Dr Pankaj Rastogi, who led the propulsion approval. Promoter Rahul Dhawan is the only family whole-time director. The chairman, Sanjeev Mehta, is independent.

people.name: Dr Pankaj Rastogi
people.since: Joined 1 May 2021 as Director – Research & Product Development; MD since 1 October 2025 (three-year term)
people.relation: Not a promoter
people.stake: About 3.4% after the IPO (9,14,400 shares; 4.47% before the issue, per the RHP), partly received from the promoter group in September 2025 as a reward for the propulsion approval
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech (Honours) in electronics from Malviyan Institute of Technology, Gorakhpur (as named in the prospectus), and an MBA from Punjab Technical University. He also has a PhD in product design from Commonwealth Vocational University, Tonga, which the prospectus flags as relying on provisional documents. He has over 32 years in power electronics and product design for railway rolling stock. Before joining he worked at Industrial Automation, Modipon and Autometers Alliance. He led the design of the three-phase propulsion equipment that won Railways approval in September 2025, and was made MD a month later. He still runs research and development. The prospectus names him as someone the company depends on heavily.

people.name: Rahul Dhawan
people.since: With the company since April 2010; director since 2019; current five-year term from 1 November 2025
people.relation: Promoter; cousin and brother-in-law of promoters Mohit Vohra, Amit Dhawan and Sumit Dhawan
people.stake: About 7.3% after the IPO (20,01,160 shares; 9.78% before the issue); promoter group together about 57.7%
people.bio: Holds a Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (BAMS) from Baba Farid University of Health Sciences, Punjab. He joined the company in April 2010 as Technical Manager – Manufacturing Operations, working on process improvement and efficiency. He joined the board in 2019 and has over 15 years of experience. He is responsible for building plant infrastructure and overseeing plant operations. He is 42.

people.name: Ajay Kumar
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com from Kurukshetra University and more than 17 years of experience. He moved to the company in July 2024 from MV Mobility, a promoter-group company. Earlier he worked at RAK (Gaoyao) Ceramics, Star Ceramics, Sietz Technologies India and Worlds Window Impex. He handles accounts and tax. He was paid ₹0.36cr in FY26.

people.name: Sanjay Mann
people.stake: About 2.0% after the IPO (5,48,400 shares, RHP), partly received from the promoter group in September 2025
people.bio: Holds a B.E. in electronics and communication from Karnatak University, Dharwad, and has 30 years of experience. He worked at Autometers Alliance and Motorola India before joining. He is responsible for embedded system design. The prospectus names him, with the MD, as key to the propulsion work, and the promoters gave him shares for it in September 2025.

people.name: Pradeep Bansal
people.bio: Holds an MBA in materials management from Madhya Pradesh Bhoj (Open) University and a diploma in tool and die making, and has more than 25 years of experience. He previously worked at Minda, Britax Motherson, Autometers Alliance, Actia India, Technico Industries and Horizon Aerospace, among others. He covers planning, sourcing and supply chain, project management, production engineering and quality. He was the company's best-paid senior manager in FY26 after R&D head Sanjay Mann, at ₹0.53cr.

people.name: Rajat Kumar Kaushal
people.bio: Holds a B.E. from Jiwaji University, Gwalior, and a postgraduate diploma in management from IILM. He has more than 18 years of experience in railway sales and business development. He worked at Arihant Electricals and Autometers Alliance before joining. He runs business development.

companies.changes: No executive changes found since the IPO (listed 6 August 2026). Pankaj Rastogi became MD on 1 October 2025; a new independent board, chaired by Sanjeev Mehta, was set up from 27 September 2025 ahead of the IPO.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Nevatia family, with hired executives brought in over the past year. Suramya Nevatia is Chairman & MD. Akshada Nevatia is an executive director, and Saurabh Nevatia, the largest shareholder at 21.0%, runs the Nashik plant as an employee. The annual report says the three are related. Suramya handed the CEO title to a hired CEO, Manoj Nair, in October 2025, and a hired Global CEO leads the overseas push (the Elventive France acquisition). Promoters own 43.93% (31 March 2026). The company has been renamed Hirect Limited.

people.name: Suramya Nevatia
people.since: Joined 2011; CEO from 1 June 2016; MD since 17 August 2020; gave up the CEO title on 10 October 2025; re-appointed MD for three years from 17 August 2026
people.relation: Promoter; related to Saurabh Nevatia and Akshada Nevatia (registered name Suramya Saurabh Nevatia; the annual report does not spell out the relation)
people.stake: 14.98% (51,49,536 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 43.93%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree from H.R. College of Commerce & Economics, Mumbai, an M.Sc. in marketing management from Aston University, UK, and a postgraduate diploma in family-managed business from S.P. Jain Institute, Mumbai. He joined the company in 2011 and became CEO in 2016 and MD in 2020. The company credits him with turning it from a component supplier into a maker of complete traction and power-electronics systems. Under him the company bought Elventive in France to build a European base. He handed day-to-day CEO duties to Manoj Nair in October 2025 but remains Chairman & MD.

people.name: Akshada Nevatia
people.relation: Promoter-group member; related to Suramya Nevatia (the annual report does not spell out the relation)
people.stake: 0.03% (11,700 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 43.93%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in psychology from S.P. College, Pune, a master's in clinical psychology from Fergusson College, Pune, and a diploma in family-managed business from S.P. Jain Institute, Mumbai. She has 16 years of business experience across finance, banking, risk management and corporate leadership. The company says she helps guide strategy and operational governance. The 2026 AGM is being asked to revise her pay and make her not liable to retire by rotation.

people.name: Saurabh Nevatia
people.relation: Promoter; related to Chairman & MD Suramya Nevatia and to Akshada Nevatia
people.bio: He has worked at the company since 1988 and is its largest individual shareholder. He is not on the board. He runs all operations at the Nashik plant as a regular senior employee, and his pay (₹0.9cr in FY26) is approved by shareholders as a related-party arrangement. SEBI settled a matter with him relating to Hind Rectifiers in February 2019.

people.name: Manoj Nair
people.bio: He has over 30 years of leadership experience in manufacturing, power, infrastructure and technology businesses. He held senior roles at Cummins India and at IIMS Limited of the CK Birla Group. He runs the domestic business as CEO and took the title over from Suramya Nevatia.

people.name: Chidambaram Balakrishnan
people.bio: He was previously Managing Director of Caterpillar Rail and, before that, Regional Director for South Asia at GE Transportation. He has chaired CII's railway division and the infrastructure division of the American Chamber of Commerce in India. His expertise is business transformation, market development and building customer and partner networks. He leads the company and its subsidiaries globally, replacing Douglas Bailey.

people.name: Anil Kumar Nemani
people.since: With the company since 1992; CFO; Whole-time Director from 11 August 2026 (three years, subject to shareholder approval)
people.bio: Holds a B.Com and is a chartered accountant and cost and management accountant. He has over 42 years in accounts and finance and has been with the company since 1992. He covers accounting, budgeting, reporting, tax, audit, financial strategy and planning, and is a permanent invitee to the audit committee. He joined the board as a whole-time director in August 2026.

people.name: K. R. Narayanan
people.bio: He has over 36 years in selling power-electronics applications across semiconductors, electrostatic pollution control and electrochemical industries. He leads the company's revenue strategy and customer relationships in India and abroad.

companies.changes: Global CEO Douglas J. Bailey (appointed January 2026, ex-Power Integrations) resigned for personal reasons on 11 August 2026; Chidambaram Balakrishnan replaced him the same day. CFO Anil Kumar Nemani also joined the board as a whole-time director on 11 August 2026. Suhas Pawar became Company Secretary on 16 May 2026, after interim CS Megha Singh Shekhawat resigned. The company has been renamed Hirect Limited.

companies.styleNote: Run by its two co-founders, Nitin Jain and Gaurav Lath, who set it up in Lucknow in 2011. Both are Managing Directors, and Gaurav Lath is also CFO. They hold 31.95% each (63.9% together, 31 March 2026). Gaurav's father, Govind Prasad Lath, is the non-executive Chairman. Nitin's wife, Mahima Jain, is a non-executive promoter director. There is no separate professional CFO or CEO; the only other KMP is the Company Secretary, Puja Gupta. The founders also direct and promote related companies the company deals with, including ProGOTA India (the Kavach partner), Fusion Electronics and Concord Lab to Market Innovations.

people.name: Nitin Jain
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; husband of non-executive director Mahima Jain
people.stake: 31.95% (33,17,600 shares, FY26 annual report); promoters together 63.9%
people.bio: A mechanical engineer who graduated from Siddaganga Institute of Technology, Tumkur. He has decades of experience in mechanical engineering. He co-founded the company with Gaurav Lath in 2011 to make electrical and electronic equipment for Indian Railways. He guides the team on strategy and long-term goals. He is also a director of the related companies ProGOTA India, Fusion Electronics, Concord Lab to Market Innovations and Drivetrain Solutions, among others.

people.name: Gaurav Lath
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; son of Chairman Govind Prasad Lath
people.stake: 31.95% (33,17,600 shares, FY26 annual report); promoters together 63.9%
people.bio: A postgraduate in business management from Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies (NMIMS), Mumbai. He has more than 20 years of business experience, much of it in oil and energy. He co-founded the company in 2011 and handles strategy, business development and finance, doubling as CFO. He is also Managing Director of a separate company, Tankup Engineers, and sits on the boards of related companies ProGOTA India, Fusion Electronics and Concord Lab to Market Innovations. So he divides his time between the two companies.

companies.changes: No executive changes. Independent director Harsh Yadav resigned on 30 March 2026; Anuradha Garg, Madan Mohan Bhatia and Shyam Bohra joined as independent directors on 31 March 2026. On 17 August 2026 the board sought shareholder approval to move from the BSE SME platform to the BSE main board and list directly on NSE.

companies.styleNote: A one-man show at the top. Promoter Aditya Vikram Birla is MD and the only executive director. His wife, Purvi Birla (8.22%), was a whole-time director until 30 June 2026 and is now non-executive. Her father, chartered accountant Pawan Kumar Tibrewalla, is also a non-executive director. The CFO is a hired professional. Promoters own 55.09% (31 March 2026): Aditya 35.47%, his company Prilika Enterprises 10.13%, Purvi 8.22%, AVB Entech 1.09% and his HUF 0.19%. Aditya and Purvi are also paid by the subsidiaries N.S. Engineering Projects and Cosmic Springs & Engineers.

people.name: Aditya Vikram Birla
people.since: Director since 14 July 2022 (with the company since 2022); re-appointed MD for five years from 1 December 2025
people.relation: Promoter; husband of Purvi Birla (non-executive director); son-in-law of director Pawan Kumar Tibrewalla
people.stake: 35.47% (32,65,600 shares, FY26 annual report); with his companies, HUF and wife, promoter group together 55.09%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in business administration from Jadavpur University, Kolkata, and a postgraduate diploma in business management from Cardiff University, UK. He has about 12 years of experience as Chief Commercial Executive running the cold-rolled forming (CRF) division, which makes cold-rolled parts and spares for railways and wagon builders. The company bought that CRF unit from Cosmic Ferro Alloys in 2022. His experience covers raw-material buying, production planning, marketing, finance and administration. As MD he runs the whole business. Under him the company has expanded through the N.S. Engineering and Cosmic Springs subsidiaries and bid for the insolvent wagon maker Amzen Transportation. He was named in Forbes India's 40 Under 40 list. He is about 37.

people.name: Ram Pada Mandal
people.since: Joined 1 April 2022 as General Manager – Finance; CFO since 2 January 2023
people.bio: Holds bachelor's and master's degrees in commerce from Utkal University, Odisha, and is a fellow of the Institute of Cost Accountants of India. He has over 20 years in accounting and finance. He was General Manager – Finance at Cosmic Ferro Alloys, Deputy General Manager – Finance & Accounts at Nezone Tubes, and Vice President – Finance at Skipper. He joined the company in April 2022 and became CFO in January 2023.

companies.changes: Purvi Birla stepped down as Whole-time Director on 30 June 2026 for personal and professional reasons and became a non-executive director from 1 July 2026. Former Calcutta High Court judge Pranab Kumar Chatterjee joined as a non-executive director on 27 August 2026. Company Secretary Trupti Upadhyay resigned in December 2025; Priya Sayani took over on 1 January 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founded by Mahabir Prasad Agarwal, who stepped down as chairman in May 2025 and is now Chairman Emeritus, an honorary role off the board. His son Brij Bhushan Agarwal is Chairman and MD, his nephew Sanjay Kumar Agarwal is Joint MD, and Brij Bhushan's son Sheetij is a whole-time director. Two long-serving non-family executives, the CFO and the Sambalpur plant head, are also whole-time directors. Promoters own 74.59%, mostly through group companies.

people.name: Brij Bhushan Agarwal
people.since: Director since the company was formed in December 2002; Chairman & MD since 10 May 2025
people.relation: Son of founder Mahabir Prasad Agarwal; cousin of Sanjay Kumar Agarwal; father of Sheetij Agarwal
people.stake: 8.34% (FY26 annual report); his HUF holds a further 0.81%; promoter group 74.59%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from the University of Calcutta. He has been a director since the company was set up in 2002 and has over three decades in the steel and ferro-alloys industry. He was Vice Chairman and MD, responsible for strategy, expansion, marketing, HR and corporate affairs, and became Chairman and MD when his father stepped down in May 2025. He has also been a director of the main subsidiary, Shyam SEL and Power, since its start. In FY26 he drew ₹2.65cr from the company and ₹2.70cr from that subsidiary.

people.name: Sanjay Kumar Agarwal
people.relation: Nephew of founder Mahabir Prasad Agarwal; cousin of the Chairman & MD; uncle of Sheetij Agarwal
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce (honours) from the University of Calcutta. He has been a director since the company was formed in 2002. He runs the integrated manufacturing operations, including the Sambalpur, Jamuria and Mangalpur plants, with a focus on capacity expansion, cost control and raw-material buying. In FY26 he drew ₹67.5 lakh from the company and ₹69 lakh from subsidiary Shyam SEL and Power.

people.name: Sheetij Agarwal
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD; grandson of the founder; nephew of the Joint MD
people.bio: Holds a Bachelor of Science in business administration from Northeastern University, USA (D'Amore-McKim School of Business). Aged 27, he is a third-generation member of the family with about seven years in steel and ferro alloys, and worked at Shyam SEL and Power before joining the board in 2023. He leads strategy and business development, covering market intelligence, new opportunities, capital investment and brand tie-ups, and has helped expand sales to over 40 countries. He was paid ₹2.40cr in FY26.

people.name: Deepak Agarwal
people.relation: The company reports no relation to other directors
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce (honours) from the University of Calcutta and is an associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. He worked at Shyam SEL and Power before joining the board in 2014 and has about 25 years of experience. He runs finance, risk management and corporate affairs for the company and its subsidiaries, and has overseen a large expansion funded mainly from internal cash. He was paid ₹97.8 lakh in FY26.

people.name: Dev Kumar Tiwari
people.relation: The company reports no relation to other directors
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in arts (honours) from Bihar University, Muzaffarpur. Before joining the board in 2009 he worked for seven years as a mechanical engineer at subsidiary Shyam SEL and Power. He oversees manufacturing operations and project execution, especially at the Sambalpur plant. He was paid about ₹67.6 lakh in FY26.

companies.changes: Founder Mahabir Prasad Agarwal stepped down as chairman on 9 May 2025 and was named Chairman Emeritus; Brij Bhushan Agarwal took over as Chairman and MD. Independent director Subrata Bhattacharya joined in February 2026. In FY26 the Enforcement Directorate provisionally attached ₹159.5cr of the company's investments in a coal-mining investigation.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Goyal family of Raipur. Brothers Suresh Kumar Goyal (Chairman & MD) and Vikas Kumar Goyal (MD & CEO) lead the company; Vikas's wife Sheetal heads CSR and promoter Shashank Goyal became Vice President – Project Management in May 2026. Three non-family executive directors run operations, projects and strategy. Promoters own 56.11%.

people.name: Suresh Kumar Goyal
people.since: Director from the company's start in 2017 (off the board January–March 2024); Chairman since March 2024; Chairman & MD since 9 May 2026
people.relation: Promoter; elder brother of Vikas Kumar Goyal; brother-in-law of Sheetal Goyal
people.stake: 6.29% (1,85,36,250 shares, FY26 AGM notice); promoter group 56.11%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University, Raipur. He has over 20 years in steel manufacturing and was earlier a director of family firms such as Ganpati Sponge Iron, Hindupur Steel & Alloys and S. Pyarelal Ispat. He was a director from the company's start, became Chairman and Executive Director in March 2024, and was made Chairman and MD in May 2026. He chairs the risk, finance and CSR committees. He was paid ₹1.8cr in FY26.

people.name: Vikas Kumar Goyal
people.since: On the board since the company was formed (2017)
people.relation: Promoter; younger brother of the Chairman & MD; husband of Sheetal Goyal
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University, Raipur. He has over 19 years in steel manufacturing and has been a director of several family steel and mining firms, including Agrasen Rerollers, S. Pyarelal Ispat, Ganpati Sponge Iron and Brijdham Minerals. He has been on the board since incorporation and runs the company as MD and CEO. He is also a director of Brijwasi Plastic and Sambhv Tubes and a partner in Caprize Global LLP.

people.name: Bhavesh Khetan
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University, Raipur. Before joining he ran Vinayak Traders, a proprietorship trading iron, scrap and coal, and had over 10 years in that trade. He has been an executive director and COO since 2023, and the board re-appointed him in May 2026.

people.name: Saurabh Patil
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in computer applications from Makhanlal University and an MBA from Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University, Raipur. He has over two decades in project management and operations, mostly in steel: he was General Manager at Ganpati Ispat from 2010 to 2025, and earlier worked at HDFC Bank and ICICI Prudential. He joined Sambhv in April 2025 as Assistant Vice President in the steel-melting division and was made an executive director in August 2025.

people.name: Bikash Agrawal
people.bio: Holds an MBA in finance and marketing from KIIT University, Bhubaneswar, and has passed the CFA examination of the CFA Institute, USA. He has over 18 years in finance, with past roles at TCS, Raheja Universal, Kanakia Spaces Realty, ECL Finance, RattanIndia Finance (vice president, wholesale lending) and RBL Bank. He joined Sambhv in November 2024 as Chief Strategy Officer and was added to the board as an executive director in May 2026.

people.name: Anu Garg
people.bio: A commerce graduate from MATS University, Raipur, and an associate member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. She joined the company in March 2023 and became CFO in July 2024, a year before the June 2025 IPO. At the IPO she had just over three years of finance experience.

people.name: Sheetal Goyal
people.relation: Promoter; wife of MD & CEO Vikas Kumar Goyal
people.bio: Studied for a bachelor's degree in arts at Sambalpur University. She has about 12 years in steel and was earlier general manager, sales and marketing at family firm Ganpati Sponge Iron. She joined Sambhv in April 2024 and heads CSR; she was paid ₹96 lakh in FY25.

companies.changes: Suresh Kumar Goyal became Chairman and MD on 9 May 2026. Bikash Agrawal joined the board the same day. Promoter Shashank Goyal was named senior management as VP – Project Management. Mayank Agrawal, AVP – CEO's Office and Investor Relations, resigned with effect from 31 May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Mansukhani family's MAN Group. R.C. Mansukhani is Executive Chairman and his son Nikhil is MD; they are the only two executive directors. Promoters own 43.21%, lower after a preferential share issue to outside investors. Investors should note a September 2025 SEBI order that fined and barred both men from the securities market for two years; the appeals tribunal has stayed it.

people.name: R.C. (Rameshchandra) Mansukhani
people.since: Family set up the company in 1988
people.relation: Promoter; father of Nikhil Mansukhani
people.bio: A first-generation entrepreneur with about five decades in industry, who has built businesses in India, the UK and the UAE. According to the company, he holds a PhD in international economics and finance, a postgraduate management degree from the UK, a master's in economics and a law degree. The family started the company in 1988 with aluminium extrusion and moved into large-diameter pipes in 1994. He chairs the board's risk and CSR committees. A September 2025 SEBI order, from a forensic audit started in FY22, fined him ₹25 lakh and barred him from the market for two years; the Securities Appellate Tribunal stayed the order in October 2025 pending appeal.

people.name: Nikhil Mansukhani
people.relation: Promoter; son of the Executive Chairman
people.bio: Holds a Bachelor of Engineering (engineering with business management) from King's College, University of London. He joined the company in 2011 and, as MD, runs day-to-day affairs, business development and customer relationships. He is named in the same SEBI order as his father (a ₹25 lakh fine and a two-year market ban, now stayed on appeal) and has given personal guarantees for the company's loans.

people.name: Sandeep Kumar Garg
people.bio: A chartered accountant with about 34 years of experience after qualifying, and a law graduate from Meerut University. He has attended a leadership development programme at Harvard. He was previously CFO of Welspun Global Brands and Director (Finance) at the Raymond Group. He joined as CFO in January 2025, replacing Sanjay Kumar Agrawal.

people.name: Jaspreet Bhatia
people.bio: Named as senior management in charge of operations in the FY26 annual report and the September 2026 corporate presentation. The company has not published his background.

companies.changes: CFO Sanjay Kumar Agrawal left in January 2025 and Sandeep Kumar Garg replaced him. Non-executive director Heena Kalantri (a promoter-group member) resigned in March 2025, and the board ran short of the required six directors until Esha Achan joined in November 2025, drawing exchange fines. The Income Tax Department searched the company's premises during FY26.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Agrawal family; the company became a separate listed entity from the Kolkata-based Manaksia group in 2010. Sushil Kumar Agrawal is MD, his son Karan is a whole-time director and his son Tushar is Senior Vice President. The chairman, Siddhartha Shankar Roy, is not a family member. A long-serving plant head sits on the board as a third executive director. Promoters own 57.78%.

people.name: Sushil Kumar Agrawal
people.since: MD since 23 November 2014; re-appointed for three years from November 2026
people.relation: Promoter; father of Karan Agrawal and Tushar Agrawal
people.bio: A commerce graduate with over 40 years in manufacturing, factory operations and management. His expertise covers household insecticides and the company's coated-metal operations. He has run the company as MD since 2014 and leads its operations end to end. He was paid ₹48 lakh in FY26, and the board has proposed raising his pay to ₹12.5 lakh a month.

people.name: Karan Agrawal
people.relation: Son of the MD; brother of Tushar Agrawal
people.bio: A commerce graduate with a diploma in management from IIM Bangalore. He has over 17 years of experience and leads corporate strategy, backward integration and investments, as well as the marketing of coated-metal products. He joined the board in 2014. He was paid ₹48 lakh in FY26, and a rise to ₹12 lakh a month has been proposed.

people.name: Venkata Srinarayana Addanki
people.role: Whole-time Director; GM (Profit Centre Head) and Project Head, Mandideep (Bhopal)
people.since: With the company over 11 years; board since 30 May 2023
people.relation: No relation to other directors
people.bio: A science graduate who is studying for an MBA. He has over 32 years of steel-industry experience in production planning, project management, cost control, plant operations and HR. He heads the Mandideep unit near Bhopal as profit-centre and project head and joined the board in 2023; he was re-appointed for three years from May 2026. He was paid ₹14 lakh in FY26.

people.name: Tushar Agrawal
people.since: With the company since June 2015; Senior VP since July 2022
people.relation: Son of the MD; brother of Karan Agrawal
people.bio: Holds an MBA from ISB Hyderabad and a BSc in finance from Bentley University, USA. He joined in 2015 and leads product modernisation, technology adoption and HR, and played a key part in the 2017 galvanising and coating upgrades. The board has proposed raising his pay to ₹6 lakh a month from April 2026, which needs shareholder approval because he is related to the directors.

people.name: Mahendra Kumar Bang
people.bio: A chartered accountant and Osmania University alumnus with over 28 years of experience in finance, risk management, compliance and forecasting. He is the company's CFO and a key managerial person.

people.name: Sakesh Soni
people.bio: A mechanical engineer with over 20 years of experience running cold-rolling mills, continuous galvanising lines and colour-coating lines, and in project planning. As COO he runs plant operations.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report. In May 2026 the board re-appointed Addanki as whole-time director from 30 May 2026 and proposed pay rises for the MD, Karan Agrawal and Tushar Agrawal.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of listed Aeroflex Enterprises (formerly Sat Industries), which owns 59.84%; the promoter group together holds 65.47%. The company classifies all its directors as non-promoters and says none are related to each other. Chairman and MD Asad Daud runs it, with Mustafa Kachwala as whole-time director and CFO. Harikant Turgalia, who has worked with the promoter since 2001, is a non-executive director.

people.name: Asad Daud
people.relation: Classified as a non-promoter director
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in accounting and finance from H.R. College, Mumbai, and a master's in the same subject from the London School of Economics. He has attended executive programmes at IIM Bangalore, ISB Hyderabad and Harvard Business School. He has more than 15 years in manufacturing and has led the growth of Aeroflex's business and product range in India and abroad. He is also a non-executive director of group company Aeroflex Neu (formerly Sah Polymers). He was paid ₹1.27cr in FY26.

people.name: Mustafa Abid Kachwala
people.since: With the company since 2010; re-appointed whole-time director from April 2026 to March 2029
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from the University of Mumbai. He has been with the company since 2010, oversees financial management and administrative planning, and chairs the board's banking, finance and investment committee. He was paid ₹13.6 lakh in FY26.

people.name: Pervez Akhter
people.bio: The FY26 annual report names him as the senior manager in charge of export sales and marketing. The company has not published his background.

people.name: Anshul Gupta
people.since: Promoted to senior management on 18 June 2026
people.bio: Holds a master's degree in international business management from Lucknow University. He has over 23 years in sales and marketing, focused on exports to the US, Canada and South America. He was promoted to Vice President – Export Sales in June 2026.

people.name: Shah Alam
people.role: General Manager – R&D, Engineering and Design
people.since: Promoted to senior management on 18 June 2026
people.bio: Holds a Bachelor of Engineering (mechanical, honours) from Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi. He has over 30 years in R&D, engineering and design, and has overseen production, assembly and new product development, most recently on the Aerovict project. He was promoted to head R&D in June 2026.

people.name: Harish Khatter
people.bio: The FY26 annual report names him as the senior manager in charge of production and planning. The company has not published his background.

companies.changes: COO Kiran Kagalkar resigned in May 2025, and the FY26 annual report lists no replacement. Company Secretary Kinjal Shah resigned in July 2025 and Ruthu Parampogi took over. In June 2026 the board promoted Shah Alam, Anshul Gupta and Narender Bhakhri (procurement and supply chain) to senior management.

companies.styleNote: Four promoters run the company as executive directors: Arun Kothari (Chairman & MD) and whole-time directors Megharam Choudhary, Dhruv Patel and Jayantiram Choudhary. The company reports no family relationships between its directors. Promoters own 48.41%.

people.name: Arun Axaykumar Kothari
people.since: Board since September 2021; re-appointed for five years from 14 September 2026
people.relation: Promoter; Payal Arun Kothari, also in the promoter group, holds 5.66%
people.stake: 6.75% (13,97,465 shares, FY26 AGM notice); promoter group 48.41%
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a bachelor's degree in commerce from Rajasthan University and about 19 years of experience. He joined the board in 2021 and, as Chairman and MD, is responsible for finance and strategy. He is paid ₹7 lakh a month.

people.name: Megharam Sagramji Choudhary
people.since: Director since the company was formed (February 2015); re-appointed from September 2026
people.relation: Promoter; the company reports no relation to other directors
people.bio: Has over 19 years in the stainless-steel pipes and tubes industry and has been with the company since it was set up in 2015. He leads sales and marketing and is the largest individual shareholder. He is paid ₹6.5 lakh a month.

people.name: Dhruv Mahendrakumar Patel
people.since: Board since June 2015; re-appointed from September 2026
people.relation: Promoter; the company reports no relation to other directors
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in engineering from the University of Pune and a master's in technology from CEPT University. He has been with the company since 2015 and leads technical work and operations. He is paid ₹6.5 lakh a month.

people.name: Jayantiram Motiram Choudhary
people.since: Director since the company was formed (February 2015)
people.relation: Promoter; the company reports no relation to other directors
people.bio: Has over 14 years in the steel industry and has been a director since the company was set up. He looks after purchasing and operations. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is standing for re-appointment. He is paid ₹6.5 lakh a month.

people.name: Kunal Bubna
people.bio: He is the company's CFO and a key managerial person, and certifies the financial statements with the MD. The FY26 annual report does not give his qualifications or background.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report. In August 2026 the board re-appointed the MD and two whole-time directors for five more years from 14 September 2026, and four independent directors for second terms from October 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Patel-family business that listed in 2025. Four promoters run it: Samarth Patel (Chairman & Whole-time Director), Jagrutkumar Patel (MD), Saurabh Patel (Executive Director) and Ravi Patel (CFO). The company reports no relation between its directors. The wider Patel promoter group owns 66.43%.

people.name: Samarth Bharatbhai Patel
people.since: Director since December 2017; Chairman & Whole-time Director since September 2024
people.relation: Promoter; the company reports no relation to other directors
people.stake: 10.35% (61,99,008 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group 66.43%
people.bio: Has over 10 years in the steel industry. He has been a director since 2017 and chairman since 2024. He leads export sales, marketing and business development and plays a key role in strategy, financial oversight and project execution.

people.name: Jagrutkumar Rameshbhai Patel
people.since: Director since September 2016; MD since September 2024 (five-year term)
people.relation: Promoter; the company reports no relation to other directors
people.bio: Has over 10 years of experience in construction and real estate. He has been a director since 2016 and MD since 2024. He runs domestic sales and marketing and oversees raw-material buying for the plants.

people.name: Saurabh Amrutbhai Patel
people.since: Director since November 2020; Executive Director since September 2025
people.relation: Promoter; the company reports no relation to other directors
people.bio: Has over 10 years in construction and real estate, focused on infrastructure and project execution. He oversees project development, including buying land, plant and machinery, and is responsible for timely execution, maintenance and technology upgrades.

people.name: Ravi Rameshbhai Patel
people.since: Associated since November 2020; CFO since 10 September 2024
people.relation: Promoter
people.bio: Has over 10 years in construction and real estate, with a focus on financial operations. He was named CFO in September 2024 and handles accounts, payments, banking, budgeting and statutory compliance. The company does not report a professional finance qualification for him.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report; the September 2026 filings covered only auditor appointments.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by the Chandaria family through two overseas promoter companies, Huron Holdings (31.67%) and Trans Asia Petroleum (26.43%), 58.1% in all. Raj Chandaria is Chairman & MD, and also Chairman & MD of the listed subsidiary Aegis Vopak Terminals. Day-to-day operations are run by a hired CEO, Sudhir Malhotra, and a professional team. Raj's son Amal Chandaria, a designer who runs Spaghetti Studios, sits as a non-executive director.

people.name: Raj K. Chandaria
people.relation: Promoter family; father of non-executive director Amal Chandaria
people.stake: nil in his own name (FY26 annual report); the family holds 58.1% through Huron Holdings and Trans Asia Petroleum
people.bio: The promoter family's representative in management, on the board since 1999 and now Chairman & MD. He sits on the audit committee and chairs the risk-management committee. He has also been Chairman & MD of Aegis Vopak Terminals, the terminal subsidiary part-owned by Vopak, since October 2024, taking no pay there. At Aegis Logistics he is paid by commission, capped at 5% of profit; the board approved ₹10cr for FY26, up from ₹6.6cr. The annual reports do not give his education.

people.name: Sudhir O. Malhotra
people.bio: The hired CEO who runs the business day to day and signs the annual code-of-conduct declaration and the CEO/CFO certificate on the accounts. The annual report and company website list him as CEO but do not give his education or earlier career.

people.name: Murad M. Moledina
people.bio: The CFO, who signs the financial statements with the CEO and Chairman. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

people.name: Rajiv Chohan
people.bio: Leads business development and sits on the board's risk-management committee with the Chairman. His background is not given in the annual report.

people.name: Keshav Shenoy
people.bio: Heads strategic planning and is part of the named key management team. His background is not given in the annual report.

people.name: Haripal S. Mann
people.bio: Runs the LPG retail business, which sells LPG to homes, vehicles and industry under the Aegis brand. His background is not given in the annual report.

companies.changes: Company Secretary resigned on 8 May 2025; Sneha Parab took over on 16 May 2025. No change in the executive team since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Delhivery has no promoter; institutions own most of it and foreign investors 51.5%. It is still run by its co-founders, who own small stakes: Sahil Barua (MD & CEO), Kapil Bharati (CTO) and Suraj Saharan (Chief People Officer) are the three executive directors. None of the directors is related to another. The chair is an independent director, Neelam Dhawan (since April 2026). A fourth co-founder, operations chief Ajith Pai, left in September 2026.

people.name: Sahil Barua
people.since: Co-founder; director since 19 December 2011; re-appointed MD & CEO from 13 October 2026 for five years
people.relation: Co-founder
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from NIT Karnataka (Surathkal) with a management diploma from IIM Bangalore. Before Delhivery he was a consultant at Bain & Company India. He co-founded Delhivery in 2011 and has led it as CEO from a start-up to a national parcel and freight network, through the 2022 IPO and the purchase of Ecom Express. He is 41. The board re-appointed him in August 2026 for five years from October 2026, subject to the AGM vote, which also covers new stock options for him.

people.name: Kapil Bharati
people.relation: Co-founder
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from IIT Delhi, aged 48. He was founder and CTO of Athena Information Solutions and earlier a senior technology manager at Sapient. At Delhivery he leads technology and data science, building the data platform and decision tools used across its own network and sold to other logistics and supply-chain firms. He is up for re-appointment as a whole-time director at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Suraj Saharan
people.relation: Co-founder
people.bio: A B.Tech from IIT Bombay, aged 43. Before Delhivery he worked at Bain & Company India, ICICI Lombard and the Unique Identification Authority of India (Aadhaar). A co-founder, he headed new ventures before becoming Chief People Officer, and joined the board in May 2025. He is also a director of Algorhythm Tech and of the Express Industry Council of India.

people.name: Vani Venkatesh
people.since: Chief Business Officer and KMP; Deputy CEO from 8 August 2026
people.bio: Was Chief Business Officer and a key managerial person. On 8 August 2026, the same day operations chief Ajith Pai resigned, the board promoted her to Deputy CEO. The annual report does not give her education or earlier career.

people.name: Vivek Pabari
people.bio: Became CFO on 1 January 2026, after Amit Agarwal resigned at the end of December 2025. He signs the FY26 accounts. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

people.name: Arun Bagavathi
people.bio: Heads network operations. He is employed by a wholly owned subsidiary and was named a KMP of Delhivery in May 2026, one of several operations and business heads promoted then (with Prashant Gazipur for in-city operations and Nikhil Ummat for engineering and automation). The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: CFO Amit Agarwal resigned effective 31 December 2025; Vivek Pabari took over on 1 January 2026. Co-founder and COO Ajith Pai resigned on 8 August 2026, effective 16 September 2026. Vani Venkatesh became Deputy CEO on 8 August 2026. In May 2026 the board named new KMPs: COOs Prashant Gazipur, Nikhil Ummat and Arun Bagavathi, Chief Procurement Officer Kumar Sunny Raja, Chief Strategy Officer Vikas Kapoor and Chief Sales Officer Varun Bakshi. Chairperson Deepak Kapoor and Saugata Gupta left the board on 1 April 2026 and Romesh Sobti on 1 July 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by its founders. Co-founders Abhishek Bansal (Chairman, MD & CEO) and Vaibhav Khandelwal (CTO) are the named promoters and executive directors; two senior executives, Gaurav Jaithlia and Praharsh Chandra, joined them on the board as whole-time directors in June 2025. Promoters hold only about 16.5% after the IPO; venture investors such as NewQuest and Eight Roads hold large stakes. The four independent directors form half the board. No family relationships are disclosed.

people.name: Abhishek Bansal
people.since: Co-founder (2015); Chairman since 23 January 2025; MD & CEO since 21 April 2025
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter
people.stake: 4,82,24,256 shares, 31.77% of equity shares at 31 March 2025 (FY25 annual report, before preference-share conversion and the IPO); promoters together about 16.5% after the IPO
people.bio: Co-founded Shadowfax in 2015 as a technology-led delivery business for instant commerce, and has built it into one of India's biggest third-party e-commerce and quick-commerce delivery networks, handling 436 million orders in FY25. He became Chairman in January 2025 and MD & CEO when the company converted to a public company in April 2025, and led the IPO. He leads the earnings calls. The company's published reports do not give his education or earlier career, so we have left them out.

people.name: Vaibhav Khandelwal
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter
people.stake: 3,76,61,673 shares, 24.81% of equity shares at 31 March 2025 (FY25 annual report, before preference-share conversion and the IPO)
people.bio: Co-founder and CTO, in charge of the technology platform; its AI address-mapping tool, SF Maps, won a technology award in 2024. He has been a whole-time director since April 2025. His education and earlier career are not given in the company's published reports.

people.name: Praharsh Chandra
people.bio: Chief Business Officer; joined the board as a whole-time director in June 2025, ahead of the IPO. His background is not given in the company's published reports.

people.name: Gaurav Jaithlia
people.role: Whole-time Director & Head of Business Strategy
people.bio: Heads business strategy and joined the board as a whole-time director in June 2025. His background is not given in the company's published reports.

people.name: Praveen Kumar K J
people.since: Named CFO and KMP on 21 April 2025
people.bio: The CFO, named a key managerial person when the company became public in April 2025. He presents the financials on the quarterly calls. His background is not given in the company's published reports.

people.name: Deepak Kumar Goel
people.bio: Runs last-mile delivery operations. Listed by the company as senior management; his background is not given.

people.name: Ankit Kala
people.bio: Runs network planning. Listed by the company as senior management; his background is not given.

companies.changes: No executive changes since listing. Directors Mamtesh Sugla and Hemant Badri left the board in June 2025, and Aditya Systla in March 2025. The FY26 annual report was not yet on the company's website when this was written, so the stakes are from the FY25 report.

companies.styleNote: Part of the TVS group. Promoter R Dinesh, with the company since its start in 2004, is Executive Chairman; his sister Shobhana Ramachandhran (MD of TVS Srichakra) is a non-executive director. Dinesh remains an executive, but daily running is in the hands of a hired CEO, Vikas Chadha, who also became MD on 1 July 2026, and professional regional CEOs. The promoter group owns 43.0%, mainly through TVS Mobility (24.3%) and T S Rajam Rubbers (14.9%).

people.name: R Dinesh
people.since: Director since 18 November 2004 (with the company since incorporation)
people.relation: Promoter; brother of non-executive director Shobhana Ramachandhran
people.stake: 72,12,620 shares, about 1.6% (FY26 annual report); promoter group 43.03%
people.bio: A commerce graduate, chartered accountant and cost accountant (B.Com, ACA, AICWA), aged 61, with more than 34 years in auto retail services, digitisation and logistics. He has been with TVS Supply Chain Solutions since it was set up and, with senior management, oversees its overall functions, strategy and expansion plans. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is standing for re-election.

people.name: Vikas Chadha
people.since: Global CEO since 22 January 2026; MD from 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2031
people.bio: An electronics and communications engineer with an MBA from the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad, aged 55. He has over 30 years of leadership experience running businesses with more than $1 billion of revenue, in multinational companies and an Indian listed company. Just before joining he was CEO of a large Dubai-based conglomerate (the company does not name it). He joined as Global CEO in January 2026 and replaced Ravi Viswanathan as MD from July 2026, subject to the AGM vote; he was paid ₹3.99cr for part of FY26.

people.name: R Vaidhyanathan
people.bio: Became CFO on 1 April 2025. His pay was 40 times the median employee in FY26. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

people.name: Sukumar Kameswaran
people.role: CEO – India, Middle East and Africa
people.bio: Runs the India, Middle East and Africa business. The annual report names him as senior management but does not give his background.

people.name: Richard Vieites
people.bio: Runs the Europe and North America business. His background is not given in the annual report.

people.name: Siddharth Jairaj
people.bio: Became CEO of the freight-forwarding (GFS) business in November 2025. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: Managing Director Ravi Viswanathan resigned from the board and stepped down as MD on 30 June 2026; Global CEO Vikas Chadha (joined 22 January 2026) became MD on 1 July 2026. R Vaidhyanathan became CFO on 1 April 2025. Siddharth Jairaj became CEO of Global Forwarding Solutions on 1 November 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 2013 by Balakrishnan, who is Chairman & MD (Chairman since 1 April 2026). His wife Sundaram Yogalakshmi is a whole-time director and his mother Rajarathinam Thiripurasundari is a non-executive director. The couple own 55.3%. Day-to-day studio operations are run with a hired COO, Zameer Hussain (also Global EVP), and CFO Gaurav Mehra (since October 2024).

people.name: Balakrishnan
people.since: 2013 (founder); MD re-appointed 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2031; Chairman from 1 April 2026
people.relation: Founder; husband of Whole-time Director Sundaram Yogalakshmi; son of director Rajarathinam Thiripurasundari
people.stake: 41.9% (1,05,88,250 shares, FY26 annual report); family together 55.3%
people.bio: Holds a master's degree in electronic media from Anna University. He founded Basilic Fly in 2013 to offer high-quality but affordable visual effects from India, and built it into a VFX studio serving Netflix, Disney, Amazon, HBO, Warner Bros., Sony and Apple TV+, with facilities in Chennai and Pune and senior staff hired in London, Los Angeles and Paris. He sets strategy, manages teams and expansion, and is the company's public face. He was re-appointed MD for five years from January 2026 and became Chairman in April 2026.

people.name: Sundaram Yogalakshmi
people.since: Re-appointed whole-time director 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2031
people.relation: Wife of Chairman & MD Balakrishnan
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electronics and communication engineering from Anna University. She works on business strategy: assessing performance, recommending improvements and streamlining operations. The annual report also calls her Director & Chief Business Strategy Officer.

companies.changes: Balakrishnan became Chairman on 1 April 2026. Whole-time director Duraiswami Prabhakar left on completion of his term on 31 December 2025. Ikkurthi Chandramohan became Company Secretary in October 2025, replacing Swati Sharma. Independent director Ravichandran Chitra joined in January 2026. Other senior managers named: Zameer Hussain (COO & Global EVP), Gaurav Mehra (CFO) and Abishek Nair (Global Creative Head).

companies.styleNote: Part of Sanjiv Goenka's RPSG Group; the promoter group owns 60.57%, mostly through Composure Services (55.28%). Dr Sanjiv Goenka is non-executive Chairperson, his daughter Avarna Jain is non-executive Vice-Chairperson and his wife Preeti Goenka is a non-executive director. The only executive director is a hired MD, Vikram Mehra, in the job since 2014.

people.name: Vikram Mehra
people.since: 27 October 2014; current terms run to 26 October 2027
people.bio: Born in 1971, he holds a B.Tech in computer science from IIT Roorkee and an MBA from IIM Lucknow. Before Saregama he held managerial and strategy roles at Tata Sky, STAR TV, Tata Motors, the Tata Administrative Services and Tata Consultancy Services. He has been MD since October 2014, with experience in digital media, content monetisation, brands and subscription businesses. He sits on the board of the Indian Performing Right Society and on the boards of Pocket Aces Pictures and Editorji Technologies. He was paid about ₹20.3cr in FY26.

people.name: Abhishek Kapoor
people.bio: A chartered accountant with an executive programme in strategy from IIM Kozhikode, he has more than 25 years in finance at listed and consumer companies across media and entertainment, FMCG, beverages and manufacturing. He came from Sula Vineyards, the listed wine maker, where he was CFO.

companies.changes: CFO Pankaj Chaturvedi resigned on 31 March 2026. Kuldeep Kothari, a 7-year finance veteran at the company, was interim CFO from 24 June to 14 July 2026, and Abhishek Kapoor took over as CFO on 15 July 2026. Nayan Kumar Misra replaced Priyanka Motwani as Company Secretary during FY26. Senior managers named in the report include Siddharth Anand Kumar (EVP – Films, Series and Events), Kartikeya Kalla (SVP – Music) and Vinay Kumar Guwalani (SVP – Music Monetisation and Marketing).

companies.styleNote: Founded by the Taurani brothers in the early 1980s; the family owns 64.15%. Kumar Taurani is Chairman & MD, his brother Ramesh Taurani and his son Girish Taurani are executive directors. The brothers also control Tips Films (about 20% each), a promoter-group company that supplies film music rights. The hired CEO, Hari Nair, left on 30 April 2026 and no successor has been announced, so the family runs the business directly with CFO Sushant Dalmia.

people.name: Kumar Taurani
people.since: Co-founder (early 1980s); re-appointed CMD for three years from 1 June 2025
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Ramesh Taurani; father of Girish Taurani
people.stake: 15.80% (2,01,99,640 shares, August 2026 AGM notice); family together 64.15%
people.bio: Co-founded Tips with his brother in the early 1980s, starting with regional and devotional music before moving into Hindi film music, and has guided the company since inception. He is Chairman of the Indian Music Industry (IMI) body and speaks publicly on music royalties. He is also Chairman and executive director of Tips Films, in which he owns about 20%. He was paid ₹1.93cr in FY26 (₹16.5 lakh a month under his 2025 re-appointment).

people.name: Ramesh Taurani
people.since: Board since 27 September 2005; re-appointed for three years from 1 June 2025
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Chairman Kumar Taurani
people.bio: Aged 66, he holds a bachelor's degree in commerce and has nearly 45 years in media and entertainment. He is a well-known film producer who has handled the creative side of Tips as it moved into film and music production, including music curation, and is credited with several hit films and with building the film and music library. He is a director of Tips Films. He drew no pay from Tips Music in FY26.

people.name: Girish Taurani
people.since: Re-appointed for three years from 1 June 2025
people.relation: Son of Chairman Kumar Taurani; nephew of Ramesh Taurani
people.stake: 2.69% (34,43,340 shares per the August 2026 AGM notice; the governance report lists 59,43,340)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce. He oversees the music and digital businesses and the company credits him with its expansion and overall management. He was paid ₹0.9cr in FY26 (₹7.5 lakh a month).

companies.changes: CEO Hari Nair resigned on 10 March 2026 and left on 30 April 2026; no replacement has been announced. Sushant Dalmia is CFO and Bijal Patel is Company Secretary. A share buyback was deferred in July 2026 to the 5 August 2026 board meeting.

companies.styleNote: Founded in Jaipur in 1992 by Dr. Mahavir Prasad Agarwal and his son Rajat Agrawal, who is now Chairman and MD. The founder stepped down as Chairman in October 2024 and has since died (the FY26 annual report carries a tribute, 1949–2026). The CEO and CFO are long-serving hired professionals; the annual report says no directors are related. Promoters own 55.88% (Rajat Agrawal 32.38% plus the Agrawal Family Private Trust 23.50%).

people.name: Rajat Agrawal
people.relation: Co-founder; son of the late founder Dr. Mahavir Prasad Agarwal
people.stake: 32.38% in his own name, plus 23.50% held as trustee of the Agrawal Family Private Trust (FY26 annual report); promoters together 55.88%
people.bio: Holds a Bachelor of Engineering from MNIT (Malaviya National Institute of Technology), Jaipur, and attended the OPM advanced management programme at Harvard Business School. He co-founded Gravita with his father in 1992 and has been on the board since August 1992, with over 33 years of experience setting up and running manufacturing operations. He built the group from a single lead-recycling plant in Jaipur into a recycler with subsidiaries in more than 13 countries, adding aluminium, plastics, rubber, lithium and copper. He became Chairman as well as MD in October 2024 when his father stepped down. He has chaired the Confederation of Indian Industry's Rajasthan council and sits on the boards of many Gravita group companies.

people.name: Yogesh Malhotra
people.bio: A mechanical engineer (BE) from MREC, Jaipur, with an MBA from the National University of Singapore. He has over 33 years of experience in India and the Asia Pacific, and earlier worked at Blue Star, Castrol and Eurochem. He joined Gravita in 2011 and joined the board as a whole-time director in March 2019; he now runs the business day to day as CEO. He is also a director of Gravita Infotech, Noble Buildestate and Rashtriya Metal Industries. His re-appointment and a revised pay package were put to the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Sunil Kansal
people.bio: A chartered accountant who also holds a master's degree in commerce from Rajasthan University, with about three decades of experience in finance. He joined Gravita in 2008 and rose to CFO, covering financial management, strategic planning, risk management and governance. He joined the board as a whole-time director on 4 October 2024. He is also a director of Gravita Infotech, Noble Buildestate and Rashtriya Metal Industries.

companies.changes: Founder and former Chairman Dr. Mahavir Prasad Agarwal died in 2026. Executive Director (Sales & Marketing, non-board) Vijay Kumar Pareek resigned from 31 March 2026; Yogesh Mohan Kharbanda joined as Executive Director (non-board) from 1 January 2026. Independent director Satish Kumar Agrawal resigned in March 2026. No executive changes filed since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: A family business run by the Parikh brothers: Rajesh Parikh is Chairman and MD, his younger brother Atil Parikh is CEO and MD, and Rajesh's wife Sejal Parikh is a whole-time director. Fellow promoter Ilaben Chandresh Parikh holds 9.02% and the family company Ionix Advanced Materials 24.56%; promoters together own 45.04%. Vedika R. Parikh, described as a relative of the promoter, was hired in 2026 as a strategy and transformation associate with shareholder approval.

people.name: Rajesh C. Parikh
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Atil Parikh; husband of Sejal Parikh
people.bio: A first-class mechanical engineer with an MBA in finance. He started work in 1994 as a trainee engineer at Jyoti Limited, a Vadodara engineering company, and then handled technical and marketing work on a china clay project. He joined the 20 Microns board at 27 and now leads the company as Chairman and MD, overseeing strategy, planning and external relations. He is also a director of 20 Microns Nano Minerals, 20 MCC Private Limited and the promoter company Ionix Advanced Materials, and chairs the CSR committee.

people.name: Atil C. Parikh
people.relation: Promoter; brother of the Chairman Rajesh Parikh
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering from Gujarat University and an MBA in finance from California. He was a management trainee at 20 Microns in 1999–2000, then moved to the US, where he worked as a management analyst at Tax Credit Company from 2003 to 2005. He rejoined 20 Microns in 2005 and worked on strategy and restructuring before becoming CEO and MD. He runs day-to-day operations and customer relationships and looks at expansion and acquisitions. He is also MD of 20 Microns Nano Minerals and a director of subsidiaries including Dorfner-20 Microns and Sievert 20 Microns Building Materials.

people.name: Sejal R. Parikh
people.relation: Wife of the Chairman Rajesh Parikh
people.bio: Holds a BE in production engineering and a postgraduate diploma in business administration. She worked for two years as a trainee engineer in the planning department of GMM Pfaudler, the glass-lined equipment maker, and has worked on heritage conservation projects. She has been a whole-time director since May 2017, covering operations, marketing and business development. She is also a director of the subsidiary 20 MCC Private Limited and a partner in Thrive Selfcare LLP.

people.name: Nihad M. Baluch
people.since: Appointed February 2025; CFO and KMP from 1 April 2025
people.bio: Holds an MBA in finance from Gujarat University (2008) and has over 16 years of experience in hospitality, infrastructure, textiles, logistics, IT, education and FMCG. He was earlier CFO of Jindal Texofab, group CFO of the Dogra Group, CEO of PDMS and a finance officer at Neesa Technologies. He joined 20 Microns as Group CFO in February 2025 and took charge as CFO and KMP from April 2025.

companies.changes: No change in key managerial personnel during FY26 or up to the annual report date. Independent director Dr. Ajay Ranka retired in September 2025 at the end of his term; Prem Kumar Taneja joined as an independent director in May 2025.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Raipur-based Hira Group. Founder B.L. Agrawal is Chairman and MD; his sons Abhishek and Siddharth Agrawal are whole-time directors, as is fellow promoter Dinesh Agrawal (whom the annual report does not list as a relative). The one hired professional on the board is Dinesh Kumar Gandhi. Promoters own 63.34%, spread across many Agrawal family members, HUFs and group companies.

people.name: Bajrang Lal (B.L.) Agrawal
people.since: Founder (company set up 1999); on board since August 2002; Chairman since 9 August 2024
people.relation: Founder; father of Abhishek and Siddharth Agrawal
people.stake: 1.75% in his own name plus 5.39% through Bajrang Lal Agrawal HUF (FY26 annual report); promoters together 63.34%
people.bio: Aged 72, he is an electronics engineer by qualification and a first-generation entrepreneur with nearly four decades in iron and steel. He founded Godawari Power & Ispat and has run the company in various roles since it started, as MD responsible for overall management. He runs several Hira Group companies. He was made Chairman as well as MD from 9 August 2024.

people.name: Abhishek Agrawal
people.relation: Son of the Chairman B.L. Agrawal; brother of Siddharth Agrawal
people.bio: Aged 42, a second-generation entrepreneur with a master's degree in international business from Leeds University, UK. He oversees the integrated steel operations at Siltara and has a key role in developing and marketing iron ore pellets, including exports of premium pellets. He is also monitoring the cold-rolling mill project, the planned new integrated steel plant and the battery storage (BESS) project in the subsidiary Godawari New Energy. The board has approved his re-appointment for five more years from November 2026, subject to shareholders.

people.name: Siddharth Agrawal
people.since: Board since January 2018; Whole-time Director since April 2022
people.relation: Son of the Chairman B.L. Agrawal; brother of Abhishek Agrawal
people.bio: Aged 45, he holds an MBA in finance and marketing and has over 20 years of experience across the group, mainly in renewable energy. As former MD of the group subsidiary Godawari Green Energy he built and scaled its solar power portfolio. He now leads the group's solar capacity and is monitoring a residential school project run through a subsidiary. He is also a director of MK Ventures Capital and Hira Infra-Tek. The board has approved his re-appointment for five years from April 2027.

people.name: Dinesh Agrawal
people.since: Director since September 1999; Whole-time Director since August 2012
people.relation: Promoter director (second-generation); the annual report says he is not a relative of the other directors under the Companies Act
people.stake: 3.62% in his own name plus 2.00% through Dinesh Agrawal HUF (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Aged 55, an engineer by qualification and a second-generation entrepreneur who has been with the company for more than two decades. He oversees setting up and running the rolling mill and the galvanised structures plant, which makes transmission towers and poles, railway overhead-line structures and solar structures. He is also a director of Hira Pipes and other private group companies. He retires by rotation and is up for re-appointment at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Dinesh Kumar Gandhi
people.since: Director since February 2005; Whole-time Director since April 2022
people.bio: Aged 63, a fellow chartered accountant and fellow company secretary with about four decades in accounts, finance, project planning and financing, strategic planning and corporate structuring. He has been on the board since 2005 and became a whole-time director in April 2022. He is also a director of Deccan Gold Mines and the subsidiary Hira Ferro Alloys. The board has approved his re-appointment for five years from April 2027.

people.name: Sanjay Bothra
people.bio: He is the company's CFO and a key managerial person, and has held the role since 2014 according to Bloomberg. He signs the financial statements alongside the Chairman and sits on the risk management committee. The annual report gives no further details of his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: No change in directors or key managerial personnel during FY26. In August 2026 the board approved re-appointing Abhishek Agrawal (from November 2026) and Siddharth Agrawal and Dinesh Kumar Gandhi (from April 2027) as whole-time directors, and pay for the three promoter whole-time directors rose to ₹40 lakh a month from July 2026 (approved at a June 2026 EGM). Senior management also includes COO KVSKN Ravindran and President (HR) Mani Mukut Dan.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Bansal family. Ashish Bansal has been MD since 2015 and became Chairman and MD in May 2026 after his father, Chairman Anil Kumar Bansal, died on 1 April 2026. The other executive director, K. Kumaravel, is a long-serving finance professional. Promoters own 39.35%, with Ashish Bansal the largest holder at 15.20%.

people.name: Ashish Bansal
people.since: Joined 2009; MD since 2015; Chairman since 26 May 2026
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late Chairman Anil Kumar Bansal
people.bio: Holds an MBA and studied at the University of Wales, Cardiff. He joined the company in 2009 and was made Managing Director in 2015. Under him the company has moved from pure lead recycling into lead alloys, aluminium and copper, and is building a copper cathode plant. After his father's death in April 2026 the board re-designated him Chairman and Managing Director on 26 May 2026.

people.name: K. Kumaravel
people.stake: not disclosed in the annual report (it refers to the annual return)
people.bio: A member of both the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and the Institute of Cost Accountants of India, with over 30 years in finance, accounts and secretarial work at public sector and listed companies. He began his career at Tamil Nadu Magnesite before joining the company in 1996. He has handled IPOs, follow-on offers, rights issues, preferential allotments, mergers and demergers, and oversees accounts, tax, governance and CSR. He helped set up the Andhra Pradesh plant and the overseas expansion, sits on the MCX product advisory committee and is a director of the Material Recycling Association of India (MRAI).

people.name: Vijay Balakrishnan (B. Vijay)
people.bio: He is the CFO and a key managerial person, and signs the financial statements with the Director – Finance. The annual report and website give no details of his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: Chairman and whole-time director Anil Kumar Bansal died on 1 April 2026; Ashish Bansal was re-designated Chairman and MD on 26 May 2026. Former IRS officer Hemant Jawahar Lal joined as an independent director on 26 May 2026. R.S. Vaidhyanathan is a non-board Executive Director in senior management.

companies.styleNote: A family company listed in August 2026. Sandeep Aggarwal is Chairman and MD, his son Nikunj Aggarwal is a whole-time director and Nikunj's wife Esha Gupta is also a whole-time director. The three promoters own 67.36% after the IPO (91.16% before); the whole promoter group held 67.62% at listing. The CFO and senior managers are hired professionals.

people.name: Sandeep Aggarwal
people.relation: Promoter; father of Nikunj Aggarwal; father-in-law of Esha Gupta
people.stake: 33.80% after the IPO (45.73% before), per the August 2026 prospectus; promoters together 67.36%
people.bio: He completed his higher secondary education (CBSE) and has more than three decades of experience in the pure lead and lead alloys business. He has been a director since April 2021 and, as Chairman and MD, is responsible for strategy, governance and board matters, operations, finance and external relationships. He sold part of his stake in the IPO's offer for sale.

people.name: Nikunj Aggarwal
people.relation: Promoter; son of the Chairman Sandeep Aggarwal; husband of Esha Gupta
people.stake: 33.56% after the IPO (45.43% before), per the August 2026 prospectus; promoters together 67.36%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in business administration (entrepreneurship) from Swiss Business School and completed the postgraduate programme in management for family business at the Indian School of Business. He has more than eight years of experience in the lead and lead alloys business. He leads manufacturing, production and operations, business development and customers, and also oversees finance and compliance. He sold part of his stake in the IPO's offer for sale.

people.name: Esha Gupta
people.relation: Promoter; wife of Nikunj Aggarwal; daughter-in-law of the Chairman
people.bio: Holds a BA (Honours) from the University of Delhi and has over four years of experience in human resource management. She joined the board in March 2025 and looks after HR planning, policies, performance management, employee development and culture.

people.name: Arun Kumar Mallik
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Lalit Narayan Mithila University with a postgraduate diploma in business management from the Institute of Management Technology. He has more than three decades of experience, mostly in auto-component companies: Belrise Industries, Minda Industries, Viney Corporation, Madhusudan Auto and Rasandik Engineering, as well as Fine Tracks and Anglo Dutch Paints. He joined as CFO in June 2025 to run the IPO, and covers risk, M&A, accounts, audit, tax, legal and IT controls.

people.name: Amitabh Agrawal
people.bio: A commerce (Honours) graduate from the University of Calcutta with 28 years of experience in operations management, earlier at Fakirchand Hetampuria & Co. and Pilot Industries. He joined in April 2022 and runs the manufacturing plant end to end, including process improvement, safety and environment, supply chain and inventory. He was the best-paid of the named managers in FY26 at ₹1.07cr.

companies.changes: Listed on 12 August 2026. The CFO (June 2025), company secretary Manish Kumar Rai (December 2025) and Head of Sales Shyam Dhar Singh (July 2025) all joined in the run-up to the IPO. No management changes filed since listing.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by promoter Chetan Shah's family, which owns 48.03% (Chetan Shah 6.94%, Dina Chetan Shah 9.63%, Manan Shah 4.35%, family trusts and the group company Ashapura Industrial Finance 17.75%). Chetan Shah stepped down as Executive Chairman in October 2025 and leaves the board at the 29 September 2026 AGM because of pending litigation, but returns from 1 October 2026 as Chief – Strategy & Planning, a key managerial post paying up to ₹2cr a year. Day-to-day running is with the hired CEO Hemul Shah. Chetan Shah's daughter Himani Shah is a non-executive director.

people.name: Hemul Shah
people.since: Board since December 2020; re-appointed ED & CEO for two years from 16 February 2026
people.bio: He has a long association with the company and experience in planning, operations and general management, according to its filings. He joined the board in December 2020 and has been Executive Director and CEO for successive two-year terms, most recently from February 2026 to February 2028. He signs the accounts as CEO and chairs board committees, and is also a non-executive director of the group company Orient Ceratech. The company does not publish his education or earlier employers. His FY26 pay was ₹80.16 lakh.

people.name: Chetan Shah
people.role: Chief – Strategy & Planning (key managerial personnel from 1 October 2026)
people.since: On the board since February 1982; Executive Chairman until 23 October 2025
people.relation: Promoter; father of director Himani Shah
people.stake: 6.94% (FY26 annual report), down from 14.28% after moving shares to family trusts under a SEBI exemption order; promoters together 48.03%
people.bio: The promoter, with over four decades in mining and minerals. The company credits him with turning Ashapura from a single-product mining company into a diversified global minerals group, building its international business, mineral portfolio and processing capacity. He was Executive Chairman until October 2025, then a non-executive director. Because of pending (sub-judice) litigation he chose not to seek re-election at the September 2026 AGM, and the board then named him Chief – Strategy & Planning from 1 October 2026, covering strategy, new businesses and new geographies, subject to shareholder approval of his pay.

people.name: Ashish Desai
people.bio: He is the Group CFO and a key managerial person, and signs the CEO/CFO certificate with Hemul Shah. The annual report gives no details of his education or career.

companies.changes: Chetan Shah's term as Executive Chairman ended on 23 October 2025; he leaves the board at the 29 September 2026 AGM and becomes Chief – Strategy & Planning (KMP) from 1 October 2026. Independent directors Neeta Shah (resigned August 2025) and Pundarik Sanyal (term ended February 2026) left; Jagdish Shetty and Wilson Mathais joined in February 2026. Other named KMP: Company Secretary Sachin Polke and HR head Sandeep Deshpande.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Nagpur-based Chadda family, which grew out of the family's trucking firms (Shree Chadda Roadlines, KSR Freight Carriers). Mohit Chadda is Chairman and MD; his cousin Rahul Chadda, and the brothers Manish and Anuj Chadda (Anuj's wife Priya is a whole-time director) fill the other executive roles. The five named promoters own 72.34% after the July 2026 IPO (86.64% before); the whole promoter group held 74.18% at listing. The CFO is a hired chartered accountant.

people.name: Mohit Satishkumar Chadda
people.since: Director since July 2014; MD since September 2024 (term to September 2029)
people.relation: Promoter; cousin of Rahul Chadda
people.stake: 28.20% after the IPO (33.48% before), per the July 2026 prospectus; promoters together 72.34%
people.bio: He enrolled for a Bachelor of Law at Nagpur University. He has been with the company since 2014 and a partner in the family logistics firms Shree Chadda Roadlines and KSR Freight Carriers since February 2008, and is also linked to Caliber Infraproject LLP, Chadda Infraprojects LLP and Caliber Resorts. He has about 17 years of experience in logistics and 5 in mining. He became MD in September 2024 and Chairman the same month, and is paid ₹20 lakh a month.

people.name: Rahul Roshanlal Chadda
people.since: Director since July 2014; Whole-time Director since September 2024
people.relation: Promoter; cousin of Mohit and Manish Chadda
people.stake: 14.93% after the IPO (97,60,378 shares, per the FY26 AGM notice); promoters together 72.34%
people.bio: Holds a BBA from Nagpur University (the prospectus says he enrolled for it). He has been with the company since July 2014 and a partner in Shree Chadda Roadlines since 2008 and KSR Freight Carriers since 2009. He has about 17 years in logistics and 5 in mining, and works on operations, logistics and strategy. He chairs the CSR committee and is also a partner in Chadda Infraprojects LLP, which the company proposes to deal with (up to ₹500cr in FY27). He is up for re-appointment at the September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Manish Krishanlal Chadda
people.since: Director since March 2017; Whole-time Director since September 2024
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Anuj Chadda; brother-in-law of Priya Chadda; cousin of Rahul Chadda
people.stake: 9.32% after the IPO (11.41% before), per the July 2026 prospectus; promoters together 72.34%
people.bio: He enrolled for a Bachelor of Commerce at Nagpur University. He has been a partner in Sutlej Transport Company since 2001 and in the family's Shree Chadda Roadlines and KSR Freight Carriers since 2017, giving him about 25 years in logistics and 5 in mining. He joined the company in 2017 and became a whole-time director in September 2024, paid ₹20 lakh a month.

people.name: Priya Anuj Chadda
people.relation: Promoter; wife of Anuj Chadda
people.stake: 0.18% after the IPO (July 2026 prospectus); promoters together 72.34%
people.bio: Holds a BA from Punjab University. She has been a director of K.S.R Motors, an automobile business, since 2018 and has about seven years of experience in the automotive industry. She joined the board as a whole-time director in November 2024; her pay was cut from ₹20 lakh to ₹10 lakh a month from August 2025.

people.name: Anuj Krishanlal Chadda
people.since: With the company since 2014; in this role since November 2024
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Manish Chadda; husband of Priya Chadda
people.stake: 19.71% after the IPO (23.56% before), per the July 2026 prospectus; promoters together 72.34%
people.bio: A mechanical engineering graduate from Nagpur University. He has been a partner in the family's Shree Chadda Roadlines and KSR Freight Carriers since 2008 and with the company since 2014. He heads maintenance and procurement for the mining fleet, and was paid ₹79.42 lakh in FY26. He is also a partner in Chadda Infraprojects LLP, a related party.

people.name: Nikhil Kamalkishor Karwa
people.stake: nil (not among shareholding directors/KMP in the prospectus)
people.bio: A chartered accountant and commerce graduate from Nagpur University with about 21 years in finance and accounts. He earlier worked at S.R. Batliboi & Co. and KPMG, and was a partner at Karwa Bhatia & Co., a chartered accountancy firm. He joined as CFO in October 2024 ahead of the IPO and was paid ₹30 lakh in FY26.

companies.changes: Listed on 24 July 2026. No management changes filed since listing. Company Secretary is Riddhi Varma (since August 2024).

companies.styleNote: A founder-run family business listed in June 2026.
