people.name: Sujit Jaysukh Bhayani
people.relation: Founder and promoter; related to Shanil Bhayani (per annual report)
people.stake: 21.16% directly plus 5.72% through his HUF (June 2026); promoter group together 76.15%, including 40.35% through Riva Resources
people.bio: He is a chemistry graduate from the University of Tulsa, USA, with over 35 years running the company. In 1989 it started with one plant making two calcium products; he has built it into a maker of mineral-based excipients and nutrition ingredients with subsidiaries in Europe and the US, plus a battery-materials unit. He sets long-term strategy and leads innovation and diversification, including the new battery-materials business (Sudeep Advanced Materials). He took the company public in November 2025.

people.name: Shanil Sujit Bhayani
people.relation: Promoter; related to Chairman & MD Sujit Bhayani (per annual report)
people.bio: He is a finance graduate from Drexel University, USA, with over nine years in sales and marketing planning, product development and running staff. He introduces new products for pharma customers and leads the push into nutrition ingredients through Sudeep Nutrition. He also co-signs the Board's report with the MD.

people.name: Ajay Shrirang Kandelkar
people.since: Joined Oct 2023 as VP Operations; whole-time director since 13 Sep 2024 (term to Sep 2029)
people.bio: He holds a bachelor's in dairy technology from Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth. Before Sudeep he worked at Food Service (India), Drytech Processes (India), the Warana dairy cooperative (Shree Warana Sahakari Dudh Utpadak Prakriya Sangh) and Taiyo Lucid. He runs production, engineering, quality and stores across the company's plants. Shareholders were asked to approve a pay rise from April 2026.

people.name: Ketan Vyas
people.bio: A chartered accountant with an MBA in finance from the University of Mumbai and 26 years in finance. He previously worked at Neogen Chemicals, ArcelorMittal and Batliboi. He became CFO in September 2024, ahead of the November 2025 IPO.

people.name: Serkan Celebi
people.bio: He runs business development, strategy and planning for the European subsidiary. He has 14 years of business experience and previously worked at Van Eeghen & Co. in the Netherlands.

people.name: Sendhil Kumar Pani
people.role: Managing Director, Sudeep Pharma USA Inc.
people.bio: He oversees strategy, finances and operations of the US subsidiary. He previously worked at IMCD US and at US Nutraceuticals (Valensa International).

companies.changes: Milin Mehta, managing partner of K C Mehta & Co, joined as a non-executive director on 26 Jun 2026. The investor nominee director, Pranav Parikh, resigned in Jun 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founder Saurabh Garg is Chairman and MD and owns 43.7% after the May 2026 IPO. His wife Amita Garg (16.9%) and son Ayush Garg sit on the board as non-executive promoter directors, though the company says Ayush leads finance, technology and planning, and he draws a salary. Promoters own 67.5% (May 2026). Most sales go to POCT Services, a partnership in which a director is a partner.

people.name: Saurabh Garg
people.since: Founder; with the company since incorporation (2010)
people.relation: Founder and promoter; husband of director Amita Garg and father of director Ayush Garg
people.stake: 43.69% (May 2026, after IPO; 62.62% before it); promoter group together 67.51%
people.bio: He holds a diploma in electronics engineering from Lucknow Polytechnic and has over 31 years in healthcare and diagnostics. He built the business around turnkey diagnostic laboratories and critical-care and cardiology solutions, working closely with government health programmes. He leads business development and strategy. He has received the Jan Swasthya Sewa Award (2018) and a Pride of Asia award for healthcare innovation.

people.name: Yethadka Subraya Prabhakara
people.bio: He holds a B.Sc. in agricultural marketing and co-operation and an M.Sc. in agricultural economics from the University of Agricultural Sciences, Bangalore, and a postgraduate diploma in agricultural management from IIM Ahmedabad. He has about 31 years in general management and running profit-and-loss units. The company says he is responsible for its overall strategy and operations.

people.name: Ajay Kumar Mahanty
people.relation: Promoter (not stated to be related to the Gargs)
people.bio: He holds an MBA from Berhampur University and an honours diploma for a B.Sc. from Utkal University. He has over 20 years in sales, marketing and strategy in diagnostics. He leads sales and marketing planning, oversees manufacturing and budgeting, drives partnerships and heads R&D to widen the product range.

people.name: Kuldeep Chowdhry
people.bio: He holds an MBA from Sikkim Manipal University and a B.Sc. from Kanpur University, and completed XLRI's executive programme in strategy and leadership. He has over 29 years in biotechnology. He oversees operations, coordinating R&D, production and quality control, and new product development.

people.name: Meenal Gupta
people.since: CFO through FY26 (start date not disclosed)
people.bio: She is CFO and signs the MD/CFO certification with Saurabh Garg. The annual report gives no education or career details; her FY26 pay was about ₹48 lakh.

companies.changes: Listed on NSE SME in May 2026. Prabhakara joined the board as a whole-time director in May 2025, ahead of the IPO. No executive resignations have been filed since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Founder Rajiv Gandhi is CEO and MD, and his daughter Priya Gandhi is Executive Director. His uncle, Dr. Bhupendra Gandhi, is non-executive chairman and his brother Sanjiv Gandhi is a non-executive director. The Gandhi family and group firms own 53.7% (June 2026). Ravin and Bela Gandhi, who live abroad, are being moved out of the promoter group.

people.name: Rajiv Gandhi
people.since: Founder (1987); re-appointed for 3 years from 1 Apr 2026
people.relation: Founder; father of Priya Gandhi, brother of Sanjiv Gandhi, nephew of Chairman Dr. Bhupendra Gandhi
people.stake: 10.48% (June 2026); his wife Nina Gandhi 8.19%; promoter group together 53.73%
people.bio: He is a graduate of Bombay University and founded Hester in 1987. He manages the whole company, with all functional heads reporting to him, and built its poultry and livestock vaccine business in India, Nepal and Tanzania. He won the Ahmedabad Management Association's Outstanding Entrepreneur of the Year award in 2016, is president of the AMA and a past chairman of FICCI's Gujarat State Council. He sits on the governing councils of SVNIT Surat and Kamdhenu University. His pay from April 2026 is ₹18 lakh a month before other benefits.

people.name: Priya Gandhi
people.since: With the company since 2016; re-appointed from 28 Oct 2026 to Mar 2029
people.relation: Daughter of CEO & MD Rajiv Gandhi; niece of Sanjiv Gandhi
people.bio: She has an undergraduate degree from the Srishti School of Art, Design and Technology, Bengaluru, and a postgraduate degree in management for family business from ISB Hyderabad. She joined Hester in 2016 and works on strategy, organisation building and coordination across businesses and subsidiaries. Her focus includes operations, business expansion, corporate communications, branding and strategic partnerships. She writes her own letter in the annual report.

people.name: Ashish Desai
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com from Gujarat University and over 25 years in accounting, budgeting, audit, costing and tax. Before Hester he was CFO of Blue Ray Aviation and, earlier, of Shreeyam Power & Steel Industries, a listed company with about ₹1,200 crore of revenue. He joined Hester as Group Finance Controller and was promoted to CFO in November 2025. He has worked on financial restructuring, trade finance, treasury and internal controls.

companies.changes: CFO Divyesh Maru resigned on 13 Nov 2025; Ashish Desai replaced him. Non-executive director Ravin Gandhi resigned on 12 May 2026, and his alternate Nina Gandhi (Rajiv's wife) left the board with him. An Aug 2026 postal ballot moves Ravin and Bela Gandhi from promoter to public.

companies.styleNote: A Zota family business. Founder Ketankumar Zota is non-executive chairman, yet is paid a commission of 0.30% of turnover. His son Moxesh Zota is MD, and three other Zota promoter-group members (Himanshu, Kamlesh and Viren) are whole-time directors; the filings do not state how they are related to the founder. The Zota family and associates own 49.4% (June 2026). A hired Group CEO, Dr. Sujit Paul, runs the Davaindia pharmacy chain.

people.name: Moxesh Ketanbhai Zota
people.since: With the company since 2014; MD since Oct 2016; re-appointment from Oct 2026 to Oct 2031 proposed
people.relation: Son of founder and Chairman Ketankumar Zota
people.stake: 1.43% (June 2026); his father holds about 11.6% across two holdings; promoter group together 49.38%
people.bio: He holds a B.Pharm from Gujarat Technological University and a master's in international marketing and business management from BPP University, UK. He joined in 2014 and runs overall management, exports, new projects and foreign product registrations. He has taken the company into more than 30 countries, with 325 products registered abroad and 261 more in process. His pay is ₹60 lakh a year plus a commission of 0.20% of consolidated turnover, which proxy adviser IiAS objected to ahead of the September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Himanshu Muktilal Zota
people.relation: Promoter group (Zota family; exact relation to the founder not stated)
people.bio: He holds a diploma in pharmacy from the Maharashtra Board of Technical Examinations and a BCA from Aptech, Surat. He has over 30 years with the company, covering strategy, tax, finance and IT. The company credits him as one of the main people behind creating and building the Davaindia pharmacy chain, and he leads project planning and execution.

people.name: Kamlesh Rajnikant Zota
people.relation: Promoter group (Zota family; exact relation to the founder not stated)
people.bio: He holds a B.Pharm from Gujarat University and has over 28 years in pharmaceutical operations. He began as a senior technical assistant at Torrent Pharma and was a production officer at Unique Pharmaceutical Laboratories before joining Zota at its start. He runs factory operations, regulatory approvals and WHO certifications, export clearances and documentation, and patents and trademarks.

people.name: Viren Manukant Zota
people.relation: Promoter group (Zota family; exact relation to the founder not stated)
people.bio: He is a business administration graduate from B.R.C.M. College. He started in franchise marketing across India and now handles buying products from outside manufacturers, managing thousands of SKUs and streamlining procurement. The company says his focus on quality, pricing and inventory has supported growth over the past five years.

people.name: Laxmi Kant Sharma
people.bio: He holds a B.Sc. in biology from Rajasthan University, Jaipur, and a diploma in pharmacy from the Maharashtra Board of Technical Examinations. Over 21 years he has worked as a medical representative, area sales manager and retail pharmacist. He joined Zota in 2018 and oversees operations at Davaindia stores.

people.name: Dr. Sujit Paul
people.since: Group CEO through FY26 (start date not disclosed)
people.bio: He holds a B.Sc. (Hons) from Calcutta University, an MBA from IMT Ghaziabad, a quality management certificate from the Philip Crosby institute and a doctorate in management from ISBM. He has over 24 years in retail pharmacy, hospitals and wellness. At Reliance Retail he built a nationwide pharmacy chain with over 5,000 staff, and at Apollo he helped launch 1,000 pharmacies. At Zota he leads the Davaindia retail pharmacy expansion.

people.name: Viral Mandviwala
people.since: CFO through FY26 (start date not disclosed)
people.bio: He is the company's CFO and a key managerial person, and signs the financial statements. The annual report gives no details of his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: At the 28 Sep 2026 AGM, shareholders voted on Moxesh Zota's re-appointment and on pay and related-party resolutions for promoter directors, which IiAS opposed; results were not yet filed. Ashvin Variya was made Group Company Secretary in May 2026. Independent director Varshaben Mehta's term ended on 9 Sep 2026, and Mahaveer Dhariwal joined as an independent director on 3 Sep 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Rabindra Prasad Sinha is Chairman and a whole-time director, and his son Amit Raj Sinha is MD and CEO. Co-promoter S. Chidambaranathan is Executive Vice Chairman. Promoters own only 36.7% (June 2026), including 15.0% through RPS Industries, and about 28% of promoter shares are pledged. Swati Sinha, a promoter-group shareholder, is VP for ESG.

people.name: Amit Raj Sinha
people.relation: Son of Chairman Rabindra Prasad Sinha
people.stake: 3.66% directly plus 0.78% through his family trust (June 2026); promoter group together 36.69%
people.bio: He holds a B.Tech and an MBA from the Indian School of Business, and is a Fellow of the Institution of Engineers. Before joining industry he served in the Indian Navy, managing critical defence installations. He has over 20 years in pharmaceuticals and fine chemicals and has pushed Sigachi's R&D and its move into drug ingredients and services. He was arrested after the fatal 30 June 2025 explosion at the Pashamylaram plant and was granted bail by the Telangana High Court in February 2026; the case is still under investigation.

people.name: Rabindra Prasad Sinha
people.relation: Founder; father of MD Amit Raj Sinha
people.stake: 3.99% directly (June 2026); RPS Industries holds another 15.02% and the RPS Family Trust 1.21%
people.bio: He holds a postgraduate degree in chemical engineering from Banaras Hindu University and has more than 40 years in cellulose and fine chemicals. He built Sigachi into a global maker of cellulose-based excipients and set up its wholly owned US subsidiary. He has personally guaranteed the company's bank loans along with other promoters.

people.name: S. Chidambaranathan
people.since: Co-promoter; retires by rotation and seeks re-appointment at the Sep 2026 AGM
people.relation: Co-promoter; not related to the Sinhas (per annual report)
people.stake: 5.08% (June 2026); his family members hold about 1.8% more
people.bio: He holds a postgraduate diploma in business administration from Annamalai University. The company says he has worked for over five decades in chemicals and cellulose derivatives. He led the domestic operations and set up the Gujarat manufacturing plants. He has also personally guaranteed the company's loans.

people.name: O. Subbarami Reddy
people.since: CFO through FY26 (start date not disclosed)
people.bio: He is CFO and a key managerial person and wrote the CFO's letter in the FY26 annual report, which promises tight capital allocation and a recovery in margins. The annual report gives no details of his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: No KMP changes were filed after the annual report. On 15 Sep 2026 shareholders rejected a ₹290cr warrant issue, reportedly with 99.4% of votes against. The internal auditor was changed in Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: Started in the early 1990s by a small group of first-generation founders, three of whom still run it as executive directors. After founder-MD Anil Jain died in an accident in February 2022, co-founder Bharat Kumar Vageria became MD. The chairman, Sanjaya Kulkarni (on the board since 1993), is non-executive. The annual report says no director is related to another. Promoters own 47.56%, much of it through Time Securities Services Pvt Ltd.

people.name: Bharat Kumar Vageria
people.since: Co-founder; whole-time director and CFO since inception; MD since February 2022
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to other directors
people.stake: 1.85% (91,29,500 shares, March 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 47.56%
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 35 years in financial management, costing and corporate governance. He is one of the founding promoters and served as whole-time director and CFO from the company's start. After the death of founder-MD Anil Jain in February 2022, the board made him Managing Director; he still holds the CFO role too. The company credits him with its banking and regulatory relationships. Investors should note that the top executive also signs off the accounts as CFO.

people.name: Raghupathy Thyagarajan
people.since: Co-founder; on the board since March 1990; re-appointed to November 2030
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to other directors
people.stake: 1.84% (90,77,500 shares, March 2026); 86,77,500 shares after moving 4 lakh shares to the promoter company Time Securities Services in June 2026
people.bio: A science graduate with a postgraduate qualification in business management, raised in Mumbai. Before co-founding the company he was Manager – Marketing at Prestige HM-Polycontainers Ltd. He has run business development and customer relationships since inception and built the marketing organisation across India and overseas. He has over 35 years of industrial experience.

people.name: Naveen Kumar Jain
people.since: Co-founder; on the board since December 1989; re-appointed to November 2030
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to other directors
people.stake: 1.82% (89,97,500 shares, March 2026); 87,97,500 shares after moving 2 lakh shares to Time Securities Services in June 2026
people.bio: An electrical engineer from IIT Delhi and a polymer-processing specialist. Before co-founding the company he was production and technical head at Prestige HM-Polycontainers Ltd. He set up the company's manufacturing plants across regions and heads the R&D team for new products and processes.

people.name: Sanjeev Sharma
people.since: Joined about 26 years ago; board since November 2022; re-appointed to November 2028
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in electrical engineering (1994) and an MBA from IIM Indore (2000). A career insider of about 26 years, he is President – International Operations, overseeing the North-East India region and the company's businesses in about 10 countries. He joined the board as a whole-time director in November 2022.

companies.changes: No executive change since the annual report. Two new independent directors joined on 5 August 2026, and independent directors Praveen Kumar Agarwal and Triveni Makhijani left on 27 September 2026. Company Secretary Manoj Kumar Mewara (Sr. VP Finance) continues.

companies.styleNote: A Garware family company. Founder Dr. Shashikant B. Garware (born 1934) is Chairman & MD, and his daughter Monika Garware is Vice Chairperson & Joint MD. His daughter Sarita Garware Ramsay, also a Joint MD, died on 9 July 2026. A third daughter, Sonia Garware, is a non-executive director. Promoters own about 61%, mostly through the S. B. Garware Family Trust (38.17%). Succession rests on the next generation, and the CFO seat is filled only on an interim basis.

people.name: Dr. Shashikant B. Garware
people.since: Founder; started the company's polyester film business in June 1957
people.relation: Founder; father of Monika Garware, the late Sarita Garware Ramsay and Sonia Garware
people.stake: 5.01% (11,63,001 shares, March 2026); promoter group together about 61%, including the S. B. Garware Family Trust's 38.17%
people.bio: Born in 1934 in Mumbai, the son of industrialist Abasaheb Garware. He studied at Dulwich College in London and did a senior business management course at the University of Edinburgh. He is credited with starting polyester film making in India in 1957 and has led the company since. In 2022 Mumbai University awarded him an honorary D.Litt. He is also a director of other Garware family companies and has been president of the Maharashtra Chamber of Commerce & Industry. He was re-appointed Chairman & MD in 2023; investors should note his age and the dependence on family succession.

people.name: Monika Garware
people.since: Long-serving executive director; current term to October 2026, re-appointed to October 2031
people.relation: Daughter of the Chairman; sister of Sonia Garware and the late Sarita Garware Ramsay
people.stake: 1.15% (2,67,504 shares, March 2026); plus the Monika Garware Benefit Trust's 2.47%
people.bio: A graduate of Vassar College in the USA, she then took an MBA from the Lubin School of Business, Pace University, New York. She is Vice Chairperson and Joint MD, second only to her father in the executive team. The board re-appointed her for five years from 1 November 2026 to October 2031, subject to shareholder approval. Her FY26 pay was about ₹14 crore.

people.name: Uday V. Joshi
people.since: Board since 1 February 2026 (three-year term to January 2029)
people.bio: Holds a B.E. in production engineering from VJTI Mumbai and a postgraduate diploma in finance and management from IGNOU. He has about 35 years of experience in BOPET film manufacturing: projects, process, quality control, technical services and resource management. He replaced Mohan S. Adsul, the technical whole-time director, who stepped down on 31 January 2026. Shareholders approved his appointment with 99.86% of votes in March 2026.

people.name: Prashant L. Pai
people.bio: Holds a master's degree and has about three decades of experience in accounting and finance, all with the company and other Garware group companies since the start of his career. He has handled the closing of accounts, statutory compliance, audits, cash-flow management and budgeting, and has worked on the SAP ERP system. He will serve until the board appoints a permanent CFO.

companies.changes: Joint MD Sarita Garware Ramsay died on 9 July 2026. CFO Abhishek Agarwal resigned in May 2026 (left 30 May); Prashant L. Pai is interim CFO from 6 August 2026. Whole-time director Mohan S. Adsul left on 31 January 2026 and Uday V. Joshi replaced him. President – Corporate HR Yogesh Chavan resigned in April 2026; Nikhil Sharma joined as Chief People Officer. Company Secretary Awaneesh Srivastava continues.

companies.styleNote: A Sanghvi family company. Founder Mahendra (Mike) Sanghvi is Executive Chairman; his wife Tilottama is a whole-time director, his brother Laxman is an executive director, and their son Amit has been MD since 2015. Four family members hold all the executive board seats. Promoters owned 43.40% in March 2026 and 41.09% by June 2026. Hired professionals run finance (CFO Paresh Jain), strategy (Sanjay Shah) and the healthcare pen business (COO Joe Kam).

people.name: Amit Mahendra Sanghvi
people.since: MD since 16 May 2015; re-appointment proposed to September 2031
people.relation: Son of Executive Chairman Mahendra Sanghvi and Whole-time Director Tilottama Sanghvi; nephew of Laxman Sanghvi
people.bio: Aged 43, he holds an electrical engineering degree from the University of Ottawa and an M.Sc. in supply chain and manufacturing from Penn State University, USA. He began as a business process consultant with Arete Inc. in the USA, working for clients such as Pepsi and Coca-Cola, and later worked at PAS Romania, Pepsi Bottling Group in New York and Coca-Cola Bottling in Indonesia. He joined Shaily as General Manager – Projects, became a whole-time director and has been MD since May 2015. He is also a director of the UK and Dubai subsidiaries. The board has proposed re-appointing him for five years from October 2026.

people.name: Mahendra (Mike) Bhogilal Sanghvi
people.since: Founder; involved in operations since inception
people.relation: Founder; brother of Laxman Sanghvi, husband of Tilottama Sanghvi, father of MD Amit Sanghvi
people.bio: A chemical engineer from Wayne State University, USA, and a plastics technologist, he also holds an MBA diploma from the University of Toronto. He has been involved in running the company since it began and has guided its strategy and export growth. He is an executive member of the Organisation of Plastics Processors of India, and has served on the boards of Integra Engineering India, Munjal Auto Industries, PLEXCONCIL and PlastIndia.

people.name: Laxman Bhogilal Sanghvi
people.relation: Brother of Executive Chairman Mahendra Sanghvi; uncle of MD Amit Sanghvi
people.bio: A chartered accountant and law graduate. He has overseen projects, procurement, stores, budget control and administration at the company. He played a key part in setting up the carbon-steel facility and is closely involved in building the plastics plant at Halol, Gujarat. He has been president of the Panchmahals Industries Association.

people.name: Tilottama Mahendra Sanghvi
people.since: Involved since inception; re-appointed for February 2026 to January 2029
people.relation: Wife of Executive Chairman Mahendra Sanghvi; mother of MD Amit Sanghvi
people.stake: 14.01% (64,38,575 shares, March 2026), the largest individual holding
people.bio: A science graduate who has been involved in the company's operations since it began. She has managed its export-oriented unit (EOU) plants and the Rania plant, and oversees administration and stores across facilities. She also contributes to project budgeting, planning and execution.

people.name: Paresh Jain
people.bio: A chartered accountant (ICAI) with a postgraduate degree in commerce and about 19 years of experience when he joined in 2024. He has worked across treasury, tax, accounting, MIS, budgeting and costing, insurance, secretarial, export-import and ERP implementation. Before Shaily he held finance roles at Banco Aluminium, Safari Industries, the Indian Oil Tanking group, Atul Ltd and the GTPL group.

people.name: Chi Hung (Joe) Kam
people.since: Joined 1 March 2026; key managerial personnel from May 2026
people.bio: A veteran of about two decades at SHL Medical and Flextronics, where he managed nine manufacturing sites across Taiwan and the US. He was hired to scale up Shaily's healthcare business, mainly GLP-1 and insulin pen injectors, which is now about half of revenue and the main growth driver. The board named him a key managerial person in May 2026.

people.name: Sanjay Shah
people.since: Chief Strategy Officer since 24 May 2024 (earlier the CFO)
people.bio: He was the company's CFO until May 2024, when the board moved him to the new role of Chief Strategy Officer and brought in Paresh Jain as CFO. He is listed among the company's key officials and senior management in the FY26 annual report. The company does not publish further details of his background.

companies.changes: No executive exits since the annual report. Joe Kam joined as COO – Healthcare in March 2026 and became KMP in May 2026. On 8 August 2026 the board proposed re-appointing Amit Sanghvi as MD for five years from 1 October 2026. Company Secretary Harish Punwani continues.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Chhabria family's Finolex group. Prakash P. Chhabria, son of founder Pralhad P. Chhabria, is Executive Chairman and sets strategy; his wife Ritu is a non-executive director. Day-to-day running is with a hired MD, Udipt Agarwal, since November 2025. Promoters own about 52%, mainly through Finolex Cables (32.39%) and Orbit Electricals (18.80%). The top job has changed hands twice in two years.

people.name: Prakash P. Chhabria
people.relation: Promoter; son of founder Pralhad P. Chhabria; husband of director Ritu Prakash Chhabria
people.stake: 0.14% in his own name (8,53,745 shares, March 2026); promoter group about 52%, including Orbit Electricals (18.80%), where he is a director, and Finolex Cables (32.39%)
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in international business from the University of Evansville, Indiana, and attended an Advanced Management Programme at Wharton and an executive programme at Stanford. He joined the board in 1992 and became Executive Chairman in 2012. The company credits him with restructuring the business and its finances and building the Finolex pipes brand. He received an honorary D.Litt. from Tilak Maharashtra Vidyapeeth in 2021-22. He is also a director of Orbit Electricals, Pawas Port and other family companies.

people.name: Udipt Agarwal
people.since: Whole-time director from 5 September 2025; MD from 1 November 2025 (term to September 2030)
people.bio: Aged 56, he holds a B.Tech in chemical technology from HBTI Kanpur and did executive education in strategic business leadership at INSEAD. He was Chief Commercial Officer at Alkyl Amines Chemicals, running strategy, P&L, procurement, supply chain, marketing and M&A. Before that he set up Cargill Bio Industrial's India business and later led its Asia region across 10 countries, and earlier held leadership roles at BASF in India and Hong Kong. He has over 30 years of experience in chemicals and specialty materials. He replaced Saurabh Dhanorkar, who resigned as MD in October 2025.

people.name: Rambabu Sanka
people.since: President-Technical from March 2025; Director – Technical from 2 August 2025 (term to August 2030)
people.bio: Aged 63, he holds an M.Tech in chemical engineering from IIT Bombay, a B.Tech in chemical engineering from Andhra University and a postgraduate certificate in senior management from the Open University, UK. He has 39 years in chemical manufacturing, 31 of them in VCM/PVC production. He was a Vice President at Reliance Industries, ran VCM and PVC operations on INEOS technology, and was Executive Vice President – Technical Services at TCI Sanmar Chemicals in Egypt. He joined in March 2025 as President-Technical and oversees plant operations.

people.name: Chandan Verma
people.since: Joined as Deputy CFO in 2024; interim CFO from 30 September 2024; CFO in FY26 annual report
people.bio: A chartered accountant with about 18 years of experience when he joined in 2024. He previously worked at Deloitte, KPMG and PCBL Ltd. He joined as Deputy CFO, stepped up as interim CFO in September 2024 and is named CFO and key managerial person as of March 2026.

companies.changes: No executive change since the annual report. During FY26 MD Saurabh Dhanorkar resigned (effective 25 October 2025) and Director-Technical Saumya Chakrabarti left (31 August 2025); Udipt Agarwal and Rambabu Sanka replaced them. Company Secretary & Head Legal Dakshinamurthy Iyer continues.

companies.styleNote: A Chheda family company across three generations. Founder Jayant Chheda is Chairman & MD; his sons Parag (Joint MD) and Vipul (Executive Director) are the other two executive directors, and all three were re-appointed in September 2026 for three years to August 2029. Parag's wife Heena heads HR and his son Nihar is VP – Strategy. Promoters own 60.95%. The CFO is the only non-family executive named as key managerial personnel.

people.name: Jayant S. Chheda
people.since: Founder; with the company since incorporation in 1987; re-appointed to August 2029
people.relation: Founder; father of Parag and Vipul Chheda; grandfather of Nihar Chheda
people.bio: The founder, with over five decades in the plastics industry. He has been with the company since it was incorporated and has led its setting-up, growth and strategy as Chairman and MD. He received a Lifetime Achievement Award at the Vinyl India Conference in 2014. Shareholders re-appointed him in September 2026 for three more years, to August 2029.

people.name: Parag J. Chheda
people.since: Director since 27 April 1996; re-appointed to August 2029
people.relation: Son of the Chairman; brother of Vipul Chheda; husband of Heena Chheda; father of Nihar Chheda
people.stake: 11.27% (1,24,56,182 shares, March 2026), the largest among the directors
people.bio: Holds an associate degree in business administration from Oakland Community College, USA. He has been a director since 1996 and has over 32 years of experience in the industry. He was named 'Inspiring Business Leader' in the business and industry category at the Economic Times Summit in 2016. He is a member of the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Vipul J. Chheda
people.since: Director since 11 March 1997; re-appointed to August 2029
people.relation: Son of the Chairman; brother of Parag Chheda
people.bio: Holds a higher secondary certificate from the Maharashtra State Board. He has been a director since 1997 and has over 29 years of experience in the piping industry, with expertise in project sales, marketing, key account management and business development.

people.name: Anand Gupta
people.bio: A chartered accountant. He spent about 14 years at ACC Ltd (2006–2020), leaving as DGM – Finance, before joining Prince Pipes, where he was Deputy CFO before becoming CFO in November 2023. He signs the CEO/CFO certificate with the Chairman and sits on the risk management committee.

people.name: Heena P. Chheda
people.relation: Wife of Joint MD Parag Chheda; daughter-in-law of the Chairman; mother of Nihar Chheda
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from the University of Bombay and has over 15 years of experience in the piping industry. She joined in 2009 and was a director on the board from October 2016 to November 2019. She leads human resources, organisation development and talent management. Her pay, about ₹12.5 lakh a month from October 2026, needs shareholder approval as a related-party role.

people.name: Nihar P. Chheda
people.relation: Son of Joint MD Parag Chheda; grandson of the Chairman (third generation)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in industrial engineering from Purdue University, USA. He joined in 2019 and works on strategy, expanding the distribution network, business development, and raw-material and technology sourcing through global partners. The company describes him as a third-generation entrepreneur. His pay, about ₹12.5 lakh a month from October 2026, needs shareholder approval as a related-party role.

companies.changes: Chief Human Resource Officer Ajay Kumar resigned for personal reasons, effective 20 August 2026. Company Secretary Shailesh Bhaskar left in February 2026; Jyoti Sancheti took over on 19 May 2026. Shareholders re-appointed all three family executive directors on 16 September 2026.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Gupta family's APL Apollo group. Promoter Sameer Gupta is Managing Director (he was Chairman & MD until May 2026). His brother Sanjay Gupta, the APL Apollo Tubes chairman, returned as non-executive Chairman on 8 May 2026. Operations are shared with Joint MD Arun Agarwal, a long-time APL Apollo executive. Promoters own 51.72%; a promoter-group company bought another 4.88% during FY26.

people.name: Sameer Gupta
people.since: Promoter; joined the family business early and set up the PVC pipes division
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Chairman Sanjay Gupta
people.stake: 22.30% (98,22,762 shares, March 2026); his wife Meenakshi Gupta holds 23.40% and son Dhruv 1.14%; promoter group together 51.72%
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University. He joined the family business at an early stage and played a key role in setting up the PVC pipes division, which he has led since. He was Chairman & MD through FY26; when his brother Sanjay Gupta became Chairman in May 2026, he continued as MD. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is proposed for re-appointment. His son Dhruv Gupta also works in the company.

people.name: Arun Agarwal
people.since: Joint MD since 1 April 2023; re-appointed for three years from 1 April 2026
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 25 years of experience running business operations. Before joining Apollo Pipes he spent 14 years at APL Apollo Tubes, where he was last Chief Operating Officer, running 11 plants and handling maintenance, power management and quality. As Joint MD he has led new projects, expansion into new business lines and a wider geographic presence.

people.name: Ajay Kumar Jain
people.since: Joined 1 April 2011 (per the senior management table)
people.bio: A chartered accountant with 27 years of experience in listed and unlisted companies. He covers accounts, finance, tax, treasury and commercial matters, as well as financial planning, MIS, budgeting, audit and risk management. He co-signs the CEO/CFO compliance certificate with the MD.

companies.changes: COO Parag Dadeech, hired on 2 March 2026, resigned on 20 May 2026 after less than three months. Sanjay Gupta joined the board as non-executive Chairman on 8 May 2026; non-executive director Ashok Kumar Gupta resigned the same day. Company Secretary Gourab Kumar Nayak continues.

companies.styleNote: There is no promoter group; foreign investors own most of the shares. But it is founder-led: Vinay Sanghi, who started it in 2009, is Chairman and MD and owns about 2.6%. His son Varun Sanghi is Group Chief Strategy Officer and non-executive chairman of OLX India. The annual report says the board members are not related to each other (Varun is not a director). The other executive director is the CFO.

people.name: Vinay Vinod Sanghi
people.since: 2009 (founder; CEO from 1 Sep 2009); MD re-appointed to 31 Mar 2031
people.relation: Founder; father of Varun Sanghi
people.stake: 2.63% (June 2026 shareholding pattern), plus 20 lakh outstanding ESOPs
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from the University of Bombay. Before CarTrade he was CEO of Mahindra First Choice Wheels, the Mahindra group's used-car business, and earlier worked at Project Automobiles (Bombay); he has over 35 years in the car trade. He founded CarTrade in 2009 and built it from one website into a group that owns CarWale, BikeWale, OLX India and Shriram Automall. He is chairman of the group's Sobek Auto subsidiary and an independent director of HDFC ERGO General Insurance. He was re-appointed MD for five years from April 2026, with pay of about ₹7.2cr a year under his earlier term.

people.name: Aneesha Bhandary
people.bio: A chartered accountant (ICAI) who also completed IIM Calcutta's CFO programme. She spent nine years as a statutory auditor with S.R. Batliboi & Co. (Ernst & Young) before joining CarWale in 2015. She led the finance work for the 2021 IPO and now runs reporting, risk and investor relations. CII named her 'Young CFO of the Year'. She is also a director of Shriram Automall and other group companies. FY26 pay was ₹1.55cr.

people.name: Varun Sanghi
people.role: Group Chief Strategy Officer (senior management); non-executive Chairman of OLX India
people.since: Full-time since May 2017; CSO from 1 Nov 2025
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD
people.bio: Studied finance at H.R. College of Commerce and Economics, Mumbai. He worked at CarTrade as a trainee while at college and joined full time in May 2017 as a product manager, launching its car-loan product. He then ran CarTrade Ventures, the group's investment arm, and led the 2023 purchase of OLX India and its integration. He was made Chief Strategy Officer in November 2025 and non-executive chairman of OLX India in April 2026. He featured in Forbes India's '30 Under 30' (2024).

people.name: Sameer Malhotra
people.role: Whole-time Director & CEO, Shriram Automall India (subsidiary)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from the University of Delhi and a postgraduate diploma in financial management. He has about 36 years in sales, with earlier roles at Ritchie Bros. Auctioneers, Ansal Housing and SREI Infrastructure Finance. A founding member of Shriram Automall, he has run it since 2010 and built it into India's largest vehicle-auction platform. He was re-appointed whole-time director and CEO of the subsidiary from April 2026.

people.name: Akshay Shankar
people.bio: Holds a master's degree in science from the University of Twente, the Netherlands. He worked at ABN AMRO and Nassau IT Services before joining CarTrade's founding team in 2009 as a product manager. He has led product and design across the group's websites and apps for 17 years and became Chief Product Officer in October 2020.

companies.changes: Banwari Lal Sharma, CEO of the Consumer Business (CarWale and BikeWale), resigned on 25 Aug 2026; the business now runs under Vinay Sanghi's direct guidance.

companies.styleNote: Run by its three co-founders, who are the named promoters and hold all three executive board seats: Rajesh Yabaji (Chairman, MD & CEO), Chanakya Hridaya (COO) and Ramasubramanian Balasubramaniam (new initiatives). They are business partners, not relatives. The promoter group owns 25.0% (June 2026). Rajesh and Chanakya are both IIT Kharagpur graduates who worked at ITC before starting the company in 2015. Accel, which has a nominee director, owns 7.2% and has been selling.

people.name: Rajesh Kumar Naidu Yabaji
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other founders
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in metallurgical and materials engineering and an MBA, both from IIT Kharagpur. Before BlackBuck he was a manager at ITC, running the technical side of its foods division. He co-founded the company in April 2015 as a freight marketplace and turned it into a payments, telematics, loads and lending app for small truck owners. He led it through its November 2024 IPO. The company was named CNBC-TV18 'Startup of the Year' in 2018.

people.name: Chanakya Hridaya
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other founders
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering and an M.Tech in manufacturing science and engineering from IIT Kharagpur. He worked in ITC's supply-chain division before co-founding BlackBuck. As COO he runs day-to-day operations, including the field sales network of over 10,000 touchpoints. He featured in Forbes India's '30 Under 30' in 2017.

people.name: Ramasubramanian Balasubramaniam
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other founders
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate diploma in business management from the Institute of Integrated Learning in Management. He has about 27 years of work experience (as of the 2024 IPO), mostly in supply chains, and is also associated with the logistics consultancy Miebach Consulting India. He co-founded BlackBuck and now leads its new businesses.

people.name: Satyakam G N
people.since: Joined 2018 as business finance manager; now CFO (KMP)
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a bachelor's degree in commerce from Bangalore University. He worked at NTT Data Services and Tesco before joining BlackBuck in 2018 as a business finance manager. He rose to CFO and runs accounting, planning, treasury, legal and investor relations. He holds 75,000 options under the 2016 ESOP plan.

people.name: Thejasvi Bhat
people.bio: Has about 20 years in software engineering. Before joining BlackBuck in 2020 he led engineering and growth teams at Swiggy. He runs the company's technology platform and holds 1,00,000 options under the 2016 ESOP plan.

people.name: Supil Chachan
people.bio: An IIM Bangalore graduate who joined BlackBuck in 2018. He runs the freight marketplace (Superloads), which matches truck owners with loads.

companies.changes: Company Secretary and Head of Legal Barun Pandey resigned with effect from 31 July 2026. Chief Product Officer Manish Singh left on 31 March 2026, and Chief People Officer Shilpi Pandey on 20 January 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Murugavel Janakiraman is Chairman and Managing Director and the only executive director; he alone owns about 58%. His wife Deepa Murugavel sits on the board as a non-executive director; the annual report says they are the only related directors. The rest of the senior team are hired managers, several of them long-serving. The CFO seat is empty again after the second CFO in 18 months left in August 2026.

people.name: Murugavel Janakiraman
people.since: Founder (company incorporated 2001); MD re-appointed to 31 Mar 2029
people.relation: Founder; husband of director Deepa Murugavel
people.stake: 58.33% (June 2026 shareholding pattern; 58.26% in the FY26 annual report); promoter group together 58.43%
people.bio: Holds a degree in statistics from Presidency College and an MCA from the University of Madras. He worked as a software engineer and consultant in the US (his last job was senior programmer at Real Soft Inc) before founding Tamil Matrimony, which grew into BharatMatrimony and Matrimony.com. He has been Chairman of IAMAI and of CII's Chennai zone, is Vice Chairman of the CII Tamil Nadu State Council and chairs The Indus Entrepreneurs (TiE). India Today named him Business Icon of the Year. FY26 pay was ₹3.42cr.

people.name: Saichitra S
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in computer science and an MCA from Bharathidasan University. She has over 22 years in product development and technology, all of it at Matrimony.com, where she has worked since its start. She runs product across the matchmaking sites and apps. FY26 pay was ₹1.24cr.

people.name: Arjun Bhatia
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in engineering from Delhi College of Engineering and an MBA from the Faculty of Management Studies, Delhi University. He has over 22 years in marketing and was head of marketing and e-commerce at Samsung India's consumer electronics business before joining in January 2021. He leads brand and performance marketing. FY26 pay was ₹1.15cr.

people.name: Venu Muraleedharan Menon
people.bio: Holds a master's in English from St Stephen's College, Delhi University, and a postgraduate qualification in HR from the Madras School of Social Work. He has over 29 years as an HR leader in healthcare, retail, manufacturing and telecom, most recently as Vice President and Head of HR Operations at Fortis Healthcare. He joined in June 2024.

people.name: Chandrasekar R
people.role: Chief Technology, Operations and Infrastructure Officer
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in science and an MCA from Bharathidasan University, with over 30 years in technology. He worked at Sify Technologies before joining in December 2006. He runs technology, operations and infrastructure.

companies.changes: CFO Harigovind Krishnasamy (joined July 2025) resigned and left on 17 Aug 2026 to relocate to Bengaluru; no successor has been named. His predecessor had quit in February 2025, and the five-month gap before his hiring broke SEBI's three-month rule. Vaitheeswaran S, VP of Personalised Services, resigned on 31 Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Three engineer co-founders from Pune own 23.03% each (69.1% together) and hold all three executive board seats; they are not related to each other. Each runs a part of the business, and the annual report says they meet every Tuesday to review operations and take key decisions. There is no hired CEO; one founder doubles as CFO. The rest of the board is three independent directors.

people.name: Atul Maruti Dumbre
people.since: Co-founder; director since incorporation (26 Sep 2017); Chairman & MD since 11 Jan 2023, re-appointed to 10 Jan 2031
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other founders
people.bio: Holds an M.Tech in energy studies from the School of Energy Studies, University of Pune (2014). At the time of the 2023 IPO he had about 12 years of work experience, ten of them in the electronic-components trade. He handles supply-chain management, customer relations and digital marketing for Robu.in. He holds no other directorships.

people.name: Binod Prasad
people.since: Co-founder; director since 26 Sep 2017; whole-time director since 11 Jan 2023, re-appointed to 10 Jan 2031
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other founders
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Pune (2010). He had about 12 years of work experience at the 2023 IPO, ten of them in the electronic-components trade. As CFO he runs accounts and finance, compliance and the warehouse operations.

people.name: Nileshkumar Purushottam Chavhan
people.since: Co-founder; director since 26 Sep 2017; whole-time director since 11 Jan 2023, re-appointed to 10 Jan 2031
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other founders
people.bio: Holds a master's degree in mechanical engineering from the Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore (2012). He has about 12 years of experience in electronics, robotics, thermals and fluids, software and electronics development, and sales. He runs business development, sales and marketing, HR and administration. He retires by rotation and is up for re-appointment at the FY26 AGM.

companies.changes: No director or key-manager changes found since the annual report (August 2026). Main-board corporate-governance rules apply to Macfos from FY27 because it has crossed the size thresholds.

companies.styleNote: Run by its two co-founders, Gaurav Bhatnagar and Ankush Nijhawan, as Joint Managing Directors. They are not related to each other; the annual report says no directors are related. The promoter group owns 44.4%: Gaurav 17.3% and the Nijhawan family's LAP Travel 21.6% are the largest pieces. Ankush's brother Arjun Nijhawan and co-founder Manish Dhingra (4.9%) are promoters but hold no board or executive role. The chairman is independent, and General Atlantic (14.4%) has a nominee director.

people.name: Gaurav Bhatnagar
people.since: Board since 6 Nov 2006 (with the company since inception)
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the Nijhawans
people.stake: 17.33% (June 2026 shareholding pattern; 1,88,18,014 shares in the FY26 annual report); promoter group together 44.41%
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in computer science and engineering from IIT Delhi and worked at Microsoft before starting out on his own. He co-founded Tekriti Software and then TBO, and has been on its board since 2006. He sits on the executive committee of the World Travel & Tourism Council (WTTC). He is named, with the company and Ankush Nijhawan, in the pending FEMA case.

people.name: Ankush Nijhawan
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; brother of promoter Arjun Nijhawan
people.stake: 0.60% directly (6,51,503 shares); he owns 40% and his brother Arjun 50% of LAP Travel, which holds 21.60% (June 2026)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in business administration (marketing, with a minor in psychology) from Bryant University, US. He co-founded TBO and has been on its board since 2007. He has been chairperson of FICCI's Outbound Tourism Committee and is a member of the Young Presidents' Organization. He was named among the '40 Most Influential Indians under 40' (URS Asia One, 2016-17). He is named, with the company, in the pending FEMA case.

people.name: Akshat Verma
people.since: CTO since 7 Feb 2023; now also a whole-time director
people.stake: 15,389 shares, about 0.01% (FY26 annual report), plus ESOPs
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in computer science and engineering from IIT Kharagpur and a master's in computer science from IIT Delhi. He worked at IBM India, MakeMyTrip, Bharti Airtel and the ed-tech company SplashLearn before joining TBO as CTO in February 2023. He has built consumer apps and systems in data science, cloud computing and distributed systems, and now runs TBO's technology.

people.name: Vikas Jain
people.since: With TBO since May 2012 (seconded from Ibibo; transferred January 2017)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from Shri Ram College of Commerce and is a rank-holding chartered accountant. He worked at S.R. Batliboi, American Express India, Bharti-Walmart and Ibibo Web, from which he was seconded to TBO in 2012 when both were in the same group. He has been CFO through the 2024 IPO and the October 2025 purchase of Classic Vacations.

people.name: Aarish Khan
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in business administration (finance) from the Eastern Institute for Integrated Learning in Management, Sikkim. He worked at Times Internet and Delhi Express Travels before joining TBO in January 2007, in its first year. He leads sales to Indian travel agents.

people.name: Gerardo Del Rio
people.since: Named in the FY26 leadership team
people.bio: Heads TBO's international business, based in Dubai. The annual report lists him in the leadership team but does not give his background.

people.name: Melissa Krueger
people.bio: Was appointed CEO of Classic Vacations, the US luxury-travel wholesaler TBO bought in October 2025, to lead its next phase of growth and its move onto TBO's platform. The annual report does not give her earlier background.

companies.changes: Deepak Khanna, Chief Operating Officer (with TBO since 2007), resigned on 30 Apr 2026. Chief HR Officer Ankush Arora left on 28 Feb 2026 and was replaced by a new Global CHRO, Aditi Madhok-Naarden; President–Strategy Anil Berera retired on 30 Sep 2025. Peter Palli joined as Chief Supply Officer. The four independent directors were re-appointed at the 27 Aug 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Swiggy has no promoter. The largest owner is Prosus (MIH India Food Holdings, 21.1%), which has two nominee directors; the chairman is independent. It is still founder-led: co-founder Sriharsha Majety is MD and Group CEO and owns about 5.6% with affiliates. The only other executive director, Nandan Reddy (Head of Innovation), resigned in April 2026, and the Instamart CEO changed in July 2026.

people.name: Sriharsha Majety
people.relation: Co-founder
people.stake: About 5.56% with his affiliates (14.54 crore shares, 30 June 2026, per the AGM notice); 4.57% in his own name in the June 2026 shareholding pattern
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical and electronics engineering from BITS Pilani and a postgraduate diploma in management from IIM Calcutta. He co-founded Swiggy and has led it since inception, taking it from food delivery into quick commerce (Instamart), dining-out and other services, and through the November 2024 IPO. The Economic Times named him Entrepreneur of the Year 2019. The July 2026 AGM notice proposes giving him the right to nominate one senior manager to the board.

people.name: Rahul Bothra
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a bachelor's degree in commerce from Bangalore University. He worked at Wipro, Britannia Industries and Olam International, in accounting, business finance, treasury, tax, M&A and assurance, in India and abroad. He joined Swiggy as CFO in 2017 and led finance through the IPO. In April 2026 the board approved him as an executive director from June 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

people.name: Phani Kishan Addepalli
people.stake: 32,75,983 shares, about 0.13% (30 June 2026, per the AGM notice)
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in computer science and engineering from IIT Madras and a postgraduate diploma in management from IIM Calcutta. He was a senior associate at Boston Consulting Group before joining Swiggy in March 2015; the company named him a co-founder in 2021. He drives user growth, engagement and monetisation. The board approved him as an executive director from June 2026, and the AGM notice proposes a right for him to nominate himself to the board while he holds at least 5 lakh shares.

people.name: Rohit Kapoor
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from the University of Calcutta and the postgraduate programme in management from the Indian School of Business, and has cleared CFA level 3. He was an engagement manager at McKinsey, chief growth officer at Max Healthcare, and global CMO at OYO before joining Swiggy in 2022. He runs food delivery, the group's profitable core.

people.name: Nandita Sinha
people.bio: An alumna of IIT (BHU) and FMS Delhi. She joined from Myntra, where she was CEO, and earlier held leadership roles at Flipkart, Britannia and Hindustan Unilever over more than two decades in fashion, e-commerce and FMCG. She took over Instamart in August 2026 after her predecessor resigned.

people.name: Madhusudhan Rao Subbarao
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in computer-science engineering from Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belgaum. He worked at Amazon and Boomerang Commerce before joining Swiggy in 2018 as vice president of engineering, and now runs technology.

people.name: Girish Menon
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Annamalai University, a law degree from Karnataka State Law University and a postgraduate diploma in business management from XIME Bangalore. He was an HR leader at Fullerton India, Vistaar Financial, HSBC, Indus Mobile Distribution and Flipkart before joining Swiggy in 2016 as vice president of HR.

companies.changes: Instamart CEO Amitesh Kumar Jha resigned on 28 Jul 2026; Nandita Sinha (ex-CEO of Myntra) took over from 3 Aug 2026. Lakshmi Nandan Reddy Obul resigned as Whole-time Director and Head of Innovation on 10 Apr 2026. Prosus nominee Roger Rabalais left the board and Renan Pinto (Group CFO of Despegar) replaced him from 11 Apr 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by its three co-founders, who started it in 2014 and were named promoters in April 2025: Abhiraj Singh Bhal (Chairperson, MD & CEO), Varun Khaitan (COO) and Raghav Chandra (Chief Technology and Product Officer). They are not related; the annual report says no directors are related. Each owns 6.34%, so the founders hold about 19% together, and venture investors such as Elevation, Prosus (Naspers), Accel and Steadview hold more. Half the board is independent.

people.name: Abhiraj Singh Bhal
people.since: Co-founder; with the company since 22 Dec 2014
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other founders
people.stake: 6.34% (9,77,62,500 shares, FY26 annual report); three founders together about 19.0%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from IIT Kanpur and a postgraduate diploma in management from IIM Ahmedabad. He worked at Boston Consulting Group before co-founding Urban Company (then UrbanClap) in 2014. He is responsible for strategy, growth, market expansion, operations and investor relations. NASSCOM named him Entrepreneur of the Year in 2020, and he received young-alumni awards from both IIT Kanpur and IIM Ahmedabad. He chairs CII's Unicorn Forum and sits on the National Startup Advisory Council.

people.name: Varun Khaitan
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other founders
people.bio: Co-founded the company in 2014 and, as COO, runs day-to-day operations. He also chairs the board's CSR committee. The annual report and investor presentation do not give his education or earlier jobs.

people.name: Raghav Chandra
people.role: Executive Director & Chief Technology and Product Officer
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other founders
people.bio: Co-founded the company in 2014 and leads its technology and product teams. The annual report and investor presentation do not give his education or earlier jobs.

people.name: Abhay Krishna Mathur
people.bio: Became CFO in February 2025 and led finance through the September 2025 IPO. He signs the company's compliance certificates with the CEO. The annual report does not give his earlier background.

people.name: Mukund Kulashekaran
people.bio: Runs the India Consumer Services business, the profitable core, which grew net transaction value 19% to ₹3,167cr in FY26 at an adjusted EBITDA of ₹131cr. The annual report does not give his earlier background.

companies.changes: Chief HR Officer Neha Mathur resigned on 10 Jul 2026 and leaves on 31 Aug 2026. Other senior managers named in the FY26 report: Kanav Arora (SVP Engineering), Richa Mohanty Rao (General Counsel), Rahul Teotia (SVP Marketing) and Nitesh Agarwal (SVP Middle East).

companies.styleNote: There is no promoter group. The largest owners are investors: Peak XV (16.7%), MacRitchie Investments (5.8%), PayPal (4.9%) and Mastercard (4.3%); Lokvir Kapoor, an early shareholder, holds 1.6% but has no executive role. The company is run by hired professionals led by Amrish Rau, CEO since 2020 and Chairman & MD since 2025. The annual report says no directors are related. The finance chair has turned over: a CFO hired in June 2025 left after under three months.

people.name: B. Amrish Rau
people.stake: 2.29% (June 2026 shareholding pattern; 5,19,58,927 shares and convertibles per the FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Has over two decades in payments. He held senior roles at First Data and NCR Corporation, building payment and technology partnerships with banks, including a joint venture with ICICI Bank. In 2013 he co-founded CitrusPay, which PayU bought in 2016. He became Pine Labs CEO in 2020 and has pushed it from an Indian card-terminal maker into a regional platform in Southeast Asia and the Middle East, adding online checkout, credit at the till and issuing software. He is paid in US dollars, and shareholders were asked to approve stock-option grants to him of 1% or more of the share capital in a year.

people.name: Kush Mehra
people.role: Executive Director, President & Chief Business Officer – Digital Infrastructure and Transaction Platform
people.since: Board since 29 Sep 2018; whole-time director since 9 May 2025
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate diploma in management from FORE School of Management. He has about 21 years in payments, with senior roles at Visa, American Express and Citibank in card issuing, merchant acquiring and EMI products. At Pine Labs he runs the merchant business, bank and card-network partnerships and expansion in India and Southeast Asia, and has grown the EMI and buy-now-pay-later offers at the till. He retires by rotation and is up for re-appointment at the FY26 AGM.

people.name: Sameer Vasudev Kamath
people.bio: Became CFO in September 2025, two months before the November 2025 IPO, after his predecessor Marc Mathenz left at the end of August 2025 after less than three months. The annual report does not give his earlier background.

people.name: Jayaram Karthik
people.bio: Has over 25 years in operations, risk, analytics and technology, with leadership roles at American Express, Citibank, Amazon, Tata and Razorpay. He joined in September 2026 to run operations and merchant experience across India and international markets.

companies.changes: Anand Raisinghani, President & Chief Business Officer of Setu, left on 17 Jul 2026, and Navin Chandani, President & Chief Business Officer – Issuing, resigned on 6 Apr 2026. Other named leaders: Sumit Chopra (COO, Digital Infrastructure), Sanjeev Kumar (CTO), Swarnendu Mukherjee (Chief Growth Officer, Issuing & Prepaid), Dheeraj Chowdhry (CBO, South East Asia) and Vijayalakshmi Swaminathan (Chief People Officer).

companies.styleNote: A husband-and-wife founder company. Co-founders Bipin Preet Singh (MD & CEO) and his wife Upasana Taku (Whole-time Director & CFO) are the only executive directors and the promoters; with two family trusts they own 25.1% (June 2026). Upasana was also Chairperson until December 2025, when independent director Navdeep Singh Suri took the chair. Bajaj Finance owns 10.1%. Below the founders, the named senior managers are a CTO, a new Chief Risk Officer and a new head of the lending subsidiary.

people.name: Bipin Preet Singh
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; husband of Upasana Taku
people.stake: 14.52% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group with family trusts 25.08%
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech from IIT Delhi and worked at Intel and NVIDIA before co-founding MobiKwik with his wife in 2009. He leads strategy, product, business expansion and technology. He built MobiKwik from a mobile-wallet app into a payments, bill-pay and small-loan platform and took it public in December 2024. In FY26 he set targets of 30–35% GMV growth in FY27 and a ten-fold rise in revenue by FY28.

people.name: Upasana Rupkrishan Taku
people.role: Co-Founder, Whole-time Director & Chief Financial Officer
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; wife of Bipin Preet Singh
people.bio: Holds a master's in management science and engineering (MS&E) from Stanford University and worked at HSBC and PayPal before co-founding MobiKwik. She runs finance, governance and business operations. She was Chairperson of the board until December 2025, when an independent director took over; she stays on as CFO, so the chief executive and chief financial officer are a married couple.

people.name: Anis Pathan
people.bio: Has over 14 years in risk management across banking, microfinance, insurance and financial services in India and the Middle East. He was most recently head of enterprise risk at Oman Arab Bank, and earlier Chief Risk Officer at Chaitanya India Fin Credit and at NSDL Payments Bank, where he also ran cybersecurity. He leads group enterprise risk, fraud prevention and financial-crime controls.

people.name: Manish Pathania
people.role: Chief Business Officer, MobiKwik Distribution Services (lending subsidiary)
people.bio: Has close to two decades in digital lending, business development and channel management. He headed the digital lending business at Bajaj Markets and earlier worked at GE Money and HDB Financial Services. He joined in August 2026 to run the lending business after it was moved into a wholly owned subsidiary, with a target of ₹1,000cr+ of quarterly disbursals.

people.name: Saurabh Dwivedi
people.bio: Named in senior management as CTO since December 2024. The annual report does not give his background.

companies.changes: Independent director Raghu Ram Hiremagalur Venkatesh resigned on 18 Sep 2026. The lending business moved to the subsidiary MDSPL in August 2026 under a new head. Navdeep Singh Suri replaced Upasana Taku as Chairperson on 17 Dec 2025.

companies.styleNote: Run by two founders. Promoter Vishal Mehta is Chairman & MD; his father Ajit Mehta, also a promoter, is non-executive Chairman Emeritus. The Mehta promoter group owns 27.3% (June 2026). Vishwas Patel, who founded CCAvenue in 2001, became MD & CEO in December 2025; he is not a promoter but personally owns 11.0%, more than any promoter. His son Vivek Patel (1.1%) is Chief Marketing Officer for India. Vishal Mehta has taken ₹1 a year; the FY26 AGM seeks fixed pay of up to about ₹1.07cr a year for each of the two MDs.

people.name: Vishal Ajitbhai Mehta
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman Emeritus Ajit Mehta
people.bio: Holds degrees in operations research from Cornell University and completed management studies at MIT Sloan. He worked at Amazon's headquarters in the US before returning to India in 2007, after nearly a decade in the US, to co-found the company with former Amazon colleagues. He led the purchase of Rediff.com and the push into AI through Phronetic AI, and the 2026 renaming to AvenuesAI. He took ₹1 a year in pay; the FY26 AGM seeks up to ₹1.07cr a year from April 2026. He is technical adviser to the Indian AI Research Organisation.

people.name: Vishwas Ambalal Patel
people.since: Board since 14 Feb 2018; MD & CEO since 11 Dec 2025 (to 10 Dec 2030)
people.relation: Founder of CCAvenue (not a promoter); father of Vivek Patel
people.bio: Holds a law degree (LLB) from Mumbai University and practised as counsel on the original side of the Bombay High Court. He founded the CCAvenue payment gateway in 2001, which became the company's payments business, and was Joint MD before being made MD & CEO in December 2025. He chairs the Payments Council of India and sits on RBI committees on digital payments. He has built the business into acquiring, issuing, remittances and markets such as the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Oman. The FY26 AGM seeks a pay revision to up to ₹1.07cr a year.

people.name: Sunil Bhagat
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 22 years in accounts, audit, tax, corporate finance and planning. He held finance leadership roles at Piramal Glass, Unimark Remedies and Shalby before AvenuesAI.

people.name: Ankit Patel
people.role: Group Chief Technology Officer and India CEO, Payments Services
people.bio: Holds an MBA in finance from Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies. He has about 15 years in IT leadership, covering infrastructure, networks, application development and booking and fares systems. He earlier served as the company's CTO and now leads the India payments business as well as group technology.

people.name: Vivek Nayak
people.bio: An economics graduate from Mumbai University with a postgraduate diploma in advertising and marketing from Xavier's. He spent 13 years in advertising at WPP, Draft FCB and Grey Worldwide before joining in 2002. He runs international expansion, infrastructure, commercial operations and analytics for the payments business.

people.name: Pankaj Dedhia
people.role: Group Chief Business Officer, India Payments Services
people.bio: Holds an MBA in marketing and business management. He leads business development, including corporate and banking alliances and key deals, and has held several leadership roles over about 11 years at the company.

people.name: Vivek Patel
people.since: Appointment put to the FY26 AGM
people.relation: Son of MD & CEO Vishwas Patel
people.bio: Holds an office of profit as CMO for India in the CCAvenue business, at up to ₹27 lakh a year; because he is a director's son, the pay is put to shareholders as a related-party item. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: Vishwas Patel was elevated from Joint MD to MD & CEO on 11 Dec 2025. The annual report says there has been no change in senior management since the year end. The company was renamed from Infibeam Avenues to AvenuesAI during FY26.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by founder Ashish Deora's Aurum group: the promoter company Aurum RealEstate Developers owns 47.9% (June 2026), and the promoter is subscribing to ₹118cr of warrants. Ashish joined the board as a non-executive director in April 2025 and became non-executive Chairman on 23 Apr 2026; the FY25 report was signed by him as 'Founder and Group CEO', so he still sets strategy. Day-to-day running is by long-serving Aurum group managers: executive director Onkar Shetye and CFO Kunal Karan. The annual report says the directors are not related. Ramashrya Yadav, founder of Integrow Asset Management, is a non-executive director.

people.name: Onkar Shetye
people.since: Joined the Aurum group in 2012; on the board since 4 May 2021
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in science from the University of Mumbai and a master's in renewable energy, enterprise and management from a UK (Russell Group) university, and is an alumnus of IIM Ahmedabad. He has about 15 years of experience across real estate, technology, energy and natural resources in India, Europe and Africa. Since joining the Aurum group in 2012 he has built new businesses and run operating and digital-transformation projects. He is the only executive director and sits on the board's investment and risk committees. He retires by rotation and is up for re-appointment at the FY26 AGM. In 2024 shareholders waived excess pay he received from exercising stock options.

people.name: Kunal Karan
people.bio: Has been CFO since June 2015. He sits on the board's Executive Investment Committee, which reviews acquisitions and divestments. The annual report's leadership page lists CA and CPA qualifications against his name but gives no earlier employers.

companies.changes: Ashish Deora became non-executive Chairman on 23 Apr 2026. Company Secretary Sonia Jain left on 30 Apr 2026; Pranali Desale took over on 1 May 2026. Independent director Padma Deosthali's term ended on 22 Jul 2026, and two new independent directors joined on 23 Apr 2026. A Deputy CFO, Shrikant Jagtap, was appointed in July 2025. The subsidiaries' statutory auditors resigned in August 2026.

companies.styleNote: The filings say the company 'is professionally managed and does not have an identifiable promoter'. Co-founders Saahil Goel (MD & CEO) and Gautam Kapoor (COO) still run it day to day, but each owns only about 3.4% after the August 2026 IPO. The largest holders are financial investors: Bertelsmann (21.3%), Tribe Capital, Eternal and Temasek; Arjun Sethi of Tribe is a non-executive director. No director or senior manager is related to another.

people.name: Saahil Goel
people.relation: Co-founder; no promoter group
people.stake: About 3.37% after the IPO (2.45cr shares, AGM notice 2026); 4.84% before it; plus vested options over 22 lakh shares and unvested over 79.8 lakh (RHP)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in business (minor in marketing) from Western International University, Arizona, and an MBA and MS from the Katz Graduate School of Business, Pittsburgh. He worked at Max New York Life from 2006 and SDLC Partners from 2010 before co-founding the company in 2011. He leads strategy and took Shiprocket public in August 2026. ET 40 under 40 (2023); fixed pay ₹1.94cr in FY26. His other directorships are only in group subsidiaries.

people.name: Gautam Kapoor
people.relation: Co-founder; no promoter group
people.stake: About 3.37% after the IPO (derived from 3.08cr shares less those sold in the offer); 4.84% before it; same option counts as Goel (RHP)
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from Delhi University and a bachelor's degree in business (minor in marketing) from Western International University. He co-founded the company and runs day-to-day operations, process efficiency and execution.

people.name: Kumar Tanmay
people.stake: 0.48% before the IPO (30.3 lakh shares), about 0.42% after (derived); vested options over 10.6 lakh shares (RHP)
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com (Hons) from Delhi University, a diploma in business finance from ICFAI and executive programmes at ISB, IIM Ahmedabad and IIM Bangalore. Over 24 years at Spencer's Retail, Burger King India, Yum! Restaurants and PepsiCo before joining. He leads finance, legal and compliance, corporate development and fundraising; named ET Group CFO of the Year (medium companies) in 2026.

people.name: Akshay Ghulati
people.since: Joined Feb 2016 as COO; in this role since 1 Apr 2024
people.stake: 0.55% before the IPO; vested options over 77 lakh shares (RHP)
people.bio: Holds a BS in economics from Wharton and an MBA from Harvard Business School. Earlier at Amazon UK, Smile Online Sales Services and The Parthenon Group in London. Runs the cross-border shipping business.

people.name: Atul Mehta
people.since: Joined Jul 2021; in this role since 1 Apr 2024
people.bio: B.Tech in chemical engineering from IIT Kharagpur and PGDM from IIM Calcutta; earlier at i-Flex Solutions and Amazon Seller Services. Runs the Core domestic shipping business.

people.name: Praful Poddar
people.bio: Engineering degree from NSIT, Delhi University, and a management degree from IIM Kozhikode; earlier at Jasper Infotech, OLX India and MakeMyTrip.

people.name: Sunil Kumar
people.bio: B.Tech in computer science from IIT Kanpur; earlier at EazyDiner, Times Business Solutions, Reliance Entertainment Digital, Rediff.com and Oracle India.

companies.changes: Co-founder Vishesh Khurana (about 1% before the IPO; sold ₹20cr in the offer) stopped being an employee on 31 May 2026 and joined Tribe Capital, per press reports. Company secretary Deepa Kapoor resigned on 3 Jul 2026; Nikhil Kumar joined on 27 Jul 2026. Also senior management: Gaurav Mangla (CEO, Pickrr checkout and ads) and Saumya Khati (CHRO).

companies.styleNote: Two co-founders run it: Dhirendra Mahyavanshi is Chairperson, MD and CEO and Anand Prabhudesai is Executive Director and COO; they set strategy but own only 13.2% together (June 2026), after selling about 10% of their shares in the IPO. Venture funds own about 40% (Nexus 19.8%, Peak XV 16.5%), and four of six directors are independent. The broking-licence company was bought from Mahyavanshi in May 2024, a related-party deal.

people.name: Dhirendra Nalin Mahyavanshi
people.since: With the company since incorporation in 2015; board since 18 Feb 2025; MD for five years from 12 Jul 2025
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to any other director or senior manager
people.stake: 6.76% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); 8.72% before the IPO, fully diluted; promoters together 13.21%
people.bio: Engineering degree (production) from Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College, University of Mumbai, and a post-graduate diploma in management from IIM Calcutta. Earlier vice president at ICICI Lombard General Insurance and vice president of sales at Quikr India; over 21 years in insurance and sales. Leads sales, distribution, strategy and expansion. He sold the broking company (Turtlemint Insurance Broking) to the listed company in May 2024. Pay ₹1.5cr a year.

people.name: Anand Rohidas Prabhudesai
people.since: Director since 7 Apr 2015 (co-founder); current term five years from 12 Jul 2025
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to other directors
people.bio: B.Tech in electrical engineering from IIT Bombay and an MBA from the University of Chicago. Earlier vice president in the mobile division at Quikr India, senior manager at Nokia India and strategic relationship manager at Yahoo India; over 23 years in technology and insurance. Runs technology, product and marketing. Pay ₹1.5cr a year.

people.name: Badrinarayan Sanjeevi
people.role: Chief Financial Officer and head of HR
people.bio: B.Com from the University of Madras, MBA from INSEAD, chartered accountant (all-India rank 28, May 1997) and cost accountant. Earlier CFO at Rakyan Beverages (Raw Pressery), group CFO at People Interactive, co-founder and CEO of Mauj Mobile, and roles at Arthur Andersen India and Deloitte in London; over 27 years in consulting and finance.

people.name: Prajakta Vijaykumar Deolasee
people.bio: Mechanical engineering degree from Nagpur University. Earlier vice president of engineering at HyperTrack, CTO at Hippily, director of engineering at Gupshup and programme analyst at SDI Tech; over 17 years in engineering. Owns the technology roadmap, platform and cyber-security for the company and its broking subsidiary.

people.name: Sunny Bhatia
people.role: Senior Vice President, Retail (sales and strategy)
people.bio: Post-graduate diploma in insurance and risk management from BIMTECH and a fellow of the Insurance Institute of India. Earlier at Cholamandalam MS General, Reliance General and SBI General; over 21 years in insurance.

people.name: Janaki Arvind Iyer
people.role: Chief Risk Officer (company and broking subsidiary)
people.bio: B.Com from the University of Mumbai and a chartered accountant; earlier associate director at B S R & Co. LLP; over 17 years in accounting and risk control. Oversees risk, compliance and audit.

people.name: Prashant Saini
people.role: Company Secretary & Compliance Officer; head of legal at the broking subsidiary
people.bio: B.Com (Hons) and LLB from Delhi University, LLM from Kurukshetra University and an associate of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India; earlier at ICICI Bank, Canara HSBC OBC Life and IndiaFirst Life (head of legal and fraud control); over 17 years.

companies.changes: Investor-nominee director Ravi Shankar Ganapathy resigned on 22 Jul 2025. No executive exits found since the FY26 annual report. Shuvamay Chowdhury (VP retail) is also senior management.

companies.styleNote: A Kirloskar Group company controlled by the Rahul and Atul Kirloskar families. Rahul C. Kirloskar is Executive Chairman and his son Aman (31) became MD on 1 April 2026, replacing long-serving professional MD K. Srinivasan. Rahul's brother Atul Kirloskar is a non-executive director. Promoters own 38.81%. Business divisions are run by long-tenured professionals.

people.name: Aman Rahul Kirloskar
people.since: Joined 2019; MD since 1 April 2026 (term to March 2031)
people.relation: Son of Executive Chairman Rahul Kirloskar; nephew of director Atul Kirloskar
people.stake: 200 shares (0.00%) directly; with his parents and sister (directly and through an entity they control) 14.72% as of February 2026; promoter group 38.81%
