people.bio: Aged 31, he graduated in business administration (global supply chain management) from Bryant University, USA, in 2017 and worked at Toyota Motors North America in international logistics. He started with the Kirloskar group as a supply chain manager at Kirloskar Chillers in 2018 and joined KPCL in 2019 as a senior manager. As General Manager (Operations) he scaled up screw and centrifugal air compressor production, and as Vice President of the refrigeration business (ACR) from April 2024 he delivered its highest-ever sales and launched new compressor and motor projects. He also leads group ESG initiatives and chairs the Indian Chamber of Commerce, Western Region. Investors should note that he took over the top job at 31 from a long-serving professional MD.

people.name: Rahul C. Kirloskar
people.since: Board since 1993; MD from December 1993; Chairman since 1998; Executive Chairman since 2012; re-appointment proposed to January 2032
people.relation: Promoter; father of MD Aman Kirloskar; brother of director Atul Kirloskar
people.stake: 11.54% (74,96,150 shares, including as karta of his HUF, June 2026); family and promoter group together 38.81%
people.bio: Aged 62, with over 40 years in engineering businesses. He began at Kirloskar Cummins, worked three years in a small family unit, and joined KPCL in 1989 as Senior Manager – Operations in the air compressor division. He became MD in December 1993 and Chairman in 1998; under him KPCL became India's leader in industrial refrigeration compressors and a major supplier to oil and gas. He has chaired CII's Pune and Maharashtra councils. The board has proposed re-appointing him as Executive Chairman for five years from January 2027.

people.name: Deepak Lokras
people.role: President & SBU Head – Air Compressors, Transmission and Nashik Manufacturing
people.bio: A mechanical engineer and certified CII Business Excellence assessor. He joined KPCL in 1986 as a graduate engineer trainee and worked in refrigeration systems, project management, marketing and sales. In 2003 he helped found the Process Gas Systems (PGS) division, building it into the oil-and-gas, CNG, EPC and wet-leasing business. He now heads the air compressor and transmission divisions and has led R&D since 2022.

people.name: Ramesh Birajdar
people.bio: Holds an M.Com and is a chartered accountant and company secretary, with an ACCA diploma in international financial reporting. He has about 27 years of experience at Kirloskar Oil Engines, the Kalyani group, the Tata group, Schaeffler India and Lear Corporation. Just before KPCL he was CFO of the listed Transformers and Rectifiers India, Ahmedabad. His strengths include accounting standards, tax, transfer pricing, debt restructuring and ERP.

people.name: Samit Gujarathi
people.bio: Holds an electrical engineering diploma and a professional qualification in marketing management. He joined KPCL in 1992 as a trainee engineer and has worked in project execution, engineering and sales. After leading sales for the Process Gas Systems unit, he now runs the whole division: gas systems, CNG, EPC and wet leasing.

companies.changes: K. Srinivasan completed his term as MD on 31 March 2026; Aman Kirloskar took over on 1 April 2026. No other KMP change since the annual report. The board has proposed re-appointing Rahul Kirloskar as Executive Chairman from January 2027. Company Secretary & Head Legal Jitendra Shah continues.

companies.styleNote: An Oberoi family company. Founder Naresh Chander Oberoi died on 10 December 2025; his son Bharat Oberoi became Chairman & MD on 23 December 2025. Bharat's sister Renu Naresh Oberoi and his son Jai Ram Oberoi (31) are whole-time directors. Long-time executive Pradeep Gupta runs the wind business. Promoters own 77.18%, mostly through family trusts. Newly listed, so the board's track record as a public company is short.

people.name: Bharat Oberoi
people.since: With the company since 1994; Joint MD from November 2003; Chairman & MD since 23 December 2025 (three-year term)
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late founder Naresh Chander Oberoi; brother of Renu Naresh Oberoi; father of Jai Ram Oberoi
people.stake: 0.44% in his own name (5,51,828 shares, June 2026); the Bharat Oberoi Family Trust holds 41.26%; promoter group 77.18%
people.bio: Aged 55, a promoter who has worked in the company since 1994 and has over 30 years in the generator-set industry. He was Joint MD from 2003 and ran manufacturing, business development and customer relationships. Before that he was a director of PSSPL, a group company since merged. The company's website lists his education as tenth standard from G.D. Somani Memorial School, Mumbai. He took over as Chairman & MD after his father's death in December 2025.

people.name: Renu Naresh Oberoi
people.since: With the company since 2012; whole-time director since 2017; re-appointment proposed from April 2027
people.relation: Promoter group; sister of CMD Bharat Oberoi; aunt of Jai Ram Oberoi
people.stake: 0.15% (1,85,348 shares) directly; controls the Kabir and Kimaya Family Private Trust's 11.22%
people.bio: Aged 52, she studied at H.R. College of Commerce and Economics and holds a diploma in fashion design from London. She joined in 2012 and has over 12 years in the wind power business and corporate functions. She is responsible for corporate and administrative functions and overall strategy.

people.name: Jai Ram Oberoi
people.relation: Son of CMD Bharat Oberoi; grandson of the founder; nephew of Renu Oberoi
people.stake: 4,000 shares directly; as trustee represents the Naresh Oberoi Family Trust's 1,66,11,393 shares (about 13%), in which he has a 55% stake
people.bio: Aged 31, he holds a bachelor's in economics and public health from Emory University and a master's in epidemiology, with a certificate in applied biostatistics, from Columbia University. He worked at Emory's Department of Human Genetics and at Clarivate Analytics before joining in 2022. He now oversees the generator-set business strategy and operations. He has just over three years of industry experience.

people.name: Pradeep Omprakash Gupta
people.since: Joined 2004; whole-time director since 2 September 2016; re-appointment proposed from April 2027
people.relation: Not related to the Oberoi family (his son Tushar works in a subsidiary)
people.bio: Aged 56, he holds a bachelor's degree in textile technology from Maharishi Dayanand University and has over 34 years in management roles. Before Powerica he was deputy MD at Texmaco and GSL (India), and president and whole-time director at Eastern Spinning Mills and Industries. He joined in 2004 as VP – Corporate Affairs and has been head of wind energy and CEO; he now oversees strategy, investments and operations of the wind division.

people.name: Ritesh Kumar Agrawal
people.bio: A chartered accountant and commerce graduate from Sambalpur University with more than 16 years in finance. He was previously CFO of Hero Motors Ltd and Ethos Ltd, and earlier worked at Spencer's Retail, Baxter Pharmaceuticals India, Intertek India and PwC. He handles financial management, planning and fund raising.

people.name: Rajan Vahi
people.role: Executive Vice President – Sales & Marketing (generator sets)
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in accounting and an MBA from Case Western Reserve University, Cleveland, Ohio, and has over 24 years in management roles. Before Powerica he worked at Mad Entertainment and Prime Focus. He runs sales and marketing for the diesel generator business.

companies.changes: Founder and CMD Naresh Chander Oberoi died on 10 December 2025. CFO Manish Agarwal resigned in July 2025 (Ritesh Kumar Agrawal replaced him). Maheswar Sahu resigned as an independent director in April 2026 and rejoined as a non-executive non-independent director on 7 August 2026. On 24 September 2026 shareholders approved re-appointing Renu Oberoi and Pradeep Gupta.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Coimbatore-based LRG Naidu/Varadaraj family group. Dr. Jairam Varadaraj, a third-generation family member, is MD, and his son Anvar is Executive Director & COO. His brother Sudarsan and younger son Varun (joined May 2026) are non-executive directors. Promoters own 31.19%, mostly through Dark Horse Portfolio Investment (20.10%). Below the family, a deep bench of hired professionals runs finance, operations, regions and R&D.

people.name: Dr. Jairam Varadaraj
people.since: Has led the group's businesses for nearly three decades
people.relation: Promoter; father of Anvar and Varun Jay Varadaraj; brother of Sudarsan Varadaraj
people.stake: 8.91% (2,82,21,616 shares, June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together 31.19%, incl. Dark Horse Portfolio Investment's 20.10%
people.bio: A third-generation entrepreneur from the LRG Naidu business family. He holds an MBA from George Washington University and a PhD in international business from the University of Michigan, and taught and did research in the US before returning to the family business. For nearly three decades he has led the group's interests in textiles, polymers, machines and consumer appliances. He is a former chairman of CII's Tamil Nadu State Committee and holds four patents in compressors, drive belts, appliances and food manufacturing. He is also on the boards of ATS Elgi, Elgi Ultra, Elgi Rubber and Elgi Sauer Compressors.

people.name: Anvar Jay Varadaraj
people.since: Joined 2015; board since 1 April 2020; COO since 2023; re-appointed to August 2031
people.relation: Son of MD Jairam Varadaraj; brother of director Varun Jay Varadaraj
people.bio: Aged 40 and a US national. He has a BA in economics and philosophy from the University of Michigan and an MBA in marketing from Cornell. He began in internal audit at Target Corporation in 2008, then worked on the Snickers brand at Mars Chocolate North America. He joined Elgi in 2015 to lead marketing in India, moved to Elgi North America in 2018, joined the board in 2020, and was President of North America in 2022. Since 2023 he has been COO in India, leading growth initiatives. Shareholders are asked to re-appoint him for five years from August 2026.

people.name: Indranil Sen
people.bio: A commerce graduate and chartered accountant. He held finance roles at EY, KPMG and PwC and worked at the US-based IT company Symphony Teleca. Immediately before Elgi he was CFO of Biocon Ltd. He runs the company's finance function.

people.name: Ramesh Ponnuswami
people.role: Executive President – Operations & ELGi Business System
people.since: Joined November 2011; took charge of operations in FY26
people.bio: A mechanical engineer with an MBA from RMIT University, Melbourne. He spent five and a half years at Sugar Research Ltd in Australia and then was Vice President – Operations at EID Parry (Murugappa group), where he led the team that built Asia's largest port-based sugar refinery. At Elgi he ran the Australia/Southeast Asia and India/Africa/Middle East regions and was MD of subsidiary ATS Elgi. In FY26 he took over operations across Elgi's Indian plants after Bheemsingh Melchisedec retired.

people.name: Bhavesh Karia
people.role: Executive President – India, South Asia, Africa, Middle East & Southeast Asia
people.since: Senior management (date of joining not disclosed)
people.bio: A production engineer who did the Management Education Programme at IIM Ahmedabad. He has about 27 years of experience, mostly in oil and gas, pipelines, power and infrastructure, at Man Industries, Welspun Corp, Larsen & Toubro and Aswan International Engineering. He runs Elgi's business across India, South Asia, Africa, the Middle East and Southeast Asia.

people.name: Dr. K. Venu Madhav
people.since: With Elgi since 1998, apart from a short break
people.bio: Holds a PhD in mechanical engineering, specialising in compressors, from City University, London. He has been with Elgi since 1998 apart from a short stint at a research organisation. He led the design of Elgi's air ends and brought rotor-design know-how in-house, and heads new product and technology development. He has two patents in compressor technology.

people.name: Dr. Premendra
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in materials science and metallurgy from IIT Kanpur, a PhD in materials science from Delft University of Technology, and the one-year MBA (PGPX) from IIM Ahmedabad. He worked at Toyota Motor Europe and Roland Berger, and was Vice President – Strategy at JK Paper before joining Elgi in March 2023. He leads corporate strategy for Elgi and its subsidiaries, product management and digital.

companies.changes: No top-level exits since the annual report. Vikas Thiruvalluru (ex-COO Jayem Automotives, ex-MD Rexnord India) joined in March 2026 and was named senior management as President & Head – GPMO on 1 September 2026. Varun Jay Varadaraj joined the board as a non-executive director on 27 May 2026. Operations head Bheemsingh Melchisedec retired in October 2025. Company Secretary Rohit Gupte replaced Devika Sathyanarayana in August 2025.

companies.styleNote: Run by Sanjay C. Kirloskar's branch of the Kirloskar family. Sanjay is Chairman & MD, his daughter Rama is Joint MD (and MD of the Kirloskar Ebara JV), and his son Alok, a non-executive director here, runs the overseas arm as MD of Kirloskar Brothers International B.V. Sanjay and his wife Pratima together hold about 40%; promoters own 65.95%. A hired CFO from Thermax joined in May 2025.

people.name: Sanjay C. Kirloskar
people.since: Director since 19 November 1985; MD since 21 September 1998; current term to March 2027
people.relation: Promoter; father of Rama and Alok Kirloskar
people.stake: 22.48% (1,78,50,090 shares, June 2026); wife Pratima 17.44%; promoter group together 65.95%
people.bio: Aged 68, he holds a B.S. in mechanical engineering from the Illinois Institute of Technology, Chicago. He has been with the company since 1985 and has run it as MD since 1998, building it into India's largest centrifugal pump maker with plants in the Netherlands, South Africa, Thailand, the UK and the US. He is also on the boards of DCM Shriram Industries, Kirloskar Ebara Pumps, Kirloskar Brothers International B.V. and SPP Pumps, UK. His current term as MD runs only to March 2027.

people.name: Rama S. Kirloskar
people.role: Joint Managing Director; also MD of Kirloskar Ebara Pumps
people.since: Director since 28 July 2017; Joint MD since 3 August 2021; re-appointed to August 2031
people.relation: Daughter of CMD Sanjay Kirloskar; sister of Alok Kirloskar
people.stake: nil in her own name (June 2026 shareholding pattern)
people.bio: Aged 36, she holds a double major in mathematics and biology from Bryn Mawr College, USA. She worked at Polaris Partners, a Boston venture capital firm, and then at MIT's Koch Institute, where her research led to work with the biotech start-up Visterra; she co-authored a 2015 paper in the journal Cell. At the company she was GM and head of product portfolio management before becoming Joint MD in 2021. As MD of Kirloskar Ebara Pumps, the JV with Japan's Ebara, she is credited with turning it into a debt-free company. She is an independent director of KPT Industries and DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals.

people.name: Alok S. Kirloskar
people.role: Non-executive Director; MD of Kirloskar Brothers International B.V. (overseas subsidiary)
people.relation: Son of CMD Sanjay Kirloskar; brother of Rama Kirloskar
people.bio: Holds a B.S. in business administration (finance) from Carnegie Mellon University, Pittsburgh. The company lists him in its management team as MD of Kirloskar Brothers International B.V., its Netherlands-based overseas subsidiary, and he chairs the Kirloskar Corrocoat JV. He holds 15 other directorships. He sits on the company's board as a non-executive director.

people.name: Bhavesh Chheda
people.role: Chief Financial Officer (VP – Corporate Finance & Accounts)
people.bio: Aged 49 at appointment, he became a chartered accountant in 2002 and has an executive postgraduate diploma in business management from Symbiosis (2010). He has about 23 years in financial planning, risk and treasury management, M&A, ERP and overseas subsidiaries. He spent his earlier career in various roles at the Thermax group, finally as CFO of Thermax Babcock & Wilcox Energy Solutions. He replaced Ravish Mittal, who left in February 2025.

companies.changes: No executive change since the annual report. Rama Kirloskar was re-appointed Joint MD from August 2026 to August 2031. Several independent directors completed their terms in May 2026 and Madhuri Kanitkar joins as an independent director on 15 September 2026. Senior manager Supriyo Bhowmik (head of engineered services) left in October 2025. Company Secretary Devang Trivedi continues.

companies.styleNote: A Kirloskar Group company controlled by the Atul and Rahul Kirloskar families. Gauri Kirloskar, Atul's daughter, is Vice Chairperson & MD. Her uncle Rahul C. Kirloskar became non-executive Chairman on 1 April 2026 after Atul Kirloskar stepped down as Chairman and left the board. A hired CEO (Rahul Sahai, ex-Cummins) runs the engines business day to day. Promoters own 41.07%.

people.name: Gauri Kirloskar
people.since: Board since 2014; MD (current term from 20 May 2025, three years); Vice Chairperson since 1 April 2026
people.relation: Daughter of Atul Kirloskar (former Chairman); niece of Chairman Rahul C. Kirloskar
people.stake: 3.96% (57,53,580 shares, June 2026); father Atul 10.09%, uncle Rahul 12.23%; promoter group together 41.07%
people.bio: Aged 42, she attended Phillips Academy, Andover, and graduated from Carnegie Mellon's Tepper School of Business. She was an investment banking analyst in Merrill Lynch's M&A group in New York and then worked in Pearson's corporate finance and strategy group. Back in the group she set up the Kirloskar real estate business in Pune before becoming KOEL's MD; the company credits her with a broad turnaround that lifted sales, profits and market share. She also guides the lending subsidiary Arka FinCap and group-level strategy, and is an independent director of Godrej & Boyce. She received the Maharashtra Udyogini award in 2023.

people.name: Rahul Sahai
people.role: Chief Executive Officer (also MD of KOEL Fluid Dynamics)
people.since: CEO and KMP (joining date not disclosed)
people.bio: An industrial and production engineer from Manipal Institute of Technology with an MBA from ISB Hyderabad. He began in sales and application engineering at Kennametal and worked in India, the USA, Nigeria and South Africa. Before KOEL he was Director – Marketing & Engineering at Cummins India, where he led channel strategy, a business turnaround, new product launches and a master distribution centre. At KOEL he runs the engines business and leads new-fuel and growth initiatives. He is President of the Indian Institution of Industrial Engineering.

people.name: Sachin Kejriwal
people.since: CFO and KMP (no KMP change in FY26)
people.bio: A chartered accountant with an MBA from SP Jain Institute of Management, Mumbai, and over 20 years in finance and strategy. He started at Ernst & Young in risk advisory, was head of internal audit at IFB Industries, and was Finance Director for the supply chain organisation at Cummins India. At KOEL he leads capital allocation, performance management, investor relations and M&A.

people.name: Kiran Bhagnure-Khapre
people.bio: A metallurgical engineer from College of Engineering Pune with a postgraduate degree in HR from Pune University, and nearly two decades in HR. She began at Cummins India, rising to lead HR for several functions, and was then India HR Head at Behr-Hella Thermocontrol. She joined KOEL in 2023, handling HR for the power generation business and the Kagal plant, then compensation and talent acquisition, and became CHRO in May 2025, replacing George Verghese.

companies.changes: Atul Kirloskar stepped down as Chairman and resigned from the board on 31 March 2026; Rahul C. Kirloskar became Chairman and Gauri Kirloskar Vice Chairperson from 1 April 2026. Independent director Satish Jamdar left on 3 August 2026. No KMP change since the annual report. Company Secretary is Farah Irani.

companies.styleNote: The Indian arm of Germany's KSB group, which owns 40.54% through Canadian Kay Pump Ltd. The Swarup family is co-promoter (mainly via Industrial and Prudential Investment Co., 21.55%); Gaurav Swarup is non-executive Chairman, and Dr. Stephan Bross and Dr. Matthias Schmitz sit on the board as non-executive, non-independent directors. Promoters own 69.8%. Day-to-day running is by a hired MD, Rajeev Jain, and a professional team. The annual report says no board members are related to each other. Its financial year ends in December.

people.name: Rajeev Jain
people.role: Managing Director (also KSB Regional Executive Officer – Asia West)
people.since: MD since 1 July 2016; re-appointed to 30 June 2031; service counted from first joining KSB in September 1985
people.bio: Born in 1964, he holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering and a master's in management sciences, with long experience in engineering. His service is counted from when he first joined KSB Ltd in September 1985, and he has been MD since July 2016. He is also the KSB group's Regional Executive Officer for Asia West and a director of KSB MIL Controls, KSB Tech and Pofran Sales and Agency. The board re-appointed him for five more years from July 2026.

people.name: Mahesh Bhave
people.role: Chief Financial Officer & Vice President – Finance, Procurement and DTC
people.bio: The company's CFO and key managerial person, who also heads procurement and DTC. He co-signs the financial statements with the MD. The annual report does not give details of his education or earlier career.

people.name: Nitin Patil
people.role: Vice President – IPD & EPD Operations; Chief Operating Officer – Nuclear Business (Pumps)
people.bio: Named by the company as senior management. He runs the industrial and energy pump operations and is COO of the nuclear pumps business, the franchise that depends on NPCIL orders and its test bed. The company does not publish his education or earlier career.

people.name: Sunil Bapat
people.role: Vice President – WPD Operations & Foundry; Chief Operating Officer – Solar Business (Pumps)
people.bio: Named by the company as senior management. He runs water-pump operations and the foundry and is COO of the solar pump business. The company does not publish his education or earlier career.

people.name: Prashant Kumar
people.bio: Named by the company as senior management and heads sales and marketing. The company does not publish his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: Rajeev Jain was re-appointed MD for five years from 1 July 2026. Senior manager Philip Puthenpurackal (Head of Corporate Quality, Integrated Management, Safety & Sustainability) resigned on 14 August 2026. No other KMP change. Company Secretary is Shraddha Kavathekar.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by Karan Thapar's group through DBH Investment Capital India (55.77%). Thapar is non-executive Chairman; the business is run by a hired MD & Group CEO, Parag Satpute (ex-Bridgestone), since April 2025. The top team has turned over heavily: the previous MD, the CFO and several senior managers changed within about 18 months.

people.name: Parag Satpute
people.role: Managing Director & Group Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Aged 52, he is a mechanical engineer from Pune University with an Executive MBA from Warwick Business School, and attended programmes at IIM Ahmedabad and IMD. He spent over two decades at Sweden's Sandvik, rising to MD and Chairman of its Indian subsidiaries, then was MD of Bridgestone India and later global President of Bridgestone Mobility Solutions. He joined Greaves in April 2025, replacing Dr. Arup Basu, and leads the Greaves.NEXT strategy across energy, mobility and industrial businesses. He is also a director of Greaves Technologies and Excel Controlinkage.

people.name: Manish Poddar
people.role: Group Chief Financial Officer (also heads IT)
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 25 years in financial leadership, strategy and governance. He held senior roles at Greencell Mobility, GMM Pfaudler and Diversey, and has worked with both promoter-run and private-equity-owned firms, including Bain Capital and ChrysCapital portfolios. He replaced Akhila Balachandar as CFO in March 2026.

people.name: Swarnendu Jha
people.bio: Named by the company as senior management and heads the Energy Solutions business. The company does not publish his education or earlier career in the annual report.

people.name: Santosh Singh
people.bio: Has about 24 years in strategy, business excellence and AI-led transformation, over 20 of them in Tata companies. Most recently he was Global Head – Marketing and Business Excellence at Tata Technologies, where he co-led its generative-AI roadmap. He joined Greaves in December 2025 to drive strategy and AI adoption.

people.name: Vinay Pawar
people.bio: Has nearly three decades in automotive electronics, industrial automation, connected mobility and embedded systems. He held several senior roles at the Spark Minda group, running digital clusters, infotainment and connected-solutions portfolios, and earlier worked at KPIT Technologies, Continental Automotive, Bosch and ABB in India and Europe.

companies.changes: CFO Akhila Balachandar left on 19 March 2026; Manish Poddar replaced her. Vinay Pawar joined as Group CTO on 4 May 2026. During FY26 MD Dr. Arup Basu resigned (April 2025) and non-executive Vice Chairman Nagesh Basavanhalli stepped down (April 2025). Group General Counsel & Company Secretary Atindra Nath Basu continues.

companies.styleNote: A Patidar family company. Founder-promoter Dinesh Patidar is Chairman cum Whole-time Director and his brother Sunil is a whole-time director; the family holds its stake mainly through the Shakti Sons, Shakti Brothers and Shakti Future trusts. MD Ramesh Patidar, with the company since 2006, is not related to the other directors per the annual report. Promoters own 50.36%.

people.name: Dinesh Patidar
people.since: Director since 30 January 2006; re-appointed for three years from 7 May 2026
people.relation: Founder-promoter; brother of Sunil Patidar
people.stake: 18.36% as beneficial owner of the Shakti Sons Trust (2,26,45,600 shares); nil in his own name; promoter group together 50.36%
people.bio: Born in 1962, a graduate and self-made industrialist with over three decades in making and selling stainless-steel pumps. The company credits him with its R&D-led growth, 15 patents, UL certifications, global expansion and move into solar-powered irrigation. He remains closely involved in mechanical and design problems. He was re-appointed Chairman cum Whole-time Director for three years from May 2026.

people.name: Ramesh Patidar
people.since: Director since 17 October 2006; re-appointed as MD for three years from 7 May 2026
people.relation: Not related to the other directors, per the annual report
people.bio: Born in 1973, a business administration graduate with a postgraduate qualification in international business and over 19 years at Shakti. He leads international business development, finding and expanding export markets. He chairs the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Sunil Patidar
people.since: Re-appointed for five years from 29 January 2026
people.relation: Brother of Chairman Dinesh Patidar
people.stake: nil in his own name (June 2026 shareholding pattern); family holds through promoter trusts
people.bio: He handles people management, industrial relations, administration and regulatory compliance. The company does not disclose his education in the annual report. His basic salary was revised to ₹24 lakh a year from May 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

people.name: Ashwin Bhootda
people.bio: Holds a master's degree in international business and has over 18 years in sales and marketing, focused on global markets. He chairs the board's CSR committee.

people.name: Dinesh Patel
people.since: Joined the Shakti group in May 2018
people.bio: A chartered accountant, cost accountant and company secretary with over 15 years in accounts, finance, audit and tax. Before joining Shakti in 2018 he worked at Mahindra & Mahindra, Mahindra Two Wheelers and CASE New Holland Construction Equipment India.

companies.changes: Chief Technology Officer Dr. Chinmay Jain resigned with effect from 25 August 2026. Dinesh Patidar and Ramesh Patidar were re-appointed for three years from May 2026. Company Secretary Ravi Patidar continues.

companies.styleNote: A Gupta family company that listed in June 2025. Promoters own 75.65%, mostly through Shorya Trading Company (47.82%) and Ess Aar Corporate Services (15.43%). The CFO seat changed hands in mid-2026.

people.name: Vivek Gupta
people.since: Board since 22 September 2006; re-appointment proposed for five years from March 2027
people.relation: Promoter; father of Amulya and Shivam Gupta
people.stake: 10.47% (1,19,30,778 shares, June 2026); promoter group together 75.65%, incl. Shorya Trading's 47.82%
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from Kurukshetra University, Haryana. He has been with the company since 2006 and has over 18 years in pump manufacturing; the company credits him with building its market presence. He received the Nation's Udyog Ratan Award from the Indian Organisation for Business Research & Development in 2005. The board has proposed re-appointing him as CMD for five years from March 2027.

people.name: Amulya Gupta
people.since: Joined August 2019; board since 4 December 2020; re-appointed to June 2031
people.relation: Son of CMD Vivek Gupta; brother of Shivam Gupta
people.stake: nil in his own name (June 2026 shareholding pattern)
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in business and management studies from the University of Bradford, UK. He joined the company in August 2019 and has over seven years in pump manufacturing. He joined the board in December 2020 and was re-appointed for five years from June 2026.

people.name: Shivam Gupta
people.relation: Son of CMD Vivek Gupta; brother of Amulya Gupta
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from the University of Delhi and a master's in management from the University of Liverpool. He joined in February 2022 and has just over four years in pump manufacturing. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is proposed for re-appointment.

people.name: Vijay Kumar Yadav
people.since: Joined as Senior GM – Finance on 22 June 2026; CFO since 8 August 2026
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 21 years in corporate finance, treasury, tax, capital markets and compliance at listed manufacturers. He was CFO of Duroply Industries and held senior finance roles at Gold Plus Glass Industry, Wires & Fabriks (S.A.) and the Texplas group. He has led IPO readiness, capital structuring and working-capital work. He replaced Subodh Kumar, who resigned in June 2026.

companies.changes: CFO Subodh Kumar resigned on 20 June 2026; Vijay Kumar Yadav became CFO on 8 August 2026. General Manager – Export & Sales Santhosh Kumar T E resigned for personal reasons with effect from 31 August 2026. Company Secretary Anish Kumar continues.

companies.styleNote: Part of Ahmedabad's Lalbhai group (Arvind Ltd), whose promoter group owns 53.83% (March 2026). The family sits on the board as non-executives: Kulin Lalbhai has been non-executive Chairman since November 2025, when his father Sanjay Lalbhai stepped down, and his brother Punit Lalbhai joined as a non-executive director. Day-to-day running passed in February 2026 from long-time MD Kamal Singal to Priyansh Kapoor, a hire from Godrej Properties. No executive is related to the family.

people.name: Priyansh Kapoor
people.since: Whole-time Director & CEO from 9 August 2025; MD & CEO since 10 February 2026
people.stake: Not disclosed individually; granted 8,50,000 stock options under ESOP 2025 (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a PGDM from Xavier Institute of Management. He joined Godrej Properties after his PGDM as a sales and marketing manager, helped build its international sales vertical and rose to General Manager, Sales & Marketing. In 2016 he moved to Mumbai's Wadhwa Group as head of sales, marketing and CRM, and in 2019 joined Godrej Housing Finance as head of business development and strategy. From 2020 he was CEO, Mumbai Zone at Godrej Properties, where the company became the second-largest developer in the Mumbai region by bookings. He joined Arvind SmartSpaces in August 2025 and took over as MD & CEO in February 2026.

people.name: Kamal Singal
people.since: Lalbhai group since 2001; led the real-estate business from 2008; MD & CEO until 10 February 2026
people.bio: Holds an Executive Post Graduate Diploma in Management from IIM Indore. He worked for nine years at DCM Textiles before joining the Lalbhai group in 2001, and was put in charge of the group's real-estate business in 2008. He ran Arvind SmartSpaces as MD & CEO for about 15 years, including its 2015 demerger and listing. He stepped down as MD & CEO in February 2026 and stays on the board as Whole-time Director for strategy and investments, mentoring the new team and taking a wider group role. He has more than 33 years of experience.

people.name: Amit Chamaria
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 20 years in finance, strategy and operations across IT, FMCG, agri-tech, food processing and manufacturing. He began his career at Infosys, then held senior finance roles at Innoterra, a global agri-food company. Before joining, he was CFO of HyFun AgriLink (frozen foods), where he led financial and digital transformation and fund-raising. He joined as CFO in November 2025, filling a gap left when the previous CFO resigned in May 2025.

people.name: Dharmesh Vyas
people.bio: Holds a BE (Civil) from COEP Pune, a PGP in Construction Management from NICMAR Pune and a civil-engineering diploma from K J Somaiya Polytechnic. He has more than 30 years in construction project management in India and the Gulf (Dubai, Bahrain, Kuwait, Maldives). He held senior roles at Adani Realty, Lodha Group, K Raheja Group, Tata Housing, Ajmera Group, Mantri Realty and Sahara group, among others. At Arvind he runs planning, project management, procurement and contracts, and delivery.

people.name: Sharvil Shah
people.since: Joined in 2024; CBO West since 22 September 2025
people.bio: Holds a master's in Civil Engineering from Purdue University, USA, and a bachelor's in construction technology and management from Nirma Institute of Technology (Gujarat University). He has about 17 years of experience in the USA and India across real estate, textiles and oil and gas, including at Bechtel Corporation, Safal (BSafal) and J Saurabhkumar & Co. He joined Arvind SmartSpaces about a year before his elevation and now runs the Gujarat region's P&L, from land buying and product to sales and delivery.

people.name: Bhasker Jain
people.bio: Holds a PGP in Management for Senior Executives from ISB Hyderabad and a B.Com from Jai Hind College, Mumbai. He has about 17 years in real estate across P&L management, business development, sales and marketing, and private-equity investments. He was earlier VP and Partner for the Mumbai region at Neoliv Real Estate, running its regional P&L, and before that held senior roles at the Wadhwa Group and worked at Godrej Properties. He leads Arvind's newer Mumbai-region business.

people.name: Ravi Vadhavkar
people.bio: An architect with a Bachelor of Architecture from the University of Mumbai, a master's in architecture (construction management) from Virginia Tech, USA, and a PGPM from ISB Hyderabad. He has about 23 years of experience, with senior roles at CapitaLand, Godrej Properties, Puravankara, Colliers, Knight Frank, Tata Housing and Pulte Homes (USA). At CapitaLand he was VP and City Head, Bangalore, running a 9 million sq ft office portfolio; at Godrej Properties he was a project director. He replaced Manoj Chellani as head of the Bengaluru business.

companies.changes: Kamal Singal handed the MD & CEO role to Priyansh Kapoor on 10 February 2026 and stays as Whole-time Director. Since the year end: CBO South Manoj Chellani resigned on 31 May 2026 (replaced by Ravi Vadhavkar); Head Legal Jai Kumar Ajbani resigned on 30 June 2026 (replaced by Tarpit Patni); Shalaka Samant joined as Chief Design Officer on 18 May 2026; Bhasker Jain joined as CBO MMR on 1 July 2026. The statutory auditor resigned in August 2026. Most of the senior team joined within the past year.

companies.styleNote: Run by its three promoters, who are all executive directors: founder Boman Irani (Chairman & MD) and his brother Percy Chowdhry, plus Chandresh Mehta, who is not related to them. Together they own 74.59% (March 2026), after selling 3.63% in an October 2025 offer for sale to meet the public-shareholding rule. Boman Irani also licenses the Rustomjee trademark to the company, and the promoters have lent money to it. A hired team runs finance, operations and projects.

people.name: Boman Irani
people.since: Founder; established Rustomjee in 1996; director since the company's incorporation
people.relation: Founder and original promoter; brother of Executive Director Percy Chowdhry
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in engineering from M. H. Saboo Siddik College of Engineering, Mumbai, and has attended leadership programmes at Harvard. He founded the Rustomjee group in 1996 and has over 30 years in Mumbai real estate, building its redevelopment-led model. He leads the group's overall strategy and growth. He heads CREDAI, the national body of real-estate developers, and earlier led CREDAI-MCHI in Mumbai. He owns the Rustomjee trademark, which the company uses under a licence agreement, and he founded the Rustom Irani Foundation and the Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers.

people.name: Percy Chowdhry
people.since: Director since 1999; re-appointment proposed for May 2027 to May 2032
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Chairman & MD Boman Irani
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from the University of Bombay. He has about 27 years in real estate and has been a director of the company since 1999. He directs the group's sales, marketing and human-resources functions. He became a promoter by acquiring shares over the years and is one of the three promoters who sold shares in the October 2025 offer for sale.

people.name: Chandresh Mehta
people.since: Director since 2004; Executive Director term to May 2027, re-appointment proposed to May 2032
people.relation: Promoter; not related to the other directors
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in electrical engineering from Banaras Hindu University (IIT BHU) and a PGDM from Xavier Institute of Management, Bhubaneswar. He has about 30 years in real estate and has been a director since 2004. He directs the group's redevelopment of old housing societies, the core of its strategy, and oversees operational excellence. He is a co-promoter by shareholding, not a family member of the founder.

people.name: Sajal Gupta
people.role: Group Chief Financial Officer and Head, Corporate Strategy
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Maharshi Dayanand University and a chartered accountant. Before joining Keystone in 2015 he worked at AMW Motors (Asia MotorWorks) and Otis Elevator Company (India). He led the finances through the company's November 2022 IPO and signed its prospectus as CFO. He also heads corporate strategy and was among the senior staff granted stock options under the company's ESOP plan.

people.name: Vinayak Bhosale
people.since: Listed as COO in the FY26 senior-management list
people.bio: The company names him as Chief Operating Officer in its FY26 annual report and on its leadership page, but has not published a profile of his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: No change in directors or KMP during FY26. Rakesh Setia, Group Head of Sales and Marketing, left on 13 April 2026; Mukesh Singh became Chief of Sales in February 2026. Salil Chinchore (TISS; ex-Asian Paints, Mondelez, Godrej Agrovet, Pidilite) joined as Group Chief Human Resources Officer on 16 April 2026. Vikas Singhal joined in August 2025 as CEO, Special Projects and Head of Strategic Initiatives.

companies.styleNote: Founder Kamal Khetan is Chairman & Managing Director and runs the company. The promoter group owns 63.28% (March 2026), mostly through family trusts and holding companies; his wife Manisha and son Akrur are named promoters but are not on the board. The other two executive directors are long-serving employees, and no director is related to another. The promoter group also took part in a ₹500cr preferential warrant issue approved in September 2025.

people.name: Kamal Khetan
people.relation: Founder and promoter; husband of promoter Manisha Khetan and father of promoter Akrur Khetan
people.stake: 150 shares, 0.00% in his own name (FY26 annual report); promoter group together 63.28%, held mainly through trusts and group companies
people.bio: Graduated in electronics and communication engineering from Mangalore University. A first-generation entrepreneur, he first set up business centres in Mumbai's Bandra-Kurla Complex for multinational companies, then founded Sunteck Realty and built it into a listed luxury developer in the Mumbai region. He sets the strategy and capital allocation and is known for his grasp of project finance. He is the founder trustee of the Sunteck Foundation, Honorary Consul of Jordan in Mumbai, a Fellow of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors and a member of the Young Presidents' Organization, ASSOCHAM, IMC and MCHI-CREDAI. He sits on the boards of many private promoter-group companies.

people.name: Ajeet Singh
people.bio: An architect with a Bachelor of Architecture and over 30 years of experience in design and development across Mumbai. His specialities are checking projects against development rules, planning and speeding up approvals, coordinating consultants, and inputs at the concept stage. He is a director of several Sunteck subsidiaries and is paid by the wholly owned subsidiary Satguru Corporate Services. He joined the board as a whole-time director in September 2025 and is up for re-appointment by rotation at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Rachana Hingarajia
people.since: Board since 31 March 2015; with the group for over 15 years
people.bio: Holds an MBA in finance, is a qualified company secretary and a law graduate. She has more than 15 years with the Sunteck group across compliance, legal work and mergers and restructuring. She has been on the board since March 2015 and runs the company's governance and secretarial function. She was granted 12,857 stock options under the company's ESOP scheme.

people.name: Prashant Chaubey
people.bio: He was head of corporate finance at Sunteck before becoming CFO in September 2022, replacing Manoj Agarwal. He presents the results on the company's earnings calls and is a director of several group subsidiaries. He was granted 15,429 stock options under the ESOP scheme. The company has not published his education or earlier employers.

people.name: Santhana Kumar
people.since: Listed as senior management at 31 March 2026
people.bio: Named as Chief Technical Officer and one of three senior management personnel in the FY26 annual report, responsible for the technical side of project delivery. He was granted 24,251 stock options, the largest grant among senior managers. The company has not published a profile of his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: Ajeet Singh joined the board as Whole-time Director on 5 September 2025. Independent directors Chaitanya Dalal and Mukesh Jain were re-appointed for a second term in January 2026. No KMP changes announced since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: A Mahindra group company: Mahindra & Mahindra owns 52.41%. It is run by a hired team under MD & CEO Amit Kumar Sinha, a Mahindra group executive; the only executive on the board is the MD. The chairman, Ameet Hariani, is independent, and M&M is represented by non-executive directors including its own MD & CEO Anish Shah. No family runs the business; senior staff often move in and out from other group companies.

people.name: Amit Kumar Sinha
people.since: Joined Mahindra group November 2020; MD & CEO since 23 May 2023 (term to 22 May 2028)
people.bio: Holds a dual MBA in finance and strategy from the Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania, and a BE in electrical and electronics engineering from BIT Ranchi; he is an Ananta Aspen Fellow. He began at Tata Motors, then held technology roles at iGate Patni in India, Singapore and the US. He spent 18 years at Bain & Company in the US and India, rising to Senior Partner and Director, advising infrastructure, real-estate, construction, energy and technology clients. He joined Mahindra in November 2020 as President, Group Strategy and sits on the Group Executive Board. Since May 2023 he has run Mahindra Lifespaces, narrowing it to premium homes in Mumbai, Pune and Bengaluru, exiting affordable housing and clearing legacy land issues.

people.name: Sriram Kumar
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a commerce degree from the University of Madras. He has over 16 years in private equity and M&A, including with Goldman Sachs Asset Management in India and the US and briefly Irevna Research. He joined the Mahindra group in March 2022 in the group partnerships team, working on fund-raising and deals such as capital raises for Mahindra Electric Automotive and Mahindra Last Mile Mobility and the FirstCry IPO. He was Vice President for FP&A, costing and investor relations at Mahindra Lifespaces before becoming CFO in November 2025.

people.name: Vimalendra Singh
people.bio: Holds an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad and an engineering degree from VJTI, Mumbai. He spent about 12 years in retail banking, starting as a management associate at Citibank and later at Standard Chartered and Bank of Bahrain & Kuwait. He moved to real estate as market head for the luxury portfolio at the Lodha group, then joined Mahindra Lifespaces, where he was chief sales and service officer. He was named Chief Business Officer for the residential business from April 2024.

people.name: Vikram Goel
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate degree in management from the International Management Institute, Delhi. He has over 23 years in real estate, mostly with HDFC Limited and its group, in real-estate finance and restructuring in India and the Middle East. He spent about eight years at HDFC Realty, rising to CEO, was chief executive of Quikr Realty, headed HDFC's special-situations group for construction finance, and was a senior vice president for realty finance at HDFC Bank. He runs the industrial parks business (Mahindra World City and ORIGINS by Mahindra) and joined the boards of the Mahindra World City subsidiaries in April 2025.

companies.changes: CFO Avinash Bapat moved to Mahindra & Mahindra on 31 October 2025; Sriram Kumar replaced him. Bijal Parmar returned as Company Secretary in October 2025. Ankur Parmar replaced Abhimanyu Mathur as Chief Marketing Officer (October 2025), Parijat Dey joined as Chief Technology Officer (September 2025) and Anshu Shukla as Chief Design Officer (June 2025). Non-executive director Asha Kharga resigned on 13 March 2026. No KMP changes announced since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: A family company run by three brothers: Vishal Gupta (MD), Ankur Gupta (Joint MD) and Varun Gupta (Whole-time Director), who split sales, projects, land and finance between them. Promoters own 61.11% (March 2026): the three brothers about 53%, relative Rachna Gupta 6.06% and the family's OPG Realtors 1.70%. The rest of the board is independent. The 2026 AGM (29 September) is voting on pay rises for all three brothers.

people.name: Vishal Gupta
people.since: With the company since 1995; MD term 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2028
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Joint MD Ankur Gupta and Whole-time Director Varun Gupta
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Sydenham College, Mumbai, with an MBA from FORE School of Management, New Delhi. He has been with Ashiana since 1995 and has over 30 years in the business, earlier focused on project execution and general administration. As MD he sets the company's strategic direction, product philosophy and customer approach, and is known for hands-on project planning and design. He is also a director of family companies such as OPG Realtors and of the listed Poly Medicure, and sits on the Construction Skill Development Council of India.

people.name: Ankur Gupta
people.since: With the company about 23 years; board since 24 December 2002
people.relation: Promoter; brother of MD Vishal Gupta and Whole-time Director Varun Gupta
people.bio: Holds a BBA from Fairleigh Dickinson University and a master's in real estate from New York University, USA, where he researched housing for seniors. He used that work on Ashiana Utsav, the company's flagship senior-living project, and senior living is now a key part of its business. He leads marketing and sales and oversees maintenance and customer care. He is a founding member of the Association of Senior Living India, has worked on NITI Aayog senior-living groups and hosts a senior-living podcast. He retires by rotation and is up for re-appointment at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Varun Gupta
people.since: With the company since 2008; current term 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2028
people.relation: Promoter; brother of MD Vishal Gupta and Joint MD Ankur Gupta
people.bio: Holds a B.S. in Finance from NYU's Stern School of Business (magna cum laude) and is an alumnus of Harvard Business School, a Kamalnayan Bajaj Fellow and a member of the Aspen Global Leadership Network. Before Ashiana he underwrote commercial real estate in commercial mortgage-backed securities at Citigroup in New York. He joined in 2008 and handles long-term strategy and project origination: buying land, structuring joint developments and conceiving new projects. He also oversees finance, legal and compliance, and introduced the company's kid-centric homes.

people.name: Vikash Dugar
people.since: With Ashiana for more than 11 years
people.bio: A graduate of Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi, and a law graduate, he is a chartered accountant, a company secretary and a member of the Insurance Institute of India. He has about 27 years of experience in finance, strategy, risk, audit and systems across real estate, telecom, hospitality, power, IT and education, including at Vodafone, the Tata group and NIIT. At Ashiana he runs corporate finance, tax, reporting, internal audit, investor relations, compliance and IT.

people.name: Shyamal Kumar Palit
people.bio: A civil engineering graduate with about 41 years of experience, 35 of them at Ashiana. He heads engineering and construction: design, planning and execution, procurement, environmental compliance and training of the engineering team. Before Ashiana he worked with Bridge & Building Construction Company and Hyundai Construction Corporation.

companies.changes: No change in KMP during FY26 or since. The Board proposed re-appointing independent director Krishna Suraj Moraje in August 2026. The company changed statutory auditors in May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder M. R. Jaishankar is Executive Chairman; his daughters run the business, Pavitra Shankar as MD (residential, finance) and Nirupa Shankar as Joint MD (hotels, offices, retail), and his nephew Amar Mysore is an Executive Director. Two long-serving professionals, Roshin Mathew and Pradyumna Krishna Kumar, are also executive directors. The promoter group owns 41.09% (March 2026). Half the 12-member board is independent.

people.name: M. R. Jaishankar
people.since: Founder; on the board since 8 November 1995
people.relation: Founder; father of MD Pavitra Shankar and Joint MD Nirupa Shankar; uncle of Executive Director Amar Mysore
people.stake: 14.13% (FY26 annual report); wife Githa Shankar 11.49%; promoter group together 41.09%
people.bio: Holds a Bachelor of Science and an MBA. He founded Brigade and has guided its growth across homes, offices, retail and hotels in south Indian cities for close to 40 years. He is the managing and lifetime trustee of the Brigade Foundation, which supports education, healthcare and community work. His honours include FKCCI's Sir M. Visvesvaraya award, an honorary doctorate from Bengaluru City University, the Nadaprabhu Kempegowda Rajya Award 2026 and lifetime-achievement awards from The Economic Times.

people.name: Pavitra Shankar
people.relation: Promoter; daughter of Executive Chairman M. R. Jaishankar; sister of Joint MD Nirupa Shankar
people.bio: Holds an MA in Economics and Mathematics from the University of Virginia and an MBA in Real Estate and Finance from Columbia Business School. Before Brigade she worked in consulting, private equity and real estate. As MD she leads the residential business and oversees strategy, sales, marketing, finance and customer experience. She is listed among Fortune India's and Business Today's most powerful women in business. She retires by rotation and is up for re-appointment at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Nirupa Shankar
people.relation: Promoter; daughter of Executive Chairman M. R. Jaishankar; sister of MD Pavitra Shankar
people.bio: Studied economics at the University of Virginia and hospitality management at Cornell University, and worked with Ernst & Young in the United States. She joined Brigade in 2009 and leads the hotel, office and retail businesses, as well as HR, public relations and innovation. She founded Brigade REAP, described as Asia's first real-estate start-up accelerator. She also draws a commission from the listed hotel subsidiary Brigade Hotel Ventures.

people.name: Amar Mysore
people.relation: Promoter group; nephew of Executive Chairman M. R. Jaishankar
people.bio: Holds a Master of Engineering from Pennsylvania State University, with earlier experience in supply-chain management, manufacturing and power. He joined Brigade in 2008 and leads business development and work with government and statutory bodies. He also supports the residential business, the Hyderabad expansion and renewable-energy buying, and is a non-executive director of Brigade Hotel Ventures.

people.name: Roshin Mathew
people.since: Heads engineering since 2007; board since 16 May 2018
people.stake: 0.03% (FY26 annual report), plus vested stock options
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in Civil Engineering from Kerala University and bachelor's and master's degrees in Building Engineering and Management from the School of Planning and Architecture, New Delhi. His career spans project management, civil construction and real-estate development. He has led Brigade's engineering function since 2007 and is the only executive director paid partly in stock options.

people.name: Pradyumna Krishna Kumar
people.since: With Brigade since 2009; board since 16 May 2018
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from the University of Madras and an MBA from the Asian Institute of Management, Manila. Since 2009 he has handled investor relations, private-equity partners and land acquisition, and has worked on several acquisitions. He was also interim CFO from October 2025 to February 2026 after the previous CFO left. He retires by rotation and is up for re-appointment at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Yogesh Patel
people.bio: A finance professional with over 25 years of experience, including about 10 years as CFO of listed companies and large business houses. He was CFO of HealthCare Global Enterprises (HCG) and, most recently, of Trianz Digital Consulting, where he also led legal, investor relations and secretarial work. He has also worked with Tata Advanced Systems, Mahindra Logistics, EY, Wipro and IBM India. His areas are corporate finance, M&A, risk and investor relations.

companies.changes: CFO Jayant Manmadkar resigned on 9 October 2025; Executive Director Pradyumna Krishna Kumar was interim CFO until Yogesh Patel joined on 2 February 2026. Since the annual report, Saroj Kumar Pati, President – Construction, resigned on 10 July 2026 for family reasons. Dr. Anurag Priyadarshi joined as Head – ESG in April 2026. A 1:3 bonus issue was approved in May 2026, so share counts rise but percentages do not change.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 1995 by PNC Menon (now Chairman Emeritus, not on the board). His son Ravi PNC Menon is non-executive Chairman; the promoters, Sobha Menon, PNC Menon and Ravi Menon, own about 52.85% (March 2026). Day-to-day running is by MD Jagadish Nangineni, a hired professional with Sobha since 2009, and Deputy MD Nisanth M N, a company veteran. No board member is related to another.

people.name: Jagadish Nangineni
people.since: Joined November 2009; MD since 1 April 2022; re-appointment proposed to 31 March 2032
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in Civil Engineering from IIT Bombay and an MBA (PGDM) from IIM Calcutta. Before Sobha he worked with technology and management-consulting firms. He joined Sobha in 2009 in senior strategy and operations roles, set up its Gurgaon operations, and as Deputy MD ran the Ahmedabad, Chennai, Gurgaon and Pune regions. He became MD in April 2022 and runs the company's operations and growth. The board has proposed a fresh five-year term from April 2027, for approval at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Nisanth M N
people.since: Joined October 2002; Deputy MD since 1 January 2025
people.bio: Completed a B.Tech in Civil Engineering from Government Engineering College, Thrissur, in 2002 and joined Sobha that October. He built his career in project execution, managing large teams, and was named best project execution head in 2015 and area head in 2016. He was Regional Head for Kerala and now oversees the Kerala, Mumbai, Pune and Gujarat operations. He joined the board as Deputy MD in January 2025, with a remit covering execution, business development, sales and customer relationships.

people.name: Yogesh Bansal
people.since: With Sobha since April 2011; CFO since September 2021
people.bio: A commerce graduate and chartered accountant (ICAI member) with over 20 years in finance, accounting, internal audit, controls, compliance and risk. Before Sobha he worked at a real-estate company and a consulting firm. He joined Sobha in April 2011 and ran finance for the NCR and Gujarat (GIFT City) regions before being made CFO in September 2021.

people.name: Raghu Balan
people.bio: Has headed quality, safety and technology at Sobha for over 11 years, after more than 15 years of project management in real estate and contracting. Earlier he was an assistant manager at Hindustan Construction Company in Mumbai and a planning engineer with Services & Trade Company in Oman.

people.name: Sumeet Chunkhare
people.bio: Holds an MBA in marketing and finance from IIM Lucknow and a B.Com from R.A. Podar College, Mumbai. He has over 15 years across FMCG, fintech and real estate, including ITC, Bayer (Monsanto Holdings) and the Lodha Group, before joining Sobha in November 2019.

companies.changes: Since the annual report: Chief Operating Officer Shanthi V (23 years at Sobha) left on 4 May 2026 'for better prospects', and Chief Design Officer Geetha K. Nair left the same day for personal reasons. The board approved Jagadish Nangineni's re-appointment as MD from April 2027. Chairman Ravi PNC Menon retires by rotation and seeks re-appointment at the 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Demerged from Raymond Ltd and listed on 1 July 2025. The Singhania promoter group owns 48.87%, mainly through J K Investors (Bombay) and other group companies. Gautam Hari Singhania is non-executive Chairman (he holds only 500 shares personally) and Gautam Trivedi is a second non-executive promoter-side director. The business is run by MD & CEO Harmohan Sahni, a hired chartered accountant who has led Raymond's realty arm since 2021, with a professional team. No family member holds an executive role.

people.name: Harmohan Sahni
people.since: CEO of Raymond's realty business from 2021; MD from 16 May 2025 to 15 May 2030
people.bio: A chartered accountant (ICAI) with more than 30 years in real estate and core sectors. He began at Tata Steel and later worked at JSW Aluminium, then held roles at Mahindra Lifespaces and GCorp Developers. Before Raymond he was COO of the real-estate business of ECL Finance (Edelweiss group). He joined Raymond as CEO of its realty business in 2021, when it was still a division of Raymond Ltd, and took it through the demerger and 2025 listing. He also remains a non-executive director of Raymond Ltd.

people.name: Ankur Jindal
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 24 years of experience across real estate, automotive and IT. He was named CFO and key managerial personnel of the listed company from May 2025, ahead of the demerger and listing, and signs its financial statements. The company has not published his earlier employers.

people.name: Sandeep Maheshwari
people.since: Senior management since 16 May 2025; board member until 21 May 2025
people.bio: A civil engineer with an MBA and more than 35 years in real estate. His expertise covers contracts, procurement, design, approvals (liaison) and construction. He sat on the company's board as a non-executive director before it was reorganised for listing in May 2025, and now runs operations and project delivery as COO.

people.name: Vishal Sharma
people.bio: Holds an MBA in marketing and has over 21 years of experience across real estate, aviation and media, having overseen several geographies across South Asia. He leads sales and marketing for the company's Thane and Mumbai projects.

companies.changes: The board was rebuilt in May 2025 for the listing: Gautam Singhania, Harmohan Sahni and Gautam Trivedi joined, and three earlier non-executive directors left on 21 May 2025. Independent director Virendrasingh Bisht joined in October 2025. No KMP changes since the annual report; the group named Salil Bawa as Group Head of Investor Relations in September 2026.

companies.styleNote: A family company: founder Ravi Puravankara is Executive Chairman, his son Ashish is Managing Director and his daughter Amanda joined the board as Whole-time Director in August 2025. The founder personally owns 75.00% (March 2026), the maximum allowed. Since Group CEO Abhishek Kapoor left in 2025, the family runs the company directly, with hired executives in finance, risk and the Provident (mid-market) arm. Half the board is independent.

people.name: Ravi Puravankara
people.since: Founder (business started in the early 1970s); re-appointed for five years from 1 April 2026
people.relation: Founder; father of MD Ashish Puravankara and Whole-time Director Amanda Puravankara
people.bio: He founded the business in the early 1970s and built it over five decades into a nationally known listed developer of premium homes, plots and offices. The company credits him with insisting on fully accounted transactions at a time when cash deals were common. His honours include CREDAI Karnataka's Lifetime Achievement Award 2023. He chairs the board's management sub-committee and retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Ashish Puravankara
people.since: MD; re-appointed for 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2031
people.relation: Promoter group; son of Chairman Ravi Puravankara; brother of Amanda Puravankara
people.bio: He has over two decades of leadership at the company and runs it day to day as MD, overseeing residential, commercial and plotted projects. He chairs the risk management committee and sits on the audit committee. His awards include Construction Week's Pride of India (2025) and Real Estate Person of the Year (South, 2023) and the Grohe-Hurun residential developer award (2023). The annual report does not state his education.

people.name: Amanda Joy Puravankara
people.relation: Promoter group; daughter of Chairman Ravi Puravankara; sister of MD Ashish Puravankara
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in psychology (Hons) from the University of Southampton, England, and completed the Executive General Management Programme at IIM Bangalore. Involved in the business from an early age, she oversees technology, customer initiatives, new business development and company culture, and works across the product cycle from land buying and design to launch. She leads the Devdan Trust and has won '40 Under 40' and Economic Times woman-achiever awards.

people.name: Niraj Kumar Gautam
people.bio: A finance executive with over 23 years in corporate finance, capital markets, tax and investor relations, mostly in real estate and infrastructure. The company says he has led capital raising of more than ₹15,000 crore. He was promoted to CFO in September 2025 after Group CFO Deepak Rastogi resigned for personal reasons. The company has not published his education or earlier employers.

people.name: Mallanna Sasalu
people.bio: A civil engineer and Harvard Business School alumnus with over 32 years in engineering, architecture and real-estate development in India and Canada. Before this role he scaled up Provident Housing, the group's mid-market subsidiary. He was named CEO – South in May 2025, the day Group CEO Abhishek Kapoor resigned, and joined the board of the Hyderabad subsidiary T-Hills in February 2026.

people.name: Amit Narain Ahuja
people.bio: A chartered accountant and certified Sarbanes-Oxley expert with about 26 years in risk and control. He has built and run risk and control functions in India, Asia and international markets for Wells Fargo, JP Morgan Chase, KPMG, Deloitte and Ernst & Young. He joined in May 2026 as Chief Risk Officer.

companies.changes: Group CEO and Executive Director Abhishek Kapoor resigned in May 2025 (relieved 15 June 2025). Group CFO Deepak Rastogi resigned on 23 September 2025; Niraj Kumar Gautam replaced him. Amanda Puravankara joined the board in August 2025. Since the annual report: Amit Narain Ahuja joined as Chief Risk Officer (May 2026), Subrahmanya Gupta Boda as Chief Technology Officer (May 2026), and Vishnu Moorthi H, SVP Risk and Control, retired on 15 September 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founded and run by film producer Anand Pandit, Chairman & MD, who personally owns 72.02% (March 2026). His daughter Ashka Pandit is Whole-time Director and her husband Paarth Chheda an Executive Director from 1 October 2026; Anand's wife Roopa Pandit left the board the same day. A hired CEO and CFO run finance and operations.

people.name: Anand Kamalnayan Pandit
people.relation: Founder and promoter; husband of director Roopa Pandit; father of Whole-time Director Ashka Pandit; father-in-law of Paarth Chheda
people.stake: 72.02% (FY26 annual report); wife and daughter each hold about 10,000 shares
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electronics and communication engineering from the University of Gujarat and a diploma in marketing management, and completed Harvard Business School's executive real-estate programme. He has over 24 years in Mumbai real estate, building luxury projects and redevelopments in western suburbs such as Juhu. He was earlier a director of Bank of Maharashtra, HUDCO and Syndicate Bank. He is also a well-known Bollywood film producer and distributor through Anand Pandit Motion Pictures, and film personalities invested in the company before its 2025 IPO.

people.name: Ashka Anand Pandit
people.relation: Promoter; daughter of Chairman & MD Anand Pandit and director Roopa Pandit; wife of Paarth Chheda
people.bio: Holds a BBA from Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies and master's degrees in real estate from NYU and in economics and international financial economics from the University of Warwick. She worked in real estate in New York before moving to India about a decade ago to join the family business. She has about nine years in real estate and has helped grow the brand and modernise it. She retires by rotation and seeks re-appointment at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Paarth Chheda
people.role: Executive Director (from 1 October 2026); President, Business Development
people.since: With Lotus Developers for almost a decade
people.relation: Son-in-law of Anand and Roopa Pandit; husband of Ashka Pandit
people.bio: Graduated as an architect from the Illinois Institute of Technology, Chicago. He has worked at Lotus Developers for almost ten years, bringing in new technology, design and value additions across its projects, and heads business development as senior management. He is a designated partner in Caproot Ventures LLP. Shareholders approved him as an Executive Director for five years from 1 October 2026 at the 29 September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Sanjay Kumar Jain
people.bio: A fellow chartered accountant (ICAI) with more than 28 years in finance and accounts, including over 14 years in real estate. He is one of the company's key managerial personnel and signs its financial statements alongside the MD and CFO. The company has not published his earlier employers.

people.name: Rakesh Kailash Gupta
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com from the University of Rajasthan and over 18 years in finance. He was named among CEO Insights magazine's top 10 finance heads of 2024. The company has not published his earlier employers.

companies.changes: Paarth Chheda (son-in-law of the promoter) became an Executive Director on 1 Oct 2026 after shareholders approved him at the 29 Sep AGM; Roopa Pandit (promoter, non-executive director) resigned on 1 Oct 2026 citing personal commitments. Three family members remain on the board.

companies.styleNote: The Max Group's real estate arm. Founder Analjit Singh is the non-executive Chairman; his son-in-law Sahil Vachani, also a named promoter, runs it as Vice Chairman & Managing Director and is the only executive director. New York Life owns about a fifth and has a board nominee. Promoter entities and family held about 45% at March 2026.

people.name: Sahil Vachani
people.since: Joined the Max Group in 2016; has led Max Estates since it was set up
people.relation: Promoter; son-in-law of the Chairman Analjit Singh
people.stake: nil in his own name (FY26 annual report); promoter group about 45%, held mainly through Max Ventures Investment Holding (21.9%) and Siva Enterprises (20.8%)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in management sciences from the University of Warwick (2003). He began as an investment banker at Citigroup in London, working on mergers and acquisitions across the Middle East and Africa. In 2004 he joined Dixon Technologies as a business head, and later co-founded and ran Dixon Appliances, building its products, team and factory and winning brands such as Panasonic, Godrej and LG as customers. He joined the Max Group in 2016 as MD & CEO of Max Ventures & Industries, from which Max Estates was built and later listed. He is also a non-executive director of Max Financial Services and Axis Max Life Insurance.

people.name: Nitin Kumar Kansal
people.since: CFO; in office through FY26 with no change
people.bio: A chartered accountant (ICAI associate) with more than 17 years in finance and commercial roles. He has held senior roles in hospitality and real estate, including as a project controller at Emaar MGF Land. At Max Estates he is the CFO and a key managerial person, and sits on the Risk Management Committee. His pay rose 60% in FY26 including exercised stock options, or 11.4% without them.

people.name: Vachan Singh
people.bio: Holds a BE (Hons) in civil engineering from BITS Pilani and attended an executive leadership programme at the Ross School of Business, Michigan. He has more than 35 years in project management and execution. Before Max Estates he was COO and business head at Adani Realty, running a portfolio of about 35 million sq ft, and earlier held senior roles at Oberoi Realty, L&T Realty, Mahagun, Tata Housing and DLF. He leads project delivery, the company's main gap given its thin delivery record.

people.name: Arihant Kothari
people.bio: A real estate private equity professional with more than 17 years across portfolio management, asset management, investor relations and capital raising in India and the UK. His earlier experience includes work with Tishman Speyer. He was named senior management at Max Estates in February 2026 to lead capital strategy.

people.name: Dharmender Kumar
people.bio: Listed by the company as senior management, appointed Director and Chief Corporate Affairs Officer from 1 November 2025. The annual report gives no further profile.

companies.changes: COO Rishi Raj left on 30 Sep 2025 (replaced by Vachan Singh). Head of Digital & IT Vikram Vij resigned, effective 30 Jul 2026. New York Life's nominee Anthony Malloy left the board on 22 May 2026; Jillian Moo-Young replaced him.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Ajmera family. Rajnikant Ajmera is Chairman & MD; Manoj Ajmera is MD and Sanjay Ajmera is a whole-time director. Several other family members (Bandish, Ashwin, Nimish and Dhaval Ajmera) are director-level senior managers. The annual report says no director is a 'relative' of another under the Companies Act, but Dhaval is the Chairman's son. Promoters own 68.2%.

people.name: Rajnikant S. Ajmera
people.since: Board since 6 October 1986; called Founder & CMD by the group
people.relation: Promoter; father of Dhaval Ajmera
people.stake: nil in his own name; shown as beneficial owner of 1,87,46,860 shares (about 9.5%) as trustee and beneficiary of the ARIIL Trust (FY26 AGM notice); promoter group 68.2%
people.bio: A civil engineer, aged 73, with more than 50 years in construction and real estate. He worked alongside the group's late founder Chhotubhai Ajmera to deliver housing colonies, and has led the group's growth into residential and commercial development. He has been President of MCHI (Maharashtra Chamber of Housing Industry) and Vice President and President of CREDAI, and led CORSMA, the cold-rolled steel makers' body. He is a core committee member of MahaRERA's Conciliation Forum. His pay is being raised for the rest of his term, with shareholder approval sought at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Manoj I. Ajmera
people.since: Board since 24 April 2012; reappointment for 3 years from April 2027 proposed
people.relation: Promoter family member; a trustee of the ARIIL Trust
people.stake: 1,70,000 shares in his own name (about 0.09%); shown as beneficial owner of 1,29,21,730 shares (about 6.6%) as trustee and beneficiary of the ARIIL Trust (FY26 AGM notice)
people.bio: A graduate, aged 64, with about 44 years in real estate. He leads strategic planning, capital allocation, fundraising, business development and growth, and also handles legal matters on several projects. He was honoured at the Construction World Architect & Builder Awards in 2025.

people.name: Sanjay C. Ajmera
people.since: Board since 24 April 2012; reappointment for 3 years from April 2027 proposed
people.relation: Promoter family member
people.stake: 1,07,000 shares in his own name (about 0.05%); shown as beneficial owner of 1,22,36,490 shares (about 6.2%) as a beneficiary of the ARIIL Trust (FY26 AGM notice)
people.bio: Holds an MBA, is 60, and has worked in the group for about 35 years. His work is business development and dealing with government and municipal authorities for project approvals. He leads the group's Pune projects and takes part in its Mumbai redevelopment projects.

people.name: Nitin D. Bavisi
people.since: CFO (group CFO); in office through FY26
people.bio: A chartered accountant, ICAI-registered valuer and professional member of RICS, UK, with more than 25 years in finance, tax and accounting. Before Ajmera he worked at Orbit Corporation and Acme Realties and practised independently. He sat on ICAI study groups that wrote the guidance note on real estate accounting (2011–12) and on Ind AS 115 for real estate (2015–16). He joined the Risk Management Committee during FY26.

people.name: Dhaval R. Ajmera
people.since: Joined the group in 2003; senior management of the listed company from 1 October 2026
people.relation: Son of the Chairman Rajnikant Ajmera
people.bio: Holds an MBA in finance from Cardiff University, UK, and joined the group in 2003. He handles strategic planning, business development, liaison, investor and public relations, marketing and sales, and was Director – Corporate Affairs at the subsidiary Jolly Brothers. The group credits him with launching Ajmera Pristine, Regalia and the Yogi Nagar township, and with work in London and Bahrain. He is Honorary Vice President of CREDAI National and CREDAI-MCHI. The board moved him into the listed company from 1 Oct 2026 at ₹2–2.5cr a year, a related-party appointment put to the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Bandish B. Ajmera
people.since: With the group for almost four decades
people.relation: Promoter family member
people.bio: Has spent almost 40 years in the group, running administration and human resources, and worked on its Shastri Nagar (Rajkot), Yogi Nagar (Borivali) and Yogi Dham (Kalyan) projects. He was the founding president of CREDAI-MCHI's Kalyan-Dombivli unit, its honorary secretary in 2018–20 and then a senior vice president of its managing committee.

people.name: Nimish S. Ajmera
people.since: With the group for about 14 years
people.relation: Promoter family member (full name Nimish Shashikant Ajmera)
people.bio: Heads the IT, projects, planning, purchase, solar and redevelopment departments, according to the group. He is described as leading technology and office-automation work across the company.

companies.changes: Dhaval Ajmera joins the listed company as Director – Corporate Affairs from 1 Oct 2026. Ashwin B. Ajmera (Director – Business Development) is also senior management but not listed here. One senior manager resigned effective 31 Mar 2026 (per the FY26 report).

companies.styleNote: M. Murali, who built the business for the Shriram Group, is Chairman & MD and a named promoter; he is the only executive on the board. Day-to-day running is shared with a hired team led by the Executive Director & Group CEO Gopalakrishnan J. Murali's son Akshay works in the company. Promoters held 27.9% at March 2026, of which Murali 21.1% directly and through Shriram Properties Holdings (27.0% by the report date).

people.name: M. Murali (Murali Malayappan)
people.since: Built the business from its start for the Shriram Group
people.relation: Promoter; father of Akshay Murali
people.stake: 0.08% directly (1,39,006 shares); 21.13% directly and through Shriram Properties Holdings at March 2026, rising to 27.04% by the date of the FY26 report; promoter group 27.89%
people.bio: An alumnus of IIM Bangalore and Harvard Business School, with more than 36 years of experience. He built Shriram Properties from scratch as the Shriram Group's real estate business and took it to its 2021 listing. He is the only executive director on the board and a named promoter. He has raised his stake through Shriram Properties Holdings during 2026.

people.name: Gopalakrishnan J.
people.since: Joined 2 April 2018 as ED & Group CFO; Group CEO since 20 July 2024
people.bio: Holds a BSc from the University of Madras and an MBA from Madurai Kamaraj University. He has more than 31 years in corporate finance, mergers, restructuring and capital-markets and debt financing. Before Shriram he worked at Reliance Industries, the Aditya Birla Group, W.I. Carr Securities, Credit Agricole Indosuez, Canbank Mutual Fund and Dalal Consultants and Engineers. He joined as Group CFO in 2018, played a key part in the 2021 IPO, and was made Group CEO in July 2024. 'Executive Director' is his job title; he does not sit on the listed company's board.

people.name: Ravindra Kumar Pandey
