people.bio: A chartered accountant (ICAI associate) with a bachelor's degree from the University of Allahabad and more than 22 years of post-qualification experience, 18 of them in real estate finance. Before Shriram he worked at Sobha, Skyline, Rolastar and Kavveri Telecom. He has led finance and treasury since 2017 and is credited with refinancing that changed the lender mix and cut borrowing costs. He took over the whole finance and accounts function after the deputy CFO left in February 2026.

people.name: K.R. Ramesh
people.since: Joined 8 August 2007; current role since 20 July 2024
people.bio: A chartered accountant (ICAI associate) with a commerce degree from Annamalai University. He was a financial controller at Southern Automatic Industries, Sun Beverages and Varun Beverages before joining in 2007. He ran operations as ED – Operations before moving to strategy and corporate development in July 2024.

people.name: T.V. Ganesh
people.bio: Holds a BTech and an MBA in finance from BITS Pilani and a diploma in mechanical engineering. He has more than 33 years in construction, mostly at Larsen & Toubro, where he worked on Microsoft buildings in Hyderabad, Hyderabad Metro depots and the Al Rayyan Stadium project in Doha; he also worked at High Energy Batteries. He runs technical and construction delivery at Shriram.

people.name: Krishna Veeraraghavan
people.bio: A civil engineering graduate of Bangalore University with more than 31 years in construction and construction management. He previously worked at B.M. Constructions, IVRCL Infrastructure, KETI Constructions, JMC Projects, SSPDL and Tata Consulting Engineers. He runs operations in Bengaluru, the company's main market.

people.name: Akshay Murali
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD M. Murali
people.bio: Holds an MBA in private equity and real estate from Columbia Business School. He worked with senior management on the 2021 IPO before his MBA, and rejoined in 2025. He works on land deals, deal structuring and new cities, and led the company's entry into Pune. He is paid ₹70 lakh a year as a permanent employee, a related-party arrangement approved by the board.

companies.changes: Deputy CFO Rajesh Shirwatkar resigned effective 16 Feb 2026; national head of customer experience Shekar H.K. resigned effective 7 Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Pankaj Bajaj, the promoter, is Chairman & MD and the only executive director; he also runs the unlisted group company Eldeco Infrastructure & Properties (EIPL), which is a promoter and has borrowed from the listed company. A small hired team (COO, CFO) runs operations. Group director Shrikant Jajodia sits on the board as a non-executive. Promoters own 54.8%: Pankaj Bajaj 34.3% and Bandana Kohli, a promoter-group member, 20.0%.

people.name: Pankaj Bajaj
people.since: Joined the group in 1996; reappointed CMD for 5 years from 14 May 2026
people.relation: Promoter; also Managing Director of promoter company EIPL
people.stake: 34.32% (33,74,735 shares; FY26 annual report); promoter group 54.83%
people.bio: A graduate of Shri Ram College of Commerce and IIM Ahmedabad. He joined the Eldeco Group in 1996 and founded Eldeco Infrastructure & Properties in 2000, which took the group into Delhi NCR. The group says it has completed more than 200 projects under him. He has served several terms as President of CREDAI NCR. He runs both the listed Lucknow company and the larger unlisted NCR business, so related-party dealings between the two (such as the ₹52.3cr loan to EIPL, since repaid) are worth watching. His pay rose 25% in FY26.

people.name: Surendra Kumar Jaggi
people.since: COO of the listed company; senior management at March 2026
people.bio: Has more than three decades in real estate, with a background in sales and marketing. Before Eldeco he held leadership roles at Ansal Housing, Ansal API and Emaar MGF. He runs operations of the listed company in Lucknow.

people.name: Kapil Saluja
people.bio: Has been CFO and a key managerial person since April 2021, and signs the company's accounts and compliance certificates with the CMD. His pay rose 21.7% in FY26. The company does not publish a fuller profile.

people.name: Ijharul Haq Siddiqui
people.bio: Named by the company as senior management, leading business development and public relations. The annual report gives no further profile.

companies.changes: Vice President (Projects & Planning) Pankaj Jain resigned effective 14 Sep 2025; Sanjay Kumar joined in the same role from 1 Sep 2025.

companies.styleNote: Run by four founder brothers, all executive directors: Pradeep Kumar Aggarwal (Chairman), Lalit Kumar Aggarwal (Vice Chairman), Ravi Aggarwal (MD) and Devender Aggarwal (Joint MD). A hired CEO, CFO and COO run daily operations. Six next-generation family members carry the title 'director' on the company's website but are not on the board. Promoters own 56.5%.

people.name: Pradeep Kumar Aggarwal
people.relation: Founder; brother of Lalit Kumar, Ravi and Devender Aggarwal
people.stake: 6.55% personally plus 3.29% through his HUF (March 2026); promoter group 56.52%, including 17.33% held by Sarvpriya Securities
people.bio: Completed senior secondary school in Haldwani. Before real estate he worked with Paywell Securities for five years and was managing director of SMC Comtrade, a subsidiary of SMC Global Securities, for ten years, overseeing its capital-market and commodity businesses. He founded Signatureglobal, which grew from affordable housing in Gurugram into mid-income and premium homes and listed in 2023. He chairs the ASSOCHAM National Council on Real Estate, Housing & Urban Development.

people.name: Lalit Kumar Aggarwal
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Pradeep Kumar, Ravi and Devender Aggarwal
people.bio: Completed senior secondary school (CBSE, Delhi). Before Signatureglobal he spent six years with Signatureglobal Comtrade (formerly P.P. Comtrade). The company says he leads its sustainability strategy, and he has been named sustainable business leader of the year at industry forums.

people.name: Ravi Aggarwal
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Pradeep Kumar, Lalit Kumar and Devender Aggarwal
people.bio: A fellow chartered accountant (FCA). He worked for a year at Paywell Securities and for over a year at SAM Global Securities (later merged into SMC Global Securities), on arbitrage and share-broking operations. He is MD of the listed company and a director of many group companies. The 2023 IPO papers listed a pending consumer case and a regulatory notice against him.

people.name: Devender Aggarwal
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Pradeep Kumar, Lalit Kumar and Ravi Aggarwal
people.bio: Completed secondary school in Delhi. He then spent more than seven years at SMC Global Securities, where he ran the arbitrage business. He is Joint MD and a director of several group companies.

people.name: Rajat Kathuria
people.bio: A chartered accountant and commerce graduate from the University of Delhi, with more than 20 years in finance, strategy and consulting. Before Signatureglobal he held leadership roles at Ernst & Young and KPMG India, advising real estate and infrastructure clients. He led the company's 2023 IPO and its shift towards mid-income and premium housing. The company had lent him ₹1.5cr interest-free at March 2026 (₹2cr a year earlier).

people.name: Sanjeev Kumar Sharma
people.bio: A chartered accountant (qualified 1997) with about 30 years in financial planning, M&A, investor relations, financing, treasury and tax. He has worked across real estate, asset management, oil and gas, manufacturing and banking, at Brookfield Properties, Blackstone, BPTP, M3M India, Apollo Tyres, JK Paper and ICICI Bank.

people.name: Sanjay Kumar Varshney
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in civil engineering from Rani Durgavati University, Jabalpur, an MSc in consultancy management from BITS Pilani and an MTech from Barkatullah University, Bhopal. He has more than 25 years in construction and real estate, including 13 years at HUDCO on housing, infrastructure and disaster-management projects. He runs construction and delivery.

companies.changes: President – Sales Sandeep Kumar Mittal resigned effective 31 Aug 2026, and Chief Business Officer – Sales & Marketing Amit Kaicker resigned effective 3 Sep 2026, both citing personal reasons. Earlier, a senior president – sales left in May 2025 and the president – legal in Nov 2025.

companies.styleNote: Amit Mangilal Jain, the promoter, has headed Arkade since 1995 and is Chairman & MD with 66.7% of the shares; the business was earlier led by Mangilal Jain. Two whole-time directors, Sandeep Jain and Arpit Jain, each own about 5.5% but are not classed as promoters, and the annual report says no director is related to another. The CMD lent money to the company during FY26, since repaid. Promoter group 71.1%.

people.name: Amit Mangilal Jain
people.relation: Promoter
people.stake: 66.71% (12,38,57,808 shares; FY26 annual report); promoter group 71.14%
people.bio: A science graduate from Mumbai University. He has led Arkade since 1995, building it into a Mumbai developer of residential and redevelopment projects in the western and central suburbs, and took it public in 2024. He chairs the CSR committee and supports education, healthcare and welfare through the Sajjan Jain Support Trust. During FY26 he lent money to the company, which was repaid in the year.

people.name: Sandeep Ummedmal Jain
people.relation: Not related to other directors, per the FY26 annual report
people.bio: An engineering graduate who leads Arkade's design, construction and legal work. He is also involved with the Sajjan Jain Support Trust's healthcare and education work.

people.name: Arpit Vikram Jain
people.relation: Not related to other directors, per the FY26 annual report
people.stake: 5.54% (1,02,87,000 shares, up from 1,02,60,000 a year earlier; FY26 annual report)
people.bio: A chartered accountant who joined Arkade in 2015. He has driven its digital and process changes and oversees finance, accounts, HR, marketing, sales and customer relations. He also lent money to the company during FY26, since repaid, and works with the Sajjan Jain Support Trust.

people.name: Samshet Balkrishna Shetye
people.bio: Before Arkade he was an Assistant Vice President at Nykaa and an Assistant General Manager at Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri, and earlier a consultant at DPSY & Associates setting up accounting systems. He presents results with the CMD on the company's earnings calls.

companies.changes: No KMP changes found since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: A family company. Founder Rajan Thomas has been MD since 1986 and is Chairman; his son Rahul Thomas is the only other executive director. His wife Sujatha Thomas and daughter Elizabeth Lavanya Thomas sit on the board as non-executive directors. The company reported no senior management below the KMP at March 2026. Promoters own 69.8%, of which Rajan Thomas 57.1%.

people.name: Rajan Meenathakonil Thomas
people.since: Founder; MD since 10 September 1986; reappointment for 5 years from 1 October 2026 put to the 2026 AGM
people.relation: Founder; husband of director Sujatha Thomas; father of Rahul Thomas and director Elizabeth Lavanya Thomas
people.stake: 57.11% (2,72,82,000 shares; FY26 annual report); promoter group 69.80%
people.bio: Holds a BA from Agra University. He founded Suraj Estate and has run it as MD since 1986, building it into a south-central Mumbai developer focused on redevelopment of cessed buildings, and took it public in 2023. He turns 70 in December 2026, so his reappointment needs a special resolution; the board has also sought approval for promoter pay above 5% of net profit for three years.

people.name: Rahul Rajan Jesu Thomas
people.since: Current term ends 30 November 2026; reappointment put to the 2026 AGM
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD Rajan Thomas; brother of director Elizabeth Lavanya Thomas
people.bio: Holds a BCom from the University of Mumbai and a corporate finance certificate from Harvard. He has long experience in the family's real estate business and works across its operations and expansion. He is the next-generation executive in a company where the founder holds most of the shares.

people.name: Shreepal Shah
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in engineering and an MBA. Before Suraj Estate he worked with P. Raj & Co. and in Kotak's investment banking business on finance, strategy and fundraising. He has been CFO since December 2021 and helped take the company through its 2023 IPO. The rise in FY26 managerial pay was mostly a performance incentive paid to him.

companies.changes: Chief Engineer Gopal Barve was reported to have resigned effective 29 Apr 2026. Warrants issued earlier were forfeited after March 2026 for non-payment (₹49.9cr of upfront money kept by the company).

companies.styleNote: Run by the Chhajer family. Ashokkumar Chhajer is Chairman & MD, and his sons Parth and Bhavik Chhajer were made Joint Managing Directors in May 2026. Nimish Shah, a non-family engineer, is a whole-time director. Promoters own 71.1% (June 2026): Ashokkumar 28.6%, Parth 14.1%, Bhavik 13.9% and Sangita Chhajer 14.5%.

people.name: Ashokkumar B. Chhajer
people.relation: Promoter; father of Parth and Bhavik Chhajer
people.stake: 28.64% (1,23,88,237 shares; June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group 71.1%
people.bio: An entrepreneur with more than 30 years in real estate; he has also run businesses in textiles and oil refining. He leads corporate strategy, project design, land buying and relations with lenders and other stakeholders. He has chaired the company since 2011 and in 2026 handed the Joint MD roles to his two sons.

people.name: Parth Chhajer
people.since: Whole-time Director from 23 July 2022; Joint MD from 15 May 2026 (5-year term, subject to shareholders)
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD Ashokkumar Chhajer; brother of Bhavik Chhajer
people.bio: Holds a BSc in economics from Pennsylvania State University. Before joining the family business around 2018 he worked in capital markets and risk services at CLSA, Equirus and Deloitte. He leads product development, marketing and sales strategy, and is closely involved in finance and investor relations.

people.name: Bhavik Chhajer
people.since: Joined 2020; Whole-time Director from 24 May 2025; Joint MD from 15 May 2026 (5-year term, subject to shareholders)
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD Ashokkumar Chhajer; brother of Parth Chhajer
people.bio: Holds a BSc in business from Indiana State University. He worked with HDFC Red and Jones Lang LaSalle on real estate before joining Arihant in 2020. He oversees construction, procurement and human resources.

people.name: Nimish Shah
people.since: Board since 13 April 2010; reappointed for 5 years from 13 April 2025
people.bio: In his early 50s, a civil engineer and a graduate of the Kelley School of Business, Indianapolis, with more than 22 years in construction. He was a government-registered contractor in Maharashtra and built water-supply and sewerage schemes for the state government. At Arihant he leads engineering: planning, execution, estimation, contracts and site organisation. He chaired the CSR committee in FY25.

people.name: Udit Kasera
people.bio: Works across investor relations, treasury, corporate finance, audit and investment banking. Before Arihant he worked at KPMG, Wipro, CRISIL, Deloitte and the CarePal Group. He replaced Dhiraj Jopat, who left in August 2025.

companies.changes: Parth and Bhavik Chhajer became Joint MDs from 15 May 2026. CFO Dhiraj Jopat resigned effective 4 Aug 2025 and Udit Kasera took over on 12 Aug 2025. Independent director Namrata Thakker resigned effective 7 May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by two brothers, sons of the late founder Govindbhai Patel: Dipakkumar Patel is Chairman & Whole-time Director and Shekhar Patel is MD & CEO. Dipakkumar's children Aneri and Anmol and Shekhar's son Amanvir sit on the board as non-executive directors. A long-serving team of presidents runs projects, legal, sales and treasury. Promoters own 73.1%.

people.name: Dipakkumar G. Patel
people.relation: Promoter; son of founder Govindbhai Patel; brother of Shekhar Patel; father of directors Aneri and Anmol Patel
people.stake: 33.11% (2,76,08,752 shares; FY26 annual report); promoter group 73.06%
people.bio: An undergraduate, aged 58, with more than 33 years in Ahmedabad real estate. He has been with the company since 1991 and is described as one of its founding figures. He leads land acquisition and government relations, and administers company policies, finance and procurement. He founded SHATAYU, an organ-donation awareness campaign, in 2004. Shareholders were asked at the 2026 AGM to approve material related-party transactions with him.

people.name: Shekhar G. Patel
people.relation: Promoter; son of founder Govindbhai Patel; brother of Dipakkumar Patel; father of director Amanvir Patel
people.bio: Has more than 31 years in real estate and has been with the company since 1994. He runs day-to-day management and sets strategic direction. Shareholders were asked at the 2026 AGM to approve material related-party transactions with him, his wife Archana and his son Amanvir. SEBI sent the company a warning letter in April 2025 over related-party approvals and disclosures in FY22–FY23.

people.name: Rajendra Shah
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant (CA, ICWA) with more than 31 years in finance. He joined in 2017 and oversaw the company's move from high debt to a debt-free balance sheet.

people.name: Pankaj Teraiya
people.bio: A civil engineer (BE) with more than 29 years in construction and project management. He is responsible for delivering the company's residential and commercial projects.

people.name: Vijay Lalaji
people.bio: Holds a BCom and LLB and is a fellow company secretary (FCS), with about 40 years in legal and governance work. He handles regulatory compliance and RERA matters.

people.name: Viren Mehta
people.bio: Holds an MCom in marketing and management from MS University, with more than 27 years of experience. He joined in 2024 to lead the go-to-market strategy for the next growth phase.

people.name: Rajendra Patel
people.bio: Has about 45 years in real estate and treasury and is the longest-serving member of the team, with the group since 1976. The company calls him the custodian of its conservative finances.

companies.changes: No KMP changes found since the FY26 annual report (August 2026).

companies.styleNote: The listed arm of the Shah family's Marathon Group. Chetan Shah is Chairman & MD; the next generation, Kaivalya Shah and Samyag Shah, are whole-time directors. Vice-Chairman Mayur Shah and Shailaja Shah sit on the board as non-executive promoter directors; the annual report says all five are relatives. Promoters own 56.4% after the QIP, mostly through Marathon Realty Pvt Ltd (51.2%), the promoter company the listed firm has lent ₹822.9cr to.

people.name: Chetan R. Shah
people.since: Promoter; shareholders approved continuing as CMD past age 70
people.relation: Promoter; relative of Mayur, Shailaja, Kaivalya and Samyag Shah (FY26 annual report)
people.stake: 0.74% (5,00,300 shares) in his own name at March 2026; promoter group 56.37%, of which Marathon Realty Pvt Ltd 51.15%
people.bio: Holds a BTech in civil engineering from IIT Bombay and an MS in structural engineering from the University of Houston. He has more than four decades in real estate and has steered the group's large developments with close control of execution. He has been President of the Lions Club. He is also a non-executive director of the group's other listed company, Citadel Realty and Developers. He leads the company while it has large on-demand loans outstanding to the promoter holding company and a merger of promoter entities pending at the NCLT.

people.name: Kaivalya C. Shah
people.since: With the company for more than 15 years
people.relation: Promoter family; son of the CMD (Kaivalya Chetan Shah), relative of Mayur, Shailaja and Samyag Shah per the annual report
people.bio: Graduated in structural engineering from the University of California, San Diego. He has worked in the company for more than 15 years and leads its urban-renewal and redevelopment work, including its slum-rehabilitation strategy.

people.name: Samyag M. Shah
people.since: With the company for more than 12 years
people.relation: Promoter family; son of Vice-Chairman Mayur Shah (Samyag Mayur Shah), relative of Chetan, Shailaja and Kaivalya Shah per the annual report
people.bio: Holds a BA in economics from the University of California, San Diego. He has worked in the company for more than 12 years and led developments including Marathon Futurex (offices) and Marathon Nexzone (Panvel).

people.name: Suyash Bhise
people.bio: A chartered accountant with certificates in business management, insurance and risk management, and US GAAP. He has more than 20 years in fundraising, private equity, forex hedging, planning, M&A, valuation and tax. He previously worked at Puranik Builders, Hinduja Realty Ventures and The Phoenix Mills. He was CFO through the ₹900cr QIP that cleared the company's bank debt.

companies.changes: Assistant General Manager – Marketing Deepak Ramakrishna resigned effective 12 Jun 2026. No change in KMP found since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: A family business. The founder Ram Chandra Agarwal is Chairman & MD; his wife Uma Agarwal is a whole-time director and his son Akash Agarwal is whole-time director and CEO. The family and its companies (mainly Ricon Commodities, 35.3%) owned 51.4% at March 2026. The hired CEO Manshu Tandon left in April 2025 and the son took over; two outside presidents for buying and store operations joined in August 2026.

people.name: Ram Chandra Agarwal
people.since: Board since 2001 (founder); re-appointed MD for five years from 22 November 2026
people.relation: Founder; husband of Uma Agarwal and father of Akash Agarwal
people.stake: 5.17% (1,88,39,620 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 51.4%
people.bio: A commerce graduate, born in 1965, with more than 30 years in retailing. He founded Vishal Retail, which listed in 2007; after heavy short-term borrowing and the 2008 downturn, the business was sold to TPG and the Shriram Group in 2011 for about ₹70cr. He then restarted with the V2 chain on a smaller scale, promising slower expansion, tighter stock control and outsourced manufacturing. He has been on this company's board since 2001 and the company credits him with pioneering value retailing in India. He won the Ernst & Young Entrepreneur of the Year award in 2008. He holds no other listed directorships.

people.name: Akash Agarwal
people.since: Board since September 2017; whole-time director since August 2023; CEO since 27 May 2025
people.relation: Son of Ram Chandra Agarwal and Uma Agarwal
people.bio: Holds a BBA from Lancaster University, UK, and an International MBA from IE Business School, Spain. He has more than ten years in retail, all within the family business. He joined the board as a non-executive director in 2017 and became a whole-time director in August 2023, looking after e-commerce, buying and finance. He took the CEO title in May 2025 after the hired CEO Manshu Tandon resigned.

people.name: Uma Agarwal
people.relation: Wife of Ram Chandra Agarwal; mother of Akash Agarwal
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in arts and has more than 16 years in the retail industry. She has been on the board since the company was formed in 2001 and oversees its marketing strategy. No outside career is disclosed.

people.name: Pratik Adukia
people.since: With the company since 2011; CFO since 10 February 2023
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Calcutta University with about 20 years in retail. He has worked at V2 since 2011 in buying, finance and project roles, and was head of buying before being made CFO in February 2023. He is also a director of V2 Conglomerate, a promoter-group company.

people.name: Dinesh Malpani
people.bio: A commerce graduate and alumnus of the Indian School of Business with about 30 years in retail. He was CEO of Jubilant Retail and of Sabka Bazaar, retail head at Hiranandani Retail, and an executive vice-president at Mahindra Retail, UrDoorStep.com and, earlier, V2 Retail itself. His background is in store operations, omnichannel and buying across small-town markets. He rejoined V2 in August 2026 to run store operations.

people.name: Manu Agarwal
people.bio: A retail buyer with about 25 years of experience in buying, sourcing, merchandise planning, product development and stock management. Before V2 he held senior management roles at Aarkey Retail. At V2 he runs buying, assortment planning, sourcing, pricing and stock control. The company discloses no family link to the promoters.

companies.changes: CEO Manshu Tandon resigned on 28 April 2025; Akash Agarwal became CEO on 27 May 2025. Dinesh Malpani (President – Operations) and Manu Agarwal (President – Buying & Merchandising) were appointed on 13 August 2026. Ram Chandra Agarwal's re-appointment as MD from 22 November 2026 goes to shareholders.

companies.styleNote: Founder-led. Co-founder Dinesh Chandra Agarwal is MD & CEO and his cousin Brijesh Kumar Agrawal is a whole-time director; together they own about 47% and the promoter group about 49%. The board has no executive chairman, and daily functions (finance, operations, product, strategy) are run by long-serving hired executives. The lawyer Manoj Bhargava joined the board as a third whole-time director in January 2025.

people.name: Dinesh Chandra Agarwal
people.since: Founder (started IndiaMART in 1996); on the board since the company's incorporation in 1999
people.relation: Co-founder; cousin of Brijesh Kumar Agrawal
people.stake: 28.01% (1,68,27,523 shares, FY26 annual report); with Brijesh Agrawal about 47%, promoter group about 49%
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in computer science from Harcourt Butler Technological Institute, Kanpur. Before starting IndiaMART he worked at CMC, the Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DOT), HCL-Hewlett-Packard, HCL and HCL America in the US. He built IndiaMART into India's largest online marketplace for business buyers and suppliers and took it public in 2019. He is an active angel investor in start-ups, sits on the governing council of the Internet and Mobile Association of India (since 2015), and is also a director of IB MonotaRO.

people.name: Brijesh Kumar Agrawal
people.role: Whole-time Director (Corporate Development and New Initiatives)
people.since: On the board since incorporation (13 September 1999)
people.relation: Co-founder; cousin of Dinesh Chandra Agarwal
people.bio: Holds a degree in management science from the University of Lucknow and a postgraduate diploma in business management from NIILM, New Delhi. He has about 31 years in internet, networking and systems development, and earlier worked at H N Miebach Logistics India. He has been a director since the company was formed and now leads corporate development and new initiatives, including the accounting-software subsidiary Busy Infotech, where he is MD & CEO. He also sits on the boards of investee companies such as Mynd Solutions and is an independent director of Shiprocket. He is a charter member of TiE.

people.name: Manoj Bhargava
people.role: Whole-time Director, Group General Counsel & Company Secretary
people.stake: 20,413 shares (FY26 annual report), a negligible stake
people.bio: Holds a B.Com (Hons) and law degree from Delhi University and a master's in law from Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, plus diplomas in intellectual-property law and cyber law. He has about 25 years in legal, secretarial and compliance work, with senior roles at Varun Beverages (RJ Corp group), HT Media, Barista Coffee and the India Today Group. He joined IndiaMART in 2017 and handled its IPO, QIP, bonus issue, buybacks and acquisitions. He was made a whole-time director for five years in January 2025 and also leads the CSR work.

people.name: Jitin Diwan
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com from Delhi University and more than 17 years in planning, business finance, investor reporting and controllership. Before IndiaMART he was head of finance (vice-president) at the stockbroker Upstox, and earlier worked at Amazon India, Bharti Airtel and Vodafone. He took over as CFO in June 2024 when Prateek Chandra moved to a strategy role. He won a CXO Verse 'CFO Impact' award in 2026 for investor relations.

people.name: Prateek Chandra
people.since: CFO from July 2015; Chief Strategy Officer since 15 June 2024
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com (Hons) from SRCC, Delhi University. He previously worked at Bharat S. Raut & Co. (a KPMG affiliate), EXL Service and HT Media. He was IndiaMART's CFO from 2015, including through its 2019 IPO. Since June 2024 he has been Chief Strategy Officer, looking after the start-up stakes IndiaMART has bought and looking for new organic and acquisition-led growth.

people.name: Dinesh Gulati
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech from Kanpur University (HBTI) and an MBA from the Faculty of Management Studies, Delhi University. He spent about 25 years building brands in telecom, consumer goods and media. Before IndiaMART he was Group President at The Indian Express, and earlier a regional CEO at Reliance Communications, with senior roles at Bharti Airtel, Etisalat DB Telecom and Kodak India. He runs IndiaMART's operations.

people.name: Amarinder Singh Dhaliwal
people.bio: A B.Tech (textile technology) graduate of IIT Delhi with a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad. He worked at the Times of India Group (where he was founding business head of Zigwheels.com and ran Indiatimes Shopping), Micromax, SBI Capital Markets and Powergen, and was co-founder and CEO of the start-up DONE BY NONE. He joined IndiaMART as Chief Product Officer in 2016 and leads the website and app product.

companies.changes: No change in KMP during FY26 or since. Non-executive director Dhruv Prakash left the board at the 29 June 2026 AGM on completing his term.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Aditya Birla Group, which owns 46.6% through Birla Group Holdings, Grasim, Hindalco and family members. It is run by long-serving group managers: Ashish Dikshit is MD (and also MD of the former parent ABFRL), and Vishak Kumar is Deputy MD & CEO. Kumar Mangalam Birla's children Aryaman Vikram Birla and Ananyashree Birla sit on the board as non-executive directors. No executive is related to another.

people.name: Ashish Dikshit
people.since: First director from 9 April 2024; MD since 1 May 2025 (term to April 2030)
people.bio: An electrical engineer from IIT Madras with an MBA from IIM Bangalore and the Advanced Management Program at Harvard Business School. He started his career at Asian Paints and then spent about 15 years at Madura Fashion & Lifestyle in sales, brand management, supply chain and sourcing, becoming president of the business in 2007 and CEO in 2012. He also served as principal executive assistant to the Aditya Birla Group chairman. He has been MD of Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail since February 2018 and took on this company when the Madura brands were demerged in May 2025, so he runs both companies at once.

people.name: Vishak Kumar
people.role: Deputy Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer
people.since: 1 May 2025 (term to April 2030); with the group since 1995
people.bio: A computer engineer from BIT Ranchi with an MBA from IIM Bangalore. He joined Madura as a management trainee in 1995 and worked across sales, marketing and retail for about 30 years. He was CEO of Aditya Birla Retail, where he led a turnaround of the 'More' supermarkets, before becoming CEO of Madura Fashion & Lifestyle. He runs the business day to day as Deputy MD & CEO since the demerger. He received the group chairman's Outstanding Leader award in 2014 and was named an Aditya Birla Fellow in 2015.

people.name: Dharmendra Lodha
people.bio: A chartered accountant (2006 batch) with more than 17 years in finance in consumer and retail companies. Before joining he was Senior Vice President – Finance at Pidilite Industries, leading corporate finance, manufacturing finance, controllership and planning with a team of about 50. He joined as the new company's first CFO when it listed in 2025.

people.name: Jacob John
people.bio: A long-time Madura hand: he spent more than eight years at Madura Fashion & Lifestyle, including as brand director of Louis Philippe and as chief operating officer. He was later deputy CEO of Landmark Group's Lifestyle department stores and CEO & MD of Modenik Lifestyle, an Advent International-owned innerwear and athleisure company. He then spent more than five years as President – Premium Brands at ABFRL. Since December 2025 he runs ABLBL's newer businesses and premium lifestyle categories. His education is not disclosed.

companies.changes: Puneet Kumar Malik, CEO of the innerwear business, ceased to be senior management from 1 February 2026. Narahari N, COO – Central Sourcing, retired on 30 June 2026. Company Secretary Rajeev Agrawal left in November 2025; Rameez Shaikh has held the post since 20 April 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder-led. Lalit Agarwal founded V-Mart in 2002 and is MD; his father Madan Gopal Agarwal, 82, is a whole-time director. Lalit's son Varin Agarwal is employed in the company (a disclosed related-party role). The board is chaired by Aakash Moondhra, a non-executive director who is not a promoter. Promoters own 44.2%, mostly through the promoter company Hurst Business Services (37.7%). Finance, operations and buying are run by hired professionals.

people.name: Lalit Agarwal
people.since: Founder; on the board since 24 July 2002
people.relation: Founder; son of Madan Gopal Agarwal; father of Varin Agarwal (an employee)
people.stake: 1.25% (9,90,518 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 44.2%
people.bio: Born in 1970, he holds a B.Com from Bombay University and a diploma in financial management from NMIMS, Mumbai, and attended the Owner/President Management Program at Harvard Business School. He founded V-Mart in 2002, pioneering organised value fashion retail in tier II, III and IV towns. He has more than 30 years in retail, was named Retail Leader of the Year by Franchise India in 2018 and was picked for NITI Aayog's Champions of Change in 2017. He chairs the northern region of the Retailers Association of India. His direct holding is small; most promoter shares sit in Hurst Business Services.

people.name: Madan Gopal Agarwal
people.relation: Father of Lalit Agarwal
people.bio: Aged 82, he holds a BA from City College, University of Calcutta, and has more than four decades in fashion retail. He started with a tailoring shop in the 1970s and later ran 'Shreeman Shreemati', a well-known apparel and footwear store in Cuttack. The company describes him as a mentor who keeps it focused on customers and costs. A firm linked to him, Harita Technopack, supplies goods to V-Mart, and his son-in-law Snehal Shah worked at the company until June 2025.

people.name: Anand Agarwal
people.role: Chief Operating Officer & Chief Financial Officer
people.since: CFO since 2017; also COO since 15 July 2026
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary with more than 26 years in planning, finance, legal, treasury, fund-raising, acquisitions and investor relations. Before V-Mart he held senior roles at HT Media and Reebok, and started at Ernst & Young; he also co-founded one of India's first internet service providers in 1999. He has been CFO since 2017 and is well known to investors. When COO Vineet Jain left in July 2026, he also took charge of operations. The company discloses no family link to the promoters despite the shared surname.

people.name: Jayesh Kothari
people.bio: Has more than 30 years in retail merchandising, including stints at Reliance and Vishal. At V-Mart he sets the product-line plan and leads buying, sourcing and design. His education is not disclosed.

people.name: Suraj Rathor
people.since: Joined 2023 as head of planning and analysis; Head of Finance since 24 July 2026
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com from Delhi University and more than 15 years in retail, restaurants and consumer goods. He spent eight years at KPMG and then held business controllership roles at Devyani International, where he worked on its IPO. He joined V-Mart in 2023 as head of financial planning and analysis and has led controllership, reporting and investor relations. He was named Head of Finance when the CFO took on the COO job.

people.name: Jaideep Jaiman
people.bio: An engineer from the first graduating batch of IIM Rohtak with about 14 years of experience, mostly as a management consultant on retail excellence, analytics, strategy and financial modelling. He founded two start-ups, one in analytics and machine-learning advice and one in video AI. At V-Mart he runs the digital strategy, with a focus on analytics and AI.

companies.changes: COO Vineet Jain resigned effective 15 July 2026; CFO Anand Agarwal took on the COO role. Suraj Rathor became Head of Finance on 24 July 2026. Earlier: VP Supply Chain Ramesh Agarwal left in November 2025 and SVP Snehal Shah (the whole-time director's son-in-law) in June 2025.

companies.styleNote: A family business started with one Patna store in 1999. Yashovardhan Sinha is Chairman & MD and his daughter Yosham Vardhan is a whole-time director; his wife Sunita Sinha (described as founder) and daughter Rashi Vardhan sit on the board as non-executive directors. Nishant Prabhakar, a whole-time director, is also a named promoter but is not related to the Sinhas. Promoters together own about 47%, down from 53% a year earlier.

people.name: Yashovardhan Sinha
people.since: Board since 31 March 2009; MD since 16 May 2016
people.relation: Promoter; husband of Sunita Sinha; father of Yosham Vardhan and Rashi Vardhan
people.stake: 27.38% (FY26 annual report, down from 32.55%); promoter group together about 47%
people.bio: Spent about 20 years as an officer in a public-sector bank before joining the family electronics retail business, which began with a single Patna store in 1999. He has driven the chain's growth from one store to about 210 across Bihar, Jharkhand, Uttar Pradesh and Chhattisgarh, and personally oversees staff training. He joined the board in 2009 and became MD in 2016. He sold about 5% of the company during FY26. He is also a director of the listed Aditya Consumer Marketing. His formal education is not disclosed.

people.name: Nishant Prabhakar
people.since: Board since 1 April 2005; whole-time director since 22 September 2016 (re-appointed to September 2031)
people.relation: Named promoter, but the company states he is not related to any other director
people.bio: A BA graduate, born in 1978, with more than 21 years in consumer electronics retail, all at Aditya Vision. He manages the company's operations and has led the widening of its product range. He has been a director since 2005 and a whole-time director since 2016; shareholders were asked in September 2026 to re-appoint him for five more years at up to ₹15 lakh a month. He sold about 0.9% of the company during FY26.

people.name: Yosham Vardhan
people.relation: Daughter of Yashovardhan and Sunita Sinha; sister of Rashi Vardhan
people.bio: A lawyer by training. Before joining the family business she was a partner at a leading Mumbai law firm, with more than nine years advising companies on cross-border mergers, acquisitions and private-equity deals. Since joining in early 2021 she has worked on the company's business strategy and expansion, works with the buying and sales teams, and handles investor relations.

people.name: Vikash Kumar
people.bio: A chartered accountant with management certifications and more than 15 years in finance across several industries. He has worked in reporting and analysis, risk-based audit, internal controls, compliance and valuations at listed and unlisted companies; his earlier employers are not named in the company's disclosure. He replaced Dhananjay Singh, who retired as CFO in May 2025.

companies.changes: CFO Dhananjay Singh retired on 31 May 2025; Vikash Kumar took over on 1 June 2025. Rashi Vardhan joined the board as a non-executive director in June 2025. Nishant Prabhakar's re-appointment from 22 September 2026 went to the 2 September 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by the Lalbhai family of the Arvind group (promoters 35.1%), who stay on the board as non-executives: Sanjay Lalbhai is Chairman, his son Kulin Lalbhai is Vice Chairman and leads the group's consumer businesses, and his son Punit Lalbhai is a director. Day-to-day management is professional: Amisha Jain, hired from Levi's, has been MD & CEO since August 2025 after Shailesh Chaturvedi left. The only executive on the board is the MD; brand CEOs run U.S. Polo Assn., Arrow and the PVH brands.

people.name: Amisha Jain
people.stake: nil shares at March 2026 (FY26 annual report); holds stock options
people.bio: An INSEAD alumna with more than 25 years in technology, consumer goods and retail. She worked at Motorola, McKinsey, Nike India and earlier in the Arvind group, then as CEO turned around the lingerie brand Zivame. Before joining she was MD and senior vice-president for South Asia, Middle East, Africa and Eastern Europe at Levi Strauss & Co., where Levi's India grew in the high teens over her three years. She was named ET People-Focused CEO of the Year 2024, and at Nike was on the Economic Times–Spencer Stuart '40 under 40' list in 2015. She is the company's only executive director.

people.name: Girdhar Kumar Chitlangia
people.bio: A chartered accountant with more than 30 years in finance leadership at large retail and consumer-goods companies in India and abroad. Before Arvind Fashions he worked at More Retail, the Coca-Cola Company and Super Max. He has attended programmes at Harvard and Oxford and has won the ICAI CA-CFO award and an Aditya Birla Group 'Exceptional Contributor' award. He took over as CFO in January 2023 after Piyush Gupta resigned.

people.name: Amitabh Suri
people.role: CEO – U.S. Polo Assn. and Flying Machine (senior management)
people.bio: An alumnus of Delhi University and NIFT with about 25 years in apparel and lifestyle brands. He spent 18 years on the leadership team of Indian Terrain, helping take it from a start-up to a listed premium brand, then ran the Iconic fast-fashion chain for Landmark Group in Dubai and was a president at Shoppers Stop, where he launched private labels and brands such as Jones New York and French Connection. He runs U.S. Polo Assn., the company's biggest brand at more than ₹2,000cr of sales, and the denim brand Flying Machine.

people.name: Nitesh Kanchan
people.since: With Arvind about 7 years; CEO of Arrow since FY26
people.bio: An IIT Delhi alumnus with more than 20 years in fashion and lifestyle, the last seven at Arvind, where he ran the NNNOW beauty retail business and then the company's digital business. Earlier he worked on brands such as Tommy Hilfiger, Calvin Klein, Louis Philippe, Arrow and Esprit, and at the retailer Pantaloons. He now runs Arrow while keeping charge of the digital business. He took charge of Arrow after its previous CEO, Anand Aiyer, left during FY26.

people.name: Satyen Momaya
people.role: CEO – PVH Arvind Fashions (Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein)
people.bio: Holds an MBA in sales and marketing from Bharati Vidyapeeth, Pune University, and has 28 years in consumer durables, telecom and retail. He began at LG Electronics and Vodafone, then spent nine years at Levi Strauss India, finally heading its retail business and franchise network. He was CEO of Celio India for eight years, leading a turnaround. He joined in August 2025 to run the Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein joint venture with PVH.

people.name: Saikot Das
people.role: Chief Brand & Strategy Officer, Digital Business (senior management)
people.bio: Has more than 20 years in apparel at Levi's, media at Disney's Star TV, consumer goods at Colgate-Palmolive and Marico, and commodities at Olam International, across India, the Middle East, Africa and Eastern Europe. He has built direct-to-consumer e-commerce businesses and led brand and category teams. At Arvind Fashions he runs e-commerce, the company website, marketing, data and analytics, and strategy. His education is not disclosed.

people.name: Lal Sudhakaran
people.bio: An engineering graduate of the College of Engineering, Trivandrum, and Mumbai University with more than 33 years in planning, supply chain, manufacturing and operations. Before Arvind Fashions he was President – Supply Chain, Cluster Development and ESG at Fabindia, and earlier held senior roles at Gokaldas Exports and Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail. He runs sourcing, which matters for the company's gross margin.

companies.changes: MD & CEO Shailesh Chaturvedi resigned effective 30 September 2025; Amisha Jain took over on 13 August 2025. Chief Revenue Officer Mallikaarjun Yarabolu and Arrow CEO Anand Aiyer left in FY26. CHRO Rohith Kumar A resigned on 30 April 2026 and was replaced by Lakshmi Krishnan (ex-Unilever) on 25 May 2026. Chief Supply Chain Officer Rajat Arora left on 22 May 2026. Footwear CEO Anurag Pandey resigned effective 30 September 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder-run but private-equity controlled. The two co-founders, Prabhat Agrawal (MD & CEO, 9.3%) and Prem Sethi (whole-time director & COO, 5.2%), are named promoters alongside the healthcare fund OrbiMed Asia III, which is the largest shareholder at 38.0% and has two nominee directors. Promoters together hold 52.4%. The co-founders are not related to each other; the chairman, Sujesh Vasudevan, is independent. Prasid Uno Family Trust (10.5%) also has a nominee director.

people.name: Prabhat Agrawal
people.since: Co-founder; with the company since inception (2018)
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to other directors
people.stake: 9.26% (40,28,395 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group with OrbiMed 52.4%
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Mumbai University with a master's in management from the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad. He is a chartered accountant and a CFA charterholder. He has more than two decades in strategy, operations, finance and acquisitions, working at A. F. Ferguson, Hero Honda Motors, Aditya Birla Management Corporation, Frigoglass Industries Nigeria, Metalfrio Solutions and Alkem Laboratories. He co-founded Entero, where the fund OrbiMed is co-promoter, and has built it through a long series of acquisitions of regional drug distributors, taking it public in February 2024.

people.name: Prem Sethi
people.since: Co-founder; with the company since inception (2018)
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to other directors
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in pharmacy from Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, Karnataka, and a master's diploma in clinical research and pharmacovigilance from the James Lind Institute. He has more than two decades in product management, business analysis and acquisitions, with earlier roles at Evalueserve, WNS Global Services, Excellence Data Research and IQVIA (formerly IMS Health) consulting. He co-founded Entero and runs its operations as COO.

people.name: Balakrishnan Natesan Kaushik
people.since: With the company since June 2018; Group CFO since 11 April 2025
people.bio: A chartered accountant with about 25 years of post-qualification experience in planning, restructuring, pricing, working-capital management, controlling, audits and due diligence. He has worked in India and abroad at Deloitte, Saint-Gobain, Quantum Advisors, Piramal Healthcare, Sandoz, IMS Health and Nestlé Skin Health. He joined Entero in June 2018 and became Group CFO in April 2025 when C.V. Ram resigned. He handles strategic finance, investor relations, treasury, reporting and controls.

people.name: Abhitesh Kumar
people.since: With Entero about seven years; Chief Growth Officer since 12 November 2025
people.bio: An engineering graduate of BITS Pilani with an MBA from IIM Calcutta and more than ten years of post-qualification experience across retail, healthcare, pharmaceuticals and financial services. At Entero he worked on preparing the company for its IPO and then ran the retail-pharmacy distribution business as President – Retail Business & New Initiatives, which he grew to more than ₹3,000cr of annual sales. Since November 2025 he leads new growth initiatives, including the push to serve consumers through partners.

companies.changes: Group CFO C.V. Ram resigned on 10 April 2025; B.N. Kaushik took over on 11 April 2025. Sambit Mohanty, President – Institutional Business, resigned effective 31 March 2026. Board changes since the annual report: nominee director Kevin Daftary resigned on 12 June 2026; the three independent directors (Sujesh Vasudevan, Rajesh Dalal and Sandhya Gadkari Sharma) were given fresh terms from 25 August 2026.

companies.styleNote: A family business started in 2005. Founder Nagakanaka Durga Prasad Chalavadi is MD and owns 33%; his brother Doodeswara Chalavadi is a whole-time director, and his son-in-law Bharadwaj Rachamadugu was made CEO in May 2026. His wife Jhansirani Chalavadi (senior vice-president, retail) and another brother, Mohana Durgarao Chalavadi (senior vice-president, operations), are senior employees, as are two brothers of whole-time director Kalyan Srinivas Annam. Promoters, including the SSKL Family Trust (25.7%), own about 61%. The chairman, Ravindra Vikram Mamidipudi, is independent. The only senior outsider is the CFO.

people.name: Nagakanaka Durga Prasad Chalavadi
people.relation: Founder; brother of Doodeswara Chalavadi; husband of Jhansirani Chalavadi; father-in-law of CEO Bharadwaj Rachamadugu
people.stake: 32.97% (5,05,66,160 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group including the SSKL Family Trust about 61%
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from Nagarjuna University, a postgraduate diploma in computer applications and an MBA from the Institute of Management Education, Pune. He has more than 20 years in retail and built the company from its 2005 start into one of South India's largest saree chains, under names such as Kalamandir, Mandir, KLM Fashion Mall and, most recently, Valli Silks. As MD he is responsible for overall management, finance, internal controls and security. He was named in the South India Business Awards 'South Powerlist 100' in 2025.

people.name: Bharadwaj Rachamadugu
people.relation: Son-in-law of the MD
people.bio: Aged 35, he holds a B.Tech in computer science from SRM University and an MBA from the University of Massachusetts, Lowell. He worked at M&T Bank in the US and ran his own business before joining the company in 2018. As senior vice-president he worked on retail operations, e-commerce, digital projects, marketing and investor relations, and helped lead the 2023 IPO. He was made CEO in May 2026 at ₹5 lakh a month, an appointment that needed shareholder approval because he is the MD's son-in-law. He is also a director of three private companies (Smartreap, Taletree Designs and Neurifix Technologies).

people.name: Doodeswara Kanaka Durgarao Chalavadi
people.since: Board since 1 June 2009; whole-time director re-appointed for three years from April 2024
people.relation: Brother of the MD
people.bio: Born in 1970, he holds a B.Com from Nagarjuna University and a master's in computing from Griffith University, Australia. He has about 15 years in the retail business and is responsible for procurement and marketing. He has been on the board since 2009.

people.name: Kalyan Srinivas Annam
people.relation: Not a relative of other directors under company law; his brothers Venkata Rajesh Annam and Subash Chandra Mohan Annam are senior vice-presidents
people.bio: Holds a law degree from Nagarjuna University and a postgraduate diploma in business management from the Institute of Marketing & Management. He has 19 years in retail and is responsible for new projects, strategic planning, brand building and business development.

people.name: Venkata Lakshmi Narasimha Sarma Konduri
people.bio: A commerce graduate and cost accountant (ICMA member), aged 67, with 38 years in finance. Before joining in March 2022 he worked at the coffee maker CCL Products. He was paid ₹1.08cr in FY26, the highest of any employee who is not a director.

companies.changes: Bharadwaj Rachamadugu was appointed CEO on 12 May 2026. Independent director Sirisha Chintapalli resigned on 6 May 2026; Sridevi Dasari joined as an independent director on 12 May 2026. Company Secretary Bhaskara Teja Matte resigned on 16 September 2026; Shilpa Kotagiri takes over on 1 October 2026.

companies.styleNote: A family business founded in Kolkata by brothers Vikash Agarwal (Chairman & MD) and Manish Agarwal (whole-time director & CFO). Vikash's wife Pinky Agarwal is a non-executive director and the largest single shareholder (30.1%, down from 46.9% after selling in the IPO); the brothers' wives, sisters and a sister-in-law also hold shares. Promoters own about 80% after the July 2025 IPO, which was entirely a promoter sale. The UK subsidiary's former CEO, Christopher Nagle, moved to a non-executive board seat in August 2026.

people.name: Vikash Agarwal
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Manish Agarwal; husband of Pinky Agarwal
people.stake: 2.99% (52,23,484 shares, FY26 annual report); wife Pinky Agarwal 30.06%; family promoter group about 80%
people.bio: Aged 48, he holds a B.Tech in textile technology from Maharshi Dayanand University, Rohtak, and a PhD from Heriot-Watt University in the UK. He was a director of Gateway Abroad in 2005 before founding Crizac, and has about 20 years in education consultancy. He built Crizac from a student-recruitment agency into a platform linking overseas universities with counselling partners in many countries, and in 2023 sold his UK company Crizac Ltd to Crizac Limited. He sits on the board of Crizac's UK subsidiary.

people.name: Manish Agarwal
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Vikash Agarwal
people.stake: 27.37% (4,78,91,049 shares, FY26 annual report; down from 30.56% after the IPO sale)
people.bio: A chartered accountant, aged 45, who has been with the company since 2011 and has about 14 years in international education. He runs finance, controls and capital allocation, and oversaw the 2025 listing. He is the second-largest individual shareholder. As CFO he is also a promoter and one of the two biggest owners, so the finance head is not independent of the family.

people.name: Priya Fulfagar
people.since: Joined May 2022 as senior consultant; COO since 31 December 2023
people.bio: Holds a B.Com and an MA in communication, both from the University of Madras. Before Crizac she worked at Suvidha Placements and Universal Test Solutions. She joined in May 2022 as a senior consultant and became COO at the end of 2023; she sat on the IPO committee in 2025. University complaints the relationship team cannot resolve are escalated to her or the MD.

people.name: Rituparno Sarkar
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in computer science (information technology) from Sikkim Manipal Institute of Engineering & Technology and has more than 19 years in software engineering, product development and digital transformation. He has held director and principal-level roles at education-technology, product and services companies. He replaced long-serving CTO Sibendu Roy in August 2026.

people.name: Nikhil Jain
people.bio: An IIT (BHU) Varanasi graduate who began doctoral research at IIT Bombay and Monash University before leaving to build technology for international education. He founded Foreign Admits and built AI-led tools such as Loan Monk, Visa Monk and My Dream University, and co-founded the bioplastics venture PHABIO. At Crizac he leads product marketing and platform strategy.

people.name: Dishant Kharbanda
people.bio: Has more than 20 years in international student mobility and education technology. He founded UniAgents, co-founded EduMentor and co-designed the Socratic Fellowship at Oxford, and wrote the book 'Hacked by History'. At Crizac he works on AI-driven projects for the student-recruitment business. His formal education is not disclosed.

companies.changes: On 2–3 August 2026: Christopher Nagle stepped down as CEO of the UK subsidiary Crizac Ltd and joined the board as a non-executive director (approved at the 11 September 2026 AGM); CTO Sibendu Roy and CMO Salaria Zaheer were moved to other roles, replaced by Rituparno Sarkar (CTO) and Nikhil Jain (Chief Product & Marketing Officer); Dishant Kharbanda was named Chief Innovation Officer; Chief Business Officer Anindita Das stays but is no longer classed as senior management.

companies.styleNote: A family business. The founder Pavan Kumar Bajaj is Chairman & MD, his son Karan Bajaj is CEO and whole-time director, and Karan's wife Astha Bajaj is a whole-time director. Father and son own 64.7% between them (promoter group 65.2% at June 2026). Day-to-day functions sit with hired executives such as the COO (ex-Samsung) and the CFO.

people.name: Pavan Kumar Bajaj
people.since: Board since 1 October 2018 (founder of Bajaj Electronics in 1980)
people.relation: Founder; father of Karan Bajaj and father-in-law of Astha Bajaj
people.stake: 32.12% (12,35,91,793 shares, FY26 annual report); with his son 64.66%; promoter group 65.17% (June 2026 shareholding pattern)
people.bio: Aged 71, he has more than 42 years in retail. He founded Bajaj Electronics as a sole proprietorship in Hyderabad in 1980; the later partnership firm was converted into this company in September 2018. The annual report describes him as a veteran of the consumer-durables trade and a pioneer of organised durables retail in India. He took no pay rise in FY26 and drew ₹2.2cr. No degree is disclosed.

people.name: Karan Bajaj
people.relation: Son of Pavan Kumar Bajaj; husband of Astha Bajaj
people.stake: 32.54% (12,51,83,592 shares, FY26 annual report; up from 32.04% a year earlier)
people.bio: Aged 39, he holds a B.Com from Osmania University and a Post Graduate Diploma in International Management from the University of Strathclyde. He has more than 14 years in retail, all in the family business, covering strategy and store operations. He is the best-paid director (₹2.4cr in FY26), chairs the finance committee and is a director of the group's dormant Cloudnine Retail. He was re-appointed at the September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Astha Bajaj
people.relation: Wife of Karan Bajaj; daughter-in-law of Pavan Kumar Bajaj
people.bio: Aged 36, she holds a master's in biochemistry from Nirma University and a B.Sc from Gujarat University. She has more than eight years in business management, all at this company, and oversees its CSR work. She was paid ₹1.5cr in FY26.

people.name: Sandeep Singh Jolly
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate diploma in management and has more than two decades in electronics retail and brands. Before joining he was Senior Director and product head at Samsung India. He is the company's highest-paid non-director executive (₹1.56cr in FY26) and runs store operations.

people.name: Premchand Devarakonda
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com and more than 30 years of experience. Before joining he worked at Services and Trade Company LLC. He sits on the risk-management and ESG committees and signs the accounts with the promoters. He was paid ₹98 lakh in FY26.

companies.changes: No changes in senior management during FY26 or since (company statement in the FY26 annual report); Karan Bajaj re-appointed at the 25 September 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: The founder Gangadi Madhukar Reddy is Chairman, MD and CEO; the board re-appointed him for five more years in May 2026. He and his two holding companies (Agilemed and Lone Furrow) own 40.2%. No family members are on the board. Pharmacy operations are run by Dr Bhaskar Reddy, a doctor who has been with the group since the start.

people.name: Gangadi Madhukar Reddy
people.role: Chairman, Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer
people.since: Board since incorporation on 30 November 2006 (founder); re-appointed MD & CEO for five years from August 2026
people.relation: Founder and promoter
people.stake: 12.79% in his own name (FY26 annual report); with Lone Furrow Investments (14.39%) and Agilemed Investments (13.04%), which he owns, 40.2%
people.bio: Aged 59, he is a doctor by training, with an MBBS from Sri Venkateswara University, and holds an MBA from the Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania. He founded MedPlus in 2006 and has been a director since incorporation. He takes a small salary (₹45 lakh in FY26, with no rise), relying on his large stake instead. He is also a director of his holding companies Agilemed Investments and Madhukar Gangadi Ventures, and of Hinshitsu Manufacturing and Optival Health Solutions.

people.name: Dr Cherukupalli Bhaskar Reddy
people.since: Board since 26 October 2023; with the group since its start
people.bio: Aged 58, he has an MBBS from Kurnool Medical College (1992), an MS in general surgery from Manipal Academy of Higher Education (1997) and an FRCS from Edinburgh (2003). He has been with MedPlus since its inception, first overseeing recruitment, training and store expansion. He now runs the pharmacy operations and has more than two decades in retail pharmacy. He was paid ₹1.03cr in FY26 and retired by rotation and was re-appointed at the August 2026 AGM.

people.name: Sujit Kumar Mahato
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a bachelor's degree in commerce, accountancy and economics from Andhra University. When appointed in November 2022 he had more than 24 years in finance and accounting, including country-level and multi-country roles in business finance, financial reporting, controls and cost cutting. He was paid ₹1.73cr in FY26.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Manoj Kumar Srivastava resigned on 20 May 2026 and a new company secretary was appointed in July 2026. Independent directors Madhavan Ganesan and Murali Sivaraman completed their terms on 10 June 2026; Ajit Rangnekar and Mohankrishna Reddy Arvabumi joined as independents in May 2026.

companies.styleNote: A family business. The founder Ravi Modi is Chairman & MD, his wife Shilpi Modi is a whole-time director, and their son Vedant Modi, after whom the company is named, is Chief Revenue Officer. The family (mainly the Ravi Modi Family Trust at 57.2% and Ravi Modi HUF at 16.0%) owns about 74.9%. Hired executives run marketing, retail and product; the CFO is leaving in November 2026.

people.name: Ravi Modi
people.since: Board since 24 May 2002 (founder); re-appointed CMD for five years from 28 August 2026
people.relation: Founder; husband of Shilpi Modi and father of Vedant Modi
people.stake: 0.69% directly (16,88,134 shares, FY26 annual report); the family trust, HUF and couple together about 74.9%
people.bio: Aged 49, he studied commerce at St. Xavier's College, Kolkata. He worked in his father's menswear shop in Kolkata from the age of 13 until about 22, then left to start Manyavar, first selling to multi-brand outlets, and built it without outside funding. He oversees design and marketing and led the move into online sales through the company's own site and marketplaces. He won the EY Entrepreneur of the Year award in 2022 (consumer products and retail) and is a co-founder and trustee of Ashoka University. He was paid ₹3.42cr in FY26.

people.name: Shilpi Modi
people.since: Board since 24 May 2002; re-appointed for five years from 28 August 2026
people.relation: Wife of Ravi Modi; mother of Vedant Modi
people.bio: Aged 47, she is a commerce graduate from Allahabad University with nearly 27 years in the garment industry, all with this company since its start. She oversees the management of the whole product lifecycle, from design to production. She was paid ₹2.28cr in FY26 and is also a director of the family's Modi Fiduciary Services, trustee of the family trust.

people.name: Vedant Modi
people.since: Chief Revenue Officer since September 2023 (earlier Chief Marketing Officer)
people.relation: Son (only child) of Ravi and Shilpi Modi
people.bio: He was Chief Marketing Officer and was re-designated Chief Revenue Officer in September 2023, with a focus on building the online business. He is listed as senior management and as a close relative of the key managerial staff; he was paid ₹52 lakh in FY26. The company does not disclose his education in its filings.

people.name: Anand Narang
people.bio: Holds a BE from Punjab Engineering College and an MBA from MDI Gurgaon, and did an advanced executive programme at INSEAD. When he joined he had about 25 years in business leadership teams at Bata, Nokia, Jio, Huawei, Comverse and Airtel, across category management, marketing, e-commerce, retail and product. He has worked in the UK, Denmark, Finland, China and India.

people.name: Aman Kumar Gupta
people.bio: Joined as Chief Retail Officer in November 2025 to run retail operations and the international business. The company's filings give no details of his education or past employers.

companies.changes: CFO Rahul Murarka resigned on 15 September 2026 and leaves on 14 November 2026; no successor named yet. Chief Human Resources Officer Arunangshu Chatterjee left in May 2025. Independent director Abanti Mitra died in July 2026; Nihir Parikh and Neetu Kashiramka joined as independents in September 2026 and Tarun Puri stepped down.

companies.styleNote: The company says it has no identifiable promoter and calls itself professionally managed. It is still founder-led: co-founder Supam Maheshwari is MD & CEO and owns 5.2%. The biggest holders are SoftBank's SVF Frog (19.8%) and Mahindra & Mahindra (8.6%, with a nominee director). Most senior executives have been with the company for a decade or more.

people.name: Supam Maheshwari
people.since: Co-founded the company in August 2010; MD since May 2022
people.relation: Co-founder
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Delhi College of Engineering and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad. In 2000 he co-founded Brainvisa Technologies, an e-learning company sold to Indecomm Global in 2007. He then started Brainbees in 2010 to build FirstCry, and later set up the logistics firm Xpressbees to handle its deliveries. Forbes India named him Entrepreneur of the Year for 2025. He chairs the board's risk-management and CSR committees.

people.name: Gautam Sharma
people.bio: A chartered accountant and fellow company secretary with a B.Com from Gujarati Commerce College, Indore. Before joining he worked at Birla Ericsson Optical, Minda Valeo Security Systems, Reliance Industries and Vindhya Telelinks. He runs finance, fund-raising, regulatory affairs and strategic planning, and led the company through its 2024 IPO. He was named Group CFO of the Year (large enterprises) at the Economic Times CFO Awards 2024.

people.name: Anuj Jain
people.bio: Holds a PGDM from IIM Lucknow and a graduate degree from Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra. He previously worked at ITC and L'Oréal. He joined in April 2025 to run GlobalBees, the group's loss-making house-of-brands subsidiary.

people.name: Prashant Jadhav
people.bio: Holds a BA in politics from Shivaji University, Kolhapur. He worked with Supam Maheshwari at Brainvisa Technologies before joining FirstCry at its founding in 2010, and has run its technology since.

people.name: Abhinav Sharma
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in mechanical engineering from Maharashtra Institute of Technology and a master's in industrial engineering from the University of Texas at Arlington. He previously worked at Fossil and Flipkart. He runs the Middle East business (FirstCry Management DWC in the UAE and Saudi Arabia), into which the company is putting more money in 2026.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Neha Surana resigned in December 2025; Mandar Joshi took over from 27 December 2025. Saloni Jain Rana joined the board as Mahindra & Mahindra's nominee in May 2026. No change in the CEO or CFO.

companies.styleNote: The K Raheja Corp group (the Raheja family) owns 66.06%. The brothers Neel and Ravi Raheja sit on the board as non-executive promoter directors, and the chairman since July 2025 is Nirvik Singh, a non-executive director. The business is run by a hired MD & CEO, Kavindra Mishra, and a hired executive team; senior staff carry the title 'Customer Care Associate'.

people.name: Kavindra Mishra
people.since: Joined early 2023; MD & CEO since 29 April 2024 (three-year term)
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate diploma from IIM Bangalore and has more than 27 years in retail and brands. He started at Aditya Birla's Allen Solly and ran its Middle East business, then held senior roles at Tommy Hilfiger and United Colors of Benetton. He was MD of Pepe Jeans India for six years, co-founded the start-up Zovi.com and was MD & CEO of House of Anita Dongre. He joined Shoppers Stop in 2023 to run external brands and the home business, and became MD & CEO in 2024. He is also on the boards of the beauty subsidiary Global SS Beauty Brands and the Retailers Association of India.

people.name: Pankaj Chaturvedi
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a master's in commerce and about 25 years across telecom, aviation and media. He was CFO of Saregama India and of Go Airlines (India), and held key finance roles at Vodafone, Reliance Jio and Hitachi. He has set a target of making Shoppers Stop debt-free by the end of FY27.

people.name: Biju Kassim
people.role: CEO, Beauty Business; MD & CEO of Global SS Beauty Brands
people.since: MD & CEO of the beauty subsidiary from 1 April 2026
people.bio: Heads the beauty business, the company's fastest-growing part, which includes the distribution of international beauty brands through the subsidiary Global SS Beauty Brands (sales ₹426cr in FY26, up 81%). He became MD & CEO of that material subsidiary in April 2026. The annual report does not give his education or earlier employers.

people.name: Arvind Rajagopalan
people.since: Before FY26 (no change during the year)
people.bio: Runs the store network, including the personal-shopper service the company is expanding. He is listed as senior management in the FY26 annual report, which does not give his education or earlier employers.

companies.changes: CFO Karunakaran Mohanasundaram resigned with effect from 17 February 2026; Pankaj Chaturvedi took over on 1 April 2026. Chairman B. S. Nagesh retired in July 2025 and Nirvik Singh became non-executive chairman. Jiten Mahendra joined as Chief Marketing Officer and Nabamita Banerjee as Chief HR Officer during FY26. Arun Sirdeshmukh joins as an independent director from 20 October 2026.

companies.styleNote: Control passed within the family in June 2026: promoter Sameer Gupta gifted his 35.07% stake to his brother Sanjay Gupta, founder and CMD of APL Apollo Tubes. In July 2026 Sanjay Gupta became Chairman & MD (without pay) and his son Rohan Gupta a whole-time director; an APL Apollo executive, Chakram Kumar Singh, joined as a non-executive director. The promoter group owns 57.9%. Daily operations sit with whole-time director Amit Thakur and a small hired team.

people.name: Sanjay Gupta
people.relation: Promoter; brother of former promoter Sameer Gupta and father of Rohan Gupta
people.stake: 35.07% (4,46,00,000 shares, AGM notice August 2026, received as a gift from his brother in June 2026); promoter group together 57.9%
people.bio: Aged 55, he is a first-generation entrepreneur with more than 40 years in steel, building materials and allied industries. He is Chairman & MD of APL Apollo Tubes, which he built into India's largest maker of structural steel tubes, and Chairman of Apollo Pipes; the wider family also controls the NBFC SG Finserve. He took over SG Mart in 2026 and draws no pay from it. The filings do not give his educational degree. Investors should note that he also runs larger group companies, which are both suppliers and related parties of SG Mart.

people.name: Rohan Gupta
people.relation: Son of Sanjay Gupta
people.bio: Aged 27, he holds a BBA and has about five years of experience in manufacturing operations, project execution, sales, branding and business development. He worked at APL Apollo Building Products, an APL Apollo Tubes subsidiary with about 12 lakh tonnes of ERW pipe capacity and FY26 revenue of about ₹5,240cr, where he helped ramp up the Raipur plant. He is also a director of several SG group companies including SG Finserve.

people.name: Amit Thakur
people.bio: Aged 47, he holds a BE and has more than 20 years in procurement and supply chain, business development, sales and marketing. He is the senior full-time executive who has signed the accounts and board reports and was paid ₹1.09cr in FY26 (a 9% rise). He retired by rotation and was re-appointed at the September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Suraj Kumar
people.bio: A chartered accountant with more than 15 years in finance, covering treasury, direct and indirect tax, banking, import-export compliance and foreign trade policy. He previously held key roles at listed companies making and trading steel and metal products, and has worked on budgeting, working capital and SAP roll-outs.

people.name: Archit Arora
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in electrical engineering and a PGDM from MDI Gurgaon, and has done executive courses at IIM Ahmedabad and the Drucker School. He has more than nine years in steel sales; before joining he was Head of Sales (Industrial Products) at Tata Steel, managing large national key accounts.

companies.changes: June 2026: Sameer Gupta gifted his 35.07% to his brother Sanjay Gupta, who became Chairman & MD on 20 July 2026 with his son Rohan as whole-time director. Joint MD Shiv Kumar Bansal resigned on 31 July 2025. SG Mart agreed in July 2026 to buy Tanwar Cargo Solutions for ₹85cr.

companies.styleNote: The founder Sanjay Thakker is Chairman and executive director, and his son Aryaman Thakker is an executive director (the annual report confirms they are father and son). The promoter group owns 49.9% (June 2026), mainly Sanjay Thakker (36.4%) and Ami Sanjay Thakker (12.9%). Long-serving hired executives run the individual brands, finance and after-sales.

people.name: Sanjay Thakker
people.since: Founded Landmark in 1998; director since 23 February 2006
people.relation: Founder; father of Aryaman Thakker
people.stake: 36.34% (1,50,69,768 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group 49.93% (June 2026)
people.bio: He founded Landmark in 1998 and has close to three decades in car retailing, building it into a multi-brand dealer group for Mercedes-Benz, Honda, MG, BYD, Volkswagen and others. He built and leads the company's professional management team. He has received the 'Business Leader of the Year' title from the World Leadership Congress. He and Ami Thakker personally guarantee several of the group's loans. The filings do not disclose his education.

people.name: Aryaman Thakker
people.since: Board since 10 December 2020; with the group since 2017
people.relation: Son of Sanjay Thakker
people.bio: Holds degrees in business administration (Pune) and in marketing and strategy (Warwick, UK), and previously worked at AutoNation in the US. Since joining in 2017 he has led expansion including the MG Motor business, and is dealer principal for Mercedes-Benz, MG and Volkswagen. He heads marketing and digitisation, handles investor and media relations, and chairs the CSR committee. He was the youngest elected member of the Mercedes-Benz Franchise Advisory Council.

people.name: Paras Somani
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from Saurashtra University and completed the CEO leadership programme at ISB Hyderabad. He has 33 years in sales and banking, earlier with Kotak Mahindra Primus, Jet Air and Sterling Resorts. He joined Landmark in 2006 as Vice President - Sales and now oversees the Mercedes-Benz business and group HR.

people.name: Garima Misra
people.role: Managing Director, Volkswagen, Jeep, Group Finance & Insurance business
people.bio: Holds an MBA from Fore School of Management and has 28 years in car retail; before Landmark she worked at Blue Skies Travels and Tours. She runs the Volkswagen and Jeep dealerships and the group's finance and insurance business, and is State Chairperson of the Delhi chapter of the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations (FADA).

people.name: Surendra Agarwal
people.bio: A chartered accountant and commerce graduate with more than 28 years in finance and accounting. Before joining Landmark in 2018 he worked at Trent, Videocon Appliances and Century Rayon. He sits on the risk-management committee.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report. Rita Teaotia joined as an independent director on 11 August 2026; Manish Chokhani and Gautam Trivedi were re-appointed as independents at the 24 September 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: A Chennai family business founded in 2010 by Prakash Kumar Saraogi, his son Gautam Saraogi and Rahul Saraogi. Prakash is MD and Gautam is executive director and CEO; Prakash's brother Vinod Kumar Saraogi joined the board as a non-executive director in August 2025. The promoters own about 55% (June 2026), held mainly through two family trusts (PKS and VKS, 27.1% each) in the names of Gautam and Rahul Saraogi; part of Rahul's holding is pledged.

people.name: Prakash Kumar Saraogi
people.relation: Co-founder; father of Gautam Saraogi and brother of director Vinod Kumar Saraogi
people.stake: 60 shares (about 0.0001%) in his own name (FY26 annual report); his family's PKS Family Trust holds 27.10%, recorded in Gautam Saraogi's name
people.bio: He co-founded Go Colors in Chennai in 2010, coming from the family's textile export business. He is the company's managing director and its highest-paid director (₹1.32cr in FY26, no rise). The annual report does not give his education or career history.

people.name: Gautam Saraogi
people.relation: Son of Prakash Kumar Saraogi; nephew of Vinod Kumar Saraogi
people.stake: 27.10% as managing trustee of the PKS Family Trust (18.88% plus 8.22% in the June 2026 shareholding pattern)
people.bio: He graduated from college in 2009, worked briefly in the family export business and started Go Colors at 22, first selling churidars and leggings through multi-brand shops and then from a mall kiosk in Chennai in April 2011. He built it into a direct-to-consumer women's bottomwear chain. As CEO he signs the accounts with the CFO and heads the business-responsibility function. He was paid ₹90 lakh in FY26, up 16.7%.

people.name: R. Mohan
people.bio: A chartered accountant who is the company's CFO and a key managerial person. He signs the financial statements with the CEO and sits on the risk-management committee. His pay rose 16.4% in FY26. The company does not publish his earlier employers.

people.name: S. Zafir Ahmed
people.bio: A retail professional with more than three decades in merchandising and planning, including merchandise planning, assortment and space management. He has held leadership roles at other retail chains, which the company's filing does not name. He joined in March 2026 as the company tries to revive same-store sales.

companies.changes: S. Zafir Ahmed joined as Chief Merchandising Officer on 2 March 2026. Vinod Kumar Saraogi joined the board as a non-executive director in August 2025 and Sakshi Vijay Chopra as an independent director in November 2025. The company bought back 2.62% of its shares at ₹460 in February 2026.
