At RailTel he was Group General Manager (Operations) and headed the RailWire retail broadband business, which crossed half a million customers on his watch. He now oversees project execution, the network operations centres and maintenance, the part of the business where low-margin projects are growing fastest.

people.name: Yashpal Singh Tomar
people.bio: Holds an M.Tech from IIT Kanpur and joined the Indian Railway Service of Signal Engineers in 1992. He worked on the Central, North Central and South Central Railways, at the research body RDSO in Lucknow and at the signal and telecom training institute IRISET in Secunderabad, in operations, projects, R&D and training. He had an earlier stint at RailTel as Group General Manager, and was Divisional Railway Manager of the Palghat division before taking this post. He is responsible for network planning, sales and marketing.

companies.changes: Government nominee director Rameshwar Meena was replaced by Rajesh Gupta (Railway Board) on 10 Aug 2026. Independent director Dr Subhash Sharma left on 15 Apr 2026 at the end of his term. No change among the CMD and functional directors found.

companies.styleNote: Founder-led but not family-controlled. Co-founders Srikanth Velamakanni (Group Chief Executive and Executive Vice-Chairman) and Pranay Agrawal (CEO of the US subsidiary, which earns most of the revenue) run it. Srikanth's wife Chetana Kumar is Chief Sustainability Officer, and Pranay's father and wife are also named promoters. Promoters together own only 16.68%; investors such as TPG and public holders own the rest. Most directors are independent or investor nominees.

people.name: Srikanth Velamakanni
people.role: Whole-time Director, Group Chief Executive and Executive Vice-Chairman; co-founder
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; husband of Chief Sustainability Officer Chetana Kumar
people.stake: 73,95,590 shares, 4.30% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoters together 16.68%
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in electrical engineering from IIT Delhi and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad. Before co-founding Fractal in 2000 he worked at ICICI Bank and ANZ Investment Bank. He leads the Fractal group and is responsible for client partnerships and revenue growth. He chairs NASSCOM, co-founded Plaksha University, and is an independent director of ideaForge, NIIT and Dr. Reddy's Laboratories. Before the IPO, 1.87% of the company's shares held by him were pledged for a personal loan; they were released for the IPO lock-in and the prospectus said he may re-pledge them.

people.name: Pranay Agrawal
people.role: Non-Executive Director; Chief Executive Officer, Fractal Analytics Inc. (US); co-founder
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; son of promoter Narendra Kumar Agrawal and husband of promoter Rupa Krishnan Agrawal
people.stake: 81,21,360 shares, 4.72% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), of which 33,32,940 are beneficially owned by the Agrawal Family Trust; his father holds 3.47% and his wife 0.48%
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from Bangalore University and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad, and is a certified Financial Risk Manager (GARP). Before Fractal he worked at ICICI Bank and ANZ Grindlays Bank. He runs the US subsidiary, the company's main operating arm, and is paid by it rather than by the listed company. IIM Ahmedabad gave him its Young Alumni Achiever award in 2018–19.

people.name: Ajoy Singh
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from IIT Delhi and a postgraduate diploma in computer-aided management from IIM Calcutta. Before Fractal he worked at GE Countrywide Consumer Financial Services as AVP-risk and at Standard Chartered Investments & Loans. He builds the company's AI, cloud and data capabilities and heads functional practices such as supply chain, marketing effectiveness and personalisation.

people.name: Natwar Mall
people.since: With the company since February 2006; in this role since 3 June 2026
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from IIT Bombay and a postgraduate diploma in computer-aided management from IIM Calcutta. He worked at Hindustan Lever, Infosys and Kotak Securities before joining Fractal in 2006. He led the financial services and insurance practice for years and was redesignated Chief Transformation Officer in June 2026.

people.name: Matthew Gennone
people.role: Chief Commercial Officer and CEO, Cogentiq
people.since: With Fractal USA since December 2018; in this role since 30 April 2026
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in psychology from West Virginia University. Before Fractal he was a digital strategy senior manager at Accenture and worked at Antuit. He built and led the healthcare and life-sciences practice at Fractal USA before being made Chief Commercial Officer and head of Cogentiq, the company's agentic-AI platform, in April 2026.

people.name: Chetana Kumar
people.since: Employee since October 2020 (pro bono CSR consultant from 2017)
people.relation: Promoter; wife of co-founder Srikanth Velamakanni
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in social and legal sciences and a law degree from the University of Pune, and a diploma in international business from Symbiosis Institute of International Business. She previously worked at e-Serve International. She advised Fractal pro bono on CSR from 2017 and joined as an employee in 2020; she heads its CSR and sustainability work.

companies.changes: CFO and Group CFO Ashwath Bhat, appointed 1 Aug 2025, resigned on 6 Jul 2026 and left on 24 Jul 2026; no successor had been named when the note was written. Chief Growth Officer Shailendra Pratap Singh (May 2026) and Chief Design Officer Raja Rajeswari Aradhyula (Apr 2026) left senior management; CPGR practice head Mrunali Majmudar left in Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 2011 by Ashok Soota (a Mindtree co-founder), who is still Executive Chairman and Chief Mentor and the controlling shareholder. Day-to-day it is run by co-founder Joseph Anantharaju (Co-Chairman and CEO) and Venkatraman Narayanan (MD); neither is related to Soota or to each other. Promoters own 44.21%. Under the merger agreed on 31 Aug 2026 it will fold into ITC Infotech, and Soota is selling about half his holding to ITC Infotech for cash, so control and the top roles are likely to change once the deal closes.

people.name: Ashok Soota
people.since: Founder (2011); whole-time director reappointed to March 2029
people.relation: Founder and promoter
people.stake: 4,92,45,787 shares, 32.77% in his own name; with Ashok Soota Medical Research LLP (11.94%), 44.13% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from the University of Roorkee (now IIT Roorkee) and an MBA from the Asian Institute of Management, Philippines. He co-founded Mindtree, which listed in 2007, and then founded Happiest Minds, which listed in 2020. He has been President of the Confederation of Indian Industry and a member of the Prime Minister's Task Force for IT. He also set up SKAN, a non-profit for medical research on ageing and neurological disorders, in 2021. Shareholders approved his continuing as a whole-time director beyond the age of 70.

people.name: Joseph Anantharaju
people.since: Joined 2011; board since November 2020; CEO since March 2025; reappointed to November 2030
people.relation: Co-founder; not related to any director or KMP
people.bio: Holds a BE from BITS Pilani and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad, and has over 30 years in technology. He began in banking and manufacturing, then led Microsoft business at Aztecsoft and, after Mindtree bought it, ran Mindtree's Microsoft business unit (about 8% of its revenue). He joined Happiest Minds at its start in 2011, built the product engineering unit, became Executive Vice Chairman in 2020 and Co-Chairman and CEO in March 2025. He is 55.

people.name: Venkatraman Narayanan
people.since: Joined April 2015; MD since November 2020 (was also CFO until June 2025); reappointed to November 2030
people.bio: A fellow chartered accountant with degrees in commerce and law, and over 25 years in general management, operations, finance and legal work. He was CFO of Mindtree, Transworks Information Services, Perot Systems TSI (India), TeamLease Services and Sonata Software, and earlier Director of Operations at Oracle and a consultant at Arthur Andersen. He joined Happiest Minds in 2015 and was MD and CFO from 2020 until a separate CFO was hired in June 2025.

people.name: Anand Balakrishnan
people.bio: A chartered accountant, cost accountant and US CPA with a commerce degree from Bangalore University, and over 20 years in finance. He spent six years in senior finance roles at listed IT firm Mindteck, where the company credits him with helping return it to profit, and earlier worked at Marsh McLennan (formerly JLT) and GE Healthcare.

companies.changes: Executive Director Rajiv Shah (head of the GBS unit) left the board on 31 Dec 2025 and senior management on 31 Mar 2026. Anand Balakrishnan became CFO in Jun 2025, taking the role from MD Venkatraman Narayanan. The company agreed on 31 Aug 2026 to merge into ITC Infotech (25 ITC Infotech shares for every 81), subject to approvals.

companies.styleNote: Founded by the husband-and-wife team A. V. Venkatraman (known as Venkat Viswanathan; Executive Chairperson) and Pramadwathi (Pramad) Jandhyala (Whole-time Director), who together own 65.1%. Both are executive directors, but day-to-day management is with a hired CEO: Sonal Ramrakhiani replaced Rajan Sethuraman on 15 Jul 2026. The other five directors are independent.

people.name: A. V. Venkatraman (Venkat Viswanathan)
people.since: Founder; on the board since January 2007; reappointed as whole-time director for 2026–2031
people.relation: Founder and promoter; husband of Whole-time Director Pramadwathi Jandhyala
people.stake: 11,79,06,923 shares, 56.98% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); with his wife, 65.1%
people.bio: An engineer from IIT Madras with an MBA from IIM Calcutta. Before founding LatentView he worked at Cognizant Technology Solutions, Moody's ICRA and the Essar Group. He is the controlling shareholder and chairs the board; he announced the change of CEO in July 2026. He is 55.

people.name: Pramadwathi (Pramad) Jandhyala
people.since: Co-founder; on the board since January 2006; reappointed for 2026–2031
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; wife of Executive Chairperson A. V. Venkatraman
people.bio: An engineer from BITS Pilani with an MBA from IIM Calcutta. Before co-founding LatentView she worked at IBM, Ford, Moody's ICRA and Kotak Mahindra Bank. She chairs the board's CSR committee and retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM, seeking reappointment. She is 53.

people.name: Sonal Ramrakhiani
people.bio: Studied at St. Xavier's College and the Nirma Institute of Management, Ahmedabad, and is an alumna of the Tata Administrative Service, with over 20 years of leadership experience. She worked at TCS and Tata Teleservices, then at Tata Technologies as COO and President of Sales (Automotive). Most recently she led Wipro's Engineering Edge business in the Americas. She sits on the board of Titan North America and is based in the US.

people.name: Rajan Bala Venkatesan
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Hindu College and a chartered accountant, with earlier experience in banking, financial services and consulting, according to the company. He is one of the three key managerial personnel and sits on the board's banking and authorisation committee.

people.name: Venky Ramesh
people.role: Chief Client Officer – Consumer, Retail & Marketplaces
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from the College of Engineering, Guindy, with an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad. He previously worked at Infosys, Capgemini and EPAM. He was hired after Chief Client Officer Krishnan Venkata resigned in September 2025, to lead the consumer, retail and marketplace clients.

companies.changes: CEO Rajan Sethuraman (CEO since 2019, through the IPO and the Decision Point purchase) handed over to Sonal Ramrakhiani on 15 Jul 2026 and stays as Strategic Advisor to the CEO for up to six months. Chief Client Officer Krishnan Venkata resigned Sep 2025. Independent directors Dipali Sheth and Mukesh Butani completed their terms in Jun–Jul 2026.

companies.styleNote: The Rajan Raheja family are the promoters with 28.17%; Viren Raheja sits on the board as a non-executive promoter director and no family member holds an executive role. The chairman, Sanjay Asher, is non-executive. The company is run by professionals: Executive Vice Chairman P. Srikar Reddy (with Sonata since 1986 and CEO 2012–2022) and a new CEO, Rajsekhar Datta Roy, who took over on 9 May 2026 after MD and CEO Samir Dhir left at the end of his term.

people.name: Rajsekhar Datta Roy
people.since: CEO since 9 May 2026 (three-year term); earlier Chief Technology Officer and Chief Delivery Officer
people.bio: Has more than 30 years of experience scaling technology practices and running global delivery for large enterprise clients. At Sonata he built the Microsoft Dynamics and Microsoft practices into industry offerings, led delivery across product engineering and enterprise systems, and drove the AI-first push including the Harmoni.AI platform. He was Senior Vice President and CTO as of March 2026, became Chief Delivery Officer from 1 April 2026, and was named CEO weeks later. He is not on the board.

people.name: P. Srikar Reddy
people.role: Executive Vice Chairman and Whole-time Director
people.since: With Sonata since 1986; CEO 2012–2022; reappointed whole-time director from 4 April 2026
people.stake: 30,10,431 shares, about 1.07% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: An engineering graduate of the Regional Engineering College (now NIT) Trichy with a postgraduate degree in management from IIM Calcutta. He has spent his whole career at Sonata since 1986 and was its CEO from 2012 to 2022, a period in which the company says revenue and profit multiplied and market value rose more than twentyfold. As Executive Vice Chairman he is now the only executive on the board, and signs the company's financial certifications with the CFO. He is also a non-executive director of Palred Technologies.

people.name: Jagannathan C N
people.role: Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Madras and a fellow chartered accountant and cost accountant, with more than two decades in finance. He was CFO of Carborundum Universal and of Mindtree, and earlier held finance roles at Bharti Airtel, HCL Technologies, Hindustan Powerplus and Ashok Leyland. His remit covers risk, tax, treasury, investor relations, internal audit and company secretarial work.

people.name: Sujit Mohanty
people.role: Managing Director & CEO, Sonata Information Technology Ltd (India business)
people.bio: Holds an MBA from XIM Bhubaneswar and has over 30 years in IT, almost all at Sonata, where he headed product marketing and product support before taking charge of the India business. He runs the Indian resale of Microsoft and cloud licences, about three-quarters of group revenue at thin margins. Before Sonata he worked at ACE in Hyderabad.

people.name: Suresh H P
people.since: COO since 1 April 2026 (earlier Executive Vice President and Chief Delivery Officer)
people.bio: Was Executive Vice President and Chief Delivery Officer during FY26 and took the new COO role from 1 April 2026, as part of the reshuffle that preceded the CEO change.

companies.changes: MD and CEO Samir Dhir did not seek renewal and left the board on 8 May 2026; Rajsekhar Datta Roy became CEO on 9 May 2026. From 1 Apr 2026 Suresh H P became COO and Manu Swami CTO. CHRO Balaji Kumar resigned in May 2025 and rejoined in Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Aditya Krishna is Chairman and MD and, directly and through Sak Industries, controls the company. His daughter Avantika Krishna joined the board as a whole-time director in May 2026, and his other daughter Kanika Krishna is a non-executive director. A hired COO-and-CFO, Niraj Kumar Ganeriwal, runs finance and operations. Promoters own 66.72%.

people.name: Aditya Krishna
people.since: Founder; on the board since 24 November 1999; reappointed CMD for April 2026–March 2031
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father of Whole-time Director Avantika Krishna and non-executive director Kanika Krishna
people.stake: 2,78,33,000 shares, 21.00% in his own name (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter company Sak Industries holds 45.72%; promoters together 66.72%
people.bio: The founder of Saksoft, with over three decades of leadership in banking, retail lending and technology services. Before Saksoft he built Nation-Wide Finance, a retail lending business, according to the company. He has chaired and run Saksoft since founding it, including its growth through bolt-on acquisitions. He is paid modestly for the size of his stake (about ₹6 million in FY26) and, as a promoter, receives no stock options.

people.name: Avantika Krishna
people.role: Whole-time Director and Chief Sales Officer
people.since: With Saksoft since February 2011; Chief Sales Officer since October 2021; whole-time director since 25 May 2026
people.relation: Daughter of Chairman & MD Aditya Krishna; sister of director Kanika Krishna
people.bio: Holds an MBA in marketing and management from Fordham Gabelli School of Business, New York, an MSc in human resource management from King's College London and a B.Sc. in economics from Stella Maris College, Chennai. She joined Saksoft as an HR executive in Chennai in 2011, worked in its New Jersey office in 2012–14, and was Key Account Director in the UK from 2014 to 2021. She became Chief Sales Officer in October 2021 and leads global sales. She is 38 and was paid about ₹10.5 million in her last year before joining the board.

people.name: Niraj Kumar Ganeriwal
people.role: Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: The company's senior hired executive, combining the COO and CFO roles, and a key managerial person alongside the CMD and company secretary. He signs the annual report's COO and CFO letter, which stresses cash generation, a net cash surplus and room for acquisitions. The annual report does not give his education or earlier employers.

companies.changes: Avantika Krishna joined the board as an additional whole-time director on 25 May 2026; non-executive director VVR Babu left the board around then. Venkatram Ramoo (head of emerging verticals) was named senior management on 25 May 2026. Aditya Krishna's reappointment as CMD for 2026–2031 was approved in Aug 2025.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of France's Expleo group, which owns 71.05% through Expleo Technology Germany GmbH. There is no Indian family promoter. The chairperson, Ralph Gillessen, is a non-executive director and an Expleo group executive; the Indian company is run by career Expleo managers led by MD and CEO Phani Tangirala. The annual report says no directors are related to each other.

people.name: Phani Tangirala
people.since: Joined Expleo 23 September 2010; MD and CEO since 1 August 2024
people.stake: 5,730 shares, about 0.04% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mathematics and statistics from Osmania University, Hyderabad, and has over 33 years of experience. He started at Life Insurance Corporation of India (1991–1998), was Chief Business Officer at Aetins Sdn Bhd in Malaysia (1998–2008) and Senior Director at SSP India (2008–2010). Since joining Expleo in 2010 he has been global head of the insurance vertical, head of digital and technology delivery, head of sales and COO, before becoming MD and CEO in August 2024 on a three-year agreement. He is the only executive on the board and retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Periakaruppan Palaniappan
people.bio: A chartered accountant with about 23 years in finance across business finance, planning and analysis, controllership, pricing, transformation projects and M&A. Before Expleo he was Head of Business Finance at Fractal Analytics, where he built the team that ran reporting, forecasting and budgeting for its global business. He replaced Desikan Narayanan, who resigned in November 2023.

people.name: Unnikrishnan Anilkumar
people.since: KMP since 14 November 2024 (then Head – Capabilities Delivery)
people.bio: Has over 23 years of experience running large delivery operations across multiple projects, including work within multinational joint ventures, according to the company. He was Head of Capabilities Delivery when he was named a key managerial person in November 2024 and is now Chief Operating Officer, responsible for delivery and operations.

companies.changes: Saket Newaskar (Director – Head of Transformation and Capabilities, a KMP) resigned effective 3 Jul 2026 and left on 31 Jul 2026. Rizwan Shaikhmohammed (Director – Sales, USA, a KMP) resigned in Aug 2026. Parent-group nominee Rajesh Krishnamurthy left the board on 12 Jan 2026. Senior Director Prasad Satkar retired Jul 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founder-run from Bhopal. Sukhbir Singh Kukreja is MD and his wife Shiney Sukhbir is a non-executive director; co-promoter Jogendrapal Singh Alagh is Whole-time Director, and Alagh's wife Supneet Kaur Alagh is in the promoter group. The two founding families are not related to each other. A CFO and company secretary were hired only in January 2025, ahead of the July 2026 IPO. Promoters owned 83.63% before the IPO and about 62.6% after it (all new shares).

people.name: Sukhbir Singh Kukreja
people.since: Director since 29 January 2002; board has approved a new five-year MD term from 29 January 2027
people.relation: Promoter; husband of non-executive director Shiney Sukhbir
people.stake: 1,65,07,790 shares: 42.16% before the IPO (RHP, July 2026), about 31.6% after it; with his wife, about 38.2% after the IPO
people.bio: Holds a B.Com, a postgraduate diploma in computer applications and a master's in computers and management, all from Barkatullah University, Bhopal, plus a network-engineering certificate from the MP Science & Technology Entrepreneurs Park at MANIT and Microsoft certifications. He began as an IT solutions analyst at the Information Technology Support Centre, Bhopal (2000–2002), and has run Xtranet since its start in 2002, focusing on technology sales, project management and government system-integration work. He is 50, with over 25 years in IT.

people.name: Jogendrapal Singh Alagh
people.since: Director since 26 June 2003; whole-time director since 23 July 2025
people.relation: Promoter; husband of promoter-group shareholder Supneet Kaur Alagh; not related to the Kukrejas
people.stake: 1,03,27,680 shares: 26.38% before the IPO (RHP, July 2026), about 19.8% after it; his wife holds about 4.6% after the IPO
people.bio: Holds a B.Com and a master's in computers and management from Barkatullah University, Bhopal, and a postgraduate diploma in computers from Makhanlal Chaturvedi University, Bhopal. He has over 20 years in IT and has been with Xtranet since 2003, working in IT sales, cloud solutions, customer retention and business development. He is 48.

people.name: Chetan Anand
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from Motilal Nehru College, Delhi University, and an MBA in finance from Symbiosis, Pune. He was Associate Vice President – Treasury at Continental Engines from 2005 to 2023 before joining Xtranet in January 2025 as its first full-time CFO in the run-up to the IPO. He was paid about ₹56 lakh in FY26.

people.name: Rajnish Gupta
people.bio: Holds a Master of Computer Applications from Madhya Pradesh Bhoj (Open) University and an MBA from Sikkim Manipal University. He was a consultant at Tata Consultancy Services from 2007 to 2025 before joining Xtranet in February 2026.

companies.changes: Jogendrapal Singh Alagh became Whole-time Director in Jul 2025; the independent directors joined in Jul–Aug 2025 ahead of the IPO. On 5 Sep 2026 the board approved Sukhbir Singh Kukreja's reappointment as MD for five years from 29 Jan 2027, subject to shareholder approval at the 30 Sep 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Founder Manjunatha Donthi Venkatarathnaiah is Chairman and MD. His elder son Suhas is Whole-time Director, President and CEO, and his younger son Sumanth is Chief Strategy and Business Development Officer. His wife Shubha, a co-promoter, is a non-executive director. Hired professionals run finance, sales, technology and manufacturing. The family owns 80.03% after the November 2025 IPO.

people.name: Manjunatha Donthi Venkatarathnaiah
people.relation: Founder; husband of director Shubha Manjunatha Donthi; father of CEO Suhas and strategy head Sumanth
people.stake: 38.46% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); family together 80.03%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from Bangalore University. He has been in the solar business since 1992. He co-founded family firm Emmvee Solar Systems in 1996 and then this company in 2007. He sets the company's strategy and is also a director of the main subsidiary Emmvee Energy and of family firms Emmvee Solar Systems and Emmvee Green Power. He licenses the Emmvee trademarks to the group. He won the Sourya Urja Bhushan award in 2015. He is 59.

people.name: Suhas Donthi Manjunatha
people.since: Board since March 2024; Whole-time Director, President & CEO since April 2025
people.relation: Elder son of the Chairman and of director Shubha Manjunatha Donthi; brother of Sumanth
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in business and engineering from Drexel University, Pennsylvania, USA. He has about seven years in renewable energy, all in the family business. He runs day-to-day operations in India and abroad, including Europe and the US, and leads strategy. He draws his pay from the wholly owned subsidiary Emmvee Energy, where he is also a whole-time director. He is 31.

people.name: Pawan Kumar Jain
people.bio: A chartered accountant (associate member of ICAI) with an executive MBA from Mohanlal Sukhadia University, Udaipur. He spent over 31 years with the Aditya Birla Group before joining Emmvee. He joined Emmvee as CFO in September 2024 and oversees finance and accounts; he took the company through its November 2025 IPO.

people.name: Sumanth Manjunatha Donthi
people.relation: Younger son of the Chairman and of director Shubha Manjunatha Donthi; brother of CEO Suhas
people.stake: 1.56% (1,07,74,776 shares, same holding as in the IPO prospectus)
people.bio: Holds an M.Sc. in management from University College London and a B.Sc. in business from the Kelley School of Business, Indiana University. He joined the company in April 2023, his first job, and runs business development and marketing. He is a named promoter. He is 25.

people.name: Rohit Dhar
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from Regional Engineering College, Srinagar, with a postgraduate diploma in marketing from Annamalai University. He has about 32 years in sales and marketing. Before Emmvee he worked at Vikram Solar, C&S Electric, Birla Power Solutions, Kirloskar Oil Engines and Larsen & Toubro. He runs sales.

people.name: T Srinath
people.bio: An engineering graduate from Bangalore University with an MBA from Monash University, Australia. He worked at family firm Emmvee Solar Systems from 2001 to 2010 before moving to this company. He runs technology, strategy and innovation for the company and its subsidiaries.

people.name: Dinesh B Shenoy
people.role: General Manager, Solar Cells Manufacturing; in charge as Chief Manufacturing Officer
people.bio: Holds a diploma in computer science and engineering from Karnataka's Department of Technical Education. He has about 35 years of work experience, over 17 of them in solar, with earlier stints at Waaree Energies, Indosolar and Phoenix Lamps. He runs cell production and quality, and took on the Chief Manufacturing Officer's duties when N Devendiran left in June 2026.

companies.changes: Chief Manufacturing Officer N Devendiran resigned effective 15 Jun 2026; Dinesh B Shenoy took charge. Company Secretary Shailesha Barve resigned on 30 Jun 2026; Murugesh C was appointed Company Secretary on 22 Sep 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Kuldeep Jain, an ex-McKinsey partner, is Chairperson and MD. Brookfield (via BGTF One Holdings) is a co-promoter with 21.3% and has two nominees on the board. Kuldeep's father Pratap Jain is a non-executive director. A team of long-serving hired professionals runs finance, the rooftop business, big projects and sales. Promoters together own about 49.5%; about 1.16 crore of Kuldeep's and his LLP's shares were pledged at March 2026 for a loan to the LLP.

people.name: Kuldeep Jain
people.relation: Founder; son of non-executive director Pratap Jain
people.stake: 8.24% directly, plus 11.10% through KEMPINC LLP, which he owns 99% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); Jain family about 19.8%; all promoters incl. Brookfield about 49.5%
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a postgraduate diploma in management from IIM Ahmedabad. He was a partner at McKinsey & Company before founding CleanMax in 2010, and has over 26 years in consulting and renewable energy. He built CleanMax into a supplier of solar and wind power to companies, with Brookfield as a partner, and listed it on the NSE and BSE in March 2026. He won the Economic Times 'Best Green Entrepreneur' award in 2018. He is a director of the IIM Ahmedabad Endowment Management Foundation. His and his LLP's shares are partly pledged to 360 One Prime for the LLP's borrowing.

people.name: Nikunj Ghodawat
people.bio: Holds a BBA from Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya, Indore, and a postgraduate diploma in business administration from ICFAI Business School. He has over 21 years in corporate finance and fund raising. Before CleanMax he was a partner at TBNG Financial Consultants and worked in investment banking at YES Bank and Adventity. He runs debt and equity raising, acquisitions, accounts and investor relations, and led the company's finances through the IPO.

people.name: Pramod Deore
people.bio: An electrical engineer from the University of Mumbai with a master's in marketing management and a Harvard Business School senior executive programme. He has over 23 years in business operations. He worked at Reliance Infrastructure and was COO of distributed solar at Mahindra Susten before joining. He runs the rooftop and on-site solar business in India and abroad, including sales, EPC execution and profit.

people.name: Amit Kumar Jain
people.bio: An electrical engineer from NIT Silchar with a diploma in international trade. He has over 19 years in operations. He was earlier deputy general manager at Mahindra Susten, and worked at Bharat Aluminium (BALCO) and Bharat Oman Refineries. He runs execution of the large off-site solar and wind farms, supply chain, and operations and maintenance.

people.name: Tejus AV
people.bio: An electrical and electronics engineer from Visvesvaraya Technological University, with postgraduate diplomas in business management (Symbiosis) and renewable energy (TERI University). He has over 21 years of experience, including at GE India Industrial and as senior VP-projects at WPA Clean Energy. He oversees project development from site selection to commissioning.

people.name: Pranjal Paul
people.since: Joined March 2016; CEO Carbon since July 2023
people.bio: Holds a dual B.Tech and M.Tech in civil engineering from IIT Madras. He has spent his whole career of about ten years at CleanMax. Since July 2023 he has run its carbon-credit business, which develops carbon projects and invests in carbon removal and avoidance projects.

people.name: Sweta Sajnani
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in computer applications and a postgraduate programme in HR management. She has over 20 years in human resources, including at Crompton Greaves and as senior manager-HR at JSW Energy. She runs hiring, pay, training and organisation design.

companies.changes: Vipin Balan was appointed Head - Projects (senior management) on 21 Sep 2026. No KMP resignations since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of Waaree Energies, which owns 74.32%. The Doshi family that controls Waaree runs it: MD Pujan Doshi is in the Waaree promoter group, and Waaree promoter Viren Doshi is a whole-time director. Two long-time Waaree group executives, Hitesh Mehta and Sunil Rathi, are also whole-time directors. The chairman, Nilesh Gandhi, is independent.

people.name: Pujan Doshi
people.since: Board since September 2016; MD re-appointed June 2025 to June 2030
people.relation: Member of the Doshi promoter group of parent Waaree Energies; the annual report names him a relative of whole-time director Viren Doshi
people.stake: nil directly (shareholding pattern, 30 Jun 2026); control sits with parent Waaree Energies at 74.32%
people.bio: An instrumentation engineer (BE) from Mumbai University. He has over a decade of experience in corporate strategy, business planning and international tie-ups, and leads the company's growth plans. He is also a director of several Waaree group firms, including Waaree Forever Energies, Waaree Energy Storage Solutions, Waaree Clean Energy Solutions and Waaree Green Data Centers. He was among the Doshi family members who sold their direct stakes in this company to Waaree Energies before its 2024 IPO.

people.name: Viren Doshi
people.since: Whole-time Director since August 2025; with the Waaree group since its start
people.relation: Named promoter of parent Waaree Energies (one of the four Doshi brothers behind Waaree); relative of MD Pujan Doshi
people.stake: none shown in his own name (shareholding pattern, 30 Jun 2026); parent Waaree Energies holds 74.32%
people.bio: Passed his higher secondary exams from the Maharashtra board. He has been with the Waaree group since its start and has over two decades in engineering. He oversees engineering, procurement and construction of solar projects across this company and its subsidiaries. He is also a whole-time director of parent Waaree Energies, where he has run the group's EPC work since 2007.

people.name: Hitesh Mehta
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Bombay and a chartered accountant (ICAI member). He has over three decades in engineering, solar and oil businesses, including as a director of Waaree Instruments. He has been a director in the Waaree group since 2011 and is also a whole-time director of parent Waaree Energies. Here he guides finance, governance and group-level work.

people.name: Sunil Rathi
people.since: Board since March 2023; Whole-time Director since August 2025
people.bio: An electronics engineer (BE) with an MBA in marketing from ITM, Mumbai. He has over three decades in sales and marketing, with past roles at Vikram Solar, Waaree Energies, Powernetics, Control Prints and Aplab. He brings sales and customer knowledge to the board. He is 55.

people.name: Manmohan Sharma
people.bio: A chartered accountant with 30 years in project finance, accounts, working capital, banking, budgeting, tax and financial modelling. He became CFO on 16 April 2025 and runs financial planning, controls and governance.

people.name: Ravikesh Singh
people.since: Named in FY26 annual report leadership team
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in electrical engineering and a postgraduate diploma in business management. He has over 25 years in power projects and leads EPC execution.

people.name: Mayur Mehta
people.since: Named in FY26 annual report leadership team
people.bio: A production engineer (BE) with a diploma in export-import management. He has over 28 years in supply chain across solar, building services, logistics and auto parts, with past roles at Blue Star, DHL and the ASTARC Group as well as within Waaree. He runs sourcing, procurement and logistics.

companies.changes: Kamlesh Harchandani, CEO of the new data-centre business, resigned effective 9 Jan 2026. No KMP changes since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Run by its three co-founders, who are not related to each other: Rupal Gupta (MD and CEO), Parveen Kumar (CTO and COO) and Anirudh Saraswat (Chief Business Officer). Each owns about 19.3%, together 57.97%. All other board members are independent. A small team of hired professionals handles finance and procurement.

people.name: Rupal Gupta
people.since: Co-founder (company set up 2013); MD since March 2023
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other directors
people.stake: 19.32% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); three founders together 57.97%
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech and has over 16 years in solar and related fields. Before Oriana he was business head of the solar division at Robotina, a Slovenian firm, and worked in Lanco Solar's technology and development team. His background includes instrumentation, weather monitoring and forecasting, and making electrical panels. He leads business development, techno-commercial strategy and overall operations, and signs off as the company's top executive.

people.name: Parveen Kumar (Jangra)
people.role: Whole-time Director, Chief Technology Officer & Chief Operating Officer
people.since: Co-founder; Whole-time Director since May 2025 (three-year term)
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other directors
people.bio: An electrical engineering graduate from Haryana. He began as a research associate at the government's Solar Energy Centre (now NISE), testing solar panel performance for the renewable energy ministry, and later worked in Lanco Solar's technology team. He has about 16 years in solar. He runs engineering and project execution, and has led the company's floating, hill-terrain and elevated solar projects.

people.name: Anirudh Saraswat
people.since: Board since April 2019; Whole-time Director since May 2025
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other directors
people.bio: A chemical engineering graduate from Panjab University (2008), with about 17 years in solar, manufacturing and new product development. He handles strategy, investor relations and fund raising,; in the FY26 annual report he set out the plan to add storage and green fuels to solar. He drew about ₹6.86 crore in pay in FY26, against an approved ceiling of ₹8 crore a year. He is 40.

people.name: Shivam Aggarwal
people.bio: A chartered accountant. Before joining as CFO in May 2023, shortly before the IPO, he was in practice as a chartered accountant, with about two years of experience at the time. He has held the CFO role since.

people.name: Amit Jain
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University, Raipur, with a postgraduate diploma in international business from IIFT, New Delhi. He has over 20 years in cement, metals and power, in senior commercial, sourcing and supply-chain roles at Dalmia Cement (Bharat), Vedanta and Talwandi Sabo Power. He was named President and a senior management person on 10 March 2026.

companies.changes: Amit Jain was designated President and senior management on 10 Mar 2026. No KMP resignations in 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Sehgal family business. Founder Ashwani Sehgal is President and MD; his wife Monica is a whole-time director and his brother Vipin runs the factory as executive director. Monica's son Aditya is CEO and her daughter Udaya is CFO; the company calls them the second generation. Promoters own 65.90%. The FY26 secretarial audit noted that pay to promoter-family executives was not first put to the audit committee; it was ratified in June 2026.

people.name: Ashwani Sehgal
people.relation: Founder; husband of Monica Sehgal; brother of Vipin Sehgal; Monica's children Aditya (CEO) and Udaya (CFO) are the second generation
people.stake: 21.89% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 65.90%
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from Punjab University. He began in 1986 at Punjab Tractors and after six years there founded Alpex in 1993, first as a trading house, then moving into wind and later solar panels and solar pumps. He has over 34 years of experience, 16 of them in solar. He was president of the Indian Solar Manufacturers Association (ISMA) for twelve years and is still on its board, where he has lobbied on the ALMM and domestic-content rules that shape the industry.

people.name: Monica Sehgal
people.relation: Wife of MD Ashwani Sehgal; mother of CEO Aditya and CFO Udaya
people.bio: Holds a master's in computer applications from Bhopal University. She began as a systems analyst setting up the IT department of the Chandigarh Housing Board. She has been with Alpex since it started and built its marketing, communications, administration and HR functions, and led the company-wide ERP rollout. She also oversees marketing at the affiliated firm Alpex Exim. She drew ₹1.84 crore in FY26. She is 58.

people.name: Vipin Sehgal
people.relation: Brother of MD Ashwani Sehgal
people.bio: A production engineer (B.Tech) with over 22 years in production and computer applications. He runs manufacturing, technology adoption and R&D, including the switch to TOPCon cells on the new cell line, and the plant's ERP systems.

people.name: Aditya Sehgal
people.relation: Son of Whole-time Director Monica Sehgal (wife of the MD); brother of CFO Udaya Sehgal
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in electrical engineering from the University of California. He started in US start-ups, working on electrical design for autonomous security robots, automated cashierless checkout systems and battery systems, and on managing contract manufacturers. He became CEO in July 2024 and runs daily operations and factory automation.

people.name: Udaya Sehgal
people.relation: Daughter of Whole-time Director Monica Sehgal (wife of the MD); sister of CEO Aditya Sehgal
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in business management from King's College London and an M.Sc. in strategic marketing from Imperial College London. She spent over six years as a product operations manager at ByteDance (TikTok's parent) and earlier was a senior marketing executive at HT Media. Her disclosed degrees are in business and marketing, not accounting. She replaced Amit Ghai as CFO on 4 June 2025.

people.name: Gaurav Bector
people.bio: An electrical engineer from Bangalore University with over 32 years in the energy sector. He worked at ABB, Siemens, Alstom T&D and Qlite on grid automation, smart energy systems and lighting, with the last 17 years in the Middle East and Africa. He runs the EPC business.

companies.changes: CFO Amit Ghai resigned on 3 Jun 2025; Udaya Sehgal took over on 4 Jun 2025. Non-executive director Satish Kumar Gupta resigned on 30 Sep 2025. No KMP changes filed since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Founder Sohan Lal Agarwal is Chairman and MD. His granddaughter Sanjana Khaitan is the only other executive director and was finance director and CFO until August 2025. A hired CFO and a long-serving technology chief run finance and the cell lines. Promoters own only 29.72%, and about 80% of their shares were pledged; the company said the pledge should fall to about 16% once a loan is refinanced.

people.name: Sohan Lal Agarwal
people.relation: Founder; grandfather of Executive Director Sanjana Khaitan
people.stake: 8.90% (3,86,32,080 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 29.72%
people.bio: Founded Websol in 1990 and has led it for over three decades, building one of India's first solar cell and module plants at Falta, West Bengal. His education is not disclosed in the company's filings. He is also a director of Websol's new subsidiary Websol Renewables, of Bright Earth Cell and of S L Industries. His pay jumped in FY26 because shareholders approved an annual commission; the average pay rise for managerial staff was 106% as a result.

people.name: Sanjana Khaitan
people.since: Board since 2022 (as Finance Director); Executive Director since November 2025 (three-year term)
people.relation: Granddaughter of the Chairman and MD
people.stake: nil (FY26 corporate governance report: no director other than the Chairman holds shares)
people.bio: A postgraduate in finance from the University of Cambridge, with experience in finance-led strategy, investment banking and global business operations. She joined the board in 2022 as Finance Director and also served as CFO until August 2025, handling bank relationships, strategic partnerships, financial controls and accounting processes. She briefly left the board in September 2025 and returned as Executive Director in November 2025. She chairs the board's CSR and risk committees and is a director of Websol Renewables and Bright Earth Cell.

people.name: Amrit Daga
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary with about 17 years in corporate finance, accounts and taxation. He became CFO on 11 August 2025, taking over from Sanjana Khaitan.

people.name: Vasanthi Sreeram
people.since: Named CTO in FY26 annual report; non-executive director until September 2025
people.bio: Has over 30 years in solar cell manufacturing. She sat on the board as a non-executive director until 1 September 2025 and now leads technology across the cell and module lines, including the second 600 MW cell line commissioned in FY26 and the planned move from PERC to TOPCon cells.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Raju Sharma resigned on 30 May 2026; Ashok Purohit is now Company Secretary. At the 22 Sep 2026 AGM non-executive director Rajeewa Arya retired, Sanjay Kumar joined as a non-executive director and Dinesh Agarwal (ex-EY partner) as an independent director.

companies.styleNote: Run by members of a Surat promoter group made up of several families (Shah, Patel, Rathi, Chandak, Patodia, Agrawal) that together own about 66%. Chairman and MD Chetan Shah, founder Kalpesh Patel and Piyush Chandak are the executive promoter directors; Piyush is related to non-executive promoter director Anil Rathi. Kiran Shah, the former CFO, is an executive director. The promoters signed an agreement among themselves on share transfers in April 2026.

people.name: Chetan Shah
people.since: Board since June 2021; CMD since August 2024; re-appointed for August 2027 to August 2030
people.relation: Promoter; not related to the other directors
people.stake: 6.83% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 66%
people.bio: An entrepreneur with over 30 years in business, first in information technology and then about 17 years in solar module making. He has led the company's expansion into gigawatt-scale module and cell plants and its Industry 4.0 upgrades. He has been president of the Southern Gujarat Chamber of Commerce and Industry and of the South Gujarat IT association, and sits on renewable-energy committees of MNRE, FICCI, ASSOCHAM and CII. His 'Dr.' title is an honorary doctorate from Kennedy International University, France; his academic degrees are not disclosed. He is 57.

people.name: Kalpesh Patel
people.since: Founded the company in October 2014; MD from July 2015; Whole-time Director since May 2025
people.relation: Founder and promoter; not related to the other directors
people.bio: A commerce and law (B.Com, LL.B) graduate with over 30 years in the solar industry. He founded Solex on 13 October 2014 and was its managing director before Chetan Shah took the top role. He now works on business strategy, policy and guiding the core team. He is 55.

people.name: Piyush Chandak
people.since: Board since June 2021; Whole-time Director since September 2024; re-appointed for September 2027 to August 2030
people.relation: Promoter; related to non-executive promoter director Anil Rathi (nature of relationship not disclosed)
people.bio: Holds a BBA from Christ University and an MBA from Auro University. He worked in textile processing and telecom before Solex. He drives operations and strategic projects, and was named among the '40 Under 40' young renewable energy leaders in 2024. He is 33, the youngest on the board.

people.name: Kiran Shah
people.since: Board since March 2021; CFO until August 2025
people.relation: Not named as a promoter; no relationship disclosed
people.bio: Has about 25 years in accounting and finance, covering day-to-day accounts, reconciliations, indirect taxes, TDS, GST, cash management and bank loans, plus administration. She was CFO until 4 August 2025 and stays on the board as the executive woman director. She is 46.

people.name: Hemal Kachiwala
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 14 years in finance, tax, treasury, budgeting, compliance and risk. He became CFO on 7 August 2025, succeeding Kiran Shah, and focuses on working capital and cost control. He is 38.

people.name: Brijesh Khanna
people.since: Named in FY26 annual report leadership team
people.bio: Has 31 years in service and manufacturing businesses, with experience in projects, marketing communications and quality assurance. He runs plant operations and process and cost improvement.

people.name: Vikash Anand
people.since: Named in FY26 annual report leadership team
people.bio: Has over 17 years in sales. He leads sales, negotiations and customer relationships, and the company credits him with much of its revenue growth.

companies.changes: No KMP changes since the annual report. In May 2026 the board approved re-appointing Chetan Shah as CMD (Aug 2027–Aug 2030) and Piyush Chandak as whole-time director (Sep 2027–Aug 2030), subject to shareholder approval.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by the Patel family, who are non-resident Indians based in Australia. Chairman and executive director Nikunjkumar Patel is the main promoter; his father Chimanbhai Patel is a non-executive director and Chimanbhai's wife Savitaben is also a promoter. Promoters own 72.62% (June 2026). Day-to-day production is run by whole-time director Dhaval Suthar, who is not family. The company buys from promoter-linked Abwatt Solar.

people.name: Nikunjkumar Chimanlal Patel
people.since: Chairman and Executive Director since August 2023
people.relation: Promoter; son of non-executive director and promoter Chimanbhai Patel, whose wife Savitaben is also a promoter
people.bio: Holds a Master of Engineering from the University of South Australia. He has over 10 years in the solar industry and lives in Australia, where he is a director of Sol Supply Pty Ltd, National Importer Pty Ltd and two family companies. He oversees the company's overall operations. He became chairman in August 2023, ahead of the SME IPO. He is 45.

people.name: Dhaval Jayeshkumar Suthar
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Hemchandracharya North Gujarat University with over eight years in the solar industry (as of 2023). He runs the production department at the Prantij, Gujarat plant. He held a small stake (727 shares) at the time of the IPO. He is about 43.

people.name: Kalpesh Virendra Vakharia
people.bio: A chartered accountant (ICAI member) with over ten years in accounting and audit at the time he joined. He was appointed CFO in August 2023, ahead of the IPO, and has held the role since.

companies.changes: No KMP changes filed in 2026. The Company Secretary is Hitesh Nagdev.

companies.styleNote: Gyanesh Chaudhary is Chairman and MD and controls the company through Vikram Capital Management, his family trust and his own shares, together 53.86% at March 2026. Hari Krishna Chaudhary is Chairman Emeritus (not on the board). Since March 2026 a hired CEO, Sameer Nagpal, runs operations, with long-time finance man K K Maskara as COO. No directors or executives are related to each other.

people.name: Gyanesh Chaudhary
people.since: Board since July 2008; CMD since March 2023; re-appointed from September 2026 for three years
people.relation: Promoter; sole managing trustee of the Gyanesh Chaudhary Family Trust; brother of Anil Chaudhary and son of Urmila Chaudhary (named relatives in the annual report)
people.stake: 2.84% directly, plus 20.17% via his family trust and 30.85% via Vikram Capital Management (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoters together 53.86%
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in business administration from the University of Wales, Cardiff, and completed Harvard Business School's Owner/President Management programme. He has over 25 years in the tea and solar businesses and was earlier a director of Vikram India Limited. He built Vikram Solar into one of India's larger module makers and listed it in August 2025. He sets strategy and oversees the company's overall growth.

people.name: Sameer Nagpal
people.since: CEO since March 2026; Whole-time Director since May 2026
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from Delhi College of Engineering (now DTU) with a postgraduate diploma in management from IIM Calcutta. He has over 30 years in business turnarounds and growth roles at Livguard Energy Technologies, the Dalmia Bharat Group, Shalimar Paints, Ingersoll Rand, Zicom and Carrier Air Conditioning. He took over as CEO from interim CEO K K Maskara on 20 March 2026 as the company pushes into cell making and energy storage.

people.name: Krishna Kumar Maskara
people.role: Whole-time Director, President - Corporate, COO & Chief Risk Officer
people.since: Board since January 2009; interim CEO Jan 2025–Mar 2026; COO since March 2026
people.bio: A chartered accountant (ICAI associate) with a diploma and postgraduate diploma in management from IGNOU. He was general manager-finance at Vikram India Limited before joining the board in 2009, and has over 21 years in finance and solar. He runs fund raising, tax, legal and corporate law work, served as interim CEO through the August 2025 IPO, and is now COO and chief risk officer.

people.name: Ranjan Kumar Jindal
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Calcutta and a chartered accountant (ICAI associate). He has over 19 years in finance, accounts, fund management and planning, with earlier roles at VISA Steel and Essar Oil and Gas Exploration and Production. He oversees financial planning, budgeting, treasury, risk and corporate finance.

people.name: Neha Agrawal
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary. She was a management trainee at Idea Cellular and a senior consultant at Ernst & Young before joining Vikram in 2014 in process management. She has over 15 years in consulting and solar and leads corporate strategy, international business planning and annual operating plans. She stepped off the board in May 2026 but remains a KMP.

people.name: Santosh Goyal
people.role: Senior Vice President & Head - Global Supply Chain
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Rajasthan University with a postgraduate business programme from Vishwakarma Institute of Management, Pune. He was an export officer at Vikram Greentech and a deputy manager at IndusInd Bank before joining in 2008. He runs procurement and supply chain.

people.name: Kunal Motwani
people.role: Executive Vice President - Enterprise Leadership & Communication
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Calcutta with a hospitality management diploma from William Angliss Institute, Australia. He has over 20 years in branding and marketing at Times Infotainment Media, Zee Entertainment and Viacom18, where he was director of regional entertainment. He was COO at the time of the IPO and now leads enterprise leadership and communications.

companies.changes: Interim CEO K K Maskara became COO and Sameer Nagpal CEO on 20 Mar 2026; Nagpal joined the board as whole-time director on 7 May 2026, when Neha Agrawal stepped off the board. HR head Arindam Chakraborty left on 31 Mar 2026 (Biresh Ranjan Das joined as SVP-HR) and manufacturing head Anil Bhadauria left on 31 May 2026. Gyanesh Chaudhary's re-appointment as CMD from 28 Sep 2026 was approved at the 4 Aug 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Run by its two unrelated co-promoters, Chairman Manish Gupta and MD Vikas Jain, who each own about 33% (together about 66%). Their wives Payal Gupta and Ekta Jain sit on the board as non-executive directors. In August 2026 the board re-appointed both for another five years from December 2026. A hired CFO and business head support them.

people.name: Manish Gupta
people.since: Board since October 2015; Chairman & Whole-time Director since December 2021; re-appointed for five years from 15 Dec 2026
people.relation: Promoter; husband of non-executive director Payal Gupta
people.stake: 33.06% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); two promoter families together about 66%
people.bio: A B.Tech in production engineering from North Maharashtra University, Jalgaon, and a first-generation entrepreneur with over 27 years in manufacturing, business strategy, projects and renewable energy. He is credited with building INA Solar, which calls itself Rajasthan's largest module maker, and handles supply chain and customer relationships. He is also joint MD of the main subsidiary Insolation Green Energy, where he draws ₹3 crore a year. He is founder president of the North India Module Manufacturers Association and holds posts at FICCI Rajasthan, CII and Rajasthan trade bodies. He is 49.

people.name: Vikas Jain
people.since: Promoter and MD; re-appointed for five years from December 2026
people.relation: Promoter; husband of non-executive director Ekta Jain; no other family link disclosed
people.bio: An engineering graduate from North Maharashtra University, Jalgaon, with over two decades running energy and industrial businesses. He earlier founded Fluidcon Engineers and Pink City Pipe Fittings, and has been an angel investor for about five years. He leads the company's restructuring, quality systems, technology upgrades and capacity expansion. He is vice president of JITO's Jaipur chapter. He is 49.

people.name: Ravi Dusad
people.bio: A chartered accountant with nearly two decades in manufacturing and services, with senior roles at Gravita India, TAB India Granites and ICICI Lombard General Insurance. He joined as CEO in September 2024, stepped down from that post in March 2025 and became CFO the next day. He is also CFO of the subsidiary Insolation Green Energy and runs financial planning and governance.

people.name: Abhishek Kaushal
people.since: Named in FY26 annual report leadership team
people.bio: Holds an MBA in oil and gas and has over 15 years in the energy sector across government, private and Chinese and Indian manufacturing firms. Most recently he was Director - South Asia at Chinese solar maker Anhui Huasun Energy. He leads business development, sales and market entry.

companies.changes: Independent director Pallavi Mishra resigned on 30 Jun 2026; Usha Sharma joined as an independent director on 28 Sep 2026. No KMP changes since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Garg brothers: Neelesh Garg is Chairman and MD and his brother Manik Garg is MD. Neelesh's wife Manavika is a non-executive director. A hired CEO, Prashant Mathur, runs operations. Promoters own 75.99% (June 2026). Finance has been unsettled: the CFO resigned in April 2026 and an interim CFO has run finance since.

people.name: Neelesh Garg
people.since: Board since November 2015; CMD since October 2024
people.relation: Promoter; brother of MD Manik Garg; husband of non-executive director Manavika Garg
people.bio: A B.Tech in computer science from IIT Delhi with a master's in management from the London School of Economics. A first-generation entrepreneur, he has over a decade in renewable energy and has led Saatvik's growth from a module maker into a wider clean-energy business. He sets long-term strategy, with a focus on manufacturing expansion, technology and backward integration.

people.name: Manik Garg
people.since: Board since January 2022; MD since October 2024
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Chairman and MD Neelesh Garg
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University, with an M.Sc. in finance from the London School of Economics. He works on growth strategy, finance, business expansion and new markets.

people.name: Prashant Mathur
people.since: CEO (KMP) as of FY26 annual report
people.bio: A renewable-energy professional with over 26 years in the industry. As CEO he led the expansion of module capacity from 1.2 GW to 4.8 GW, the integrated plant in Odisha and the move into EPC and power-plant ownership. His education is not disclosed in the annual report.

people.name: Rishabh Mehtta
people.bio: A chartered accountant and CFA charterholder with over ten years in finance, accounting and tax. He was earlier with audit firm C. B. Chhajed & Co., handling statutory and tax audits of listed firms, banks and insurers, worked as a virtual CFO, and was on the IPO team of Tara Jewels. He was made interim CFO on 23 April 2026 after CFO Abani Kant Jha resigned.

people.name: Pushpendra Nath Samadhiya
people.since: Named in FY26 annual report leadership team
people.bio: Has over 17 years in solar module sales, business development and key accounts. He leads sales and business development.

people.name: Manik Paul
people.since: Named in FY26 annual report leadership team
people.bio: Has over three decades in IT, digital transformation and automation, with leadership roles at Vikram Solar, Century Plyboards, Thriveni Earth Movers, Orica Mining Services and ICI India. He runs IT and cybersecurity.

companies.changes: CFO Abani Kant Jha resigned effective 7 Apr 2026; Rishabh Mehtta became interim CFO on 23 Apr 2026. CHRO Aman Attree resigned on 8 Apr 2026. COO Vaibhav Bhardwaj moved to subsidiary Saatvik Solar Industries from 30 Apr 2026. Company Secretary Bhagya Hasija left in Feb 2026; Jyoti Verma was appointed on 23 Apr 2026.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by the Aggarwal family of the BLS group. Chairman Diwakar Aggarwal became an executive director again in August 2025, and his son Shikhar Aggarwal is Joint MD (reappointed to 2030). Chartered accountant Nikhil Gupta, not family, is MD. Shikhar's cousin Karan Aggarwal moved to a non-executive role in May 2025. Promoters own about 70.4% through family members and a dozen group investment companies, with no pledge.

people.name: Diwakar Aggarwal
people.since: With the BLS group since 1983; executive director again from August 2025
people.relation: Promoter; father of Joint MD Shikhar Aggarwal; uncle of director Karan Aggarwal
people.stake: 5.76% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 70.4%
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Delhi. He has been with the BLS group since 1983 and helped turn it into a diversified group spanning government services, education, petrochemicals, plastics and infrastructure. He led the creation of BLS International, which grew into one of the world's top three visa outsourcing firms. He was a non-executive chairman until August 2025, when he became an executive director on a salary of up to ₹30 lakh a month plus commission.

people.name: Nikhil Gupta
people.bio: Holds an honours degree in economics from the University of Delhi and is a chartered accountant. He has about 44 years in audit, consulting, finance and business leadership. He worked at PricewaterhouseCoopers, Novartis India, Raychem RPG and RPG Cables, and was MD and CEO of a manufacturing company for over a decade, where he led a turnaround. He joined BLS as MD in February 2020.

people.name: Shikhar Aggarwal
people.since: Joint MD since June 2016; reappointed for three years from June 2027
people.relation: Son of Chairman Diwakar Aggarwal; cousin of Karan Aggarwal
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Delhi, aged 35. He has been Joint MD since June 2016 and oversees all business verticals, leading BLS's expansion to more than 100 countries and its acquisitions. He was on the Times 40 Under 40 list and received an ET Global Indian Leaders award in 2022. He was paid ₹1.2cr in salary plus ₹1.5cr commission in FY26, and his next term from June 2027 carries ₹20 lakh a month.

people.name: Amit Sudhakar
people.bio: A chartered accountant with about 36 years of experience. He joined BLS in May 2019 as CFO. He frames the company's visa growth guidance on the earnings calls. The annual report gives no earlier employers.

people.name: Charu Khosla
people.bio: Holds a PGDM and has about 24 years of experience, all of it at BLS since joining in May 2002. Runs the government and institutional business in strategic markets and was the company's highest-paid employee in FY26, at about ₹2.5cr.

people.name: Gaurav Aggarwal
people.relation: Member of the promoter group; the company says he is not related to any director
people.bio: Has over 12 years of experience managing global projects and international relations at BLS. He has helped expand the international business and specialises in government outsourcing, support for diplomatic missions, and visa and consular services. He was named President – Business Development and senior management in May 2026.

companies.changes: CHRO Ajit Hugh Dias, hired in November 2025, resigned from 5 June 2026. Gaurav Aggarwal was named President – Business Development in May 2026. Manoj Joshi joined as an independent director in August 2026. No change in the MD, Joint MD or CFO.

companies.styleNote: ixigo has no promoter group; it is run by its two co-founders, both IIT Kanpur graduates: Aloke Bajpai (Chairman, MD & Group CEO) and Rajnish Kumar (Group Co-CEO), who own about 4.3% and 4.6%. The largest holders are financial investors: MIH Investments (16.2%), Gamnat (8.3%) and Peak XV (6.0%). No directors are related to each other.

people.name: Aloke Bajpai
people.since: Co-founder; on the board since June 2006
people.relation: Co-founder; not related to other directors
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in electrical engineering from IIT Kanpur and an MBA from INSEAD. He worked at Amadeus in France as a software development engineer and later a systems and network engineer. He co-founded ixigo in 2006 and runs the company overall. He is a charter member of TiE and on the governing council of IAMAI, and received IIT Kanpur's Distinguished Alumnus Award in 2022.

people.name: Rajnish Kumar
people.since: Co-founder; on the board since April 2010
people.relation: Co-founder; not related to other directors
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in computer science from IIT Kanpur and worked as a software development engineer at Amadeus in France. He co-founded ixigo and leads product, technology, marketing, research and AI work, and he built the ixigo-trains app. The board lists him as a non-executive director even though he is Group Co-CEO. He received IIT Kanpur's Distinguished Alumnus Award in 2023.

people.name: Saurabh Devendra Singh
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from IIT Delhi and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad. Before ixigo he was Chief Business Officer, India, for the research services division of Sanford C. Bernstein. He handles finance, investor relations and strategic planning.

people.name: Dinesh Kumar Kotha
people.since: Co-founded ConfirmTkt (service counted from June 2015); CEO of the trains business since January 2024
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech (Hons) in electronics and communication from NIT Jamshedpur and worked at o9 Solutions before starting ConfirmTkt, which ixigo bought and later merged into itself. He runs the trains business, including business development and hiring.

people.name: Sripad Vaidya
people.since: Co-founded ConfirmTkt (service counted from June 2015); COO since January 2024
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in computer science from SASTRA University, Thanjavur. He co-founded ConfirmTkt with Dinesh Kumar Kotha and now runs day-to-day operations, support and finance for the trains business, and new revenue lines.

people.name: Lenin Koduru
people.bio: Holds an engineering degree in electronics and instrumentation from Bharathiar University. He worked at Impulse Systems, Unisoft (India), Inatech InfoSolutions and Buzznet in Malaysia before joining ixigo in August 2021. He leads technology and growth for the bus business, which grew bookings 39% in the latest quarter.

people.name: Nitin Gurha
people.role: Senior Vice President – Business (flights and hotels)
people.bio: Holds a BSc from the University of Delhi and a PGDBM from the Northern Institute for Integrated Learning in Management. He worked at Amadeus India, Kale Consultants and Yatra Online (as vice president). He was at ixigo from 2008 to 2015 and rejoined in 2020 to run the flights and hotels businesses and partnerships.

companies.changes: No changes in directors, KMP or senior management in FY26 or since the annual report. Key managers were paid ₹42cr in FY26, mostly in shares.

companies.styleNote: The promoter is Yatra's own Nasdaq-listed parent, Yatra Online Inc., which holds 62.65% through THCL Travel Holding Cyprus and Asia Consolidated DMC and is being merged with the Indian company. Co-founder Dhruv Shringi is Executive Chairperson and whole-time director, and a hired CEO, Siddhartha Gupta (ex-Mercer India), has run the business since November 2025. There is no family control, and no directors are related to each other.

people.name: Dhruv Shringi
people.relation: Co-founder; not related to other directors
people.bio: A chartered accountant with an MBA from INSEAD. Before founding Yatra he worked at Ford Motor Company, Arthur Andersen and ebookers. He co-founded Yatra; since a hired CEO joined in November 2025 he has been Executive Chairperson and the company's only executive director.

people.name: Siddhartha Gupta
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate diploma in business management from Xavier Institute of Management. He was previously President of Mercer India and CEO of Mercer Mettl. He joined Yatra as CEO on 25 November 2025.

people.name: Manish Amin
people.role: Co-founder, Chief Information and Technology Officer
people.bio: Holds a General Certificate in Business Studies from the UK's Business Technician Education Council. Before Yatra he worked at ebookers and Flightbookers. He co-founded Yatra and leads its technology.

people.name: Sabina Chopra
people.role: Co-founder, COO – Corporate Travel & Head Industry Relations
people.bio: Has over 32 years in travel and hospitality. Before joining Yatra she headed the India operations of ebookers. She runs the corporate travel business and its relationships with airlines and hotels.

people.name: Anuj Kumar Sethi
people.since: April 2025 (interim at first); with Yatra over a decade
people.bio: A cost accountant with more than 25 years in the travel industry. He spent over a decade in senior finance and accounts roles at Yatra before becoming CFO in April 2025, when Group CFO Rohan Mittal left.

companies.changes: Group CFO Rohan Mittal resigned in April 2025; Anuj Kumar Sethi took over. Siddhartha Gupta joined as CEO in November 2025. Company Secretary Darpan Batra left in September 2025; Jyoti Chawla replaced him in December 2025. Roshan Mendis joined the board as a non-executive director in September 2025. No executive changes since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by Canada's Fairfax Financial (Prem Watsa) through Fairbridge Capital, which owns 64.8%. Fairfax is represented only by non-executive directors such as Sumit Maheshwari. The company is run by long-serving insider Mahesh Iyer as MD & CEO, the only executive director. Long-time Executive Chairman Madhavan Menon retired in May 2025 and left the board in September 2025 with a ₹17.1cr ex-gratia payment; G. Soundarajan has been non-executive Chairman since November 2025. No directors are related to each other.

people.name: Mahesh Iyer
people.since: With the company for over 30 years; MD & CEO, term to July 2028
people.bio: Has spent more than three decades at Thomas Cook India, working up through roles as Head of Foreign Exchange, Chief Operating Officer, CEO and Executive Director before becoming MD & CEO. Since Madhavan Menon retired in 2025 he has overseen operations across the whole group, including SOTC, Sterling Holiday Resorts and the overseas destination businesses. His pay was restructured from April 2025 to reflect this wider role. The annual report does not give his education.

people.name: Debasis Nandy
people.bio: President and Group CFO, overseeing finance across the Thomas Cook India group, and a member of the board's banking committee. He is named as senior management in the FY26 annual report, which does not give his background.

people.name: Brijesh Modi
people.bio: The company's statutory CFO and key managerial person, who signs the accounts with the MD, and a member of the board's banking committee. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

people.name: Deepesh Varma
people.since: Joined March 2013; in this role from April 2026
people.bio: A hotel management graduate (1999) who completed a senior management programme at IIM Calcutta in 2010. Before Thomas Cook he was a business improvement consultant at British Telecom (2011–2013), ran operations at WNS (2004–2011), trained sales staff at ebookers and worked at Hotel Le Meridien. He joined in 2013 as head of business process and moved to the foreign-exchange business in 2018, which he now leads.

people.name: Deepti Sheth
people.since: Joined November 2014; in this role from April 2026
people.bio: Holds a commerce degree from Narsee Monjee College (2004) and a postgraduate qualification in HR (2006). She worked at Edelweiss Financial Services, ASK Investment Holdings and Avenues India before joining Thomas Cook in 2014. She was HR head at SOTC Travel from 2019 and took over group HR in April 2026 when Mona Cheriyan retired.

companies.changes: Chairman Madhavan Menon retired as executive in May 2025 and resigned from the board in September 2025; G. Soundarajan became non-executive Chairman in November 2025. HR head Mona Cheriyan retired in March 2026 (replaced by Deepti Sheth), and Deepesh Varma took over foreign exchange from April 2026. Fairfax nominee Chandran Ratnaswami left the board on 10 September 2026.

companies.styleNote: The Kanwar family controls it with about 37% of the shares, mostly through Sunrays Properties (31.85%). The founder's son Neeraj Kanwar runs it as Vice Chairman & MD. His father Onkar Kanwar is Chairman but sits as a non-executive promoter director. Sunam Sarkar, named on the website as President & COO, sits on the board as a non-executive director. The rest of the top team are hired professionals, several from Michelin, Pirelli and FMCG firms.

people.name: Neeraj Kanwar
people.since: Board since 1998; Joint MD 2006, Vice Chairman 2008, MD 2009
people.relation: Son of Chairman Onkar Kanwar
people.stake: 0.11% (671,380 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 36.93%
people.bio: An engineering graduate from Lehigh University in Pennsylvania, USA. He started at Apollo as Manager, Product & Strategic Planning, joined the board in 1998 as Chief, Manufacturing and Strategic Planning, and became Chief Operating Officer in 2002. He was made Joint MD in 2006, Vice Chairman in 2008 and MD in 2009. The company credits him with taking Apollo from about US$450 million to US$3 billion in sales through the Dunlop South Africa deal, the 2009 purchase of Vredestein in the Netherlands and the Hungary greenfield plant. He was recently Chairman of the Automotive Tyre Manufacturers' Association and sits on the boards of group firms PTL Enterprises and Artemis Medicare. He was paid about ₹78cr in FY26, mostly commission, and also drew pay from the UK subsidiary.

people.name: Gaurav Kumar
people.role: Chief Financial Officer until 6 October 2026 (left; no successor named)
people.since: Joined 2004; CFO since May 2015; Whole-time Director June 2024 to August 2026
people.stake: Not disclosed in the FY26 annual report; granted 267,948 stock options in FY26
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from IIT Delhi with an MBA in finance from the Faculty of Management Studies, Delhi University. He started as a management trainee at UB Group in 1993 and also worked at SRF and HCL Technologies. He joined Apollo in 2004 as Head, Corporate Strategy, joined the management board in 2010 and became CFO in 2015. He worked on the South Africa entry, the Vredestein purchase and the Hungary plant, and runs global finance, tax and investor relations. He resigned from the board on 6 August 2026 to pursue outside opportunities and stays as CFO only until a successor takes over.

people.name: Rajeev Kumar Sinha
people.role: Whole-time Director and Chief Manufacturing & Sustainability Officer
people.since: Joined April 2025; Whole-time Director from 13 August 2026
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from IIT Kanpur with more than 36 years of experience. Before Apollo he was Global Chief of Manufacturing Operations at Cipla, and earlier Executive Vice President and Global Head of formulations operations and manufacturing at Glenmark. He also held senior operations and productivity roles at PepsiCo and worked at Cadbury. He joined Apollo in April 2025 as Chief Manufacturing Officer and now runs global manufacturing and sustainability, including plant management, industrial engineering and AI/ML-based manufacturing systems. He joined the board on 13 August 2026 for five years, subject to shareholder approval.

people.name: Benoit Rivallant
people.since: Joined 2014; President Europe from October 2018; now CCO
people.bio: A mechanical engineer who also holds a BA in business from Montpellier University, France. He spent most of his career at Michelin, where his last role was Vice President, Asia, for earthmover and industrial tyres, based in Shanghai; he also ran the China and Hong Kong truck and bus tyre business. He joined Apollo in 2014 as Group Head, Global Product Management (commercial vehicle and off-highway tyres) and led the launch of Apollo's truck tyres in Europe. He became President of European operations and CEO of Apollo Vredestein in 2018. As CCO he runs sales and marketing across regions and sits on the Executive Committee.

people.name: Daniele Lorenzetti
people.bio: Runs Apollo's global research and development for car and truck tyres and holds several tyre-related patents. Before Apollo he spent close to 20 years at Pirelli, ending as Product Director of the industrial division, in charge of product, materials and process development for truck, farm and special-vehicle tyres. He was also Vice President, R&D (agro, forestry and industrial tyres) at Trelleborg Wheel Systems.

people.name: Parmeshwaran Iyer
people.since: Listed as senior management in March 2026
people.bio: Leads Apollo's global supply chain. He has over 30 years of experience in FMCG, healthcare, oil and white goods, covering planning, procurement, logistics and customer management. He came from Beiersdorf AG, where he worked in Germany, the UAE, Russia and India, and his last role there was Global Vice President, Digital Supply Chain.

people.name: Mahalakshmi Ramaswami
people.bio: Has more than two decades of HR leadership in FMCG, telecom, pharmaceuticals and consulting. Before Apollo she was Head of HR for the Southeast Asia cluster at Mondelez International, and earlier HR Director for Mondelez India, where she worked on a business turnaround. She runs Apollo's global people strategy.

companies.changes: CFO Gaurav Kumar, who left the board on 6 August 2026, resigned as CFO from the close of business on 6 October 2026 'to pursue new personal and professional challenges'; no successor has been named. Rajeev Kumar Sinha joined the board as a Whole-time Director on 13 August 2026. Chief Quality & Safety Officer Yoichi Sato retired in June 2026. Independent director Berjis Desai resigned in April 2026.

companies.styleNote: Part of Harsh Goenka's RPG Group; the promoter group owns 47.29%, mostly through Instant Holdings (29.51%) and Swallow Associates (11.09%). Harsh Goenka is non-executive Chairman and his son Anant Goenka is non-executive Vice Chairman (they hold 0.33% and 0.04% directly).
